location: Berlin Office, Bosnia, Romania, Norway, Estonia, Latvia, Slovenia, Italy, Netherlands, Hungary, Portugal, France, Poland, Serbia, Germany, Austria, Finland, Albania, Lithuania, Slovakia, Ireland, Bulgaria, Denmark, Belgium, Czech Republic, United Kingdom, Croatia, Spain, Greece
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.
n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders
 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects
 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation
That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.
We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
Your main goal will be to empower n8n enterprise users to treat automation as software, enabling them to develop, deploy, and scale mission-critical workflows with absolute confidence.
To do so, you’ll own product strategy and execution for n8n’s Enterprise team, focused on application lifecycle management, developer tools, and production-grade workflow operations:
WORKFLOW LIFECYCLE MANAGEMENT
 - Define how teams move workflows from development to production with clear environment separation and promotion paths.
 - Shape capabilities for workflow version history, rollback, branching, and conflict resolution.
 - Build product experiences that help engineering teams safely manage changes across mission-critical automations.
ENTERPRISE DEVELOPER EXPERIENCE
 - Own Git-based source control workflows that make n8n fit naturally into modern software development practices.
 - Work closely with Engineering and Design to deliver powerful yet intuitive tools for technical teams.
 - Translate complex developer workflows into product experiences that feel reliable, scalable, and easy to adopt.
PRODUCTION OPERATIONS AND OBSERVABILITY
 - Build visibility into workflow performance, usage, and reliability across environments and instances.
 - Define how enterprise teams manage external secrets, variables, and configuration across deployments.
 - Help customers operate n8n at scale through multi-instance management and cross-instance visibility.
PRODUCT DISCOVERY AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP
 - Deeply engage with enterprise customers, engineering leaders, admins, and developers to understand their software delivery needs.
 - Prioritize ruthlessly across technical depth, usability, enterprise readiness, and long-term platform leverage.
 - Align Engineering, Design, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and leadership through clear strategy, specs, and communication.
REQUIREMENTS
MUST-HAVES
 - Proven product management experience: You’ve shipped complex technical products in enterprise environments and can point to lessons learned that shaped your craft.
 - Strong developer empathy: You understand how engineering teams build, test, version, deploy, and operate software in production.
 - Thrive in ambiguity: You bring structure to fuzzy technical problems and prioritize clearly across many possible directions.
 - Exceptional product sense: You anticipate edge cases, second-order effects, and enterprise-grade reliability needs without needing perfect information.
 - Ownership and bias for action: You fix what’s broken, ship, learn, and iterate rather than over-plan.
 - Influence without authority: You align engineering, design, data, sales, solutions engineering, customer success, and docs through clarity and trust.
 - Technical product judgment: You’re comfortable making tradeoffs across usability, scalability, security, reliability, and implementation complexity.
NICE-TO-HAVES
 - Git and source control experience: You’ve worked on or closely with products involving Git, branching, versioning, pull requests, or conflict resolution.
 - Enterprise security experience: You understand secrets management, environment variables, access control, or secure configuration patterns.
 - Observability experience: You’ve worked on products involving monitoring, usage insights, performance visibility, or operational dashboards.
 - Coding or SQL skills: You can code, write SQL, or go deep enough technically to partner effectively with engineers on architecture-level discussions.
 - Remote work experience: You’re familiar with remote-first work environments and can collaborate effectively across time zones.
 - Entrepreneurial or early-stage experience: You’ve worn many hats and can navigate in many areas at once.
Why join us?
At n8n, your work won’t disappear into a slide deck. You’ll shape how engineering teams build, version, deploy, and operate mission-critical automations at scale — turning n8n into the platform where automation is treated with the same rigor as software. You’ll join a fast-growing, remote-first team with high autonomy, strong technical ambition, and direct visibility into enterprise customer impact.
Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?
Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

Your main goal will be to make n8n's Core Platform ready for the company's next stage of growth: more scalable, reliable, secure, and flexible as customer usage and technical complexity increase. You'll own the foundations that everything else, including our AI and agent capabilities, is built on.
To do so, here are your responsibilities:
OWN THE CORE PLATFORM STRATEGY & ROADMAP
 - Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for the Core Platform in partnership with Engineering and Product leadership.
 - Prioritize foundational investments based on customer impact, enterprise needs, technical risk, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs between near-term customer needs, technical debt, and long-term architecture explicit.

SCALABILITY, RELIABILITY & EXECUTION ENGINE
 - Drive work on the scalability and reliability of n8n's execution engine, including areas like worker pools and distributed execution.
 - Improve the reliability of triggers and execution behaviour across complex deployment setups, from multi-main Cloud environments to self-hosted enterprise installations.
 - Shape a more secure and flexible approach to executing code within n8n.

Must-haves

 - Enterprise platform reality: You understand what running software in customer-controlled environments means, including self-hosted, air-gapped, and restricted deployments
Nice-to-haves
 - Hands-on ability: You can read code or prototype, even if you're not shipping it.

 - Domain familiarity: You know workflow automation, orchestration, or open-source / developer-community products.

title: Senior Program Manager, Product & GTM Programs
description:
About Parloa 
 Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience — one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com , HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale. 
 About the role: 
 As Senior Program Manager, Product & GTM Programs, you run program management between our GTM organization and Product & Engineering. 
 You are the connection point between both sides. You bring them together early on upcoming changes, align on what those changes mean for customers & partners, and determine what support customers need and which internal teams have to be prepared. From there, you own the path to our customers and partners.
 Where a change is large enough to become a program in its own right, you own that program end to end. Other teams own their functional deliverables; you own the plan, the sequence, the cadence, the deadline, and the outcome. These programs carry hard cutoffs and significant revenue.
 This is a cross-functional program management role at its core: a lot of coordination, judgment, and real accountability for the outcome. There's no playbook waiting for you — building it is part of the job.
 Areas of ownership: 
 GTM to Product & Engineering Interface: Serve as the connection point for upcoming customer-impacting changes, bringing both sides together early to align on how customers and partners are affected and what they need to do. You determine which internal teams have to be enabled, from Engagement Managers and Sales to Solution Engineering, Partnerships, and Product Marketing.
 Program Orchestration: Act as the single coordination point across Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Product Marketing, Partnerships, Operations, and Engagement Managers. You steer cross-functional kickoffs, run the cadence that keeps programs moving, and hold functional owners to their commitments, including when that means escalating or re-sequencing.
 Communication Sequencing: Design the plans for customer and partner communication so they experience one coordinated channel instead of several, and collect early customer and field feedback before it becomes an escalation.
 Execution and Accountability: Track progress against plan, enforce deadlines, own escalation management end to end, and report to senior leadership in a way that makes risk visible early rather than defensible late.
 Building the Discipline: Define and measure success metrics for each program, run retrospectives that produce process change rather than documents, and build the playbooks, SOPs, and governance cadence that make this function durable.
 Who you are: 
 5-7+ years in program or project management, owning complex cross-functional programs end to end — not workstreams inside someone else's program
 You've worked as the connective tissue between technical and commercial teams, translating in both directions
 Technically fluent in enterprise software platforms: you can assess what a change means for customers without Engineering explaining it each time
 You operate without formal authority — you've held teams to deadlines you don't own, and you're comfortable making the call
 You build the system, not just the tracker; you've created or fixed a process that outlived your tenure
 Energized rather than paralyzed by ambiguity; you build the playbook while running the plays
 An exceptionally strong writer, equally at home in technical detail and executive narrative
 Our recruiting process: 
 Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser
 Why Parloa? 
 We’re at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn’t just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We’re building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren’t just support tickets; they’re defining experiences. We’re here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale—and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments—this is where you do it.
 At Parloa, ownership isn’t a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that’s evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.
 We’ve grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we’ve kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.
 Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we’re scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.
  
 Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.
 Parloa is an e-verify employer in the USA. Please click here to learn more .
 * We provide equal opportunities to all qualified applicants regardless race, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, national origin, disability status, socioeconomic background and other characteristics.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
About Parloa 
 Parloa’s mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience — one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com , HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale. 
  
 About the role: 
 How do you deliver an AI platform capability that spans multiple engineering teams and an enterprise customer’s go-live date - without compromising quality, reliability or security?
 This is the challenge you’ll solve as a Senior Technical Program Manager at Parloa. We’re looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead one of Parloa’s most strategic cross-organizational programs from definition through launch.
 Parloa is building an enterprise AI platform powering Fortune 2000 companies with conversational AI. Our Agent Management Platform (AMP) is trusted by global organizations including Booking.com, Allianz and American Express. As we scale rapidly, we’re building an engineering organization optimized for speed, quality and innovation.
 This role is about delivering outcomes, not coordinating activity.
 You will be accountable for one of the company’s highest-impact programs, bringing together multiple engineering teams and cross-functional partners to deliver a critical business outcome. You will own the integrated execution plan, dependency management, launch readiness, executive communication and decision-making mechanisms that determine whether the program succeeds.
 When the program is at risk, you’re expected to know first, understand why, and arrive with well-reasoned options - not just status updates.
 This is not a delivery coordination or Scrum facilitation role. Product defines what we build. Engineering owns how we build it. You ensure we successfully deliver across organizational boundaries.
 Enterprise customers expect reliability, security and operational excellence - not just feature delivery. You will establish a clear readiness bar for your program, ensure delivery trade-offs are explicit and well understood, and help leaders make informed decisions before deadlines force implicit ones.
 Although you won’t write production code, this is a highly technical role. You should be comfortable discussing architecture, rollout strategies, system dependencies, and reliability risks with senior engineers, and be able to challenge assumptions when delivery plans don’t align with technical complexity.
 The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity and has successfully delivered complex technical programs across teams they did not directly manage. You are an exceptional written communicator who can simplify ambiguity for executives while earning credibility with engineers. Experience building AI products is valuable, but curiosity, learning velocity and sound engineering judgment matter more than prior domain expertise.
  
 Areas of ownership: 
 Serve as the accountable leader for one strategic cross-organizational program, or two closely related programs, with clear business impact.
 Build and maintain the integrated execution plan, including milestones, critical path, dependencies and cross-team commitments.
 Drive end-to-end risk management by identifying leading indicators, removing blockers, tracking mitigations and escalating only when executive decisions are required.
 Define and continuously raise the quality bar for your program by establishing objective launch criteria across functionality, reliability, security and operational readiness.
 Lead release readiness across Engineering, Product, Platform, Security, Legal and Commercial teams, ensuring launches are based on measurable readiness rather than feature completion alone.
 Make delivery trade-offs explicit. Where timelines require compromises, ensure decisions are documented, owned by the appropriate stakeholders and supported by clear mitigation plans.
 Drive executive decision-making through concise written narratives, data and clear recommendations, replacing fragmented status reporting with a trusted source of truth.
 Define and monitor delivery metrics that enable objective decisions around scope, schedule, quality and execution risk.
 Build lightweight mechanisms that improve planning, dependency management and execution across teams, leaving the organization stronger after the program completes.
 Influence technical and organizational decisions without direct authority, aligning engineering, product and business stakeholders around shared outcomes.
 Who you are: 
 7+ years of Technical Program Management experience, or equivalent experience leading large-scale technical programs with software engineering teams.
 Proven experience delivering complex cross-functional programs from definition through launch across organizations you did not directly manage.
 Experience leading release readiness for production systems, including defining objective launch criteria and driving launch decisions.
 Strong track record of identifying delivery risk early, driving mitigation plans and making effective escalation decisions.
 Sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with senior engineers on architecture, rollout strategies, system dependencies and engineering trade-offs.
 Experience defining program metrics and using data to guide execution and executive decision-making.
 Exceptional written communication skills. You can distill a complex technical situation into a clear one-page narrative for senior leadership.

 Experience delivering AI, machine learning or LLM-powered products at scale, ideally in a high-growth engineering organization.

It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.
 About the role:
 As  Technical Project Manager , you will own the end-to-end delivery of high complexity Agentic AI deployments for enterprise customers, running your pod (TPM, Forward Deployed Engineer, Agent Architect) as a single accountable delivery unit from scoping through go-live and hypercare.
 This is your opportunity to sit at the center of how global enterprise brands adopt Agentic AI, translating technical complexity into business outcomes for executive stakeholders at companies like Booking.com, SAP, and Allianz.
 Areas of ownership:
 Project Delivery: Own scope, schedule, budget, risk, and quality for assigned Agentic AI customer projects, selecting the right delivery methodology (Waterfall, Agile, or Hybrid) for each customer context.
 Customer & Stakeholder Management: Act as the primary delivery contact for customer sponsors, IT, and business stakeholders, running governance calls, steering committees, UAT readouts, and go-live reviews.
 Cross-Functional & Pod Coordination: Align Forward Deployed Engineers on integration readiness and Agent Architects on discovery and conversational design, while coordinating with Sales, Solution Engineering, Product, and Support across the customer journey.
 Methodology & Process Discipline: Facilitate sprints and retros or lead stage-gate reviews depending on methodology, and enforce documentation standards across charters, design docs, runbooks, and handovers.

 We are looking for a Product Manager to own the product vision and roadmap for the Command & Control (C2) systems and Human-Machine Interfaces (HMIs) that operators use to task, monitor, and collaborate with autonomous combat air systems.  Work fluently with engineering and design: You are comfortable in deep technical discussions and can partner effectively with engineers and designers to make sharp trade-offs on scope, architecture, and UX.
 Think in systems and interoperability: You understand how software integrates into a broader ecosystem and can drive product decisions around interfaces, data exchange, and upstream/downstream dependencies.

 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.   
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.   
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers.  We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.   
 The role 
 As Senior Programme Manager, Maritime, you will shape Helsing's strategic partnerships and the customer programmes that are defining the future of naval warfare. Working directly with industry partners, procurement agencies and armed forces, you will own the strategy, vision and roadmap for current and future maritime defence programmes. This means building a deep understanding of customer needs, developing new opportunities with navies and the broader defence industry, and driving complex programmes from early engagement through to delivery. You will work alongside a distinctive partnerships and programmes team, drawing on varied expertise to shape how partners and customers think about software and AI in defence.
 The day-to-day 
 Shape and execute Helsing's market strategy, vision and roadmap for current and future maritime defence programmes
 Anticipate market trends and client needs to identify and develop new business opportunities with navies, armed forces and industry partners
 Take end-to-end responsibility for complex defence programmes, from early-stage engagements through to high-quality, on-time delivery
 Lead programmes in close collaboration with government customers, industry partners and internal stakeholders, ensuring alignment at every stage
 Own strategic campaigns, coordinating all activities and decisions required to deliver in line with Helsing's strategic goals
 You should apply if you 
 Have built a track record of leading complex programmes across both business development and delivery within defence, government or related professional services
 Bring domain knowledge relevant to maritime defence, developed through experience or education in areas such as political science, international security, business administration, data science or engineering
 Take end-to-end ownership of strategic challenges, driving programmes from initial engagement to successful completion
 Communicate and collaborate effectively with senior government, armed forces and industry stakeholders, building lasting and trusted relationships
 Meet the requirements for national security clearance in the applicable country
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically   under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Nice to Have 
 Bring prior military or domain experience, particularly in naval warfare or related operational roles
 Hold existing relationships with key stakeholders in European naval procurement or defence industry ecosystems
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields   
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward 
 In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts 
 We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about 
 What we offer 
 Competitive salary and VSOP options 
 Relocation support : up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation
 Learning : €500/£450 yearly allowance
 Health & wellness : gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)
 Social : regularly company events and monthly social allowances
 Enhanced parental leave : 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers.
 Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work
 These are the core benefits across all locations, there may be additional benefits in certain locations.

title: Lead Technical Product Manager — Machine Learning Platform
description:
About the opportunity
 We are seeking an experienced Lead Technical Product Manager for our Machine Learning Platform within the Intelligent Operations Platforms segment. In this role, you will define the long term vision, platform architecture, and execution strategy for core Machine Learning infrastructure across N26. Your work will enable squads across the bank to automate risk assessments, prevent financial crime, and scale operational efficiency.
 Our ML Platforms team serves as the central nervous system for real-time, data-driven decisioning. We build and scale horizontal ML capabilities that allow critical functions including Financial Crime, Credit Risk, and Core Operations to execute with absolute precision at scale. As a Lead Product Manager, you will drive multi-squad strategy, transforming complex predictive models into resilient, compliant, sub-second scoring systems.
 In this role, you will 
 Drive the Core ML Platform Vision: Define and execute the multi-year roadmap for the central Machine Learning platform, ensuring alignment with broader engineering architecture and executive business goals.
 Lead High-Volume ML Portfolios: Oversee complex predictive ML capabilities supporting high-throughput banking systems, focusing on real-time transaction monitoring, automated credit risk scoring, and operational workflow decisioning.
 Scale Enterprise MLOps Infrastructure: Own the platform tooling and standards across the full ML lifecycle. Drive strategic decisions around feature stores, real-time feature extraction pipelines, model registries, automated retraining triggers, and CI/CD for ML.
 Establish Model Evaluation and Governance: Define robust offline and online model evaluation frameworks, shadow deployment mechanics such as champion and challenger testing, and real-time monitoring for model drift, inference latency, and data quality degradation.
 Bridge Technical Leadership and Compliance: Partner closely with Principal Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Security, and Legal stakeholders to ensure models meet strict European banking governance, explainability, and auditability standards.
 Elevate and Mentor the PM Function: Serve as a functional leader within the product organization. Establish best practices, PRD standards, and self-service ML integration blueprints while mentoring Product Managers in the team.
 What you need to be successful 
 Background & Experience 
 7+ years of Product Management experience in a technology-driven environment, with at least 4 years deeply focused on building, scaling, and managing core Machine Learning platform capabilities or data infrastructure.
 High-Volume B2C Scale: Proven track record of shipping ML products within high concurrency and low latency environments such as FinTech, payment processors, or high-scale consumer tech platforms.
 Strategic & Portfolio Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading multi-squad initiatives, shaping platform strategy across cross-functional engineering triads, and presenting to C-level executives and regulatory bodies.
 Technical & Domain Skills 
 Deep ML and MLOps Literacy: Hands-on understanding of predictive ML methodologies including classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, and ranking. This must be paired with architectural mastery of modern MLOps pipelines such as Kafka event streams, feature stores, vector databases, and automated retraining.
 Analytical and Evaluation Rigor: Highly proficient in defining model performance metrics like precision, recall, ROC-AUC, and F1-score, with a clear ability to translate them into business ROI such as reduced false-positive fraud blocks or manual review cost savings.
 Latency and System Trade-Offs: Strong ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between real-time inference and batch scoring, feature compute complexity and latency SLAs, and model accuracy versus explainability.
 Financial Governance and Compliance: Deep understanding of regulatory constraints around automated financial decisioning, model transparency, data privacy under GDPR, and audit trails in regulated environments.
 Traits 
 Platform Visionary: Ability to abstract domain-specific requirements into reusable horizontal ML services consumed by multiple engineering squads.
 Decisive Technical Leader: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, making high-stakes technical trade-off decisions, and prioritizing foundational infrastructure investments alongside feature delivery.
 Uncompromising Quality Standard: High bar for system resilience, monitoring, and fail-safe mechanisms, recognizing that core banking engines demand 99.99% reliability.
 What’s in it for you 
 Accelerate your career growth by leading core infrastructure at one of Europe’s premier digital banks.
 Employee benefits including a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, fitness & wellness discounts, and public transportation subsidies.
 A Premium N26 bank account subscription for you, plus subscriptions for friends and family.
 An additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
 High autonomy to drive the ML technical agenda, working with a diverse, international team of peers.
 A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.
 Who we are 
 N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.
 We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.
 We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500 strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

title: Product Manager - Investments
description:
About the opportunity 
 Empower retail investors by turning complex wealth-building tools into seamless, intuitive customer experiences. 
 Our Investments team exists to help everyday people build a better relationship with their money and achieve long-term financial stability. We build accessible, transparent, and compliant investment products - spanning stocks, ETFs, crypto, and managed portfolios - that make wealth creation effortless for millions of users.
 As a Product Manager on the Investments team, you will take end-to-end ownership of key capabilities and results across one of our core Wealth building verticals. Working at the intersection of UX, product strategy, and financial engineering, you will translate complex market mechanics and regulatory requirements into simple, engaging products.
 You won't be managing features in isolation - you will act as the central operational node, bringing together engineering, design, compliance, legal, and external B2B partners to ship impactful, scalable products safely and swiftly. You will join an ambitious team with direct impact, high autonomy, and clear runway to drive meaningful product outcomes from day one.
 In this role, you will: 
 Own a team’s Roadmap: Take full product ownership of the team’s scope, translating strategic priorities into well defined roadmaps and outcomes.
 Drive execution grounded in evidence: Drive the product development lifecycle for new and existing Investments features—from initial user research and technical scoping to engineering delivery, go-to- market strategy, and post-launch iteration. 
 Navigate Complex Ecosystems : Act as the central node between engineering, design, compliance, and legal teams to safely and swiftly bring scalable products to market while adhering to strict regulatory requirements. 
 Build Stakeholder relationships: Working closely with other teams is a fundamental aspect of the success you can have as a product manager. Building relationships with other team players early on is critical. 
 Data-Driven and evidence-grounded decisions: Dive deep into user behavior, market trends, and competitive analysis to uncover new opportunities, optimize the customer journey, and continuously refine our portfolio.
 What you need to be successful: 
 Proven Product Management Experience: 3+ years of product management experience, with a track record of shipping complex digital products end-to-end. Experience within Investments or Fintech is a strong plus.
 Pragmatic Bias for Action: Strategic thinker who can craft a long-term product vision while executing effectively in the short term—moving forward, making quick decisions, and driving outcomes with comfort in a fast-moving, liquid, and ambiguous environment.
 Autonomy & Ownership: Thrives in an entrepreneurial environment with a high level of independence, responsibility, and operational excellence.
 User Empathy & UX Intuition: You care deeply about UX and know how to translate complex financial concepts and market mechanics into simple, intuitive, and engaging customer journeys.
 Cross-Functional & Stakeholder Leadership: Ability to articulate product decisions, drive alignment, and influence at all levels of the organization. Experience building relationships early, navigating complex financial ecosystems, and collaborating cross-functionally with engineering, compliance, legal, marketing, and finance teams, as well as managing external B2B relationships to safely and swiftly bring scalable products to market.
 Analytical & Data-Driven: Strong ability to interpret investment data, market trends, user behavior, and competitive insights to uncover new opportunities, inform product decisions, and optimize adoption, retention, and product growth.
 What’s in it for you: 
 Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
 Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation. 
 As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.

 A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.

 Who we are 
 N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.
 We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

title: Product Manager - Product Factory
description:
About the Opportunity
 We are seeking a passionate, technically-minded Product Manager - Product Factory to join our Core Systems team. Our mission is to disrupt traditional core banking technology standards by building highly configurable, modular, and automated solutions that enable rapid financial product launches across Europe, backed by automated compliance and seamless data flows.
 The Core Systems segment is split between our Barcelona and Berlin, which serve as the primary product and tech hubs for N26 globally.
 What is the "Product Factory"?
 The Product Factory is the central engine room of N26’s core banking platform. Rather than hardcoding software from scratch for every new country or account type, the Product Factory builds the modular "building blocks" (flexible APIs, internal configuration engines, and a centralized product catalog) of the bank.
 As the Product Manager for this group, you will own the internal platforms that allow N26 to dynamically mix, match, and launch new financial products (like specialized savings accounts, premium tiers, or localized lending features) in a highly competitive, scalable, and compliant manner.
 In this role you will:
 Build Internal Self-Service Tools: Drive the strategy and execution for self-service product configuration and orchestration tools, enabling internal regional and market teams to launch or modify financial products without needing engineering intervention.
 Own Platform Strategy & Roadmap: Define and execute the roadmap for N26's core product infrastructure, including the orchestration of transactional and gateway data flows that power our underlying financial systems.
 Manage the Central Product Catalog: Maintain and scale the central system of record for N26's financial features, interest rates, limits, and fee structures, ensuring high system availability and data integrity.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with other product managers, designers, and core engineers to continuously improve N26's platform architecture, ensuring it aligns with global business goals.
 Navigate Compliance & Rollouts: Work closely with cross-functional domains, including Local Market Teams, Legal, Operations, and Compliance to ensure that automated compliance guardrails are baked directly into the Product Factory framework for seamless market rollouts.
 Vendor & Third-Party Integration: Oversee technical relationships and integrations with high-engagement third-party core banking providers and external financial vendors.
 What you need to be successful:
 Experience: 4+ years of Product Management experience, ideally gained within a FinTech, modern banking environment, core banking provider, or a highly complex platform/API-driven ecosystem.
 Technical & Data Acumen: Strong familiarity with backend architectures, relational databases, system integrations, and building/managing internal API products. You speak the language of engineering effortlessly.
 Domain Knowledge: Proven experience working with centralized digital product catalogs, configuration engines, or complex financial orchestration systems.
 Vendor Management: Previous experience managing high-engagement third-party vendors and aligning external roadmaps with internal engineering goals is a major plus.
 Education: Undergraduate degree in a STEM field, Business, or Economics. An MBA, MS, or equivalent advanced degree is a plus.
 Execution & Communication: An autonomous, adaptive operator with an entrepreneurial mindset, a strong bias for action, and exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
 Agile Mastery: A deep understanding of agile product development, continuous integration, and scalable delivery practices.
 What’s in it for you:

 A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, experiences, and backgrounds.

title: Senior Product Manager - Operations Automation & Enablement (OAE)
description:
About the opportunity
 We are seeking a hands-on, strategic Senior Product Manager - Ops Automation & Enablement (OAE) with a passion for building the intelligence and systems behind world-class banking operations.
 This is a true builder’s role: you will lead the strategy, design, delivery, and enterprise-scale adoption of Agentic AI, hyperautomation, process mining, and internal tooling to reshape how complex, control-intensive Banking Operations are executed.
 You will work cross-functionally with product managers, engineers, data scientists, and operational leaders to ensure N26 can scale aggressively across markets and product offerings without proportional headcount growth—all while maintaining the strict regulatory and quality standards our customers expect.
 In this role, you will:

 AI Champion: Act as the primary AI Champion for Banking Operations: translating complex ML/AI concepts into practical, working systems rather than just talking about them.
 Change Management & Value Realization: Identify structural and behavioral barriers to adoption; design frameworks that embed new AI capabilities into day-to-day operations and team decision-making.
 End-to-End Operating Model & Process Intelligence:

 Core CRM & Platform Integration: Partner with Conversational Banking and Platform owners to optimize Salesforce (our core case-management backbone) and integrate AI agents with our central architecture and AWS infrastructure.
 Operational Efficiency & ROI: Define and track clear metrics for every initiative (FTE impact, handling times, error rates, cost-per-unit, and time saved) to ensure high business value and ROI.

 Operational Readiness: Own product readiness for launches: ensuring changes in one pod do not disrupt downstream processes, control environments, or customer outcomes.
 What you need to be successful:
 Product Management Experience: 5+ years in Product Management, Process Engineering, or Operational Transformation, ideally in a fast-moving tech, digital, or fintech environment.

 Regulated Environment Experience: Background in banking or fintech, navigating compliance, legal, and risk sign-offs in a control-heavy environment.

 Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills with a track record of presenting complex trade-offs to senior leadership (EXCO/SteerCo) and influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority.

title: Senior Product Manager - Investment & Pension Products (m/f/d)
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the  FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.
 Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from  more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.
 Team 
 The Investment and Pension Products tribe builds Raisin's capital markets–based products. We take complex, highly regulated financial systems and turn them into easy, transparent, and scalable product experiences. If you have prior experience in Product Management or related fields, have a passion for Fintech, and are eager to join us on this mission, this role is for you.
 Your Responsibilities 
 Own one of Raisin’s Investments and Pensions product areas end to end, from problem discovery to delivery, adoption, and measurable business impact.
 Develop a deep understanding of your product area (customers, market, regulation, competitive landscape) and identify the highest-leverage opportunities across the broader domain.
 Shape and maintain a value-driven 12-month roadmap, balancing strategic bets, improvements, and platform/operational needs; align stakeholders through clear narratives and trade-off decisions.
 Set and track quarterly OKRs with your Engineering Lead, ensuring plans are grounded, measurable, and connected to Raisin’s strategy; you’re accountable for outcomes, not just output.
 Lead cross-functional collaboration with Engineering, Design, Data/Analytics, Operations, Legal/Compliance, and other stakeholders to deliver a seamless customer experience.
 Communicate effectively through written product artifacts (e.g., PRDs, user journeys, wireframes, sequence diagrams, experiment plans, and release notes), providing enough clarity to enable autonomous team execution while keeping scope focused and aligned.
 Your Profile 
 Must haves 
 At least 3 years of Product Management hands on experience leading a cross functional team.
 Demonstrated success in defining, launching, and scaling complex products that combine deep technical systems, non-trivial business logic, and high operational or regulatory constraints.
 Proven ability to collaborate with diverse stakeholders (Engineering, Design, Business, Compliance, Legal, Marketing, Executive Leadership) and drive cross-functional alignment on product vision and prioritization. You have a sufficient grasp of these disciplines, such that you can sketch high-level solutions to product problems in software design artifacts.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
 Owner’s mentality: you tackle challenges head-on and drive solutions with conviction.
 Highly data-driven approach to prioritization and decision-making, including the ability to define KPIs, create product impact dashboards, and synthesize data into actionable product requirements.
 A track record of leveraging qualitative (customer interviews) and quantitative (product usage data) insights to validate assumptions and drive product strategy.
 Bonus qualifications 
 Fluency in German.
 Experience in Investment products, preferably with a leading European Fintech, investment firm or a Bank’s investment division.
 Experience with Looker or similar analytical tools.
 Join our mission, join our team – and grow with us! 
 At Raisin, we care about each other and it is one of our top priorities to foster an open and caring environment in which everyone feels welcome and comfortable. Our culture is strongly driven by our ambitious team, which connects more than 75 different nationalities.
 As part of our team, you will benefit from:
 Employee Development Budget of €2,000 and four full training days per year.
 Flexible working hours, home office and 30 vacation days.
 A company pension scheme (Betriebliche Altersvorsorge), which we support with 20%.
 Enjoy more than 50+ different sports with Urban Sports Club: We subsidize your membership with more than €20 per month. 
 Do you miss being in the office? The Deutschland Ticket gets you there, which we subsidize with €25 per month.
 Love cycling? With JobRad, lease the bike of your choice and enjoy tax savings, plus Raisin covers your monthly insurance costs.
 Hungry all the time? Snacks, daily fresh fruit as well as drinks provided at the office.
 You are moving from another country or city to join us? We may support your relocation.
 Raisin Applicant Privacy Policy 
 We value diversity and the unique experiences each individual brings. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
 We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for everyone, regardless of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, or gender identity.

title: Senior Product Manager - SuperApp
description:
About the team: 
 The Engagement tribe sits at the heart of SumUp's merchant experience, responsible for the product surfaces that 4.3 million business owners interact with every day, from the information they see about their business to the actions they take to grow it. As our Senior Product Manager, you'll own the merchant facing SuperApp end to end, a rare individual contributor role spanning product strategy, UX quality, and squad delivery, on the single surface the wider product organisation depends on to build and ship effectively. If you're looking for a role where your product decisions have a direct impact on how millions of businesses run and scale every day, this is it.
 What you'll do: 
 Own the end to end product experience of our SuperApp across iOS, Android and web dashboard, raising the bar on UX quality, information architecture, and navigation for the surfaces merchants rely on most
 Spot and execute activation, upsell, cross sell, and retention opportunities that measurably grow engagement and long term value for merchants
 Shape the product strategy that makes the SuperApp an essential, everyday tool for small business owners running their business globally
 Act as the main point of contact for stakeholders across the business who depend on the SuperApp to reach merchants, partnering closely with design and data on priorities
 Build strong working relationships across engineering, design, and commercial teams, turning direct merchant insight into a clear, prioritised roadmap
 You'll be great for this role if: 
 Track record leading a product squad end to end, from strategy through to shipped outcomes in engagement, retention, or monetisation
 Strong technical or analytical foundation, whether from an engineering background or hands on experience as a data or business analyst, with the ability to think in systems and structure ambiguous problems
 Comfort working fluently with both qualitative and quantitative data to inform decisions, rather than relying on others to surface the answer
 Strong visual and UX judgement, with experience partnering closely with design and giving clear, constructive feedback
 Ability to build a well reasoned product strategy independently, without needing a dedicated research or strategy function to get there
 Experience advocating for merchants, with a track record of translating their everyday problems into practical product decisions
 Why you should join SumUp: 
 🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setu
 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 
 🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success
 📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget of €2000 for your individual development, which can be used to attend conferences and/or advance your career through further education 💶 A corporate pension scheme where we match up to 20% of your contributions
 🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave plus public holidays and special leave days
  🏙 Numerous other benefits such as Urban Sports Club subsidy, Kita placement assistance, subsidised office lunches
 🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service
 🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team
 About SumUp: 
 Be empowered to do more that matters.
 At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.
 Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. title: (Senior) Product Manager - Member Management (m/f/d)
description:
ABOUT US
Pliant is a modular B2B payments platform that combines commercial card issuing, payment accounts, FX, and spend management in one system — adapting to existing setups rather than requiring customers to replace them.
Businesses across industries such as travel, e-commerce, and insurance use Pliant to manage complex payment workflows with cards, backed by credit lines Pliant underwrites itself.
Fintechs and software platforms embed Pliant's payment infrastructure into their own products, from API-based Cards-as-a-Service to fully white-label solutions. Banks use Pliant's Card & Spend OS, the customer-facing interface, on their own infrastructure to run card programs.
Founded in 2020 and headquartered in Berlin, Pliant serves 5,000+ businesses and 40+ partners across Europe and the United States. A principal member of Visa and Mastercard, Pliant issues commercial cards in 13 currencies across 32 countries — under its own European e-money license and with licensed partners in the UK and US.
Learn more at http://www.getpliant.com/www.getpliant.com http://www.getpliant.com
About the role
Member Management is the trust layer of Pliant. The team owns identity, authentication, access and permissions, the full member lifecycle, and the multi-region tenant structure underneath it all. As Pliant moves up-market and works with banks and larger partners, this area becomes increasingly important: security reviews and vendor assessments depend heavily on how well we handle identity and access.
As (Senior) Product Manager - Member Management (m/f/d), you will own how members - and increasingly AI agents - access Pliant. Your scope covers authentication (passkeys, eIDs, enterprise IDPs, SSO), the permissions model, the joiner-mover-leaver lifecycle, and multi-tenant, multi-region identity for partners and banks. The main challenge is combining bank-grade security with an access experience that stays simple for members.
This is a hands-on, platform-heavy role for someone who enjoys structuring ambiguous problems, working closely with engineers on identity topics, and building capabilities that other teams at Pliant rely on.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
 - Own strategy, roadmap, and execution for Member Management: identity, authentication, access and permissions, the member lifecycle, and tenant management
 - Advance passwordless, adaptive authentication (passkeys, eIDs, enterprise IDPs, SSO) and step-up verification for sensitive actions
 - Build multi-tenant, multi-region identity that lets partners and banks launch quickly and lets members move easily between tenants and organizations
 - Automate the member lifecycle end to end: HRIS sync plus just-in-time provisioning, so joiners, movers, and leavers always have the right access
 - Work with Security, Compliance, and Engineering to meet the authentication, access-control, resilience, and audit bar that banks and regulated institutions require
 - Design the permissions and entitlements model that other Pliant domains build on
 - Prepare the platform for AI agents as governed members: verifiable identity, scoped permissions and limits, and a full audit trail
WHAT YOU'LL BRING
 - 5+ years in product management or a related role, ideally in B2B SaaS, fintech, identity/security, or platform-heavy environments
 - Experience with identity and access - authentication, SSO and IDPs, permissions and RBAC, provisioning - or a strong interest in getting deep into the domain
 - Strong technical fluency: comfortable discussing auth flows, multi-tenancy, integrations, and system-design trade-offs with engineers
 - Ability to work through ambiguity, create structure, and make sound decisions without perfect information
 - Familiarity with fintech trust and compliance requirements (e.g. PSD2) is a strong plus
 - Experience coordinating with large partner banks or other enterprise stakeholders - aligning requirements and timelines and keeping delivery on track across organizations
 - High ownership, bias for action, and clear cross-functional communication
 - Fluent English; other languages are a plus
WHAT WE OFFER
 - The opportunity to work in a growing team with big responsibilities that thrives on a strong exchange of knowledge and excellence
 - Attractive remuneration
 - Your choice of preferred OS, Windows or Mac
 - Flat hierarchy and transparent communication in a relaxed, professional atmosphere
 - Opportunity to develop your talent in a dynamic team with ambitious goals
 - Flexibility and possibility to work remotely
 - Monthly mobility benefit
 - Wellhub Membership
 - Pliant Card with monthly credit to explore the product and enjoy food with colleagues
Pliant is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and abilities, and are committed to an inclusive hiring process. If you need any accommodations during the interview process, please let us know.

title: Lead Product Manager, User Platform
description:
Change the way the world travels 
 GetYourGuide is the globally leading marketplace for unforgettable travel experiences. Travelers use GetYourGuide to discover the best things to do in a destination. Since its founding in 2009, people from all over the world have booked more than 150 million tours, activities, and attraction tickets through GetYourGuide. Powered by a global team of over 1000 travel experts and technologists, we are headquartered in Berlin and have 17 local offices around the world. Visit our careers website to learn more.
 Team mission 
 GetYourGuide knows a great deal about every traveler, and almost none of it is usable today. Identity, booking history, browsing behavior, care conversations, preferences and predictions sit in separate systems, in different shapes, so every team that wants to act on what we know rebuilds its own partial version of it. The User Platform team is building the traveler context layer: resolving who someone is across devices and sessions, and turning scattered signals into a shared, interpretable and predictive understanding that every team can build on. We start with travelers, because that is where the leverage is, and the layer is designed to extend to our other users over time.
 Your mission 
 As a Lead Product Manager, you will own the vision and strategy for a new platform at GetYourGuide, and you will be the first product manager on the team that builds it. Working with an Engineering Manager, engineers, an embedded data scientist and an analyst, you will define what the traveler context layer holds, how it is served, and which problems it solves first. This is a genuine zero to one: the identity model, the semantic memory that both humans and LLMs can read, the forward-looking predictions on top of it, and the self-serve interfaces that make it usable are all still to be designed.
 The work is equal parts product craft and demand creation. Our consumers are other teams: search and ranking, lifecycle and paid channels, customer care, and the traveler experience itself. Their need is real and widely felt, but they struggle to define what would really solve their problems.
 We are looking for a product leader who is fluent in data and machine learning without needing to be a data scientist, who is comfortable when the scope of a domain is still being drawn, and who wants to build the foundation that personalization at GetYourGuide will run on for years.
 What You'll Do 
 Ownership: Develop and own a 12+ month vision and strategy for the traveler context domain, define how we win in it, and take full responsibility for the outcomes. Identify where the non-incremental impact sits and sequence the roadmap to reach it.
 Ambiguity: Operate in a domain that is being defined as you build it. Break an open-ended platform problem into a phased, coherent plan, and make confident calls with incomplete information.
 Prioritization: Choose the few use cases that prove the platform, and be explicit about what we will not build. Balance the depth a single consumer wants against the breadth the platform needs, and sequence to maximise learning.
 Collaboration: Build trust with consuming teams across Growth, Retention, Search, Care and Supply, and negotiate the line between what we own and what they own. Proactively manage the dependencies and handoffs that keep the strategy executable.
 Communication and adoption: Make the platform legible to the rest of the company, from engineers to executives. Create demand where none exists yet by showing teams what becomes possible, then convert that into committed adoption.
 Technical fluency: Set the technical bar for the team and work credibly with data scientists and engineers on identity resolution, feature and embedding design, and serving architecture. Bring a clear point of view on when a heuristic beats a model, and on build versus buy versus partner.
 Experimentation: Validate the layer with real consumers and real traffic. Design the tests that show a shared representation outperforms the local copies teams build today.
 Leadership: Represent the interests of our users and our internal consumers at every level of the organization. Act with openness and transparency with your team, your peers and executive leadership, and coach others on the craft of building platform products
 Your toolkit 
 6+ years of professional experience in product management, including at least 2 years at Lead level or with equivalent scope, and meaningful time spent on data, machine learning or platform products
 Demonstrated ownership of a product area whose users are other teams, such as an internal platform, an API or a data product, including strategy, KPI definition, goal setting and adoption, not only delivery
 Strong data literacy: comfortable querying and interpreting large datasets, designing experiments, and working day to day with data scientists and analysts
 A working understanding of the machine learning lifecycle and how it differs from software delivery, plus the judgment to know when analytics and good heuristics are the better answer
 A track record of building alignment across a large and varied set of stakeholders, including senior leadership, in a way that is consistent with our Guiding Principles
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
 Bonus: experience with customer data platforms, identity resolution, segmentation or personalization systems
 Bonus: experience putting LLMs into production
 Bonus: experience in a marketplace or another two-sided platform
 Bonus: an engineering or analytics background
 How we’ll make your career journey extraordinary 
 Annual personal growth budget and mentorship programs for continuous learning and development
 Work from anywhere in the world for 30 days per year
 A hybrid working approach with three days of in office collaboration (Mon, Tue, Thur) and two days of optional at home focus time.

 Work with engineering, design, and other product teams to build product experiences that support human-in-the-loop and autonomous development workflows.
 Partner with teams working on demos and prototypes, including near-term work around spec-driven planning and autonomous development modes, including which decisions stay with a human and why.
 Use customer insights, product usage data, and market context to identify opportunities that can deliver customer value quickly.
 Help teams ship fast with quality, balancing near-term execution with longer-term product direction.
 Explore how planning can better account for reviewing code, reviewing test cases, and validating that work produced by agents matches the intended outcome.
 Collaborate across Plan, Source Code Management, Code Review, and AI product areas to reduce friction across the software development lifecycle.

 Experience as a product manager working on developer tools, DevOps tools, source code management, planning tools, AI-native products, or related software development lifecycle products.

 A data-forward approach to product management, including experience using data to identify customer impact and guide prioritization.
 Comfort operating in ambiguous spaces where there may not yet be a clear market pattern or established product category.

 Ability to think creatively about how AI changes the software development lifecycle and how product experiences should adapt.
 Strong collaboration and communication skills, especially in an all-remote, asynchronous environment.
 A bias toward action and the ability to help teams ship meaningful customer value quickly.

 This role sits within the Product organization and will work closely with teams across Plan, Source Code Management, Code Review, and AI. We are focused on helping GitLab customers plan, build, and deliver software in a faster, more connected way.
 You'll join a group that is rethinking how planning and coding should work as AI changes the speed and shape of software development. Rather than treating planning, coding, and review as separate stages, we're exploring how to bring these workflows closer together so humans and agents can collaborate more effectively.

 An overview of this role

 You'll turn a technically complex problem space into a focused strategy, roadmap, and developer experience. Working closely with Engineering and Design, you'll explore how agents can diagnose failures, recommend next steps, and help teams recover safely. The goal isn't to add artificial intelligence (AI) for its own sake. It's to reduce manual work and help developers get back to a safe, shippable state without losing trust or control.
 At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. You'll contribute to that mission by making testing and coverage insights more useful across the software development lifecycle.
 What you'll do 
 Define and communicate the Test & Code Coverage product vision, strategy, and outcome-focused roadmap, from discovery through a minimum viable product, beta, launch, and continued iteration.
 Identify customer problems across pipeline failure diagnosis, test automation, test optimization, code coverage, and recovery. Build the case for investment, prioritize foundational and customer-facing work, and reshape or stop initiatives that aren't creating value.
 Work with Engineering to understand pipeline failures caused by flaky tests, testing gaps, environment issues, configuration problems, and coverage blind spots. Connect code changes, tests, pipeline behavior, historical patterns, and risk to help developers find a diagnosis and an actionable next step.
 Work directly with customers to understand how they author, maintain, select, prioritize, and debug tests. Connect test selection, test impact analysis, code coverage, and pipeline intelligence to reduce flaky tests, shorten feedback loops, and focus testing effort where it lowers the most risk.
 Partner with Engineering and Design to prototype agent-driven workflows for failure diagnosis, test authoring and repair, optimization, coverage analysis, and recovery. Make actions reviewable through evidence, confidence, human approval, and safe paths to propose code changes and merge requests. Use AI tools in your own product work to investigate problems, explore code and data, prototype concepts, and accelerate learning.
 Define and measure outcomes such as time to diagnose, time to recover, failure recurrence, test signal quality, and developer confidence. Validate problems and solutions with customers and learn from production usage.
 Partner across Product, Engineering, Design, Quality, Developer Experience, Customer Success, Support, and Product Marketing to connect testing insights with code review, pipelines, and release decisions. Turn customer evidence into clear narratives that support adoption and future investment.
 Lead through clear written communication, prioritization, and product judgment. Influence senior stakeholders, establish repeatable discovery and measurement practices, and mentor other product managers.
 What you'll bring 
 Experience owning complex technical products, platforms, or developer workflows at Staff, Senior Staff, Principal, or equivalent scope, including building a new product or capability from initial validation through launch and adoption.
 Strong product fundamentals in customer discovery, problem framing, prioritization, roadmap development, outcome measurement, and iterative delivery.
 Technical fluency in one or more relevant areas, such as software testing, test automation, code coverage, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), developer tools, DevOps, developer experience, quality engineering, or software delivery.
 An understanding of how engineering teams build, test, review, and ship software, and the ability to work with engineers on test architecture, pipeline behavior, code changes, data, integrations, reliability, and scale.
 Experience diagnosing technical problems and turning complex, noisy signals into clear user experiences and actionable workflows.
 Experience exploring AI or agent-driven solutions for developer workflows, with the judgment to distinguish useful automation from unsafe or low-confidence actions.
 Experience using customer conversations to understand problems and inform product decisions, communicating clearly in writing and conversation, and influencing across functions with shared owners

 Experience leading complex, cross-functional strategic programs at the executive level and turning ambiguous direction into delivered outcomes without a fully scoped brief.

 Reliable follow-through and the ability to navigate conflict and competing priorities across a broad stakeholder group.

 The role entails
 Ensuring programs and projects are delivered within the schedule, scope, cost, budget and resources expectations 
 Identifying key technical and project risks and issues and actively put mitigating actions in place

 Conducting regular status meetings and business reviews with customers and providing direction when needed 
 Managing the delivery schedule of critical third party deliverables for the project 
 Advocating to customers the appropriate technologies from Canonical's portfolio  
 Driving project success while managing risks 
 What we are looking for in you
 Experience in Enterprise IT Programs, Process Improvement, and Software Engineering Project Management
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
 Experience leading cross-cultural, remote and global project teams and customers.
 Strong negotiation and influencing skills  
 Strong communication skills 
 Deep understanding of Linux, Open Source, and Cloud Technologies  
 Bachelor's Degree in a STEM discipline 
 Project Management Certification, preferably PMP or equivalent certification 
 Agile Project Management certification, preferably Scrum Master or equivalent certification 
 Ability and willingness to travel domestically and internationally

 We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide.  Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
 Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
 Annual compensation review
 Recognition rewards
 Annual holiday leave
 Maternity and paternity leave
 Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
 Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
 Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
 About Canonical 
 Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
 Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

 Canonical’s product management team are technologists who have a passion for delivering products and solutions that help shape market demands while elevating open source software everywhere. During the interview process we will identify specific software products which would be a good fit for your interests.
 We believe that open source is transforming the way that enterprises solve their business needs. Although open source has been around for thirty years, it is only now fundamental to every corner of the software landscape. Going forward we believe open source will have an even bigger impact as it moves into specialised vertical markets. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’, starting with Ubuntu but expanding to cover every class of application on every class of compute. Our product managers set the vision and the direction to ensure teams deliver the right products in the right markets at the right time.  We have open product manager roles across a wide range of product domains, including:
 Ubuntu Platform - Our Ubuntu experience on Desktop, Server, Windows (WSL), Multipass, Gaming, Enterprise, & Hardware Enablement
 Ubuntu Pro Services - Our key commercial offerings Ubuntu Pro, Compliance, Standards, Security Engineering, and Managed Services on cloud and on prem

 Finance - Open source solutions for financial institutions including trading platforms, blockchain technologies, regulatory compliance, and AI-driven analytics
 Automotive - Open source solutions for autonomous driving, in-vehicle infotainment, connected vehicles, and compliance with automotive industry standards such as ISO 26262 and ISO 21434
 Application Management - Open source solutions in the enterprise including Observability, IAM, App Stores and technologies such Grafana, GitOps, and Juju Charms
