title: Product Manager - Data
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
 The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
 Canonical’s product management team are technologists who have a passion for delivering products and solutions that help shape market demands while elevating open source software everywhere. This is a general application track for the product management positions at Canonical. You will set a clear vision, prioritize work effectively, and ensure the team delivers high-quality products that meet business and user needs. Apply here if you excel at leadership, communication, and technical vision, and believe you can drive product strategy for the business needs of tomorrow. During the interview process we will identify specific software products which would be a good fit for your interests.
 We believe that open source is transforming the way that enterprises solve their business needs. Although open source has been around for thirty years, it is only now fundamental to every corner of the software landscape. Going forward we believe open source will have an even bigger impact as it moves into specialised vertical markets. Our goal is to make open source easier, more reliable and more secure for deployment and development. We strive to be the provider of ‘most software to most companies’, starting with Ubuntu but expanding to cover every class of application on every class of compute. To deliver on that ambition, we select product managers for their intellect and strong drive to advance the open source community. Together, we aim to improve open source quality, outreach, and impact. Our product managers set the vision and the direction to ensure teams deliver the right products in the right markets at the right time. They push the boundaries of the technology landscape to identify and deliver products into new and existing market opportunities.
 Our product managers are technology professionals with a software engineering background who strive to become business executives and entrepreneurs. We discuss strategy, plan product development, drive engagement, and promote the open source way. We oversee the entire product lifecycle from conception to delivery, blending technical expertise, strategic thinking, analytics, project management skills and effective communication to ensure products meet both user needs and business objectives.
 We have open product manager roles across a wide range of product domains, including:
 Ubuntu Platform - Our Ubuntu experience on Desktop, Server, Windows (WSL), Multipass, Gaming, Enterprise, & Hardware Enablement
 Ubuntu Pro Services - Our key commercial offerings Ubuntu Pro, Compliance, Standards, Security Engineering, and Managed Services on cloud and on prem
 AI/ML & MLOps - Open source AI/ML solutions, AIOps automation, model lifecycle management, Kubeflow, MLFlow, KServe, and AI infrastructure on cloud and edge
 IoT - Ubuntu on embedded devices and/or edge servers, device management, and robotics
 Cloud - Ubuntu in public and private clouds, promoting automation frameworks, and including technologies such as Kubernetes, MAAS, and LXD
 Telco - Open source for Telco's including technologies and standards related to Core Network, RAN/vRAN, SoNIC, DENT, and SmartNICs
 Finance - Open source solutions for financial institutions including trading platforms, blockchain technologies, regulatory compliance, and AI-driven analytics
 Automotive - Open source solutions for autonomous driving, in-vehicle infotainment, connected vehicles, and compliance with automotive industry standards such as ISO 26262 and ISO 21434
 Application Management - Open source solutions in the enterprise including Observability, IAM, App Stores and technologies such Grafana, GitOps, and Juju Charms
 If your domain of expertise isn’t listed above, yet you feel it’s relevant to Canonical, then feel free to apply anyway. We will route you to the most suitable team.
 Location: These roles are home based in the EMEA time zone. You will be expected to be located in this region.

 Lead the product development lifecycle, reviewing the priorities and goals for your product
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams such as engineering, design, marketing, and sales
 Address common challenges across projects, align on priorities, enable informed decisions, and keep business execution on track
 Conduct market research, analyse industry trends, and gather customer feedback to identify opportunities

 Conduct usability testing, analyse user feedback, and iterate on the product to improve the user experience
 Collaborate with marketing, sales, and support teams to develop go-to-market strategies, create product documentation, and provide training
 Contribute to the success of our sales team in winning new opportunities, reviewing customer feedback and participating in customer meetings
 Oversee the work of a product line, ensuring consistency in strategy and execution across different teams
 Facilitate collaboration and resolve conflicts within different teams and across other departments

 Exceptional academic results at high school and university

 We are hiring a Project Manager - Ubuntu Embedded Systems at Canonical 
 As a Project Manager for Canonical’s Devices business, this role is responsible for the coordination and completion of large complex customer-facing projects, overseeing all aspects of project delivery and acting as the primary delivery liaison between Canonical's engineering teams and Canonical's customers.
 You will be managing the projects that involve the delivery of Ubuntu images on a wide variety of devices ranging from robots, edge gateways, and IoT devices to PCs and automotive systems. This is a high-profile project management position where you are expected to build and maintain working relationships with team members, customers, other partners/vendors (Silicon vendors, OEMs, ODMs, IHVs), and other Canonical departments/teams. 
 Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAs and/or EMEA regions.
 The role entails 
 Managing projects through their complete life cycle and ensuring that the overall goals for both Canonical and the client are met
 Successfully delivering engineering professional services for assigned projects
 Working with engineering teams on custom board enablement and delivery of Ubuntu images to the customers
 Assisting in the development of project statements of work
 Drafting and maintaining project-specific schedules/project plans 
 Obtaining client agreement to the project schedule and agreed-upon work items
 Ensuring projects are delivered within the time/resources/scope expectations
 Managing project risk mitigation and plans
 Driving technical issues to reach desired delivery outcomes
 Maintain daily and weekly communication with the client and all internal stakeholders
 Managing delivery schedule of critical third-party deliverables for the project
 Keeping management informed of the status of assigned projects
 Identifying custom engineering requests that are not part of an existing business contract
 Advocating the appropriate technologies from Canonical's product portfolio to customers
 Supporting different time zones and work non-traditional hours as required to support the assigned projects
 What we are looking for in you 
 Solid project management experience in delivering engineering services to customers managing software development teams and field engineers
 Extensive experience successfully managing projects with cross-cultural and multi-continent internal and external project resources, preferably with resources in Asia, Europe, and the Americas
 Educational degree preferably in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Math
 Good knowledge of Linux and the wider Open Source Software community, and understanding of computer architecture
 Excellent communications skills, both verbal and written, in English
 Strong leader and problem solver with extensive experience building successful internal and external partnerships and effective working relationships with demanding project sponsors in complex organizational environments
 PMP/PMI or PRINCE2 Practitioner Certification preferred
 Ability to work non-standard work hours in support of a worldwide sales and project team
 Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
 What we offer colleagues 
 We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
 Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
 Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
 Annual compensation review
 Recognition rewards
 Annual holiday leave
 Maternity and paternity leave
 Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
 Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
 Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
 About Canonical 
 Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
 Canonical is an equal opportunity employer 
 We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.  Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Product Manager, Enterprise (Senior/Staff-level)
description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 
As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.
Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.
ROLE OVERVIEW
Synthesia is used by over 90% of the Fortune 100, and the largest deployments now run thousands of creators across dozens of markets, languages, and compliance regimes. What decides whether those accounts expand or stall is not another avatar, it is whether admins, legal, and programme owners can actually stay in control. 
You'll own that layer end to end: workspace setup and governance, the content lifecycle, and the analytics and integrations that close the loop. This is the work that turns a proof of concept into a seven-figure renewal, and right now it is wide open.
WHY THIS ROLE NOW
AI video has crossed from experiment to standard tooling inside the world's biggest companies. The next phase of growth is won or lost on whether we can make that scale safe and manageable. That is your remit.
WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING
 - Owning the end-to-end roadmap for content lifecycle, governance, and the operational layer that keeps enterprise deployments running - from workspace setup through compliance controls
 - Getting close to enterprise customers: understanding how IT admins, legal teams, programme managers and content owners think about governance, and what "in control" actually looks like at scale
 - Translating that into clear product direction, what to build, in what order, and why, and keeping engineering and design aligned to it as the strategy evolves
 - Working closely with the engineering manager and designer in the team; writing clear specs, making good calls on trade-offs, and providing the context that helps engineers build the right thing first time
 - Partnering with Solutions, CS, and Legal on complex enterprise deals. These features are frequently deal-critical and the commercial loop matters
 - Defining the metrics that tell us whether this layer is working: adoption of admin tooling, compliance feature usage, reduction in support escalations related to governance gaps
WHO YOU ARE
You've excited by the challenge that comes with untangling the inherent complexity of enterprise platform products. You understand that governance and compliance work isn't glamorous, but you know it's the difference between a proof of concept and a seven-figure renewal.
You can hold a conversation with a CISO and with a content creator, and understand what each of them needs from the same system.
YOU MAY BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU BRING
 - Significant experience owning a critical product domain - setting strategy, not just executing it
 - A track record of connecting product outcomes to commercial results: ARR, retention, expansion, or equivalent
 - Comfortable working across a broad surface area. You can prioritise ruthlessly and make the case for what gets built next
 - Strong written communication: PRDs, strategy docs, and customer insight summaries that others can act on without a follow-up
 - Ability to ramp quickly on to the complexity of enterprise buying motions. You'll be close to the commercial team on complex deals and that context matters
 - Based in London or open to regular travel; the team is London-anchored and in-person time matters
We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every point above. Strong candidates rarely match a list exactly, and we'd rather hear from you.
OUR CULTURE
At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here. https://www.notion.so/How-we-work-at-Synthesia-f794caa72f8446efb6be22b551ce0fa2?pvs=21
LOCATION
Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office or remote from Europe. 
GLOBAL BENEFITS:
 - You will be compensated well with a generous salary and equity. 
 - You get 25 days of annual leave + local holidays.
 - Regular team offsites where you’ll get to collaborate with the product & engineering team in person. 
 - Work from home budget 
 - Work from anywhere policy of 60 days per year
 - Generous referral scheme
 - Enhanced parental leave - maternity leave includes 16 weeks at full pay, and paternity leave includes 5 weeks at full pay (if your country’s government scheme offers more generous support, you receive whichever is greater—our enhanced policy or the local statutory benefit)
BENEFITS SPECIFIC TO UK: 
 - Private healthcare via AXA for you with a discount for dependants
 - 5% pension match 
 - Team lunches Tuesday-Friday in the London office

title: Product Manager (ex-founder or ex-product engineer)
description:
ABOUT POSTHOG
PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.
We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort https://posthog.com/handbook/story. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:
 - A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics https://posthog.com/product-analytics, replay vision https://posthog.com/replay-vision, AI observability https://posthog.com/ai-observability, and error tracking https://posthog.com/error-tracking
 - PostHog MCP https://posthog.com/mcp for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data
 - Data warehouse https://posthog.com/context-warehouse/managed-warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.
We are:
 1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.
 2. Default alive https://paulgraham.com/aord.html. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.
 3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.
We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible https://posthog.com/deskhog. 
THINGS WE CARE ABOUT
 - Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook https://posthog.com/handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.
 - Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams https://posthog.com/handbook/wide-company and make product decisions https://posthog.com/handbook/which-products. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.
 - Shipping fast: Why not now? https://posthog.com/handbook/values#why-not-now We want to build a lot of products; we can't do that shipping at a normal pace. We've built the company around small teams – autonomous, highly-efficient groups of cracked engineers https://posthog.com/founders/cracked-manifesto who can outship much larger companies because they own their products end-to-end.
 - Time for building: Nothing gets shipped in a meeting. We're a natively remote company. We default to async communication – PRs > Issues > Slack. Tuesdays and Thursdays are meeting-free days https://posthog.com/handbook/company/culture#were-on-the-makers-schedule, and we prioritize heads down building time over perfect coordination. This will be the most productive job you've ever had.
 - Ambition: We want to solve big problems. We strongly believe that aiming for the best possible upside, and sometimes missing, is better than never trying. We're optimistic about what's possible and our ability to get there.
 - Being weird: Weird means redesigning an already world-class website for the 5th time. It means shipping literally every product that relates to customer data. It means building an objectively unnecessary developer toy https://posthog.com/deskhog with dubious shareholder value. Doing weird stuff is a competitive advantage. And it's fun.
PRODUCT AT POSTHOG
Product management plays a slightly different role at PostHog https://posthog.com/handbook/product/product-team than at most other companies and is incredibly important. Instead of micro-managing engineers, PMs are responsible for research, data, and setting high-level context across the organization. They work across multiple products https://posthog.com/handbook/product/product-team#small-team-membership to determine how products are being used, what the competitive landscape is like, and how users are feeling about PostHog. Using the usual PM jargon we could say PMs at PostHog are very discovery-focused and don’t engage in delivery https://www.svpg.com/discovery-vs-delivery/ almost at all.
Among other things, they:
 1. Run growth reviews https://posthog.com/handbook/product/per-product-growth-reviews for products that have product-market-fit
 2. Dive into data research projects to answer challenging questions without obvious answers
 3. Organize user interviews https://posthog.com/handbook/product/user-feedback
 4. Provide just-in-time product feedback for new and existing features, following our principles of shipping and iterating quickly
 5. Coach product engineers on "how to do product https://posthog.com/handbook/engineering/product-engineering"
If you want to know more about our philosophy of building products, read our article “Product Management is broken. Engineers can fix it.” https://posthog.com/newsletter/product-management-is-broken
WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING:
You will be joining PostHog as a Product Manager, working with one of our small engineering teams https://posthog.com/teams (with the potential to cover more than one team/product after your onboarding period), with a heavy emphasis on analyzing data, talking to users and owning the commercial aspects of your product(s):
 - We have a growth review https://posthog.com/handbook/product/per-product-growth-reviews with every product every month. As the PM, you ensure we have the right metrics, dig into things that have changed, understand what users are doing, why they're churning, etc. You use the findings to figure out if we need to dig deeper into a trend or reprioritize what we're building.
 - Across our 10+ https://posthog.com/pricing products (and counting!), we have thousands of paying customers and many more on the free tier. That’s a lot of users an

title: Product Lead - Infrastructure
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE
Supabase is the open-source Postgres development platform that 10M+ developers and thousands of enterprises depend on every day. Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime and Vector Search all run on one platform: the same compute https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/compute-add-ons, the same disks https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/database-size, the same network and control plane, in every region we operate.
Supabase's hardest problems live in that platform. Millions of databases, growth that compounds every quarter, and a customer base running from a developer on a free project to a regulated enterprise routing traffic through PrivateLink https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/privatelink. Reliability, capacity, cost and the enterprise features that close deals all come back to the same primitives. We're hiring a Product Lead to own them.
ABOUT THE ROLE
You own the platform primitives every Supabase product runs on: compute, disks, networking, the API gateway, capacity and regions. You own the enterprise surfaces built on top of them too, including read replicas https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/read-replicas, custom domains https://supabase.com/docs/guides/platform/custom-domains, PrivateLink and Bring Your Own Cloud. You report to the Head of Product and set direction for the whole area alongside the leads for our other product lines. You're the only product person on the platform today, and the team grows under you as the area does.
WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:
 - You talk to customers across the full spectrum. Developers running a single small project, growing startups whose bill is mostly compute and disk, enterprises walking through a network architecture review, and partners building on top of Supabase.
 - You own the problem statement and requirements behind every platform bet. You define what we're building and why before engineering starts, name the cost, capacity and reliability constraints, and keep that clarity current through execution.
 - You decide what gets built, what gets deferred, and what gets cut. Every quarter you're choosing between enterprise unlocks that open new markets, cost and performance wins for the long tail of projects, and net-new capabilities that change what Supabase can run. The priorities are yours, and so is defending them.
 - You own reliability as a product surface. You set service levels that track what customers experience, hold teams to them, and show customers what it takes to run millions of databases.
 - You define how each launch is measured before it ships. The metric, the threshold and the read afterwards are yours: whether a launch moved enterprise deal velocity, project economics, or platform reliability.
 - You keep engineering, design and leadership aligned. The platform touches every other Supabase product, every region and every customer tier. You write down what's coming, why, and in what order, and you surface dependencies before they become blockers.
YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU:
 - Have 8+ years of product management experience on developer tools, or are an ex-founder who has built in this space. You're technical enough to read an architecture doc and follow a design discussion.
 - Have shipped cloud infrastructure as a product. You've owned at least one of compute, networking, storage, or multi-region and multi-tenant systems at a cloud, infrastructure or PaaS company, as the owner rather than a neighbouring team. You can judge the tradeoffs: instance sizing and capacity, disk and storage economics, scale-to-zero versus always-on, single-tenant versus shared, and the distance between "works in one region" and "works in twenty." Familiarity with how enterprises buy infrastructure (PrivateLink, BYOC, procurement) is a bonus.
 - Have grown with an infrastructure product. You've owned infrastructure small enough to hold in your head, and stayed with it until capacity, regions and cost became the real constraints.
 - Are biased toward speed. You'd rather ship something imperfect and learn from it.
 - Build with what you own. You stand up a read replica, put a custom domain in front of a project, terminate traffic through PrivateLink, deploy onto BYOC. You develop opinions through first-hand use.
 - Use AI to move faster. You lean on AI for the slow parts of the job (research, drafting, synthesising feedback) so you spend more time on judgment calls.
 - Work async by default. We're fully remote. You make decisions in writing and move work forward without meetings.
WHAT WE OFFER
 - Fully Remote
 We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.
 - ESOP
 Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.
 - Tech Allowance
 Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.
 - Health Benefits
 Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.
 - Annual Off-Sites
 Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.
 - Flexible Work
 We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.
 - Professional Development
 Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.
ABOUT THE TEAM
Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.
 - ~400 team members
 - 60+ countries
 - 20+ languages spoken
 - Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)
 - 540,000+ community

title: Product Manager - Strategic Partner Integrations (Bay Area based)
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE
Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.
More than 10 million developers build on it, from solo founders shipping over a weekend to teams and builders via Vercel, Lovable and Stripe, and every one of them reaches Supabase through a surface: an API, an auth flow, an SDK, or a Partner's product with Supabase integrated.
The current and next wave of software leans on those surfaces harder than any before it.
Agents now act on behalf of developers and end users, authentication has to work machine-to-machine as seamlessly as it once worked human-to-human, and independent platforms increasingly need to authenticate, delegate, and coordinate with each other without a person in the loop. For a platform built on Postgres with Auth, Compute, Storage and generated Data APIs at its core, the surfaces where Supabase meets Partners and their systems are some of the most important avenues that we own - this role owns these surfaces.
This role owns a focused portfolio of those Partners. Not the platform as a whole, but a small number of strategic Partners whose integrations you are accountable for making excellent. Success here is a product measure, not a commercial one: the integration is high quality, the developers who use it are well served, and it keeps improving. That means living close to those developers, obsessing over where the integration fails them, and turning what you learn into the roadmap. It is a product and engineering job first, because the best integrations are won in architecture reviews and pull requests, not in meetings.
WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR
 - Owning the success of a focused portfolio of strategic Partners, a small number of them rather than the platform as a whole. You are accountable for the outcome of each partnership: a high-quality integration that the developers who use it reach for, and that keeps getting better.
 - Living close to the developers who use these integrations. Talking to them constantly, finding where each integration breaks down in real use, and building the roadmap from that signal rather than from a Partner's wishlist.
 - Deciding the right integration model for each Partner: what Supabase owns, what the Partner owns, what you build jointly, and what stays open and Partner-agnostic, reading whether the two roadmaps run together or diverge and choosing accordingly.
 - Working hands-on with each Partner's product and engineering counterparts to ship. Holding your own in an architecture review and a code-level design discussion, and turning strategy into shipped, high-quality integrations rather than long conversations.
 - Setting the quality bar for what a great integration looks like, and building the mechanisms (documentation, tooling, guardrails, versioning) that hold every Partner to it as adoption scales.
 - Defining what success looks like for each integration and measure it honestly: adoption by the developers who use it, integration quality, and reliability in real use. Using those signals to decide how deep to go with each Partner and where to push the integration next.

 - Have shipped integration or platform surfaces that other companies' systems build against, owning APIs, auth or identity flows, or developer-facing platform surfaces end to end, and can reason at the product level about how two independent systems should authenticate and exchange data: where to be open, where to be strict, and where trust lies in these integrations. title: Senior Product Manager – Digital Clients: Growth & Expansion
description:
**Your Role**
=============
As Senior Product Manager – Private Wealth (f/m/d) you build the product for LIQID's most demanding clients: entrepreneurs, families and executives whose relationship with us runs through a personal Relationship Manager. You design for two users at once – the client and the RM – and your mandate is twofold: make our Relationship Managers radically more effective, and design the end-to-end hybrid service, sales and relationship model for our most complex offerings. Our private clients hold portfolios that include private equity funds from KKR, EQT, CVC and Permira and venture stakes in companies like SpaceX, OpenAI, Stripe and Anduril. You make sure that advising on, investing in and living with these portfolios feels like the best of private banking – with the speed and clarity of a digital product.
**What you'll do**
==================
* **End-to-End Segment Ownership:** Own the private client journey from introduction and first advisory meeting through onboarding, investment and long-term servicing to the next allocation. You define the segment's North Star and KPI tree – net new money, share of wallet, time from advisory to investment, private markets adoption, retention, RM book capacity and cost-to-serve – and develop it further where you see sharper signals.
* **RM Enablement & Advisory Tooling:** Treat Relationship Managers as users, not stakeholders. You build the tools that give them more time for advice and less for administration: a client 360 view, meeting preparation and follow-up, next-best-action signals, pipeline visibility and AI copilots that draft, summarize and document – within the requirements of MiFID II on suitability, cost transparency and record-keeping.
* **Hybrid Service & Sales Design:** Blueprint the service model end-to-end: which moments are digital, which are personal, and which are both. Together with RM and Sales leadership you design seamless handovers, a shared view between client app and RM workspace, and service tiers that scale high-touch quality to more clients without diluting it.
* **Complex Offerings, Made Simple:** Make sophisticated products understandable and executable: private markets with capital calls, distributions and J-curves, and the underlying funds and companies, from Cinven and Advent to Mistral and Databricks, as well as bespoke mandates, company and holding accounts, family structures and consolidated reporting across portfolios. You work closely with the Investment team, Compliance and Operations so every journey is compliant by design.
* **Discovery, Data & Experimentation:** Join advisory meetings, shadow RMs and run continuous discovery with clients for whom every interaction matters. You combine qualitative depth with rigorous measurement in a small-n, high-value segment, define tracking schemas for client and RM journeys, and use AI-assisted prototyping to converge on solutions in few iteration cycles.
* **Thought Leadership with Hands-on Mentality:** Act as Product Manager and Product Owner for a cross-functional team of Engineering, Design and Product Ops. You drive adoption of what you ship inside the RM organization, prioritize transparently by impact and effort – which also means saying no – and grow into the thought leader for hybrid wealth management at LIQID.
**What you bring**
==================

title: Senior Project Manager (m/w/d)
description:

As a **Senior Project Manager**, you will lead the execution of large-scale industrial equipment projects valued at €25M+, managing the full project lifecycle from contract handover to customer acceptance. You will coordinate cross-functional teams across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, software, and customer organizations, ensuring successful delivery in a global environment. The role requires strong project management and Agile expertise, as well as close collaboration with customers and partners in Asia, particularly Japan, including extended travel during key project phases.
**You Will Make an Impact By:**
***Project Leadership and Execution***
* Lead strategic capital equipment projects valued at €25M+, with full accountability for scope, schedule, budget, quality, risk management, customer satisfaction, project governance, execution planning, change management, and contractual compliance.
***Cross Functional Leadership***
* Lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams across engineering, software, manufacturing, supply chain, service, and customer organizations, ensuring stakeholder alignment, effective collaboration, and timely decision-making across global locations.

***Risk and Opportunity Management***

title: Product Manager (m/f/d)
description:
**Verstehe, wie Menschen arbeiten. Bau die Software, die ihre Arbeit besser macht.**
Bei Buena kaufen wir Hausverwaltungen und entwickeln die Software, mit der sie täglich arbeiten. Wir können direkt beobachten, wo Prozesse haken, welche Informationen fehlen und was Menschen unnötig Zeit kostet.
Wir suchen einen Product Manager, der diese Probleme verstehen und lösen will. Du gehst zu den Nutzern, erkennst gemeinsame Bedürfnisse über mehrere Verwaltungen hinweg und übersetzt deine Erkenntnisse in klare Prioritäten und konkrete Produktverbesserungen.
Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering und Design zusammen. Du gestaltest die Richtung und kümmerst dich um die Details, die aus einer guten Idee ein funktionierendes Produkt machen.
**Was du bei uns machst**
=========================
* **Nutzer und Arbeitsabläufe verstehen:** Du beobachtest die Arbeit in unseren Hausverwaltungen und findest auch Probleme, die uns über Supportanfragen oder Online-Feedback bisher nicht erreichen.
* **Gemeinsame Bedürfnisse erkennen:** Du vergleichst Abläufe zwischen Verwaltungen und identifizierst Verbesserungen mit dem größten Nutzen.
* **Die Roadmap gestalten:** Du verbindest einzelne Projekte mit einer klaren Produktrichtung, begründest Prioritäten und machst sie für das Team verständlich.
* **Lösungen entwickeln:** Du recherchierst Alternativen, erarbeitest Vorschläge und durchdenkst Nutzerabläufe gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design.
* **Zusammenhänge durchdringen:** Du verstehst, wie Immobilien, Einheiten, Eigentümer, Dokumente und weitere Daten miteinander verbunden sind – und welche Folgen Änderungen an einer Stelle haben.
* **Von der Idee bis zur Nutzung begleiten:** Du lieferst die passende Detailtiefe für ein Projekt, klärst offene Fragen während der Entwicklung und überprüfst nach dem Release, ob die Verbesserung ankommt.
* **KI praktisch einsetzen:** Du nutzt Tools, um Produktverhalten zu untersuchen, Ideen auszuprobieren, Prototypen zu bauen und Tests zu unterstützen.
**Was du mitbringst**
=====================
* **Erfahrung mit Software für reale Arbeitsabläufe:** Beispielsweise aus ERP, Supply Chain, HR, CRM oder anderen komplexen Geschäftsprozessen. Du verstehst, dass Software bestehende Abläufe und Rahmenbedingungen berücksichtigen muss.
* **Starke Discovery-Fähigkeiten:** Du fragst präzise nach, gehst über den ersten Wunsch hinaus und findest heraus, welches Problem tatsächlich gelöst werden muss.
* **Gutes Produkturteil:** Du machst aus einer unübersichtlichen Ausgangslage eine klare Richtung, sinnvolle Prioritäten und verständliche Nutzerabläufe.
* **Verständnis für verknüpfte Systeme:** Du kannst Beziehungen zwischen Daten und die Auswirkungen von Veränderungen nachvollziehen.
* **Praktische technische und KI-Kompetenz:** Du kannst mit Tools ein System untersuchen und einen Prototypen bauen. Eigenständig produktionsreifen Code zu liefern, setzen wir nicht voraus.
* **Eigenverantwortung und Teamfähigkeit:** Du bringst klare Vorschläge ein, lässt sie hinterfragen und entwickelst mit anderen eine bessere Lösung.
* **Eine pragmatische Arbeitsweise:** Du kommst mit Unsicherheit zurecht, arbeitest dich in Details ein und bringst Dinge in einem kleinen Team voran.
Du musst noch kein Experte für Hausverwaltung sein. Du brauchst die Neugier und Fähigkeit, dich in diese Welt einzuarbeiten. Erfahrung in einem frühen Startup kann dafür ein guter Beleg sein – wir sind aber offen für unterschiedliche Hintergründe.
**Warum du bei Buena einsteigen solltest**
==========================================
* **Du bist nah am Problem:** Du hast direkten Zugang zu unseren Nutzern und kannst überprüfen, ob deine Arbeit ihren Alltag verbessert.
* **Du gestaltest das Produkt mit:** In unserem kleinen Team haben deine Erkenntnisse und Entscheidungen direkten Einfluss darauf, was wir als Nächstes bauen.
* **Du wächst mit deinem Beitrag:** Gute Ergebnisse führen bei uns schnell zu mehr Verantwortung.
* **Du arbeitest eng mit dem Team:** Persönlicher Austausch und kurze Wege sind uns wichtig. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam aus unserem Büro in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg.
**Deine Benefits**
==================
* **Büronähe wird belohnt:** Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus bei einem Wohnort mit 10–20 Minuten Fußweg zum Büro.
* **Verpflegung:** 110 € monatliches Lunch-Budget.
* **Sport:** 50 € Fitnesszuschuss.
* **Weiterentwicklung:** 1.200 € Bildungsbudget pro Jahr.
* **Lesestoff:** Bücher, die du lesen möchtest, übernehmen wir.
**Du willst komplexe Abläufe verstehen und daraus ein Produkt machen, das Menschen gerne nutzen? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.**

title: Product Manager - Accounting (m/f/d)
description:
**Mach aus komplexer Buchhaltungssoftware eine, die Menschen ihre Arbeit leichter macht.**
Bei Buena kaufen wir Hausverwaltungen und entwickeln die Software, mit der sie täglich arbeiten. Dadurch sind wir direkt an den Menschen, Prozessen und Problemen, für die wir bauen.
Buchhaltung ist ein zentraler Bestandteil dieser Arbeit. Ob Mietausschüttung, Unterkonten oder Jahresabrechnung: Abläufe müssen verständlich, Ergebnisse korrekt und Automatisierungen auch dann zuverlässig sein, wenn etwas vom Standardfall abweicht.
Wir suchen jemanden, der Buchhaltung tief versteht und dieses Wissen in bessere Software übersetzen kann. Gemeinsam mit unseren Nutzern, Engineering und Design findest du heraus, welche Probleme wir lösen müssen, wie eine gute Lösung aussieht und wohin sich unser Accounting-Produkt entwickeln soll.
**Was du bei uns machst**
=========================
* **Probleme wirklich verstehen:** Du arbeitest dich in die Buchhaltungsprozesse unserer Hausverwaltungen ein – inklusive Sonderfällen, fachlichen Anforderungen und bestehender Einschränkungen.
* **Die richtigen Verbesserungen identifizieren:** Du unterscheidest zwischen fehlenden Funktionen, unklaren Abläufen, technischen Fehlern und Fragen zur Bedienung.
* **Die Produktrichtung gestalten:** Du entwickelst eine klare Vorstellung davon, wie Accounting bei Buena funktionieren soll, und priorisierst Verbesserungen nach Nutzen, fachlicher Notwendigkeit und Wirkung.
* **Lösungen konkret machen:** Du übersetzt komplexe Anforderungen in verständliche Konzepte, Spezifikationen und Nutzerabläufe, die du mit Engineering und Design weiterentwickelst.
* **Korrektheit sicherstellen:** Du prüfst Lösungen, denkst Sonderfälle durch und beurteilst, ob neue Funktionen die zugrunde liegenden Anforderungen erfüllen.
* **Bis zur Nutzung dranbleiben:** Du begleitest Verbesserungen bis zur Einführung und überprüfst, ob sie das ursprüngliche Problem im Alltag lösen.
Das kann eine gezielte Verbesserung bei Mietausschüttungen sein – oder die grundlegende Weiterentwicklung unserer Kontenstruktur.
**Was du mitbringst**
=====================
* **Tiefes Buchhaltungsverständnis:** Du kannst Abläufe erklären und erkennst, wenn etwas fachlich fehlt oder nicht stimmt. Erfahrung in der Immobilien- oder WEG-Buchhaltung ist besonders wertvoll.
* **Produktdenken:** Du hinterfragst bestehende Arbeitsweisen, unterscheidest echte Anforderungen von Gewohnheiten und entwickelst Ideen für bessere Abläufe.
* **Analytische Stärke:** Du zerlegst komplexe Probleme, vergleichst Lösungswege und erkennst, welcher nächste Schritt den größten Nutzen bringt.
* **Technische Neugier:** Du möchtest verstehen, wie unsere Software funktioniert, und kannst Anforderungen und Abwägungen mit Engineers diskutieren.
* **Klare Kommunikation und Eigenverantwortung:** Du bringst Fachlichkeit, Nutzerperspektive und Produktentwicklung zusammen und bleibst an einer Lösung, bis sie praktisch funktioniert.
Besonders relevant ist Erfahrung mit der Entwicklung oder Verbesserung von Buchhaltungssoftware. Dein bisheriger Jobtitel ist dabei zweitrangig: Entscheidend ist, dass du Buchhaltung verstehst und daraus sinnvolle Softwarelösungen ableiten kannst. Praktische Erfahrung mit KI-Tools für Recherche, Prototypen oder Tests ist ein Plus.
**Warum du bei Buena einsteigen solltest**
==========================================
* **Dein Fachwissen verändert das Produkt:** Du arbeitest direkt mit den Menschen, die unsere Software nutzen, und siehst, was deine Entscheidungen im Alltag bewirken.
* **Du ergänzt ein starkes Team:** Engineering und Design bringen ihre Expertise ein. Gemeinsam könnt ihr Probleme von der fachlichen Ursache bis zur fertigen Lösung bearbeiten.
* **Deine Ergebnisse schaffen Möglichkeiten:** Wir wachsen schnell und geben Menschen Verantwortung, die etwas bewegen.
* **Du baust langfristig mit:** Unsere Mission ist, Wohneigentum zugänglicher zu machen. Gute Software und funktionierende Hausverwaltungen bilden dafür die Grundlage.
**Deine Benefits**
==================
* **Büronähe wird belohnt:** Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus bei einem Wohnort mit 10–20 Minuten Fußweg zum Büro.
* **Verpflegung:** 110 € monatliches Lunch-Budget.
* **Sport:** 50 € Fitnesszuschuss.
* **Weiterentwicklung:** 1.200 € Bildungsbudget pro Jahr.
* **Lesestoff:** Bücher, die du lesen möchtest, übernehmen wir.
**Du verstehst Buchhaltung und hast konkrete Ideen, wie Software sie besser machen kann? Dann möchten wir dich kennenlernen.**

title: Product Owner (m|w|d)
description:
Deine Rolle bei uns
 Als Product Owner übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle zwischen Fachbereich, Stakeholdern und Entwicklungsteam. Du arbeitest dich schnell in komplexe Geschäftsprozesse ein, strukturierst fachliche Anforderungen und sorgst dafür, dass daraus tragfähige, nutzerorientierte und wirtschaftlich sinnvolle Softwarelösungen entstehen.
Dabei behältst du Nutzer- und Geschäftsnutzen, technische Abhängigkeiten und Projektziele im Blick, setzt klare Prioritäten und schaffst ein gemeinsames Verständnis zwischen Business und Entwicklung.
 Hör dir unseren Podcast Product Owner:innen im Alltag an! 
 Aufgaben
 Du analysierst, strukturierst und spezifizierst fachliche Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Kund:innen und Stakeholdern.
 Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, identifizierst die zugrunde liegenden Nutzer- und Geschäftsprobleme und leitest daraus passende Lösungsoptionen ab.
 Du priorisierst und pflegst das Product Backlog unter Berücksichtigung von Nutzen, Scope, Aufwand, Qualität, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten.
 Du übersetzt komplexe fachliche Anforderungen in verständliche und umsetzbare Aufgaben, User Stories und Akzeptanzkriterien für das Entwicklungsteam.
 Du moderierst Workshops und Abstimmungen mit Fachbereichen, Entwicklung, UX/UI, Architektur und weiteren Stakeholdern.
 Du sorgst für Transparenz bei Anforderungen, Prioritäten und fachlichen Zielen und beziehst relevantes Nutzer- und Stakeholderfeedback in die Weiterentwicklung ein.
 Du begleitest Refinements, Sprint Plannings, Reviews und fachliche Abnahmen.
 Du bereitest Entscheidungsgrundlagen vor, kommunizierst Zielkonflikte transparent und erkennst Risiken sowie Abhängigkeiten frühzeitig.
 Qualifikation
 Du verfügst über mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle im Software- oder Digitalisierungsumfeld.
 Du kannst komplexe fachliche Anforderungen analysieren, strukturieren und adressatengerecht aufbereiten.
 Du bewertest Nutzer- und Geschäftsnutzen, Aufwand, Qualität, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten und leitest daraus fundierte Prioritäten und Entscheidungen ab.
 Du bewegst dich sicher in komplexen fachlichen und technischen Umfeldern und arbeitest dich schnell in neue Geschäftsprozesse ein.
 Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis moderner Softwareentwicklung mit und vermittelst souverän zwischen Fachbereich und Entwicklung.
 Du kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern, verstehst Nutzerbedürfnisse und wirtschaftliche Zusammenhänge und entwickelst auch bei unterschiedlichen Interessen tragfähige Lösungen.
 Du hast Erfahrung mit agilen Arbeitsweisen sowie idealerweise mit Jira und Confluence.
 Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich, strukturiert und mit einem hohen Maß an Selbstorganisation.
 Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1-Niveau).
 Benefits
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, remote zu arbeiten
 Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten inkl. Übernahme von Weiterbildungskosten
 Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
 Individuelle Entfaltung und ein respektvolles Miteinander
 Offene Unternehmenskultur, angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre & regelmäßige Teamevents
 Langfristige Perspektiven, betriebliche Altersvorsorge & Krankenversicherung
 Mehr Work-Life-Balance durch eine Kooperation mit unserem Partner voiio
 Wahlweise Zuschuss zu Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft oder BVG Ticket
 Inanspruchnahme von Rabatten über unseren Partner Corporate Benefit
 Über uns
 Wir sind da, bis digitales Arbeiten Freiräume für morgen schafft
 Als mittelständisches Unternehmen aus Berlin sind wir am Wandel und dessen Gestaltung interessiert. Unser Angebot umfasst das gesamte Spektrum einer kohärenten Digitalstrategie: von der fach- und sachkundigen Beratung, über die individuelle Entwicklung und Anpassung von adäquaten Softwarelösungen, bis hin zur Wartung von Altsystemen und der eventuellen Migration in neue Systemumwelten. Was wir anbieten, sind nicht nur einzelne Produkte, sondern digitale Komplettlösungen für komplexe Situationen und Problemstellungen, die den Arbeitsalltag unserer Kunden erleichtern sollen. Dabei gleicht kein Projekt dem anderen. Individuelle Bedürfnisse werden als solche ernst genommen und haben einen Einfluss auf unseren Arbeitsprozess. Zu diesem Zweck ist eine nahbare Kommunikationskultur auf Augenhöhe unabdingbar. Neben unserem Standort in Berlin, unterhalten wir außerdem Büros in Stralsund, Hannover und Nürnberg.
 Auf diese Daten darf gebaut werden:
 3 bis 7 Tage bis wir uns nach Bewerbungseingang bei dir melden
etwa 28 Tage vom ersten Kennenlernen bis zur Entscheidung
bis zu 3 Mal können wir uns in Gesprächen besser Kennenlernen
Neugierig geworden? Schaut auf unserer Website vorbei und überzeugt euch selbst von unseren Qualitäten: https://www.assecor.de

title: Product Manager (m/w/d)
description:
immowelt – where new chapters begin
 A new home is more than an address – it's the place where a new chapter begins. Since 1991, as one of Germany's leading online real estate marketplaces, we've brought millions of people exactly there. Our mission is to digitalize every step of the real estate transaction, making it as simple as possible for house-hunters, sellers, or agents – from the first search all the way to financing. Operated by AVIV Germany GmbH, immowelt is part of the AVIV Group – one of the largest real estate tech companies. Here, decades of market expertise meet the power of a global PropTech network.
 Find the team that's right for you.
 Don't look for just any colleagues – find a team that shares your drive! Whether in Software Development, Sales, Product Management or Brand Marketing: at immowelt, tech visionaries, data specialists and creative talents work together across locations like Nuremberg, Berlin and Hamburg. We live a culture where ideas count for more than hierarchy. We've got each other's backs – whether at a shared B2Run, at summer parties, or relaxing over Guten-Morgen-Müsli in the team lounge. Whether you bring professional experience, are a manager, or an ambitious career-changer: with us, it's your potential that counts.
 About The Job
 AVIV is Europe's largest real estate tech company, backed by KKR. Our teams build the technology and business models shaping how people across France, Germany and Belgium buy, sell, rent, lend and own property.
In Germany, our teams run a major share of the business through immowelt.de — a Top 2 German portal for valuation, rent, buy and sell, with 18m average monthly visits, 19.3k agents, 320k+ listings, and €168m revenue in 2023.
 Role Summary
 This role owns a bounded slice of the Pro Tools surface (e.g. statistics, invoice self-serve, or a specific stage of the agent portfolio experience) and ships measurable improvements against agent-experience metrics — the delivery engine next to the Staff PM, turning framed problems into shipped, measured solutions.
 Responsibilities
 Answer who your users are, why they need the product, and what their needs are
 Continuously track product success and health metrics
 Generate, collect and prioritize hypotheses for product improvement
 Test hypotheses with the team to build understanding of the product and drive specific improvements
 Build the product backlog based on qualitative and quantitative data
 Write specs / user stories for product improvements
 Set product tasks for the team and explain the product logic — why, for what reason, for whom
 Present results at team events
 Proactively ensure transparency of goals and results for stakeholders
 Take into account the interests of other units and departments, and see the full picture
 Back up the Engineering Manager on development-team management issues — monitor problems, propose solutions
 Required Experience
 Experience in marketplaces/classifieds or B2B products
 Experience with customer-facing product interfaces, with a track record of improving funnel conversion
 Native German speaker
 Skillset
 Critical thinking, ability to build valid argumentation
 Ability and willingness to prove/justify one's decisions
 Empathy, ability and willingness to put oneself in others' shoes — viewing the product from the perspective of users and their needs
 Commitment to continuous self-development
 Clarity of thought, both verbal and written
 Understanding of Lean Startup approaches
 Key areas of project management: planning, risk management, stakeholder management, communications management
 Working with AI tools
 Ability to effectively use LLMs (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to speed up product work: generating hypotheses, specs, user stories, data analysis
 Prompt engineering — ability to formulate queries to AI models to get high-quality results
 Using AI tools for user research: interview analysis, insight synthesis, feedback clustering
 Ability to formulate product requirements for AI features
 Understanding of the unit economics of AI features
 Ability to assess where in the product AI creates real value versus where it's a hype feature without ROI
 Understanding of data privacy issues when using AI
 Skills
 Ability to formulate the data needs required to work through a task
 Ability to validate a product hypothesis through experiments, articulate expectations for metrics and outcomes
 Proficiency with key product work tools and approaches: story mapping, impact mapping, MVP
 Knowledge of basic approaches to product metrics and data analytics (Excel, Google Analytics, Tableau/Snowflake)
 Understanding of where different user research approaches apply: in-depth interviews, hallway testing
 Methods for prioritizing the product backlog (e.g., Kano, RICE)
 Describing product tasks from the user's and business's perspective
 Presentation and public speaking skills in front of audiences of up to 100 people
 Basics of Agile approaches: Scrum, Kanban
 What We Offer
 We offer you real freedom and strong benefits:
 Flexible working hours & leave: Individual arrangements and part-time options by agreement, plus up to 30 days of leave per year
 Training and coaching: Regular internal training, external development opportunities, and individual coaching as a core part of onboarding
 Company pension & benefits: An attractive, financially supported pension model and capital-forming benefits paid in full
 Mobility, transport links & parking: A free Deutschlandticket, JobRad bike leasing, or simple rental of a fixed parking space in the immowelt car park for a small fee
 Sport, fitness & health: Urban Sports Club memberships, a monthly contribution toward professional massages, and mental health support via Kyan Health
 Food: Guten-Morgen-Müsli, fresh fruit & vegetables, coffee, tea and water on the house, plus cozy lounges for cooking and getting together at the Nuremberg and Berlin locations
 Employee discounts: Exclusive offers and discounts via Corpo

title: Lead Technical Product Manager — Machine Learning Platform
description:
All positions
Lead Technical Product Manager — Machine Learning Platform
Department:Tech - Ops Platforms & AI Enablement
Location:Berlin
Apply for this position
 About The Opportunity
 We are seeking an experienced Lead Technical Product Manager for our Machine Learning Platform within the Intelligent Operations Platforms segment. In this role, you will define the long term vision, platform architecture, and execution strategy for core Machine Learning infrastructure across N26. Your work will enable squads across the bank to automate risk assessments, prevent financial crime, and scale operational efficiency. Our ML Platforms team serves as the central nervous system for real-time, data-driven decisioning. We build and scale horizontal ML capabilities that allow critical functions including Financial Crime, Credit Risk, and Core Operations to execute with absolute precision at scale. As a Lead Product Manager, you will drive multi-squad strategy, transforming complex predictive models into resilient, compliant, sub-second scoring systems.
In this role, you will
 Drive the Core ML Platform Vision: Define and execute the multi-year roadmap for the central Machine Learning platform, ensuring alignment with broader engineering architecture and executive business goals.
 Lead High-Volume ML Portfolios: Oversee complex predictive ML capabilities supporting high-throughput banking systems, focusing on real-time transaction monitoring, automated credit risk scoring, and operational workflow decisioning.
 Scale Enterprise MLOps Infrastructure: Own the platform tooling and standards across the full ML lifecycle. Drive strategic decisions around feature stores, real-time feature extraction pipelines, model registries, automated retraining triggers, and CI/CD for ML.
 Establish Model Evaluation and Governance: Define robust offline and online model evaluation frameworks, shadow deployment mechanics such as champion and challenger testing, and real-time monitoring for model drift, inference latency, and data quality degradation.
 Bridge Technical Leadership and Compliance: Partner closely with Principal Data Scientists, ML Engineers, Security, and Legal stakeholders to ensure models meet strict European banking governance, explainability, and auditability standards.
 Elevate and Mentor the PM Function: Serve as a functional leader within the product organization. Establish best practices, PRD standards, and self-service ML integration blueprints while mentoring Product Managers in the team.
 What you need to be successful
Background & Experience
 7+ years of Product Management experience in a technology-driven environment, with at least 4 years deeply focused on building, scaling, and managing core Machine Learning platform capabilities or data infrastructure.
 High-Volume B2C Scale: Proven track record of shipping ML products within high concurrency and low latency environments such as FinTech, payment processors, or high-scale consumer tech platforms.
 Strategic & Portfolio Leadership: Demonstrated experience leading multi-squad initiatives, shaping platform strategy across cross-functional engineering triads, and presenting to C-level executives and regulatory bodies.
 Technical & Domain Skills
 Deep ML and MLOps Literacy: Hands-on understanding of predictive ML methodologies including classification, regression, clustering, anomaly detection, and ranking. This must be paired with architectural mastery of modern MLOps pipelines such as Kafka event streams, feature stores, vector databases, and automated retraining.
 Analytical and Evaluation Rigor: Highly proficient in defining model performance metrics like precision, recall, ROC-AUC, and F1-score, with a clear ability to translate them into business ROI such as reduced false-positive fraud blocks or manual review cost savings.
 Latency and System Trade-Offs: Strong ability to evaluate technical trade-offs between real-time inference and batch scoring, feature compute complexity and latency SLAs, and model accuracy versus explainability.
 Financial Governance and Compliance: Deep understanding of regulatory constraints around automated financial decisioning, model transparency, data privacy under GDPR, and audit trails in regulated environments.
 Traits
 Platform Visionary: Ability to abstract domain-specific requirements into reusable horizontal ML services consumed by multiple engineering squads.
 Decisive Technical Leader: Comfortable navigating ambiguity, making high-stakes technical trade-off decisions, and prioritizing foundational infrastructure investments alongside feature delivery.
 Uncompromising Quality Standard: High bar for system resilience, monitoring, and fail-safe mechanisms, recognizing that core banking engines demand 99.99% reliability.
 What’s in it for you
 Accelerate your career growth by leading core infrastructure at one of Europe’s premier digital banks.
 Employee benefits including a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, fitness & wellness discounts, and public transportation subsidies.
 A Premium N26 bank account subscription for you, plus subscriptions for friends and family.
 An additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
 High autonomy to drive the ML technical agenda, working with a diverse, international team of peers.
 A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.
 Who we are
N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use. We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do. We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500 strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Enter. Jetzt ist der Moment.

title: Founders Associate im B2B-SaaS (m/w/d)
description:

 Unser SaaS wächst aktuell jeden Monat um einen sechsstelligen ARR-Betrag und verzeichnete in den vergangenen zwei Monaten 0 % Churn. Mit einer erfolgreich abgeschlossenen Finanzierungsrunde skalieren wir TendiGo nun noch schneller.
 Jetzt suchen wir einen Founders Associate (m/w/d), der gemeinsam mit uns das Unternehmen aufbaut und die nächste Wachstumsphase maßgeblich gestaltet.
 Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern zusammen, bringst Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zum messbaren Ergebnis und übernimmst vom ersten Tag an Verantwortung für zentrale Themen in Strategie, Operations, Business Development, Investorenkontakt und Sales.
 Du willst unternehmerische Verantwortung übernehmen, mit hohem Einsatz ein skalierendes B2B-SaaS aufbauen und dich dabei extrem schnell weiterentwickeln? Dann könnte das deine Rolle sein.
 Was dich auszeichnet 
 Du willst viel bewegen, früh Verantwortung übernehmen und schnell dazulernen. Dass du eigenständig etwas voranbringen kannst, hast du bereits gezeigt:
 Track Record & Excellence: Du hast in einer Beratung, einem Startup oder mit einer eigenen Gründung bereits bewiesen, dass du exzellente Ergebnisse erzielen kannst. Auch im Studium gehörtest du zu den Besten.
 High Agency & Ownership: Du erkennst, was das Unternehmen am stärksten voranbringt, und setzt es mit dem höchsten Einsatz eigenständig um, ob in Strategie, Operations oder Sales. Dabei übernimmst du die volle Verantwortung von der ersten Idee bis zum messbaren Ergebnis.
 Self-Management & Fast Learner: Du arbeitest dich eigenständig und schnell in neue Themen ein, behältst viele Herausforderungen gleichzeitig sowie zuverlässig im Blick und kommst zügig ins Handeln. Deine Schwerpunkte passt du an, wenn sich Prioritäten im Unternehmen ändern.
 Speed & High Standards: Du setzt schnell um und lieferst Ergebnisse verlässlich. Du weißt, wann ein pragmatischer erster Schritt reicht und wo maximale Sorgfalt entscheidend ist.
 Entrepreneurial Drive: Du verstehst, was Kunden brauchen, und kannst den Mehrwert einer SaaS-Lösung überzeugend rüberbringen. Du willst nicht nur Wachstumsstrategien entwickeln, sondern selbst verkaufen, Kunden gewinnen und den Umsatz skalieren.
 AI-Native Mindset: Du nutzt KI-Tools konsequent, um den Output und die Qualität deiner Arbeit zu steigern und deine eigenen Prozesse zu optimieren.
 Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau:  Du sprichst und schreibst verhandlungssicheres Deutsch, denn du arbeitest eng mit uns Gründern und unseren deutschsprachigen Kunden zusammen.
 Was dich bei uns erwartet 
 Ambitioniertes Team: Du arbeitest direkt mit Gründern und einem kompetenten, schnell wachsenden Team zusammen, das schnell handelt, hohe Standards setzt und sich gemeinsam weiterentwickelt.
 Prägender Einfluss im Unternehmensaufbau: Du arbeitest direkt mit den Gründern in einem stark wachsenden B2B-SaaS an konkreten unternehmerischen Entscheidungen, etwa daran, wie wir Kunden gewinnen, interne Prozesse aufbauen und unser Wachstum steuern.
 Hohe Verantwortung, die mit dir wächst: Du kannst schon früh Verantwortung übernehmen und in einem wachsenden Startup dein eigenes Team aufbauen und in eine Führungsposition wachsen.
 Attraktive Vergütung: Wir bieten dir ein sehr attraktives Gehalt, das deiner Leistung und der Verantwortung dieser Rolle gerecht wird.
 Bewerbungsprozess 
 1. Bewerbung & Screening 
 Schick uns:
 Deinen CV. Ein Anschreiben ist optional.
 Optional: Nenne zwei Dinge, die du selbst angestoßen und bis zu einem konkreten Ergebnis gebracht hast. Was war jeweils dein persönlicher Beitrag, was kam heraus und woran lässt sich das nachvollziehen? (max. 200 Wörter) Füge eine vorhandene, anonymisierte Arbeitsprobe zu einem deiner Beispiele hinzu.
 2. Erstes Interview 
 Wir lernen uns kennen und sprechen über deine bisherigen Ergebnisse, deine Arbeitsweise und deinen unternehmerischen Antrieb. Wenn es für beide Seiten passt, laden wir dich im nächsten Schritt zur Case Study ein.
 3. Case Study 
 Du bekommst eine Aufgabenstellung und bearbeitest diese eigenständig. Anschließend präsentierst du deine Ergebnisse in einem 30-minütigen digitalen Termin.
 4. Persönliches Interview vor Ort 
 Wenn du die Case Study bestehst, laden wir dich zum finalen Interview in unser Office ein. Dabei geht es vor allem darum, uns gegenseitig persönlich kennenzulernen und herauszufinden, wie gut wir zusammenpassen.
 Wenn es nach dem Gespräch für beide Seiten passt, bekommst du das Jobangebot.
 Interesse? 
 Wenn du unternehmerisch denkst, ein sehr hohes Engagement hast, eigenständig exzellente Ergebnisse erzielst und Lust hast, als Founders Associate ein schnell wachsendes KI-Unternehmen mit aufzubauen, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.
 Sende uns deine Unterlagen an Dr. Arthur Kari (arthur.kari@tendigo.de).

title: Chief of Staff (m/w/d)
description:
Über uns
Bei VREY bauen wir das EnergyOS für Mehrfamilienhäuser .
In Deutschland stehen über 3,3 Millionen Mehrparteienhäuser – und sie sind das schwarze Loch der Energiewende. VREY kombiniert zertifizierten Messstellenbetrieb mit eigener Software und ermöglicht Eigentümern erstmals, ihren selbst erzeugten Solarstrom direkt an ihre Mieter zu verkaufen – einfach und ohne selbst zum Energieversorger zu werden (
 42b EnWG).
 Damit wird regulatorischer Zwang zu einer profitablen und planbaren Chance:
 Zweistellige Renditen und Wertsteigerung für Eigentümer,
 ~20 % Stromkostenersparnis für Mieter, und
 digitale Infrastruktur für Speicher, Wärmepumpen und Flexibilität.

Im Zuge unserer Seed-Finanzierung haben wir 3,3 Mio. € von führenden Impact- und Energy-VCs (u. a. Rubio Impact Ventures, HTGF, Kopa Ventures) eingesammelt. Mit dem frischen Kapital gehen wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase und bauen unser Team gezielt aus.
Wir stehen am Anfang eines strukturellen Marktumbruchs. Wer heute die Energieinfrastruktur im Mehrfamilienhaus definiert, prägt sie für Jahrzehnte. Werde Teil von VREY und baue mit uns das führende EnergyOS.

 Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Consulting (Tier 1/Tier 2), High-Growth Start-ups, oder im VC/PE gesammelt
 Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation in einem relevanten Bereich wie z.B. Wirtschaftsingenieurswesen, Energiewirtschaft oder Betriebswirtschaft
 Du hast bereits Erfahrung in der Energie- oder Immobilienbranche, oder bringst ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Start-ups, Energie oder Immobilien mit
 Du denkst unternehmerisch, triffst eigenständig fundierte Entscheidungen und setzt klare Prioritäten mit Blick auf Impact, Skalierbarkeit und langfristigen Unternehmenserfolg
 Du suchst bewusst keinen 9-to-5-Job, sondern willst in einem schnelllebigen, gründer-nahen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen, Strukturen aufbauen und das Wachstum aktiv mitgestalten
 Du strebst danach, die beste Version deiner selbst zu werden und suchst Umgebungen, in denen du dein volles Potenzial entfalten kannst
 Du bist in Berlin (oder bereit umzuziehen) - unser Büro ist unser Homebase
 Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch fließend
 Deine Aufgaben
 Mission der Rolle
 Du arbeitest als verlängerter Arm der Gründer und stellst sicher, dass strategische Prioritäten klar definiert, sauber umgesetzt und unternehmensweit ausgerichtet sind.
Dein Ziel: Fokus, Geschwindigkeit und Struktur in ein schnell wachsendes Unternehmen zu bringen und VREY auf die nächste Skalierungsstufe zu heben.

 Du strukturierst komplexe Fragestellungen und bereitest fundierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen vor
 Du übersetzt Vision und Strategie in konkrete Roadmaps und operative Ziele

 Steuerung unternehmenskritischer Initiativen
 Du übernimmst Ownership für bereichsübergreifende Schlüsselprojekte (z. B. neue Geschäftsmodelle, Organisationsdesign, Fundraising-Vorbereitung)
 Du stellst die strukturierte und fristgerechte Umsetzung strategischer Initiativen sicher
 Du identifizierst Engpässe frühzeitig und löst kritische Themen mit hoher Eigenverantwortung

 Du hilfst beim Aufbau skalierbarer Strukturen, Entscheidungsprozesse und Reporting-Systeme
 Du etablierst klare Zielsysteme (z. B. OKRs) und Performance-Transparenz
 Du unterstützt bei Recruiting, Teamentwicklung und Führungsthemen
 Benefits
 Verantwortung: zentral Rolle in unserem Kernteam
 Vergütung: Kompetitives Gehalt und Anteile am Unternehmen
 Startdatum: so bald wie möglich, unbefristet
 Team & Benefits: Lustiges Team, Tech Budget von 2 Tsd.€, regelmäßige Team Events und Learning Lunches, Gratis Getränke, Deutschlandticket
 Weitere Vorteile: Tägliche Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern, Getränke & Snacks, Personalverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, das Unternehmen von Grund auf mitzugestalten

Wenn du von Tag 1 an etwas Großem mitgestalten möchtest, bist du bei uns genau richtig.
