description:
Job Description
 As a Product Manager (m/f/d) at SIXT, you will be creating solutions used globally by millions of users, revolutionizing the way people experience mobility. In this role, you will own the digital rent experience that enables customers to skip the counter and get on the road faster. As we push to make fully digital rentals the future of car rental, you will expand the availability of our Mobile Check-In product to new customer segments and reservation types, eliminate friction from the funnel, and ensure every eligible customer can complete their journey independently.
 YOUR ROLE AT SIXT
 You lead the expansion of Mobile Check-In (MCI) to new customer segments and reservation types, helping the company achieve the goal of transitioning to a Digital Rent-first experience
 You work closely with design and engineering to bring to life frictionless interfaces that guide customers confidently from digital rent onboarding, through vehicle selection, payment, and damage documentation
 You navigate local market complexity by configuring country-specific requirements such as DVLA checks in the UK, US local customer fees, and other regional compliance needs
 You work at the intersection of multiple business functions, aligning with stakeholders across the company to remove blockers and expand digital checkout eligibility
 You establish and monitor KPIs including digital checkout quota, funnel conversion rates, damage funnel usage, SES scores for digital checkouts, etc. 
 Your Skills Matter
 Product Experience You bring several years of product management experience, ideally with checkout flows, payment systems, or mobile-first customer experiences
 UI/UX Excellence You have a strong eye for UI and user experience: you can evaluate designs critically, provide constructive feedback, and partner effectively with designers to optimize conversion funnels
 Mobile Expertise Experience with mobile app products, self-service flows, or operational technology that bridges digital and physical experiences is a strong plus
 Stakeholder Management You communicate complex technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and can align competing interests across operations, finance, risk, and customer experience teams
 Data-Driven Mindset You are data-driven and experimentation-oriented: you define metrics upfront, use A/B testing to optimize funnels, and let data guide your prioritization decisions
 What We Offer
 Extra benefits Enjoy discounts on SIXT rent, share, ride and SIXT+, attractive vehicle leasing offers, and exclusive deals with partners for travel, tech, fashion and more
 AI at your fingertips From day one, you'll have access to Claude by Anthropic and SIXTgpt, SIXT's own AI platform, to supercharge your work. We invest in every team member's AI journey: encouraging experimentation, building knowledge, and making sure you're ahead of the curve
 Mobility Boost You will receive a monthly allowance from us as a contribution to your individual mobility
 Future security We contribute to your retirement plan and support you with capital-forming benefits to ensure you are well covered
 Feel-good atmosphere Stay active with our modern SIXT gym, various leisure activities like the gaming area or the SIXT choir, and enjoy our high-quality employee restaurant
 Flexibility Enjoy 30 days of vacation and a hybrid working model with flexible hours
 Giving back Take one day each year to volunteer at a charitable organization dedicated to supporting children
 Additional Information
 About us:
 We are a globally leading mobility service provider with a revenue of €4.3 billion and around 9,000 employees worldwide. Our mobility platform ONE combines our products SIXT rent (car rental), SIXT share (car sharing), SIXT ride (taxi, ride, and chauffeur services), and SIXT+ (car subscription), giving our customers access to our fleet of 360,000 vehicles, the services of 4,000 cooperation partners, and around 5 million drivers worldwide. Together with our franchise partners, we are present in more than 100 countries at 2,000 rental stations. At SIXT, top-tier customer experience and outstanding customer service are our highest priorities. We believe in true entrepreneurship and long-term stability and align our corporate strategy with foresight. Get started with us and apply now!

title: Chief of Staff (m/w/d)
description:
WIR SUCHEN DICH! 
 Chief of Staff (m/w/d)  - Strategie mit Bodenhaftung
 DEINE MISSION 
 Als Chief of Staff arbeitest du direkt mit unseren Gründern und Geschäftsführern Paul und Julia auf Augenhöhe zusammen. Du sorgst dafür, dass ZukunftMoor fokussierter wächst, indem du Prioritäten klärst, strategische und operative Themen in die Umsetzung bringst, bereichsübergreifende Projekte verantwortest.
 Nach ein bis zwei Jahren kann sich daraus die Verantwortung für einen größeren operativen oder unternehmerischen Bereich entwickeln, abhängig von deinen Stärken, deinen Interessen und der weiteren Entwicklung von ZukunftMoor. Denkbare Perspektiven liegen beispielsweise in Finance, Operations, Business Development oder der Verantwortung für eine Tochtergesellschaft.
 DEINE ROLLE 
 Die Rolle lebt vom täglichen Wechsel zwischen Strategie und operativer Arbeit. Du arbeitest mit den Gründern an einer Entscheidung und setzte diese anschließend mit Finance, Research oder Operations praktisch um.
 Dabei bist du weder klassische Assistenz noch ausschließlich Koordinator. Du denkst mit, gibst eine eigene Einschätzung ab und übernimmst selbst Themen. Einige Aufgaben wirst du dauerhaft verantworten, andere zunächst aufbauen, strukturieren und später an den zuständigen Bereich übergeben.
 Deine Arbeit lässt sich in drei Bereiche gliedern:
 1) Mitdenker und Multiplikator der Gründer 
 Du unterstützt Paul und Julia bei der Priorisierung der richtigen Themen und bei der Umsetzung von Entscheidungen.
 Dazu gehört:
 Du strukturierst komplexe Fragestellungen und bereitest Entscheidungsoptionen mit einer klaren Empfehlung vor. Dabei erkennst du, wo Entscheidungen oder Informationen fehlen und springst rein. Du hinterfragst Annahmen und widersprichst Paul und Julia konstruktiv, wenn du zu einer anderen Einschätzung kommst.
 Du hältst die gemeinsamen Prioritäten im Blick und sorgst für klare Verantwortlichkeiten und nächste Schritte.
 Du bereitest Management- und Investorenthemen inhaltlich vor.
 Du kommunizierst auf allen Ebenen – insbesondere ins Team. Du erklärst Entscheidungen und Prioritäten verständlich, schaffst den notwendigen Kontext und sorgst dafür, dass alle Beteiligten wissen, was als Nächstes zu tun ist.
 2) Verantwortung für strategische und bereichsübergreifende Projekte 
 Du übernimmst Projekte, die für ZukunftMoor wichtig sind, aber noch nicht eindeutig in einem Bereich verankert sind. Du strukturierst die Aufgabe, bringst die Beteiligten zusammen und bleibst verantwortlich, bis ein belastbares Ergebnis erreicht ist.
 Mögliche Themen sind beispielsweise:
 die Steuerung unseres strategisch wichtigen Saatgutprojekts,
 die zeitweise operative Leitung des Bereichs Business Development sowie die Zusammenführung von Forschungsprojekten,
 die Weiterentwicklung des Vertragsmanagements und Einschätzung, wo Automatisierung und KI konkret helfen können.
 Du arbeitest dich dafür auch in Themen ein, die zunächst neu für dich sind. Neben Analyse und Projektsteuerung gehört dazu, selbst Unterlagen zu erstellen, Daten auszuwerten, offene Punkte zu klären und konkrete Aufgaben abzuarbeiten.
 3) Weiterentwicklung für Finance und Unternehmenssteuerung 
 Du entwickelst unsere Finanz- und Steuerungsprozesse, damit diese mit ZukunftMoor mitwachsen.
 Dazu gehört:
 Du standardisierst gemeinsam mit der Finanzbuchhaltung Prozesse und etablierst verlässliche Routinen und
 entwickelst darauf den Bereich Finance und Controlling weiter. Wo sinnvoll, evaluierst du den Einsatz KI-
 gestützter Arbeitsabläufe.
 Du baust einen pragmatischen Planungs- und Forecasting-Prozess auf, der alle Bereiche umfasst. Daran
 angekoppelt entwickelst du ein Management-Reporting, das finanzielle, operative und strategische
 Entwicklungen zusammenführt.
 Du kannst dabei das Thema Fibu verantworten, bis die Prozesse auf unser Wachstum ausgerichtet sind. Du solltest finanzielle Zusammenhänge dafür sicher verstehen, gerne mit Zahlen und Excel arbeiten und in der Lage sein, daraus klare Entscheidungsgrundlagen zu entwickeln.
 DEIN PROFIL 
 Wir schätzen Menschen mit Bodenhaftung. Dabei suchen wir nicht zwingend jemanden mit landwirtschaftlichem Hintergrund oder spezifischem Moorwissen, sondern vor allem einen analytisch starken Generalisten mit echtem Interesse an der praktischen Verbindung von Unternehmertum, Landwirtschaft und Klimaschutz:
 Sehr gut abgeschlossenes Studium, z. B. in Wirtschaft, Finance, Ingenieurwesen.
 Zwei bis fünf Jahre relevante Erfahrung, etwa in Strategieberatung, Startup Strategy & Operations oder einer
 unternehmerischen Rolle, PE/VC.
 Nachweisbare Verantwortung für komplexe Projekte, von der Analyse bis zur operativen Umsetzung.
 Sehr gutes Finanzverständnis und sicherer Umgang mit Excel, Finanzmodellen und Business Cases.
 Erfahrung mit den Wachstumsschmerzen junger Unternehmen und ein gutes Gespür dafür, wann pragmatisches
 Abarbeiten ausreicht und wann belastbare Strukturen notwendig sind. Dafür sind eine äußerst strukturierte und
 eigenständige Arbeitsweise sowie die Fähigkeit, mehrere anspruchsvolle Themen zu priorisieren, sehr wichtig.
 Strategisches Denken, Hands-on-Mentalität und Bereitschaft, selbst ins Detail zu gehen.
 Sehr klare Kommunikation auf allen Ebenen und die Fähigkeit, Orientierung und Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen.
 Sehr gutes Deutsch und Englisch sowie Bereitschaft zur regelmäßigen Präsenz in Gnarrenburg und zu
 projektbezogenen Reisen.
 DEIN ARBEITSORT 
 Unser zentraler operativer Standort ist Gnarrenburg. Die persönliche Zusammenarbeit vor Ort ist deshalb ein wichtiger Teil der Rolle. Daher ist geplant, dass du in der Regel drei bis vier Tage pro Woche in Gnarrenburg arbeitest, insbesondere dann, wenn das operative Team ebenfalls vor Ort ist.
 In Gnarrenburg stellen wir dir eine Unterkunft. Ergänzend kannst du aus dem Homeoffice arbeiten. Perspektivisch soll auch regelmäßiges Arbeiten in Hamburg möglich sein.
 DIE RAHMENBEDINGUNGEN 
 Vollzeit und unbefristete Festanstellung mit Mobility-Option
 Unterkunft

title: Chief of Staff to the CEO – FUTRUE Group
description:
Deine Mission bei uns 
 Gestalte die Zukunft von FUTRUE: Als Chief of Staff arbeitest Du direkt mit unserem CEO an der strategischen Agenda der gesamten Unternehmensgruppe. Du treibst als seine rechte Hand zentrale Prioritäten voran, steuerst bereichsübergreifende Projekte und sorgst dafür, dass aus strategischen Entscheidungen messbare Umsetzung wird. Ein zentraler Hebel unseres Wachstums und die oberste Priorität unseres CEO ist die Rekrutierung der weltweit besten Talente, daher verantwortest Du gleichzeitig den Bereich People & Talent.
 Du verbindest strategische Flughöhe mit operativer Umsetzungsstärke, denkst unternehmerisch und fühlst Dich in einem anspruchsvollen, dynamischen Umfeld wohl. Wenn Du Wirkung schaffen, Verantwortung übernehmen und ein Unternehmen auf das nächste Level heben willst, bist Du bei FUTRUE genau richtig.
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Du agierst als rechte Hand des CEOs und arbeitest gemeinsam mit ihm an den strategisch wichtigsten Themen der Unternehmensgruppe.
 Du analysierst komplexe, häufig unstrukturierte Fragestellungen und entwickelst pragmatische, umsetzbare Lösungen mit klaren Handlungsempfehlungen.
 Du berätst die Geschäftsführung strategisch, priorisierst Initiativen, bereitest Entscheidungen vor und managst Stakeholder.
 Du steuerst bereichsübergreifende Projekte von der Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung und stellst sicher, dass aus strategischen Entscheidungen messbare Ergebnisse werden.
 Du verantwortest die Talent-Strategie der Gruppe mit Fokus auf die Gewinnung der weltbesten Talente für Leadership- und Schlüsselpositionen.
 Du entwickelst den Bereich People & Talent als strategische Funktion weiter, führst das Team und baust FUTRUE als Arbeitgebermarke weiter auf.
 Dein Profil 
 Du verfügst über einen exzellenten Studienabschluss einer führenden Universität.
 Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung, idealerweise mit 2+ Jahren in einer Unternehmensberatung, im Venture Capital, Private Equity oder in einem vergleichbar anspruchsvollen, dynamischen und leistungsorientierten Umfeld.
 Du verstehst, wie man A-Player identifiziert und gewinnt — aus eigener Erfahrung oder weil Du selbst in Hochleistungsteams gearbeitet hast.
 Du willst etwas bewegen, denkst unternehmerisch und legst großen Wert auf Qualität und Details.
 Du arbeitest hochanalytisch, strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert und behältst auch in komplexen Situationen den Überblick.
 Du hast eine Hands‑on‑Mentalität, hohe Eigeninitiative sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten.
 Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.
 Über uns 
 FUTRUE ist mehr als eine international ausgerichtete Healthcare-Gruppe!  Konzeption und Umsetzung der AI-First-Roadmap von FOSTEC & Company: Delivery-Modelle, Prozesse und Wissensmanagement konsequent KI-nativ neu denken

 Hohe IT-Kompetenz, idealerweise Studium der Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbar, und täglicher Umgang mit KI-Tools
 Ausgeprägte Organisationsfähigkeit sowie strukturierte und eigenständige Arbeitsweise
 Unternehmerisches Denken und Handeln
 Übernahme von Verantwortung für End-to-End-Prozesse, vom Konzept bis zum Ergebnis
 1–4 Jahre Erfahrung in Strategieberatung, Start-up, Venture Building oder Private Equity
 Deutsch auf C2-Niveau und verhandlungssicheres Englisch in Wort und Schrift
 Warum FOSTEC?

 Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Managing Partner und unmittelbarer Impact auf die strategische Ausrichtung
 Gestaltungsraum für den Aufbau einer AI-First-Beratung statt Verwaltung des Status quo
 Vielfältige Einblicke in Strategieberatung, Private Equity und Company Building in den Beteiligungen der FOSTEC Ventures GmbH

 Klarer Entwicklungspfad bis hin zu Managementverantwortung in einer Beteiligung der FOSTEC Ventures GmbH

 Über uns
 Als eine der führenden unabhängigen Strategieberatungen entwickeln wir bei FOSTEC & Company durch unsere Expertise in den Bereichen künstliche Intelligenz (KI), Digitalisierung und E-Commerce für unsere Kunden eine zukunftsfähige Gesamtstrategie und daran angeknüpft digitale Geschäftsmodelle und E-Commerce-Distributionsstrategien. title: IT Project Manager SCM Warehousing (m/f/d)
description:
Knauf stands for opportunity. This exciting role offers you the ideal opportunity to begin and further develop an impressive career within a values-driven culture. 
 As a global building materials manufacturer with 43,500 employees in 90 countries , we offer diverse opportunities to ambitious talent. We value every contribution and are committed to creating a safe and inclusive work environment with the aim of developing sustainable solutions for a better future .
 Knauf Information Services GmbH is proud to be a part of the Knauf Group. With a long-standing tradition, and a growing international presence, we are seeking dedicated individuals to help us achieve our long-term vision.

 Do you consider the future and upcoming generations in your actions?

 What you'll do 
 Lead the rollout, upgrade and continuous optimisation of SAP EWM warehouse solutions, including connected automation systems such as MFS, AGVs and YM
 Own project planning and delivery from initial setup through testing, go-live and hypercare
 Act as the functional SAP EWM lead, coordinating IT Process Managers, Application Specialists, developers, testers, key users and external partners

 Drive change and adoption while identifying relevant innovations, new SAP EWM capabilities and technologies to improve warehouse and related logistics processes
 Who you are 
 Bring a strong track record of leading or co-leading SAP EWM logistics projects, ideally in an international environment
 Combine sound SAP EWM and warehouse-management expertise with a strong understanding of end-to-end business processes and IT
 Communicate confidently with both technical and business stakeholders, building alignment across diverse, cross-functional teams
 Take ownership, enjoy guiding colleagues and partners, and drive projects through to successful delivery
 Work confidently with project-management approaches and tools such as ServiceNow, Jira and MS Project; bring initial experience of agile methods, fluent English and German, and a willingness to travel occasionally to Knauf locations worldwide
 What we offer you 
 We all shape our lives individually. As an employer, we play a significant role in the daily life of our employees and aim to support them with various offerings. This includes, among other things:
 Security : Permanent employment contract in a stable, successful family-owned company.
 Flexibility : 30 days of vacation, special leave for certain occasions, flexitime account with a broad time window for flexible working and weekly home office days.
 Fitness and health : Discounts on various sports and leisure activities (e.g., fitness studio Iphofen, swimming training, soccer, etc.), as well as opportunities for active health promotion through our company doctor and occupational health and safety offers.
 Daily time savings: Ample parking and access to public transport (train, bus).
 Welcome approach : Individual onboarding days, company and team events
 Career and professional development : Individual support and promotion for part-time studies, further education and training.
 Benefits and vouchers : Discounts on well-known brands and reduced-price employee purchases.
 Bike leasing : Using tax advantages while promoting your own health.
 Relocation support : Assistance with international relocation
 Knauf as an employer

A team of 500 highly qualified experts is committed to supporting the Group and its customers worldwide with innovative IT solutions and customized services. The core competencies of Knauf IT cover a wide range of IT services, including the development and implementation of complex software solutions, the optimization of business processes through digital technologies and ensuring IT security and data protection.
 The Knauf Group is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment, and we make all personnel decisions across all areas of our company based on experience, skills and integrity. We encourage applicants from all walks of life to apply for our positions, regardless of age, gender, gender identity, disability, sexual orientation, origin, religion and so forth. 
 Share our values and become part of the team to shape the future of Knauf together.

title: Data & Project Manager (All Genders)
description:
Hey!
 Imagine amateur football finally had the platform it deserves.
 Every weekend, millions of people write their own personal football stories – on pitches, in clubs and on the sidelines. We believe this passion deserves a digital home too.
 That's Exactly What We're Building Every Single Day.
 tl;dr
We're looking for someone who turns data into real insights - you'll own our Teamwear partner reporting and lead our Data Squad.
Main information
 Start: Immediately
 Location: Cologne 
 Workload: Full-time
 Team: Teamwear
 Is this a match?
The most important basics – so we both know if it could work.
 Location: You can see yourself in our Cologne office (Belgisches Viertel) and are able to come in at least 3 days a week.
 Experience: You bring 2-5 years of experience in analytics, BizOps, key account or project management and feel confident in the role.
 Languages are no problem: You speak German and English fluently.
 You know football: You're genuinely interested in amateur football and have a feel for what moves this community.
 Startup spirit: You'd rather shape things than just tick boxes - even when that means figuring stuff out without a finished roadmap.
 What you'll do - your playing field
 This is how you move our mission forward every day.
 You're the mind behind our partner reporting. From the monthly update to the quarterly business meeting and the half-yearly market share report - it all comes together with you.
 You find the story in the data. You work with data on tens of thousands of amateur teams and turn it into insights and recommendations that actually make a difference.
 You’re the go-to person for our partner. You prepare our meetings with our partner, are the main contact for our counterpart there and present your results with confidence.
 You lead our Data Squad. Together with our working students and mini-jobbers, you set priorities, split the work and make sure the data is clean.
 You get our Teamwear KR projects over the line and keep track of the department’s KPIs. You plan, keep an eye on progress and bring the whole team along.
 In addition to your core responsibilities, you will also:
 Prepare ad-hoc analyses and presentations for the Head of Teamwear and the founders
 Run the weekly Jour Fixe and company reporting for Teamwear
 Build market analyses for our European expansion
 What you bring to the team
We're not looking for a perfect CV. But you should recognise yourself in these points.
 Reporting: You’ve prepared recurring reporting before and turned it into a management-ready deck.
 Data storytelling: You turn numbers into a clear storyline with a recommendation and present it confidently to management.
 Team coordination: You've led or coordinated small teams, working students or freelancers.
 Structure: You keep the overview even when lots is going on - and you enjoy bringing all the pieces together.
 Communication: You communicate confidently - internally and with external partners.
 Tools: Google Sheets / Excel at an advanced level (pivots, lookups), Google Slides / PowerPoint, Notion or similar with database logic (tables, joins, filters), AI tools in your daily work
 Good to know
 We want you to know what this role really looks like from day one.
 This role is all about coordination, reporting and partner communication - less about strategy consulting or data engineering. A big part of your month follows a steady reporting rhythm with clear deadlines. If you like that kind of reliability, you’ll feel right at home.
 You'll stand in front of a major brand partner's management and lead a small team at the same time - if both excite you, you're in exactly the right place.
 Bonus
Not a must – but this'll definitely earn you extra points.
 Experience in sporting goods, teamwear or team sports
 Basic SQL or a BI tool
 The Prematch Setup
We want you to love joining us - and still love being part of the team a long time from now.
 Employee participation (VSOP) - directly benefit from the company’s success.
 Modern tech setup - We provide the tools and devices you need to be productive.
 AI-powered work - We use AI tools to work smarter and more efficiently, and provide you with the tools you need to make the most of AI in your day-to-day work.
 27 vacation days per year - For your rest and to recharge. Plus special arrangements if you’re a parent, so you can better balance family and relaxation.
 Remote work - depending on your distance to the office, you work 1–3 days a week onsite and the rest flexibly remote - whatever suits you best. Tech & Product roles sometimes offer 100% remote.
 Three cool offices in Cologne, Berlin, and London - true startup vibes to work and grow together. Want to visit another office? We support that too!
 Remote, even from afar - Whether it’s a week of sunshine abroad or a few days with family - we allow flexible work from outside your usual location.
 Team events at our locations - Whether after work in Cologne, Berlin, or London: we regularly bring teams together to connect and grow stronger.
 Offsites with the whole team - Four days out of the daily grind with the entire team: trips, brainstorming, onsite collaboration, and real team spirit.
 Still here? Sounds like a pretty good match.
If you've made it this far, we hope we've managed to show you one thing: how we work, what we believe in and why this role at PREMATCH is something special.
Maybe this is exactly the moment you've been waiting for: a team that thinks big, a vision that actually moves things and the chance to help reshape amateur football digitally – together with us.
 Now it's your turn.
 Hit Apply now and upload your CV - that’s all we need to get started.
 Tell us a bit more about yourself in our short application form - and you’re in the game!

title: Product Manager
description:
About the Job 
 Neptune Software is the AI execution layer for SAP. Enterprises are moving from software that records to software that acts — AI agents running routine work while people govern the exceptions. What stands in the way isn't the models; it's that the logic agents need to act on is locked inside SAP. Neptune runs inside the customer's own landscape and makes that logic executable by AI: agent-ready context, governed tools, and applications where agents act under the customer's own authorizations, with guardrails enforced by the platform — not by the prompt. With Naia, our AI layer, teams build from natural language and deploy agents on ECC today that carry to S/4HANA unchanged, always at Clean Core. SAP-certified, 500+ enterprises, fifteen years in production: we are where core business systems learn to act.
 Location 
 Remote - Portugal
 Position 
 As a Product Manager, you will act as a conduit between our customers, all our internal teams, and the community at large. You will work with clients to understand their needs and desires and use your technical and communication skills to align them to internal workstreams within Engineering, Solution Consulting, and Marketing. In addition, you will work closely with our Customer Success department.
 As a Product Manager, you will explore and develop product ideas, whether as a result of discussions with clients and partners, via market research, or by investigating open-source technologies. You will help craft, manage, and roll out comprehensive enablement material via marketing channels, community content, and social media.
 You will be hands on with the products and services that our internal and external customers utilize, understanding its benefits and limitations, focusing on bringing the best out of every facet of the platform and the supporting ecosystem.
 Responsibilities 
 Thorough understanding of the overall market, leading vendors, and open-source technologies
 Work closely with stakeholders (customers, partners, and community) to understand needs and priorities
 Translate market and stakeholder needs into product requirements
 Collaborate with Engineering and Solution Consulting team on feature ideas to prioritize and bring potential solutions to life
 Drive the Business Development in close alignment with our Customer Success team as well as the Sales team
 Become the Company’s Product Advocate and outbound spokesperson via video content, podcasts, webinars, and written releases
 Co-own product specifications, requirements, and release plans
 Collect and synthesize inputs from Engineering, Sales, Marketing team, and the general market to lead business and products direction
 Partner with cross-functional teams to ensure quality product output, timeliness, and market requirements
 Drive and operate internal Project Management and Pre-Sales topics in collaboration with other teams in Neptune Software
 Nurture and grow developer (& partner) community, Neptune Heroes, Social Media presence Create internal and external technical enablement material and collaterals for internal (Pre-Sales) and external audiences (Academy, E-Learning, and Classroom-Training)
 Create internal competitive analysis content
 Maintain a growing library of Marketplace items, consisting of modular Application Building Blocks to comprehensive Add-On solutions designed to enhance the product offering
 Contribute towards the roll out of our innovative AI Assistant integration
 Assist with various internal project initiatives to help improve quality of work and service within the business and for our customers
 Contribute toward the management and improvement of the public facing demo environment
 Qualifications 
 Bachelor/Master’s degree in computer science or software product management
 3 - 7 years of software product management or related experience
 Strong technical aptitude — comfortable with software architecture concepts and hands-on with AI tools; formal coding experience is helpful but not essential
 Exceptional strategic communications skills
 Experience with enterprise architecture
 A confident and trusted advisor who can provide accurate inside into market development and client needs
 Customer and service-oriented mindset and like to pass on knowledge and experience
 Networking is not a foreign concept, you have the ability to build effective working relationships and work closely with our global go-to-market team and local sales team, but also with our customers and partners
 Able to work both independently and as part of a team
 Team player with an entrepreneurial mindset and a hands-on mentality in a hyper-growth environment
 Strategic mindset, long-term-planning with passion for detail and excellence
 First-class written skills in English
 Comfortable working in Confluence and GitHub — documenting specs and decisions, and navigating repos, issues, and pull requests alongside Engineering
 Experience with low-code / no-code application platforms is a plus, not a requirement — we will train the right candidate
 SAP knowledge (ECC, S/4HANA, or ABAP/SAP development) is a plus, not a requirement
 Microsoft or cloud platform technology know-how is welcome
 What we offer 
 International work environment;
 Emerging and leading technology;
 Work on exciting projects for the largest companies in the world;
 The opportunity to be part of a success story.
 Competitive salary and benefits.
 Opportunity to build real things and make a difference by putting your code into production.
 A flexible and fun place to work.
 Please note 
 We welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Product Manager – Mapal Operating System (MoS) 
 We’re looking for a Product Manager to join our team at Mapal and take ownership of Mapal Operating System (MoS) — the core platform that connects and powers all Mapal products.
 MoS acts as the source of truth for our global ecosystem: it hosts shared data, global services, and cross-product functionalities that make the entire Mapal suite work seamlessly together.
 This role is ideal for someone who understands technology deeply, enjoys solving complex problems, and is comfortable navigating unfamiliar territory — turning technical foundations and ambiguity into scalable, valuable product experiences.
 🚀 Your Mission: 
 Define and drive the product strategy for MoS, ensuring it provides a robust, unified backbone for all Mapal applications. You’ll collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Customer Success, Data, and Operations to evolve MoS as a truly global platform, connecting business and customer needs with technical possibilities.
 🛠 What You’ll Do: 
 🔹Define and own the product vision and roadmap for MoS.
 🔹Partner closely with Engineering to translate architectural and infrastructure needs into clear product goals, requirements, and deliverables.
 🔹Navigate complex and evolving product areas , digging into unfamiliar topics and limited documentation to uncover requirements, dependencies, and opportunities for improvement.
 🔹Work with Engineering throughout the full product lifecycle , from discovery and delivery to troubleshooting, bug fixing, and continuous improvement.
 🔹Ensure data consistency and interoperability across all Mapal products.
 🔹Drive the development of shared services such as notifications, authentication, integrations, and analytics that can be reused across the ecosystem.
 🔹Collaborate with other Product Managers to identify and prioritise cross-product functionalities that should live in MoS.
 🔹Contribute to technical design discussions , ensuring alignment between business goals, customer needs, and technical feasibility.
 🔹 Leverage AI throughout the product development lifecycle to improve discovery, analysis, delivery, testing, and product optimisation.
 🔹Establish metrics and dashboards to measure the adoption, stability, and performance of MoS.
 🔹Build strong relationships across Engineering, Product, Customer Success, and Operations , effectively navigating different perspectives and priorities.
 🧩 You Are: 
 🔹A Product Manager with 6+ years of experience in Product Management or Product Ownership within a SaaS or platform-based environment .
 🔹Experienced in working closely with Engineering on complex technical products , from discovery and requirements definition through delivery and continuous improvement.
 🔹Comfortable working with APIs, system architecture, and data modelling .
 🔹Experienced in using AI throughout product development , beyond general-purpose productivity tools.
 🔹Someone who can quickly understand unfamiliar and complex systems, connect the dots, and turn ambiguity into structured product requirements .
 🔹A strong communicator with excellent stakeholder management and interpersonal skills , able to build effective relationships across technical and non-technical teams.
 🔹 Curious, resilient, detail-oriented, and hands-on , with the drive to dig deeper when the answer isn’t immediately obvious.
 🔹Comfortable working in a fast-moving environment , balancing technical complexity, business priorities, and customer needs.
 🔹Experienced in hospitality technology ? Even better 😉
 ✨ About Mapal 
 We are a fast-growing B2B SaaS company transforming how hospitality businesses operate through technology. Mapal Group provides an integrated platform that helps restaurants, hotels, and contract catering brands optimise operations, empower their teams, and scale efficiently. 
 Operating across Europe, the UK, and LATAM, we continue to expand our footprint as we accelerate our growth. 
 💜 Life at Mapal 
 Our culture is shaped by six core values: Commitment, Customer Obsession, One Team, Ownership, Resilience, and Think Big . These values drive everything we do, from how we support our customers to how we work together as a team. We seek individuals who bring curiosity and creativity to their work, take ownership of their contributions, build strong relationships, and embrace collaboration and innovation to achieve ambitious goals. 
 🤝 Everyone’s Welcome 
 At Mapal, we believe our differences make us stronger. We’re proud to offer equal opportunities to everyone, no matter your background, identity, or life experience. What matters most to us is your talent, your passion, and the ideas you bring to our team.

title: Product Manager - Plateforme d'IA generative
description:
SFEIR 💻 Product Manager / Product Owner — Plateforme d'IA générative 
 Sharp Tech. Real Impact 
 Équipe : RAISE Core · Contrat : CDI · Lieu : France — hybride / remote-friendly — minimum 2 jours/mois à Paris
 🔎 Qui sommes-nous ? 🔍 
 SFEIR est un catalyseur d'innovation technologique à la pointe de la révolution IA. Nous transformons les organisations en créant un impact tangible et durable — non pas en suivant les tendances, mais en les industrialisant à côté de nos clients.
 Notre conviction : l'IA agentique bien orchestrée permet une accélération massive sur les cycles de livraison. Les organisations qui prendront de l'avance ne seront pas celles qui adopteront l'IA le plus tôt, mais celles qui sauront l'industrialiser avec méthode. C'est exactement ce que nous faisons à travers notre approche du Context Engineering, notre partenariat avec Anthropic et notre plateforme GenAI RAISE.
 Nos chiffres clés :
 950 consultants passionnés par la tech et augmentés par l'IA
 8 agences en France, au Luxembourg et à Bruxelles
 Partenaire Anthropic Select au sein du volet Services du Claude Partner Network
 15 ans de partenariat avec Google Cloud, Partner of the Year à plusieurs reprises, et un écosystème de partenaires premium (AWS, Microsoft, Scaleway, S3NS, Databricks, Snowflake, Confluent, dbt…)
 +100 clients actifs et +5000 personnes formées par an via SFEIR Institute
 🚀 RAISE en deux mots 🚀 
 RAISE (Responsible AI Sovereign Engine) est la plateforme d'IA générative souveraine de SFEIR : créer, déployer et gouverner des assistants IA branchés sur la connaissance de l'entreprise — assez simple pour que les métiers déploient un cas d'usage en autonomie, assez cadré pour que la DSI et le RSSI gardent le contrôle (gouvernance, RBAC, audit, maîtrise des coûts, souveraineté FR/EU, zéro lock-in).
 La plateforme est déjà en production chez de grands comptes et sort une version majeure tous les 3 à 4 mois. On ne part pas d'une feuille blanche : on fait grandir un produit vivant, utilisé, avec de vrais enjeux d'échelle, de gouvernance et de fiabilité.
 💻 Ton futur rôle 💻 
 Faire évoluer la plateforme RAISE de bout en bout — du back au front — et contribuer au support de dans le bon ordre, avec une ligne de vue claire : vision → stratégie → roadmap.
 Aujourd'hui la roadmap est tenue à temps partagé par un Delivery Manager, le CSM et le Lead Dev. Ta venue crée un rôle produit dédié au cœur de l'équipe Core.
 📅 Ton quotidien 📅 
 Maintenir la roadmap NOW / NEXT / LATER comme un livrable vivant : des bets (paris) outcome-first, chacun relié à un objectif stratégique et tracé jusqu'à la preuve qui le justifie (pull client, données d'usage, discovery). Confiance graduée honnêtement, pas de dates gravées dans le marbre.
 Gérer le backlog des développements en cours (GitHub) : découper, prioriser, spécifier, arbitrer — animer le Roadmap RAISE hebdo
 Qualifier et arbitrer les remontées support (Comop) : priorisation, alignement vision produit, au contact des Delivery Managers, du CSM et du support.
 Faire de la discovery continue : parler aux clients et aux champions métier, confronter les paris au réel, promouvoir/rétrograder les items selon la preuve.
 Évaluer les 4 risques avant d'engager : valeur métier, utilisabilité (les clients l'utiliseront-ils ?), faisabilité (avec l'équipe tech), viabilité business (légal, sécurité, vente).
 Naviguer la tension des deux personas : la vitesse du champion métier vs le contrôle de la DSI/RSSI — c'est le filtre maître de chaque décision produit sur RAISE.
 De « Product Owner » à « Product Builder » 
 Ce poste est pensé pour évoluer . RAISE expose déjà un serveur MCP à Claude Code , et un agent interne assiste déjà l'équipe sur le triage et la rédaction d'issues. La direction que nous voulons prendre : un·e product manager qui prototype et implémente lui/elle-même certaines fonctionnalités avec Claude Code — pour raccourcir la boucle idée → preuve → produit, valider un risque valeur ou utilisabilité par un vrai prototype plutôt qu'un slide, et livrer les petits incréments sans mobiliser toute l'équipe.
 Ce n'est pas un prérequis au démarrage — c'est une trajectoire . Si l'idée d'écrire du produit avec un agent de code t'enthousiasme, c'est exactement le bon endroit.
 Notre philosophie produit 
 Marty Cagan ( Inspired / Empowered / Transformed ) : outcomes over output , équipes empowered à qui on confie des problèmes (pas des specs), discovery continue , et refus du « feature factory ». La roadmap est un artefact de communication — ce sur quoi on travaille et pourquoi — pas un plan de projet daté.
 👉Profil recherché👈🏽 
 Indispensable 
 • Expérience confirmée en Product Management / Product Ownership sur un produit logiciel (SaaS / plateforme B2B).
 • Culture IA générative (LLM, RAG, agents, gouvernance) et de ses enjeux entreprise.
 • Pratique d' outils de code assistés par IA (Claude Code ou équivalent)
 • Tu sais prioriser sous incertitude et dire non.
 • Français courant, anglais courant.
 Apprécié 
 • Aisance technique réelle : tu lis du code, tu dialogues d'égal à égal avec des développeurs, tu comprends une architecture et ses contraintes de faisabilité.
 • Expérience du dual persona métier / DSI-sécurité, ou de la vente/déploiement grands comptes.
 • Sensibilité design / UX.
 ✨ Pourquoi nous rejoindre ✨ 
 Travailler sur un produit qui compte : de l'IA générative souveraine, gouvernée, déployée chez des grands comptes européens — pas un énième POC.
 Relever un vrai défi d'ingénierie : une plateforme IA déployable partout, fiable et souveraine.
 Rejoindre une équipe performante : craft, décisions rapides, standards de qualité non négociables.
 Grandir chez SFEIR : communautés, veille, montée en compétence continue, événements tech.
 🤝 Notre process de recrutement 🤝 
 Échange RH avec Vanessa → entretien technique avec l'équipe Core → mise en situation courte → rencontre avec le CPTO.
 ———————————————————————————

title: Senior Product Manager, Employer of Record
description:
About RemotePass
 RemotePass is a global employment, payroll, and spend platform that helps companies hire, pay, and support talent in 150+ countries. Recognised as one of G2's Top 100 Fastest Growing Software Products, we're on a mission to break down geographical barriers and create a world where exceptional talent can thrive anywhere.
From hiring and onboarding to payroll, compliance, and financial services, we give organisations everything they need to build high-performing global teams, and give workers worldwide access to opportunities that were once out of reach.
We're backed by world-class investors including EBRD Venture Capital, 500 Global, Endeavor Catalyst, BECO Capital, Wamda Capital, 212 VC, Oraseya Capital, Khwarizmi Ventures, and Access Bridge Ventures.
 About The Role
 Employer of Record is the core of our business. We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own our EOR product end to end and make it the best in the market. You'll sit in the Product & Operations team with a direct line to the CEO.
This role is about depth and craft, not a big title. You'll own the full employee lifecycle, from quotes and onboarding to compliance, benefits, and offboarding, along with the internal tooling and AI agents that run behind it.
We're also moving our product organisation from delivery-led to discovery-led, and EOR leads that shift. The scope is real from day one.
 What You'll Do
 Own the full EOR lifecycle. Quotes, onboarding, contracts, country compliance, benefits, changes during employment, and offboarding. Know where it breaks today, and fix it
 Set the roadmap. Decide what gets built and what doesn't, and defend those calls
 Lead discovery. Spend real time with customers, prospects, employees, and our operations teams, and set the standard for discovery-led product at RemotePass
 Turn noise into direction. Distil CS escalations, ops pain, sales objections, prospect calls, and support tickets into a clear, prioritised view of what matters. Make your reasoning visible so the business knows where it stands
 Go deep on countries. EOR runs on a mix of our own entities and in-country partners, each with its own rules. Turn employment law, compliance requirements, and country-specific flows into product that works at scale
 Build the machinery behind EOR. Own the internal platforms and AI agents behind EOR operations, including onboarding and contract automation, compliance checks, ops workflows, and support tooling, so operations can scale without adding headcount
 Drive execution across time zones. Connect product, engineering, operations, and go-to-market, and work closely with Payroll where EOR and payroll meet. Drive outcomes without waiting for a room to walk into
 Requirements
 What We're Looking For
 5+ years in product, with hands-on ownership of EOR, HR tech, or complex B2B workflow products such as onboarding, compliance, or operations platforms

title: Senior Product Manager - Asphalt Legends
description:
About Gameloft
 Here at Gameloft, we create moments of happiness for our players all over the world through exciting gaming experiences. This is our mission, and it has been the same for over 25 years. We are the proud creators of Asphalt, Dungeon Hunter, Modern Combat, and over 200 other great games.
 There is a game for everyone, and we are now expanding to cross-platform games on PC and consoles, with titles such as Disney Speedstorm and Disney Dreamlight Valley, to provide our players with even more amazing adventures.
 With more than 3,000 passionate Gamelofters across the globe, we take great pride in our differences and draw on them to create games just as diverse as we are.
 If you’re looking for a new challenge and want to work with a bold and talented group of people, don’t hesitate to join the game!
 Job description
 As Senior Product Manager for Asphalt Legends , you will be a key figure behind the game’s financial health and long-term sustainability.
 Together with the Game Manager and key stakeholders, you will orchestrate the revenue strategy across the product lifecycle, balancing aggressive growth in engagement and monetization with AAA player experience.
 You are not just managing a product; you are scaling a global racing phenomenon.
 YOUR CHALLENGES & RESPONSIBILITIES
 Strategic Vision: Partner with Game Leadership (Game Manager, Design, and Marketing) to define the roadmap for future years, ensuring the game’s vision aligns with aggressive commercial targets. 
 Live Ops Excellence: Drive a high-performance Live Operations strategy focused on two pillars: Data-Driven Growth: Continuous optimization of events and offers to maximize LTV and ARPU. 
 Operational Efficiency: Streamlining workflows and automating processes to reduce production times and costs. 
 Monetization Innovation: Own the end-to-end lifecycle of new monetization systems—from conceptual design to post-launch optimization—while constantly auditing existing systems for untapped potential. 
 Data Leadership: Lead hypothesis-driven development by overseeing A/B testing, deep-dive data analysis, and KPI forecasting models to de-risk major business decisions. 
 Mentorship & Influence: Act as a force multiplier for the product team, mentoring junior PMs and fostering a culture of excellence. 
 Organizational Evangelist: Serve as the primary business voice for Asphalt 9 to internal and external stakeholders, elevating the game’s profile across the entire organization. 
 Qualifications:
 6+ years of experience in Product Management of F2P games (Mobile, PC, or Console). 
 Proven Impact. A track record of significantly moving the needle on monetization and retention for top-tier live titles. 
 Analytical Mastery. Exceptional ability to translate complex data sets into actionable business insights. Proficiency in advanced analytics tools is expected. 
 Excellent presentation and documentation skills , with the ability to distill complex strategies into compelling narratives for executive leadership. 
 Bachelor’s degree in economics, business management, marketing, or related field.
An MBA or advanced degree is highly valued. 
 Fluent English, both written and spoken .
 BONUS POINTS
 Experience as Product Manager or similar role in other markets. 
 Design Mindset. Strong grasp of Game Design fundamentals and behavioral economics. 
 Deep passion for, or professional experience with Racing Games. 
 Experience with Cross-Platform games or experience in both mobile and PC/Console. 
 Experience in a role that implied team management duties. 
 Why Join the World of Gameloft?
 Because you want to be part of an exceptional experience within a company that is constantly growing!
 Because you want to work with talented people who are industry pioneers!
 Because you want to be part of an international environment with daily contact with other countries & cultures!
 Because you want to work in an inclusive equal opportunity workplace!
 Or, just because you’re looking for a great place to work!
 Benefits:
 Permanent contract, full-time job with excellent Social Benefits. 
 25 vacation days per year
 Private medical health insurance
 Flexible compensation with Ticket Restaurant Card
 Flexible work from home hybrid model
 Free language courses
 Birthday day off!
 1 month of remote work
 Merit based salary progression system and a competitive initial salary package. 
 Career-development opportunities. 
 Excellent local working conditions (quality of offices, geographical location of office in the centre of Barcelona). 
 ... and Thursday afterwork beers!
 We can’t wait to find our next great talent!
 Join our team, recently recognized in Forbes' top 100 companies to work for! We're gamers from all walks of life, united in creating a culture of inclusivity. Partnering with organizations like COGAM, we ensure a safe workplace for everyone, regardless of background or gaming preference. Whether you're a casual or hardcore gamer on any platform (we're cross-platform now!), we want you to feel like you belong. Be part of shaping the gaming industry with us!
 Please note that only selected candidates will be contacted and your CV will be saved in our files for a period of 6 months.
 Want to know more? Please visit our Website: www.gameloft.com
 If the offer interests you, Join the Game!

title: Staff Product Manager, Enterprise Deployment Solutions | Spain | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Spain.
 About Product Management
 As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.
Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.
The role
As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes Grafana Federal Cloud , for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) , which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.
Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.
Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.
As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will:
 Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value against engineering cost and technical constraints
 Own positioning, messaging, and differentiation for these products, including how they compare to regular Grafana Cloud, and partner with Product Marketing on launches, competitive analysis, enablement, and demand programs
 Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity
 Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options
 Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal to work through product changes affecting our authorization or existing customer commitments
 We’re excited about you because you have
 5+ years of product management experience on a technical B2B product, or a technical background (software engineering, solutions architecture, SRE, or technical program management) plus a demonstrated move into product ownership
 Hands-on experience with a non-standard SaaS deployment model, such as self-managed, air-gapped, sovereign, BYOC, single-tenant, or FedRAMP/government cloud, and a firsthand understanding of how it changes the product, its operations, and its economics
 Experience with cloud infrastructure, platform software, or developer tools
 Clear product and go-to-market judgment: you've shaped what a product should be and how it's positioned and sold, not only when it ships
 Interest in working with US public sector customers and learning their needs and buying cycles. Deep compliance expertise isn't required.
 Experience leading across multiple teams without direct authority, with excellent written and verbal communication in a remote, globally distributed organization
 Bonus Points
 Experience selling to or building for US federal, state, or local government customers, or other highly regulated industries
 Familiarity with government or sovereign cloud frameworks, such as FedRAMP, StateRAMP/GovRAMP, BSI C5, or SecNumCloud, or with offering

title: Senior Product Manager, Identity & Risk Intelligence
description:
This is Adyen
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.
For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.
 The Opportunity
 We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead our Anti-Money Laundering (AML) detection product within Identity & Risk Intelligence. Financial crime keeps getting more complex, and as Adyen expands into new products and markets, our detection needs to scale with it - without becoming a bottleneck for growth.
This role needs a Product Manager who can take a clear strategy and drive it to execution, make strong trade-offs, and build trust with Compliance and other senior stakeholders. You need a track record of building ML-driven products in a regulated environment. You'll lead a team of Data Scientists, Data Analysts and Backend Engineers, and work closely with Compliance, Operations and other product teams.
 What You'll Do
 Risk Detection & ML Modeling- Lead the build and scaling of Machine Learning models, rules and risk signals that detect financial crimes across Adyen's products, markets and customer base.
 Scalable, Self-Service Detection- Move financial crime detection toward a self-service framework that picks up new typologies quickly, using ML, GenAI and agentic approaches to reduce manual effort and keep pace with Adyen's growth without adding headcount.
 Strategy Execution & Prioritization- Own the execution of the financial crime detection strategy. Prioritize ruthlessly, make data-driven trade-offs, and stop or descope work when the evidence shows it is not worth pursuing.
 Compliance & Regulatory Partnership- Act as the main product partner for Compliance. Translate regulatory expectations into clear product boundaries, agree how the team delivers within them, and demonstrate continuous improvement to regulators.
 Performance & Effectiveness- Define how detection quality and efficiency are measured in a domain where the ground truth is often unknown, and continuously improve signal quality for our Investigations team.
 Cross-Functional Leadership- Lead a team of Data Scientists, Data Analysts and Backend Engineers alongside your engineering lead, and keep Compliance, Operations, and other risk teams aligned on the roadmap.
 Who You Are
 Experience- 8+ years of Product Management experience building ML-driven, high-scale products in fast-growing tech or fintech environments. 2+ years of experience in AML, fraud detection or financial crime.
 ML Product Expertise- Proven track record of owning and scaling ML-driven products such as detection, scoring or risk models. Comfortable going deep with Data Scientists on model performance, evaluation and trade-offs.
 Regulated Environment- Experience building products in highly regulated environments such as payments, banking or fintech, with a solid understanding of how regulation shapes product decisions.
 Stakeholder Management- Strong influence with senior and opinionated stakeholders, especially Compliance, Legal and Risk. Able to hold a position, explain the reasoning and keep their trust.
 Decision-Making- Clear, data-driven trade-offs and the confidence to say no. Comfortable owning outcomes without a single clean success metric.
 Ownership- Highly autonomous and accountable, able to take an agreed strategy and drive it through execution.
 Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at Adyen
 We actively seek different perspectives to sharpen our ideas. Our unique culture is a product of our diverse backgrounds and experiences. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome to be your true self at Adyen.
 If you need accommodations or support during the recruitment process to perform at your best, you’ll have the opportunity to let our team know in your application. We encourage people from all backgrounds and abilities to apply.
 What’s next?
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.
This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

You operate across both strategic and operational levels – shaping product direction while working closely with teams to ensure efficient delivery. Your soft skills are strong and you know how to navigate having many different stakeholders in a dynamic environment, as well as manage both upwards, sideways and downwards. You are the type of person that takes ownership, and with a pragmatic mindset, you balance innovation, cost awareness, and technical feasibility to deliver competitive solutions that create real business value.
 How You'll Make An Impact
 Act as Product Manager for OT software and SCADA-related solutions, owning prioritization and value delivery across agile teams
 Translate real-world wind farm operational challenges into product requirements, ensuring solutions are practical and customer-focused
 Balance strategic roadmap ownership with hands-on involvement in agile delivery teams
 Drive prioritization based on business value, cost efficiency, and technical feasibility
 Identify technology trends and partnerships that support scalable, maintainable, and competitive solutions
 What You Bring
 Master’s degree in software engineering or similar combined with strong experience in Wind Power SCADA systems and OT environments
 Hands-on understanding of wind farm operations and the challenges faced by operators and service organizations
 Proven experience working both strategically and operationally within Product Management or similar roles
 Strong business mindset with focus on cost efficiency, maintainability, and pragmatic decision-making
 Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and business domains
 Who is Siemens Energy?
 At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With +100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemensenergy.com/employeevideo
 Our Commitment to Diversity
 Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
 Rewards/Benefits
 Become a part of our mission for sustainability: Clean energy for generations to come
 A global team of diverse colleagues who share passion for renewable energy
 Personal and professional development to grow internally within our organization
 Flexible working hours as well as home-office

 Local benefits such as subsidized lunch and public transport tickets, employee discounts and much more

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Senior Product Manager, Cluster Scalability
Location: Dublin
 About The Role
 MongoDB is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own scalability for the Atlas data platform. Atlas is how the world’s most demanding applications run on MongoDB — from real-time gaming and financial transactions to AI workloads with unpredictable traffic patterns. When those applications grow, slow down, spike, or contract, scalability is the layer that decides whether the customer trusts us to keep running their business.
This role owns the end-to-end product experience for how customers scale up, scale down, and horizontally scale their Atlas deployments. That includes vertical scaling (instance tier changes), autoscaling, horizontal scaling (sharding and shard key strategy), and the operational workflows around all of them. You will set the strategy, drive execution with engineering, and be accountable for measurable year-over-year improvements in how reliably and predictably customers scale.
We care less about whether you’ve worked on databases before and more about whether you’re the kind of PM who can ramp fast on a hard technical domain, form a clear opinion about what needs to happen, and defend that opinion to senior engineers, field partners, and enterprise CTOs, especially when they disagree with you. Database and scaling concepts are teachable. Judgment, conviction, and crispness are not.
 Responsibilities
 Set a clear, opinionated vision and strategy for Atlas cluster scalability and translate it into concrete, prioritized bets each release.
 Own the end-to-end roadmap for vertical scaling, autoscaling, and horizontal scaling, including the operational and observability surfaces customers rely on during scaling events.
 Make hard prioritization calls, including saying no to things with real customer or leadership support, and own those decisions and their consequences.
 Build deep technical understanding of Atlas scaling internals (instance tier mechanics, autoscaler logic, sharding, balancer behavior, capacity headroom) and use it to shape requirements and tradeoffs with engineering. You don’t need to know this on day one. You do need to know it deeply by month two.
 Represent product direction with conviction to senior engineering leaders, field partners, and enterprise customers, especially when they disagree.
 Stay close to customers and field partners to deeply understand scaling pain points, failure patterns, and the moments where trust is won or lost.
 Define success metrics for scalability, build analytics that surface issues early, and use data to inform clear, timely decisions under ambiguity.
 Lead proactive, cross-functional execution with Engineering, Design, Docs, Support, Marketing, and Sales to ship reliable, high-quality scaling experiences and accelerate adoption.
 Mentor junior PMs, contribute to strategic product thinking across teams, and influence leadership-level product decisions, all while operating without direct reports.
 Be accountable to year-over-year growth on the metrics that matter for Atlas scalability.
 Requirements
 Required qualifications
 5+ years of product management experience on technically complex, infrastructure-level products. Database, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure experience is a plus but not required. We care about your ability to ramp fast on hard technical domains and make sound product decisions once you do.
 Demonstrated success owning enterprise-grade, technical products end-to-end — not just shipping them, but delivering measurable customer and business outcomes you can quantify.
 Technical fluency: comfortable discussing architecture, failure modes, performance characteristics, and tradeoffs with senior engineers, and connecting technical decisions directly to customer outcomes. You don’t need to know what an autoscaler does on day one. You do need to be the kind of PM who will understand it deeply within your first month and have an opinion about how it affects the customer experience by month two.
 Track record of taking products from 0 to 1 and from 1 to 50 — building something new and scaling what works.
 Strong customer-orientation and field-connection, regularly engaging directly with customers and field teams and translating their input into clear requirements and roadmap decisions.
 Excellent written and verbal communication: crisp, high-quality artifacts and the ability to tailor the message by audience (engineering, executives, customers, field). In this role you will represent product direction to enterprise CTOs and to senior engineering leaders who may disagree with your priorities. You need to hold the room.
 Strong analytical skills and metrics rigor, including defining success metrics, instrumenting and debugging analytics, and using data to inform (but not replace) judgment.
 Demonstrated decision-making speed and conviction under ambiguity, with specific examples of making hard calls, cutting scope, and holding a position under pushback. We will ask you about this in the interview, and we will push back on your answer.
 Desire to be a part of the Go-to-Market, Marketing, and Sales enablement process.
 Nice to have
 Hands-on experience with databases, distributed systems, or cloud infrastructure platforms (compute, storage, networking, capacity planning).
 Prior product ownership of developer tools, infrastructure platforms, or mission-critical SaaS used by enterprise customers.
 Experience with autoscaling, capacity planning, sharding, or similar elasticity problems in any domain.
