title: AI Product Manager
description:
We are on a mission to become the leading international force in residential property management. What we do matters to millions of people in their everyday lives.
Residential real estate is the world’s largest asset class, and for most families, buying a home is the single biggest financial decision they will ever make. For too long, residential property management has fallen short of homeowners' and residents' expectations, and the industry is ready for change. Odevo was formed to make that change happen.
In just six years, Odevo has grown more than 70-fold, establishing us as the leading international player. We are more than 14,000 people across the US, the UK, the Nordics, Germany, Spain, Portugal, Mexico, and Italy building Odevo. Together, we aspire to break new ground through innovation and cultivate a workplace where we help each other succeed, where ideas matter more than titles, and where kindness is a strength.
By combining the power of people and technology, we set a new standard for how homes are managed. Our technology-enabled services simplify living for residents and create a better experience for property owners and boards.
Our ambition is to continue our fast-growing journey through new customers, service expansion, and by partnering with great companies that share our mindset and ambition, both in existing and new markets.
As we continue to grow, we stay true to who we are, challenge unnecessary bureaucracy, and keep decision-making close to our customers.
If you share our mindset and ambition, we’d love you to join us and help accelerate our mission together.
At Odevo, we build production-grade AI systems that change how residential living is managed at scale. Our AI Engineering team is deeply technical, highly collaborative, and driven by learning - and we're now looking for a Product Manager to help shape what we build and why.
This is a role at the intersection of cutting-edge AI and real-world property management. You'll work side by side with AI engineers, domain experts, and business stakeholders to turn emerging AI capabilities into products that thousands of residents, property managers, and support teams rely on every day. You'll own the product direction for AI-powered features - from early exploration to production - and make sure we're always solving the right problems in the right order.
You'll drive the roadmap for tools like our case triage engine - defining what great looks like, gathering user feedback, and working with engineers to continuously improve how we understand and route incoming maintenance issues.
 Your Main Responsibilities
 Bring structure, clarity, and momentum to a complex case management landscape shaped by decentralized organizations, differing local processes, legacy systems, and uneven technical maturity.
 Own the product direction for AI-powered case management automation, turning ambiguous operational needs into clear priorities, actionable backlog items, and scalable solutions.
 Build deep understanding of how case handling works in practice today across the business - immersing yourself in operational workflows, pain points, and variations to ensure we solve real problems in ways users trust and adopt.
 Act as the bridge between AI engineers, operations teams, domain experts, and business stakeholders - translating between technical possibilities, business needs, and day-to-day operational reality.
 Drive alignment, prioritization, and delivery together with the AI engineering team and stakeholders, balancing business value, technical constraints, data dependencies, and long-term product evolution.
 Drive adoption and measurable impact end to end - from discovery and rollout to follow-up, iteration, and continuous improvement based on usage, feedback, and outcomes.
 Who You Are
 You thrive in complexity and ambiguity, and you are at your best when bringing structure, focus, and progress to situations that are not yet well defined.
 You are genuinely curious about how work happens in practice and willing to go deep into the domain to understand workflows, edge cases, and operational pain points.
 You build trust quickly and communicate clearly across functions, levels, and backgrounds - from highly technical teams to operational stakeholders and senior leadership.
 You are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, balancing short-term needs with long-term direction, and adjusting course as new insights emerge.
 You combine strategic product thinking with hands-on execution, and you care as much about adoption and outcomes as you do about delivery.
 You are excited by applied AI and motivated by the challenge of turning new technology into products that create real value in complex environments.
 What We Are Looking For
 A true product owner who is the natural go-to person for the AI product domain - perceived as an owner, not a coordinator.
 Someone who can bridge the gap between engineers who care deeply about their craft and stakeholders who care about outcomes.
 A data-driven decision maker who is comfortable making trade-offs and driving alignment across functions.
 An excellent communicator - verbal and written - who can make complex AI concepts accessible to any audience.
 A team player who thrives in a collaborative, open, and supportive environment.
 Relevant Experience
 5+ years as a Product Manager, Product Owner, or similar product leadership role, ideally in B2B SaaS or tech-driven services.
 Hands-on experience working with AI, ML, or data-driven product teams is a strong plus.
 Experience in PropTech or the service industry is a plus.
 Bachelor's degree in a relevant field is preferred.
 Fluent in Swedish and English.
 Location
 Our office is located at Tulegatan 4 in Stockholm, and our AI team follows a hybrid work model with three days in the office to balance focus and collaboration.
 Excited? 
 If you have any questions about the role or recruitment process, feel free to contact Henrietta Dalma

title: Product Manager
description:
About Ministry Brands
 Ministry Brands is a leading provider of SaaS operational management systems, payments platforms, digital engagement tools and background screening solutions for purpose-driven organisations. We serve more than 95,000 customers as a trusted partner in digital transformation and enablement – advancing missions, driving efficiencies, and building engaged communities for more than four decades.
Our Galway R&D centre is Ministry Brands' global AI R&D hub and is in the middle of a major expansion as we deliver a multi-year AI-native transformation of our product portfolio.
 What You Will Do
 As the Product Manager, you will be responsible for supporting the development, strategy, and execution of a company's product initiatives. PMs typically work closely with leadership, cross-functional teams, and stakeholders to help bring products to market successfully.
 Key Responsibilities
 Product Development: Assist in managing the product lifecycle from ideation to launch, including gathering requirements, writing product specifications, and working with engineering and design teams to deliver solutions. Owns the completion of the committed initiatives in the quarter.
 Market Research: Conduct research to understand market trends, customer needs, and competitive products. Help define the product's position in the market.
 Data-Driven Decision Making: Analyze data to track product performance, customer behavior, and areas for improvement. Use analytics tools to identify opportunities and recommend improvements.
 Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with engineering, design, marketing, and sales teams to ensure the successful development and launch of new products and features. Serves as product ambassador internally and externally, sharing knowledge and answering questions. Participates in sprint meetings and backlog refinement sessions.
 Customer Feedback: Engage with customers and users to gather feedback on existing products, features, and enhancements.
 Prioritization: Assist in product backlog prioritization by evaluating business value, customer needs, and technical feasibility. Manages the product backlog and prioritizes based on changing requirements.
 Product Documentation: Help create and maintain clear product documentation, including user stories, technical specifications, and product roadmaps. Leads the product-release plans and sets expectations for delivery of new functionalities. Creates user stories in a standardized format.
 Support Execution: Assist in executing product initiatives and meeting deadlines. Ensure timely delivery of projects in alignment with the product strategy. Owns the sprint and quarterly coordination of key initiatives.
 Who You Are
 Passionate and enthusiastic about helping purpose driven organizations
 Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
 5+ years of experience in product management or relevant experience
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze data and derive actionable insights
 A track record of measurable results — you can point to the specific metrics your work moved and by how much
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
 Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
 A passion for technology and understanding customer needs and product usability
 Experience with tools like AI, Monday.com, or other product management software is a plus
 Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment 
 What's In It For You
 At Ministry Brands, we invest in our people and provide the support, flexibility, and opportunities you need to do your best work and grow your career.
 Hybrid working model based from our Galway office.
 25 days annual leave plus public holidays.
 100% employer-paid private health insurance, including cover for dependents.
 Dental coverage.
 Employer-matched pension scheme.
 Income protection and life assurance.
 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) and wellbeing initiatives.
 Career development through mentorship, professional training, and certification opportunities.
 Galway Gym membership.
 Annual Volunteer Day.
 Amazing company culture.

title: Senior Product Manager (Roadmap) - Star Trek Fleet Command
description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Star Trek™ Fleet Command team in Dublin on a hybrid basis.
Star Trek Fleet Command's ongoing success goes from strength to strength. Our in-house developed 4X MMO was launched in 2018 and continues to evolve, being consistently one of the top grossing Massive Multiplayer Strategy games on the market.
At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.
What You Will Do
As the Senior Product Manager , you will be the product owner for key monetisation and engagement initiatives across the live game. This includes driving the roadmap and execution of our monthly content releases, ensuring they are cohesive, compelling, and highly performant. You will work cross-functionally with Game Design, Product Marketing, Product Ops, Economy Design, and Data Science teams to define, prioritise, and deliver exceptional player experiences that meet business and player goals.
 Own the content and performance strategy for our monthly releases, aligning them to player motivations, economic balance, and business KPIs
 Define and manage the monthly content calendar, collaborating with Design, Production, and Engineering to deliver high-quality, on-time experiences
 Use data and experimentation to optimise monetisation, engagement, and retention across a broad player lifecycle—from new users to end-game whales
 Deeply understand player behaviour across multiple geos and platforms to ensure we deliver value through personalisation and segmentation strategies
 Work closely with the economy and systems design teams to ensure content aligns with long-term progression goals and avoids inflation
 Partner with UX, Research, and Community teams to develop empathy for player sentiment and pain points, and translate them into actionable product improvements
 Build business cases for major new initiatives and content verticals, including competitive research and revenue forecasting
 Mentor junior PMs and contribute to a culture of product excellence and cross-functional collaboration.
 What We're Looking For
 Extensive experience in product management, ideally with significant responsibility on a F2P mobile game
 Demonstrated success managing complex monetisation and engagement systems, with extensive experience in content development
 Data-native mindset, with the ability to translate raw performance metrics into strategic insights and actionable plans
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven track record of aligning diverse teams around a shared product vision
 Strong player empathy and experience working with user research, community feedback, or other voice-of-player channels
 Experience driving impact across cross-functional pods, including creative, design, and engineering teams
 At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!
 About Scopely
 Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.
Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.
Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.
Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

 Possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow.

title: Senior Product Manager - Payments
description:
About Us
 Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance . That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close.
We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.
 What You'll Be Doing
 As our Senior Product Manager of the Investments domain, you'll be the person who makes investing radically simple and accessible for our users, across any asset type they want to put their money into.
 Here's What Your Day-to-day Will Look Like
 Roadmap ownership - Own the roadmap for our investment products (ETFs, stocks, ready-made funds, money market funds, pension funds), from opportunity sizing to shipped feature, backed by data and user research.
 Regulatory complexity - Navigate the added complexity of investment products, balancing simplicity for the user with the regulatory and product intricacy underneath.
 Compliance collaboration - Work closely with compliance/legal given the regulated nature of investment products.
 User research - Talk to users constantly (interviews, usability tests, support tickets) and turn what you hear into concrete product decisions.
 Execution & iteration - Define specs and work day-to-day with design and engineering to ship, then iterate based on what the numbers tell you.
 KPI management - Track and own your core KPIs (activation, adoption, AUM/volumes) and report on them without spin.
 Who We're Looking For
 This role needs someone data-driven and user-centric, who thrives on turning complex investment products into simple, engaging consumer experiences.
 Experience - at least 6+ years of experience in a Product Manager role, ideally with exposure to regulated products (investing, lending, insurance) or genuine complexity.
 Investments expertise - You bring a proven track record in the investment space, paired with a genuine, contagious passion for the world of finance
 Data-driven mindset - You build hypotheses, validate them, and rely on analytics to lead the way
 User-centric focus - You prioritize direct user feedback and research over unverified assumptions.
 Cross-functional collaboration - You thrive working alongside designers and engineers every day, staying involved far beyond just handing over specifications.
 Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.
 CareAbout: how we support your impact
 About
 We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:
 ❤️ Health (Private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops)

 We embrace two days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday), with the option to request extra remote time.
 Salary: €68.000 - €87.000 gross per annum
This range is set using objective, gender-neutral criteria for the role's core requirements. However, we do not believe in putting a ceiling on talent. The final compensation package is tailored according to your unique experience and expertise. If your skills go beyond the standard profile, apply anyway so we can discuss a package that reflects your true value.
 Equal opportunity employer

title: Senior Product Manager- IDNA
description:
Overview
 Security represents the most critical priorities for our customers in a world awash in digital threats, regulatory scrutiny, and estate complexity. Microsoft Security aspires to make the world a safer place for all. We want to reshape security and empower every user, customer, and developer with a security cloud that protects them with end to end, simplified solutions. The Microsoft Security organization accelerates Microsoft’s mission and bold ambitions to ensure that our company and industry is securing digital technology platforms, devices, and clouds in our customers’ heterogeneous environments, as well as ensuring the security of our own internal estate. Our culture is centered on embracing a growth mindset, a theme of inspiring excellence, and encouraging teams and leaders to bring their best each day. In doing so, we create life-changing innovations that impact billions of lives around the world.
We are looking to hire a Senior Product Manager to join the Access Management and Governance (AMG) team. AMG builds the control layer for enterprise access across Microsoft Entra, and owns Entra ID Governance, Privileged Identity Management, tenant governance, Workload ID, and Entra Agent ID. Our products define how organizations grant, review, and revoke access for employees, partners, workloads, and AI agents, across Microsoft and non-Microsoft systems. In this role you will shape how enterprises maintain a continuously accurate picture of who and what holds access, and how they act on it.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
 Responsibilities
 Define and drive product vision, strategy, roadmap, and execution for security and identity-related products and services.
 Partner closely with engineering, design, research, data science, and business stakeholders to deliver innovative customer-facing solutions. 
 Engage customers and partners to understand needs, validate scenarios, gather feedback, and inform product decisions.
 Translate customer, market, and business opportunities into clear product requirements and execution plans.
 Drive alignment across cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders to achieve shared outcomes.
 Prioritize investments and features based on customer impact, business value, technical feasibility, and strategic goals.
 Define success metrics, monitor product performance, and communicate results and impact to leadership.
 Support go-to-market efforts by partnering with marketing, sales, and business teams to drive adoption and customer success.
 Identify emerging trends, opportunities, and challenges across security, identity, governance, compliance, access management, and related technology domains.
 Foster a culture of innovation, customer obsession, accountability, and continuous improvement.
 Adopt an AI first mindset and implement AI tools as needed 
 Qualifications
 Required/minimum qualifications
 Bachelor's Degree AND experience in product/service/program management or software development
 OR equivalent experience.
 Experience taking a product, feature, or experience to market (e.g., design, addressing product market fit, and launch, internal tool/framework).
 Experience improving product metrics for a product, feature, or experience in a market (e.g., growing customer base, expanding customer usage, avoiding customer churn).
 Experience delivering customer-facing products in partnership with engineering teams.
 Product strategy, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
 Other Requirements
 Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft background and Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
 Additional Or Preferred Qualifications
 Bachelor's Degree AND experience in product/service/program management or software development
 OR equivalent experience.
 Experience in AI-native PM experience
 Knowledge of identity, security, governance, compliance, cloud security, or Microsoft Security/Entra technologies.
 Experience managing products that serve both external customers and large-scale internal enterprise consumers simultaneously.
 Demonstrated ability to drive complex migration programs involving legacy infrastructure, multiple stakeholders, and escalation-heavy timelines.
 Track record of shipping security or infrastructure products in Azure or comparable hyperscale cloud platforms.
 Understanding of non-human identity (workload identity, managed identity, service principal, SPIFFEE) security patterns and challenges.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Voor een snelgroeiende ontwikkelaar van innovatieve ERP- en MES-softwareoplossingen grafische en verpakkingsindustrie gaan we momenteel op zoek naar een Senior Product Manager. 
 In deze rol sta je samen met je directe collega aan het roer van de verdere ontwikkeling en uitrol van een gloednieuw cloudproduct dat de komende decennia bepalend zal zijn voor de sector. Je komt terecht in een modern hoofdkantoor in de regio Oostkamp en maakt deel uit van een internationaal en multidisciplinair team.
 De organisatie staat bekend om haar mensgerichte, dynamische en pragmatische bedrijfscultuur waarin hard werken en het belonen van medewerkers hand in hand gaan. Naast flexibiliteit en professionele groeimogelijkheden biedt de werkgever een grondig onboardingstraject om de specifieke niche en business door en door te leren kennen.
 Hoe zal jouw takenpakket eruit zien? 
 Je werkt nauw samen met de lead product manager aan het beheer en de verdere vormgeving van de productroadmap voor de SaaS-oplossingen.
 Je trekt zelfstandig kleinere, innovatieve cloudprojecten en bent nauw betrokken bij het UI/UX-design van specifieke softwaremodules.
 Je neemt Scrum-gerelateerde verantwoordelijkheden op je door daily stand-ups te leiden, deadlines te bewaken en de teamwerking te optimaliseren.
 Je stemt dagelijks af met een internationaal team van software developers in België en Zweden om een efficiënte oplevering te garanderen.
 Je verzamelt en analyseert behoeften uit de markt om waardevolle functionaliteiten te vertalen naar heldere specificaties voor de IT-teams.
 Wat verwachten wij van jou? 
 Je bent in het bezit van een masterdiploma en je brengt relevante ervaring mee in complexe software- of ERP-omgeving.
 Je hebt een sterke proactieve drive, uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden en schrikt er niet van terug om met weerstand of confrontatie om te gaan.
 Je bent flexibel ingesteld om de rol vanuit zowel een Product Management- als een Scrum Master-invalshoek te benaderen.
 Je hebt een resultaatgerichte manier van werken en een internationale KMO-context schrikt jou niet af. 
 Wat bieden wij jou? 
 Brutosalaris tussen € 5.000 en € 6.800 per maand, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring. 
 Bedrijfswagen met laadkaart (keuze uit onder meer Skoda Elroq, Volvo EX30 of Cupra Born inclusief thuislaadstation of smart cable en B2B-laadkaart voor EU). 
 Maaltijdcheques van € 8 per dag. 
 Netto onkostenvergoeding tot € 210 tot € 230 per maand (en € 20 netto internetvergoeding). 
 Extralegale voordelen zoals een uitgebreide AXA-hospitalisatieverzekering, groepsverzekering, cafetariaplan (met opties voor fietslease en multimedia), ecocheques (€ 250), telefoonabonnement, laptop en 32 vakantiedagen (20 wettelijk + 12 ADV).

title: Senior Technical Product Manager - Internal Developer Platform
description:
This is Adyen
 Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.
For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.
 Senior Technical Product Manager - Internal Developer Platform
 The Internal Developer Platform (IDP) cluster is on a mission to create standardized, scalable, and delightful experiences across the software development life cycle (SDLC) so Adyen engineers are empowered to deliver value more efficiently and reliably for our customers.
As a Senior Product Manager within the IDP cluster, you will manage a key stream of our platform evolution. Your goal is to transition our engineering organization from fragmented, "tribal knowledge" based flows to a cohesive, automated ecosystem that reduces cognitive load, minimizes manual toil, and ensures our platform scales with our global engineering footprint. 2026 is our year of deep optimization and resilience; you are a product leader who understands that scaling a platform requires balancing innovation with mandatory reliability and stability mandates
 What You’ll Do
 Optimize the SDLC- Drive initiatives to reduce SDLC friction, such as reducing CI flakiness and improving build insights, to help teams shift from centralized, manual processes to systemic, automated "golden paths".
 Drive Product Maturity- Take ownership of product lifecycle management by assessing the maturity of our toolset, executing on necessary deprecations, and ensuring our core products have clear adoption paths and value propositions.
 Build Technical Context- Partner with IDP engineering to bridge the gap between generic AI models and Adyen’s complex architecture. You will prioritize the rollout of AGENTS.md standards, internal RAG pipelines, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for tools like GitLab and Jira.
 Foster Developer Autonomy- Work across the organization to bridge the gap between infrastructure and developer needs, building "LEGO-block" style abstractions that allow teams to own their pipelines and release cycles while maintaining secure, compliant guardrails.
 Validate ROI & Manage Vendors- Implement data-driven feedback loops to track adoption and measure SDLC improvements against core metrics like DXI, Change Failure Rate, and developer velocity
 Who You Are
 10+ years of product experience ideally within Platform Engineering, Developer Experience (DevEx), or AI-enabled technical products.
 You are technically credible. You can confidently spar with engineers about system architecture, CI/CD pipeline constraints, and the balance between centralized governance and team autonomy.
 You are a master of change management. You know how to influence developer habits and drive adoption in highly opinionated technical environments.
 You are data-driven, capable of translating subjective developer feedback and system/usage data into clear impact metrics.
 You thrive in ambiguity. You can execute quickly without waiting for perfect information and adapt quickly to new information
 Internally the role is being called Senior Product Manager - Developer Experience
 Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments 
 Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.
Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!
 What’s next?
 Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here. Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.
This role is based out of our Amsterdam office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

title: Senior Product Manager - Pharmacy Care
description:
The Senior Product Manager, Pharmacy Care presents an exceptional opportunity for a strategic, Member-obsessed product leader to shape the future of Transcarent's Pharmacy Care solution line. This role requires a highly analytical, proactive individual with strong product instincts, healthcare industry expertise, and the ability to translate Member and client needs into a compelling product roadmap. This leader will define product strategy, prioritize the roadmap, and partner closely with Engineering, Design, Clinical, and Solutions teams to build pharmacy experiences that are simple, transparent, and effective. This role is critical in translating Transcarent's mission of transforming how people access and experience care into tangible product outcomes for Pharmacy Care Members.
What you'll do
 Own the product strategy and roadmap for key features and integrations within our Pharmacy Care portfolio, balancing Member experience, clinical outcomes, and business impact 
 Partner with Engineering, Design, Clinical, and Solutions teams to define requirements, prioritize features, and ship high-quality product releases 
 Collaborate with integration partners (PBMs, Pharmacies, and other third parties) to deliver shared outcomes and differentiated Member experience 
 Translate Member journey pain points (e.g., prescription transfers, benefit navigation) into clear product requirements and measurable success criteria 
 Use qualitative and quantitative data: Member feedback, usage analytics, funnel and conversion metrics, to identify opportunities and validate product decisions 
 Define and track key product metrics, reporting on performance and outcomes to stakeholders and leadership 
 Collaborate with Solutions and Client Success teams to understand client and plan sponsor needs and incorporate them into the product roadmap 
 Partner with Clinical teams to ensure product decisions reflect sound clinical judgment and improve health outcomes 
 Write clear product requirements, user stories, and specifications; lead sprint planning and backlog prioritization with Engineering 
 Stay current on the pharmacy and PBM landscape, including regulatory changes, competitive offerings, and emerging technology (including AI-enabled tools), to inform product direction 
 What we're looking for
 Bachelor's degree required; master’s or higher in healthcare, public health, or business-related field preferred 
 Minimum of 5-7 years of product management experience, including experience in pharmacy, PBM, or healthcare solution delivery 
 Demonstrated experience owning a product roadmap end-to-end, from discovery through launch and measurement 
 Strong business acumen and comfort translating ambiguous Member/client problems into structured product solutions 
 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills; able to work cross-functionally with Integration Partners, Engineering, Clinical, Design, and Solutions teams 
 Data-driven approach to decision-making, with comfort analyzing funnels, cohorts, and Member outcomes 
 Comfortable in fast-paced and evolving organizations with a willingness to be flexible and pivot when needed 
 Excellent at prioritization, scoping, and documentation 
 Familiarity with modern product tools and AI-assisted workflows is a plus 
 While working in Transcarent, you will enjoy the following benefits:
 5 weeks of vacation + personal days 
 1 paid day off for your volunteerism per year 
 Stock options 
 Home office and flexible working hours 
 Cell phone and a plan for unlimited personal use as well 
 Sodexo Gastro Pass Card with no contribution 
 Flexi Pass Card per month or Multisport Card 
 FreshPoint fridge with meals & snacks at 30% discount 
 Work from abroad up to 4 weeks a year 
 Udemy Business Platform for Hard/Soft skills training 
 Virtual hospital service uLekare.cz 
 Ginger Emotional Support app (www.ginger.com) 
 Who we are
Transcarent is the One Place for Health and Careᵀᴹ, bringing medical, pharmacy, and point solutions together with the WayFindingᵀᴹ experience, the first and only generative AI-powered health and care platform for health consumers.
Our WayFinding experience, paired with transparent and consumer-driven pharmacy care, 2nd.MD expert medical opinions, and virtual primary care, works seamlessly with comprehensive Care Experiences – Cancer Care, Surgery Care, and Weight Health – to support people with all of their health needs, simple or serious. More than 1,700 employers and health plans rely on us to provide information, guidance, and care, empowering health consumers with more choice, an experience they love, access to higher-quality care, and lower costs for 21 million Members. For more information, visit transcarent.com , and follow us on LinkedIn .
 At Transcarent, Our Values Guide Everything We Do
 People First: We prioritize our Members, clients, and each other in every decision 
 Care: Every decision starts with improving health and care for our Members 
 Resilience: We push boundaries and take the uncharted path to change an industry 
 Results: We take ownership, solve with speed, and deliver for our people and each other 
 Humble and Human: We lead with humility, bring fun to tough moments, and go further together

title: Senior Data Engineer / Technical Product Manager, Data Platform
description:
At Viaplay Group, we entertain millions of people every day through our streaming services, radio networks, and TV channels. We believe in the power of content not just as a way of telling stories and touching lives, but also expanding worlds.  
We’re looking for the best people to join us on our journey. Right now, we’re searching for a Senior Data Engineer/Technical Product Manager, Data Platform in our Stockholm office – are you ready to hit play on an exciting career change? 
 The Role 
 As a Senior Data engineer / Technical Product Manager, Data Platform , you will shape the future direction of Viaplay's data platform and help expand its role across our technology landscape.
Our Databricks platform is already a critical enabler for analytics, reporting, and machine learning. We believe it can play a larger role in how software is built at Viaplay, powering operational use cases, real-time data products, platform integrations, and new capabilities across engineering teams.
In this role, you will combine strong technical expertise with product thinking. You will work closely with engineering leaders and development teams across the organization to understand their challenges, identify opportunities, and translate them into platform investments and technical capabilities.
While you are expected to stay hands-on and contribute as an engineer, your primary responsibility is to drive the platform's strategy, roadmap, and adoption. Success in this role is measured not only by what the team builds, but by how effectively the platform creates value across the wider organization.
 What You Will Be Doing
 Own and drive the product vision and roadmap for Viaplay's data platform
 Partner with engineering leaders to understand challenges, identify opportunities, and uncover new platform use cases
 Expand the adoption of Databricks beyond traditional analytics and reporting workloads
 Identify platform gaps and proactively propose solutions that create value for Viaplay
 Contribute hands-on to architecture discussions and engineering initiatives when needed
 Support the continued modernization of our data ecosystem and migration away from legacy platforms
 Act as a trusted advisor to engineering and business stakeholders on data platform strategy and architecture
 Mentor and guide engineers within the Data Platform team
 What We’re Looking For 
 We understand you may feel confident ticking certain boxes more than others and that’s why we always keep an open mind in our recruitment process. But, in order to thrive in this role, we do believe you’ll have experience in the following: 
 Extensive experience in Data Engineering, Data Platforms, or related technical disciplines
 Experience working with modern cloud data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or similar technologies
 Strong understanding of data architecture, data product and modern platform thinking
 Experience defining roadmaps, prioritizing investments, and driving product strategy for technical platforms
 Ability to engage with senior engineering stakeholders and influence decisions across organizational boundaries
 A proactive mindset with a demonstrated ability to identify opportunities and drive initiatives from idea to implementation
 Excellent communication skills and the ability to bridge the gap between engineering, data, and business domains
 It’s a bonus if you have:  
 Experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, and modern Lakehouse architectures
 Experience enabling operational and customer-facing use cases from data platforms
 Experience building ML platforms, feature stores, or AI-enabling data capabilities
 Previous experience as a Technical Product Manager, Platform Product Manager, Staff Engineer, Principal Engineer, or similar role
 What we offer you
 We’ve got you covered! 30 days of paid vacation every year, an attractive pension and insurance scheme, and generous parental leave pay lift. 
 Your wellbeing matters. We provide you with various wellbeing initiatives including wellness allowance. 
 Flexibility that works. We follow a hybrid model with at least three days a week in the office, giving you the best mix of collaboration and focus time.
 A safe space to grow and up-skill. Our learning culture puts you in the driver’s seat of your own development.
 An innovative environment with Hack Days once a year. This week-long initiative allows you to think outside the box and deliver creative, technical solutions that (more often than not) go on to be implemented, either in our product or our ways of working. 
 Entertainment is what we love, and entertainment is what we do. So, unlimited access to Viaplay seems only fair for you to get to know the product – including serier & viewing events, new release movie rentals, linear channels and more. 
 Hit play today 
 If this feels like your kind of challenge, make sure you apply by attaching your CV here – you may also want to add your LinkedIn profile. Please don’t send us your application via email because we won’t be able to accept it. We do, however, welcome any questions you may have about this particular position. 
Want to learn more about who we are and what we do? Check out our careers page or follow us on Instagram! We’re only ever a few clicks away.

title: Product Manager Interopérabilité
description:
Tu cherches à donner du sens à ton talent et à avoir un impact positif sur le monde ?
 Née En 2016, Padoa C’est 350 Collaborateurs Passionnés Autour D’un Logiciel Et Une Offre De Services Conçus Pour Moderniser Les Services De Santé Au Travail. Aujourd'hui, Plus De 9 Millions De Salariés En France Sont Suivis Sur Notre Logiciel SaaS. Après Une Levée De Fonds De 80M€ En 2022, Padoa Est Rentable Et Nous Poursuivons Notre Mission Avec Encore Plus D’ambition :
 Faire du monde du travail un univers de prévention afin d’améliorer la santé de millions de personnes !
 Grâce à nos équipes et à notre positionnement premium, nous sommes devenus leader sur le marché français. Nous recrutons régulièrement les meilleurs talents pour concevoir, améliorer, développer, promouvoir et déployer padoa.
Le projet te plait ? Rejoins l’aventure !
 Tes Missions :
 Quand un médecin du travail reçoit un salarié, il ne devrait plus jamais partir d’un dossier vide. C’est l’objectif fixé par les pouvoirs publics, et l’un des grands chantiers de la santé au travail pour les années à venir : faire circuler la donnée médicale en toute sécurité entre les services, les institutions et les professionnels de santé.
Tu prends en main la squad Interop, avec une ambition claire : faire de Padoa le premier système de santé au travail entièrement interopéré de France. La squad a déjà posé des bases solides :
 le transfert du dossier médical d’un service à l’autre ;
 une base nationale de suivi des intérimaires ;
 l’identité nationale de santé (INS) ;
 la messagerie sécurisée MSSanté ;
 la récupération des résultats de laboratoire.
 Tu travailles au croisement du produit, de la technique et de la réglementation en santé. C’est un terrain exigeant, où tu développeras une expertise rare. Tes décisions auront un effet direct sur le suivi médical de millions de salariés.
 Tes Missions :
 Construire une vision de la circulation sécurisée de la donnée de santé, au sein de Padoa et vers l’extérieur, puis la porter auprès des équipes.
 Concevoir le système d’interopérabilité avec les product designers, les équipes techniques et le juridique. Deux grands chantiers sont déjà fixés pour 2027 : à toi de définir comment les mener.
 Animer des ateliers de conception avec les développeurs pour arbitrer les priorités et les choix techniques, et garantir la maintenabilité.
 Protéger les échanges de données contre les changements des autres squads, qui produisent la donnée que tu fais circuler, en mettant en place des garde-fous.
 Piloter l’adoption chez les clients avec les référents métier : bêta-tests, déploiement, accompagnement. C’est aujourd’hui le principal frein de l’interopérabilité.
 Suivre la réglementation (DGT, ministère de la Santé, Europe) et les projets nationaux qui imposent de travailler avec d’autres éditeurs. Tu arbitres entre ces obligations, les engagements clients et ta vision.
 Qualifications Clés :
 Formation d’ingénieur, ou parcours très technique avec une expérience concrète de l’interopérabilité. Tu discutes flux, API et modèles de données d’égal à égal avec les développeurs.
 Au moins 3 ans d’expérience en tant que Product Manager, idéalement sur un logiciel destiné aux entreprises. Ce que tu as accompli compte plus que le nombre d’années.
 Capacité à prendre de la hauteur : tu te forges des convictions et tu les défends, au-delà du suivi de la livraison.
 Goût pour les sujets de fond : données de santé, sécurité, conformité, avec la rigueur qu’ils exigent.
 Capacité à embarquer les équipes et à leur faire partager une vision.
 Un plus : une expérience dans la santé, sur des sujets de certification ou de réglementation, ou une connaissance des standards d’interopérabilité en santé.
 Ce poste n’est sans doute pas fait pour toi si tu cherches surtout à concevoir des fonctionnalités grand public, ou si tu préfères te concentrer sur la livraison plutôt que sur la vision.
 Notre souhait chez padoa est de se projeter sur le long terme avec nos collaborateurs et de les faire évoluer (Gestion de chantiers techniques ou produit, Lead, accompagnement de profils plus juniors, etc.).
 Ce que tu trouveras chez nous
 🚀 Un environnement technique solide avec une stack technique de qualité et plus 50% de profils tech à padoa qui t'offriront de beaux challenges !
🤝 Un positionnement premium avec une accompagnement reconnu et apprécié par nos clients !
🏡 Une organisation flexible : 2 jours de télétravail flexibles par semaine. 5 semaines de CP + 10 RTT / an + 3 jours enfants malade.
🧑‍💻 Un cadre de travail agréable : des locaux bien desservis et spacieux dans le 17ème avec du matériel de qualité. Une prise en charge de ton transport (à 50%) mais aussi vélo !
👋 Un super onboarding : sur padoa et ses équipes puis sur les spécificités de ton métier !
👣 Une évolution professionnelle : une structure dynamique qui valorise l’initiative et l’engagement à tous niveaux de séniorité, expert comme manager.
🎉 Une vie d'entreprise bien remplie dans un cadre convivial : réunions all staff suivies d’une soirée, séminaire d’entreprise, budget team building, activités thématiques et un arbre de Noël.
🥗 De quoi bien manger : une carte Swile (10€/jour pris en charge à 59%). Café, thé, céréales, fruits en libre accès !
⚕️ Une super mutuelle q ui rembourse bien (car la santé est une priorité pour nous !).
🦾 Une politique handicap avec une charte d’entreprise et des actions concrètes.
😊 Un CSE dynamique qui propose notamment des abonnements GymLib et HappyPal, des tarifs de groupe sur des évènements extérieurs.
 padoa s'inscrit dans une démarche d'inclusion et s'engage à étudier toutes les candidatures aux regards des compétences et qualifications de chacun.
 Dans un souci de clarté, l’écriture inclusive n’est pas utilisée dans cette annonce. Les termes employés se réfèrent aussi bien au genre féminin que masculin.

title: Staff Product Manager, Enterprise Deployment Solutions | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
This is a fully remote position and we're considering candidates in Sweden.
 About Product Management
 As a Product Manager at Grafana Labs, you'll develop a vision and strategy for your product domain. You will own the experience for your product as well as its roadmap and competitive positioning, and you will collaborate with company leadership on setting your product's goals. You will be the primary advocate and expert in your area, with a strong ability to communicate needs, functionality, and details effectively both to external customers and internal stakeholders. The teams and people you will be interacting with will be 100% remote and globally distributed, so strong and proactive communication is essential.
Product Managers are the bridge that connects R&D to GTM. You are a facilitator who ensures the free flow of information across these teams and are expected to be technically proficient when representing our products to our customers.
The role
As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you'll own the Grafana Labs offerings that run outside our standard multi-tenant SaaS. That includes Grafana Federal Cloud , for organizations that need FedRAMP-authorized observability: US federal agencies; state, local, and education (SLED) customers; and commercial companies that sell FedRAMP offerings of their own. It also includes Grafana Cloud Bring Your Own Cloud (BYOC) , which delivers the full Grafana Cloud experience while the customer pays the infrastructure bill directly to their cloud provider, saving them significantly at scale.
Your mission is to make Grafana Labs the obvious choice for organizations that can't use standard SaaS because of compliance, data, or cost-at-scale constraints. Deployment choices change the product: features that are simple in standard SaaS can be hard, expensive, or impossible in a regulated or customer-owned environment. You’ll be responsible for adapting existing Grafana Cloud capabilities to these environments, deciding which features come in, which wait, and which stay out, and occasionally building something specific to BYOC or Federal Cloud. You'll also help shape which deployment models we offer next.
Along the way, you’ll use AI tools daily to speed up research, analyze product signals, and develop positioning, applying strong judgment to the results.
As the Staff Product Manager for Enterprise Deployment Solutions, you will:
 Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Grafana Bring Your Own Cloud and Grafana Federal Cloud products, using product data and market research to balance customer value against engineering cost and technical constraints
 Own positioning, messaging, and differentiation for these products, including how they compare to regular Grafana Cloud, and partner with Product Marketing on launches, competitive analysis, enablement, and demand programs
 Partner with Engineering and Technical Program Management on buildouts for these environments, balancing customer timelines with engineering capacity
 Work directly with customers, prospects, and the field on strategic deals and brief partners, resellers, and analysts on our deployment options
 Partner with Security, Compliance, and Legal to work through product changes affecting our authorization or existing customer commitments
 We’re excited about you because you have
 5+ years of product management experience on a technical B2B product, or a technical background (software engineering, solutions architecture, SRE, or technical program management) plus a demonstrated move into product ownership

title: Robotics Product Manager - Arduino, Turin, Italy
description:
Company
 Qualcomm Europe, Inc. Italy Branch Office
 Job Area
 Operations Group, Operations Group > Product Management
 General Summary
 Arduino is now part of the Qualcomm organization!
 Are you passionate about shaping the future of robotics and building technology that empowers engineers, educators, and innovators around the world? At Arduino , we’re looking for a Robotics Product Manager to lead the evolution of our robotics platforms—including mobile robots, robotic arms, sensor and actuator ecosystems, and learning kits—designed to support real-world exploration, hands-on education, and advanced prototyping.
In this role, you’ll partner closely with engineering, design, research, and business teams to define and deliver robotics products that truly matter. From early concept validation to launch and continuous improvement, you’ll own the entire product lifecycle with a strong focus on user needs, technical robustness, integrated hardware-software experiences, and business impact.
This position will be based at our operational headquarters in Turin, Italy .
 Minimum Qualifications
 Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Systems, Computer Science, Humanities, or related field.
 4+ years of Product Management or related work experience.

 Individual growth objectives supported by a dedicated learning and training budget.

 A meaningful role in a mission-driven company committed to empowering people worldwide.
 And if you live near one of our offices…
 Ping pong and football tournaments (plus sport/gym benefits for everyone!)

 What You'll Work On
 Shape the Vision

 Identify new robotics opportunities through market research, user insights, and competitive analysis.
 Translate ideas into clear product strategies that align with Arduino’s mission and the evolving robotics ecosystem.
 Drive Development

 Oversee mechanical, electrical, and firmware development, ensuring alignment with cost, quality, and timeline targets.
 Coordinate with supply chain and operations throughout prototyping, pre-series builds, and production ramp-up.
 Ensure documentation, safety, and compliance standards relevant to robotics (including mechatronics and motion systems).
 Partner with content and support teams to produce tutorials, example projects, classroom resources, and getting-started guides.
 Prepare for Go-to-Market and Launch

 Collaborate with marketing and sales to define product messaging, materials, and training.
 Contribute to pricing, positioning, and segmentation strategies for robotics products.
 Align teams across the company to ensure smooth and successful product rollout.
 Own the Lifecycle
 Track product performance using KPIs, user feedback, usage analytics, and community insights.
 Identify opportunities for enhancements, revisions, and long-term product evolution.
 Support lifecycle decisions including margin reviews, pricing updates, and end-of-life planning.
 What You Bring
 3 to 5 years of experience in product management, ideally within robotics, embedded systems, or mechatronics.
 Strong technical background with an understanding of robotics development—including motors, motion control, sensing, simulation, and firmware.
 Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary teams: mechanical, electrical, firmware, software, UX, supply chain, marketing, and sales.
 Strong grasp of full product lifecycle management: ideation, requirements, roadmap, release planning, and iteration.
 Data-driven mindset with the ability to use user insights, experiments, and metrics to drive decisions.
 Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical audiences.
 Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and a proactive attitude toward problem solving.

 4+ years of Product Management or related work experience.

 Experience with educational robotics platforms, robot kits, mobile robotics, or robotic manipulators.
 Familiarity with ROS/ROS2, simulation tools (e.g., Gazebo, Webots), or robotics middleware.
 Experience working with open-source hardware or software communities.
 Knowledge of Arduino’s hardware, software, and ecosystem.
 Ability to write or review technical content (tutorials, datasheets, guides).
 Experience with electronic design tools (KiCad, Altium) and mechanical CAD (Fusion 360, SolidWorks).
 Curiosity, adaptability, and enthusiasm for exploring new robotics domains.

 Responsibilities
 Responsibilities:
      Product Vision & Strategy: Develop and communicate a clear product vision and strategy for Core Lab’s solutions, aligning with Medpace's overall objectives.

 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

 Nice-to-have
 Strong understanding of medical imaging technologies and workflows in clinical trials.
 Knowledge of regulatory standards and quality procedures for medical devices and software
 Experience with SQL databases, Angular, C#.NET 
 Medpace Overview
 Medpace is a full-service clinical contract research organization (CRO) providing phase l-lV clinical development services to the biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and medical device industries. Our mission is to accelerate the global development of safe and effective medical therapeutics through the advancement of clinical research. We leverage in-country regulatory and therapeutic expertise across all major therapeutic areas including oncology, cardiology, metabolic, endocrinology, central nervous system, and anti-viral and anti-infective. Headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, we employ more than 6,500 people across 40+ countries.
 Why Medpace?

 Industry renowned onboarding and training programs designed to accelerate professional development
 Ongoing training and continuous learning opportunities throughout your career
 An environment that encourages employees to influence change, contribute ideas, and grow quickly
 Other Employee Benefits
 Competitive compensation programs that recognize and reward performance
 Comprehensive health, wellness, retirement, and PTO benefits
 Office based culture with occasional WFH that provides flexibility for eligible positions after training
 Company-sponsored social events 
 Please note benefits may vary based on country. 
 What To Expect Next
 A Medpace team member will review your application and if your profile matches our current needs, you will be contacted for an interview. While we review all applications carefully, we are unable to respond to every applicant, and only candidates selected for interviews will be contacted.

title: Product Manager
description:
At Zinco, we're building the back-office of the future for millions of small businesses: accounting, taxes, payroll, financing, all powered by cutting-edge AI and automation, delivered with the trust of real human advisors who truly understand what matters to clients. 
We're early. We move fast. And we're looking for someone who thrives in that environment, not despite it. 
 Your mission 
As an AI Product Manager, your mission is to compress the distance between idea and validated reality. You won’t wait for engineering capacity to explore whether something works — you'll build it yourself. Using AI tools, automation platforms, and low-code environments, you’ll ship functional prototypes end-to-end, put them in front of real users, and iterate fast enough that by the time a squad takes over, the hard questions are already answered. 
You’re the person who turns “we think this might work” into “we know it works, here’s the evidence.” 
 What you’ll do: 
 Build AI-powered workflows that automate accounting and tax processes, built and tested by you before engineering touches them.
 Create functional prototypes of internal tools that improve advisor productivity and client experience.
 Develop automations and agent pipelines that validate operational hypotheses.
 Ship end-to-end features to prove value at small scale before being productized by the squad.
 Define clear thresholds for “ready for the squad” handoffs: what signals, retention, or operational evidence demonstrate success.
 Run lightweight user tests on prototypes, gather feedback, and iterate fast.
 Document learnings, not just specs, to help squads build on validated foundations.
 Share tools, patterns, and workflows that help the team build and validate faster, you’re a multiplier, not just an individual contributor.
 What we’re looking for 
 Must-have: 
 Hybrid role based in Madrid: collaborate in-person several days a week while enjoying flexible remote work.
 Proven builder experience: shipped working software, automations, or AI-powered workflows that real people used.
 Fluency with modern maker tools: comfortable with Cursor, Claude / AI coding assistants, n8n, Zapier, or similar platforms.
 Thrive in ambiguity: structure fuzzy problems, prioritize ruthlessly, and bring order to chaos.
 Sharp product sense with a bias toward validation: focus on learning over perfection; make smart tradeoffs between fidelity and speed.
 Deep user empathy & strong UX instincts : understand first-time and power users, and know what good UX looks like.
 Ownership & extreme bias for action: build what’s needed to answer questions without waiting for permission.
 Comfortable with “good enough to learn”: know when to be scrappy vs. when to raise the bar.
 Influence without authority : align engineering, design, data, and docs through clarity and trust.
 Data fluency: strong intuition for interpreting signals from prototypes and experiments.
 Nice-to-have: 
 Growth experimentation experience: designed/analyzed A/B tests and know when experiments aren’t the right tool.
 Entrepreneurial/early-stage experience: worn many hats and navigated multiple areas at once.
 How we work: 
 Real problem, real users : You won’t build in a vacuum. Work closely with accountants, advisors, and small business owners — understand their pain firsthand and turn it into solutions that actually work.
 Flexibility & hybrid work : Ownership matters more than schedule. We value working side by side in the office to collaborate, think, and build as a team.
 Tools & setup : AI-first tools, automation platforms, low-code environments, and latest-generation hardware to move faster and think clearer.
 Growth & development: Dedicated training budget, clear company direction, and periodic performance reviews for career progression.
 Compensation: Meritocratic culture: your impact shapes your growth. Flexible benefits to make day-to-day easier.

description:

 « L’IA avance à la vitesse de vos données » est notre devise.

 Les avantages pour vous

 Pourquoi choisir Hilti

title: Senior Product Owner (AI & Legacy Evolution)
description:
Company Description
 As Hungary’s most attractive employer in 2025 (according to Randstad’s representative survey), Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions is a subsidiary of the Deutsche Telekom Group. The company provides a wide portfolio of IT and telecommunications services with more than 5300 employees. We have hundreds of large customers, corporations in Germany and in other European countries.
DT-ITS recieved the Best in Educational Cooperation award from HIPA in 2019, acknowledged as the the Most Ethical Multinational Company in 2019. The company continuously develops its four sites in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs and Szeged and is looking for skilled IT professionals to join its team.
 Job Description
 The Project: Internal Support Tools Evolution 
 You are joining an initiative focused on the evolution, modernization of the Internal Application Landscape. This project involves the strategic transition of well-known cloud services and legacy .NET architectures into a next-generation, AI-augmented, and cloud-native software landscape.
Our goal is not simply to "maintain" the existing system, but to proactively transform it—ensuring sovereignty, high-performance scalability, and seamless handover readiness through disciplined engineering.
 Our Engineering Philosophy 
 We operate at the intersection of Legacy Stability and Modern Innovation. Our approach is defined by:
 AI-Augmented Engineering: We utilize advanced AI development environments (such as Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Code) and cutting-edge model families to accelerate code comprehension, refactoring, and documentation. 
 Disciplined SDLC Patterns: We move beyond traditional development by implementing repeatable, evidence-based SDLC patterns. Every change is backed by structured engineering evidence and rigorous automated testing. 
 The "Strangler Fig" Modernization: We prioritize risk-mitigated evolution, using sophisticated patterns to wrap, refactor, and eventually replace legacy components. 
 High-Seniority Autonomy: We operate as a lean, highly autonomous unit. We value "technical detectives" who can navigate ambiguity and perform deep reverse engineering. 
 Mission 
 To lead the evolution of the Internal Application Landscape by designing repeatable SDLC patterns that bridge the gap between legacy OpenStack-derived services and next-generation AI-assisted software engineering. You will ensure that the transition from legacy architectures to modern, AI-integrated platforms delivers maximum business value while maintaining rigorous engineering evidence.
 Role Focus
 This role anchors the engineering approach for repository-scale understanding and sovereign software handover. You will focus on defining AI-assisted SDLC patterns for repository intake, service mapping, and engineering evidence generation, ensuring that coding agents and open-weight models are used to accelerate refactoring and documentation without compromising confidentiality.
 Key Responsibilities
 AI-Assisted SDLC Pattern Definition: Lead the design of patterns for repository intake, code exploration, build diagnosis, and engineering evidence generation using AI-driven workflows. 
 Strategic Roadmap & Prioritization: Manage and prioritize the Product Backlog, making critical decisions on the balance between "Run" (maintaining OpenStack-derived services) and "Change" (modernizing via AI-assisted refactoring). 
 AI Model Evaluation: Guide the evaluation and operationalization of AI development platforms and approved coding model stacks (e.g., DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral) for secure enterprise use cases. 
 Stakeholder Orchestration & Handover: Produce senior stakeholder-ready artifacts, including transition risks, service decomposition views, and structured evidence templates for sovereign software handover. 
 Human-in-the-loop Governance: Establish quality gates, prompt libraries, and reusable review patterns to validate AI-generated engineering outputs. 
 Rapid Prototyping: Utilize Microsoft PowerApps to quickly prototype business logic workflows and validate requirements with stakeholders. 
 Qualifications
 Experience: 7+ years in Product Ownership or Senior Business Analysis, ideally in complex cloud-native or AI-driven software environments. 
 Technical Literacy: Deep understanding of the SDLC, API-led architectures, and the complexities of managing technical debt in legacy/OpenStack environments. 
 AI Mindset: Familiarity with how LLM capabilities and agentic workflows can be used to enhance product evolution and operational efficiency. 
 Core Competencies: Exceptional analytical skills, ability to navigate extreme ambiguity, and expertise in translating "black-box" legacy logic into structured requirements. 
 Tooling: Proficiency in Jira/Azure DevOps, SQL, and experience with AI-assisted productivity tools. 
 Power Platform: Hands-on experience or strong interest in using Microsoft PowerApps for rapid prototyping. 
 Additional Information
 Please be informed that our remote working possibility is only available within Hungary due to European taxation regulation.
