title: Technical Product Owner
description:
Chyron is a global leader in products, services, and solutions for professional broadcast. As part of the Chyron team, you will be working with products that create content viewed by billions every day. We serve live television, news, and sports production, as well as other markets such as corporate, government, house of worship, esports and education. We offer the industry leading PRIME Live Platform, encompassing broadcast grade graphics, branding, augmented reality, video and audio mixing and more. Privately held, Chyron is headquartered in Melville, New York.
 We are looking for a Technical Product Owner to join our software development team and act as the critical link between Product Management, Engineering, and key stakeholders. The Product Owner will translate product vision and strategy into actionable deliverables, ensuring the team builds high-value, user-centric solutions that align with business objectives. The role of Product Owner will own a product focused on virtual studios and augmented reality based on Unreal Engine. Using world class graphical fidelity to drive broadcasts augmented with virtual graphics all across the world.
 This role requires strong communication, prioritization, and collaboration skills. You will manage the product backlog, write user stories, coordinate releases, and actively participate in Scrum ceremonies to drive the successful delivery of features and improvements.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Communicate the product vision by ensuring alignment between business objectives, product strategy, and development teams.
 Translate product roadmap into actionable User Stories that clearly capture customer needs, technical feasibility, and business value.
 Own and manage the product backlog , ensuring items are clearly defined, prioritized, and transparent to all stakeholders.
 Prioritize product needs , making informed trade-offs between scope, time, and budget to maximize business impact. 
 Participate in Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, demos, and retrospectives.
 Facilitate cross-team communication between development (Frontend, Backend, DevOps), Product Management, Support, and UI/UX teams to ensure shared understanding of requirements and priorities.
 Gather and evaluate feedback at each iteration to continuously refine backlog items and product direction.
 Collaborate with UI/UX teams to influence and validate design decisions, ensuring the product delivers a delightful user experience.
 Work closely with DevOps teams to track dependencies, groom requirements, and ensure operational readiness for new features.
 Coordinate releases , ensuring development, QA, and stakeholders are prepared, scope is validated, and risks are mitigated before launch.
 Requirements 
 Proven experience as a Product Owner or in a similar product-facing role (Business Analyst, Product Manager, etc.) within an Agile/Scrum environment.
 Experience with Unreal Engine and technical background as developer or tester
 Strong understanding of Agile principles and hands-on experience with Scrum ceremonies and backlog management.
 Ability to write clear, actionable User Stories and acceptance criteria.
 Excellent communication skills, able to bridge technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to make informed trade-off decisions.
 Familiarity with software development processes, DevOps practices, and UI/UX design collaboration.
 Experience coordinating product releases and ensuring stakeholder alignment.
 Nice to Have 
 Certification such as CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner) or equivalent.
 Background in software engineering or UX/UI design.
 Experience with tools like Jira, Confluence, or similar Agile management tools .

title: Senior ERP Product Owner - Manufacturing
description:
Job Description
 Position Summary
Leads the strategic functional direction of Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) modules at global scale — ensuring cross-module coherence, driving process convergence across regions, and shaping the long-term evolution of the platform. Serves as the single point of design authority for Oracle EBS functional domains, translating enterprise business strategy into a unified, scalable ERP roadmap aligned to manufacturing operations.
 Responsibilities
 Strategic Governance & Platform Direction
 Governs the strategic evolution of Oracle EBS functional domains, ensuring coherence and harmonization across all global modules and business units
 Defines and drives global convergence initiatives — aligning processes, data models, and solution patterns across regions to eliminate fragmentation
 Leads the translation of business strategy into Oracle EBS functional direction, serving as the bridge between enterprise objectives and platform capabilities
 Shapes the long-term platform roadmap, anticipating business needs and positioning Oracle EBS capabilities ahead of demand
 Prioritization & Demand Management
 Owns the end-to-end prioritization process for Oracle EBS capabilities, balancing global needs, functional dependencies, and long-term transformation goals
 Validates and refines business demand, ensuring correct alignment of backlog items with strategic priorities and architectural standards
 Arbitrates competing priorities across regions and business units, applying a consistent framework for investment decisions
 Design Authority & Solution Oversight
 Coordinates feasibility assessments, high-level solutioning, and design authority activities across functional teams
 Validates functional solutions and configuration enhancements against platform integrity, cross-module dependencies, and scalability requirements
 Evaluates long-term implications of design choices, ensuring decisions do not create technical debt or compromise future flexibility
 Roadmap Execution & Delivery Governance
 Validates cross-functional platform initiatives and Oracle EBS module enhancement roadmaps, including scope definition and delivery planning
 Tracks completion of Oracle EBS module enhancements — including configuration updates, functional changes, and release outcomes
 Ensures delivery milestones align with committed timelines and that release outcomes meet functional acceptance criteria
 Qualifications
 Experience
 8-10 years of experience in Oracle EBS product ownership, functional leadership, or global process governance
 Proven track record managing Oracle EBS modules at enterprise scale, including cross-module alignment and multi-region convergence
 Demonstrated experience prioritizing complex Oracle EBS backlogs and balancing global, functional, and technical constraints
 Experience operating within matrixed, multi-stakeholder environments across geographies and business units
 Education
 University degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or equivalent experience; Advanced Degree may be required
 Technical Skills
 Deep understanding of Oracle EBS architectures, module interactions, and integration patterns
 Ability to evaluate functional impacts, cross-module dependencies, and long-term implications of design choices
 Familiarity with Oracle EBS configuration management, release processes, and upgrade planning
 Working knowledge of data models, process harmonization frameworks, and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) convergence methodologies
 Communication & Influence
 Ability to articulate complex technical trade-offs to senior business stakeholders in clear, decision-ready terms
 Proven ability to build consensus across competing regional and functional priorities
 Skilled at orchestrating alignment across distributed teams without direct authority
 Professional Competencies
 Strategic thinking — ability to connect platform decisions to long-term business outcomes
 Decisive leadership — comfortable making high-stakes prioritization calls with incomplete information
 Systems-level perspective — sees interdependencies across modules, regions, and timelines
 Influence without authority — drives convergence and alignment across matrixed organizations
 Physical & Environmental Demands
 Standard office environment; no unusual physical demands
 Time Travel Required
 Up to 15% 
 The successful candidate will embrace Vertiv’s Core Principals & Behaviors to help execute our Strategic Priorities.
 OUR CORE PRINCIPLES : Safety.  Integrity.  Respect.  Teamwork.  Inclusion.
 OUR STRATEGIC PRIORITIES
 High-Performance Culture 
 Customer Focus 
 Operational Excellence 
 Innovation 
 Financial Strength 
 VERTIV BEHAVIORS
 Own it 
 Act with urgency 
 Foster a customer-first mindset 
 Think big and execute 
 Lead by example 
 Drive continuous improvement 
 Learn and seek out development 
 Promote transparent & open communication 
 About Vertiv
 Vertiv (NYSE: VRT) brings together hardware, software, analytics and ongoing services to enable its customers’ vital applications to run continuously, perform optimally and grow with their business needs.  Vertiv solves the most important challenges facing today’s data centers, communication networks and commercial and industrial facilities with a portfolio of power, cooling and IT infrastructure solutions and services that extend from the cloud to the edge of the network. Headquartered in Westerville, Ohio, USA, Vertiv employs around 34,000 people and does business in more than 130 countries. Visit Vertiv.com to learn more.

Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.
 Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Product Owner
description:

Vous serez en interaction avec notre partenaire développeur et avec toutes les équipes (DSI, métiers opérationnels, transformation…). Vous participerez aux réunions d'équipe (Projet, RUN), participerez aux décisions sur votre périmètre et serez force de proposition.

 Identifier, recueillir les besoins utilisateurs et business,

title: Product Owner - ASD DP
description:
A Siemens Mobility Kft. K+F központjában, a XI. kerületi Infoparkban olyan projekteken dolgozunk, melyek biztosítják a zavartalan, fenntartható, megbízható és biztonságos közlekedést.
 Tudj meg többet a cégünkről: www.siemens.hu/mobility
 A projektről és a pozícióról: egy nemzetközi csapat (Németország, Ausztria) tagjaként részt veszel az LMC (mozdonyok és vasúti kocsik) Smart Asset Suite szoftvertermék-portfóliójának alakításában, ügyfélközpontú termékfejlesztési megközelítéssel.
Product Ownerként specializálódsz a mozdonyfelügyeleti és -menedzsment webes és mobilalkalmazásokra, digitális termékeink mozgatórugójaként fogsz működni. Te fogod irányítani a webalapú IoT szolgáltatásaink vízióját és megvalósítását, amelyek mozdonyadatokat gyűjtenek, elemeznek és vizualizálnak.
Kezdetben a mozdonyalkalmazásokra összpontosítva, később pedig szerepköröd kiterjedhet a vasúti eszközmenedzsment teljes webes fejlesztési rétegének felügyeletére.
Teljes felelősséged lesz azokért a digitális termékekért, amelyek segítik az üzemeltetőket mozdonyflottáik karbantartásában és optimalizálásában – beleértve a funkcionális követelmények meghatározását, a fejlesztési tervezést és a termékfunkciók ütemtervét.
 A csapat tagjaként az alábbi feladatok várnak rád:
 Az LMC Smart Asset Suite webes és mobilalkalmazásainak termékvíziójának, stratégiájának és fejlesztésének irányítása. 
 Az üzleti és felhasználói igények kezelése, valamint a járműadat-vizualizációs és prediktív karbantartási funkciók priorizálása. 
 A termékbacklog kezelése és a fejlesztőcsapatokkal való együttműködés koordinálása. 
 Nemzetközi, agilis frontend- és backend-fejlesztő csapatok munkájának támogatása a mozdonyfelügyeleti megoldások fejlesztésében. 
 Teljes termékfelelősség ellátása, beleértve a tervezést, előrejelzést és az üzleti igények műszaki megoldásokkal való összekapcsolását. 
 A termékminőség biztosítása a fejlesztési életciklus valamennyi szakaszában. 
 Kapcsolattartás az üzleti területekkel, marketinggel, ügyfélszolgálattal és egyéb érintettekkel. 
 Együttműködés mozdonymérnökökkel és karbantartási szakemberekkel a digitális termékcélok megvalósítása érdekében.
 Te vagy az ideális jelölt, ha:
 Informatikai területen szerzett felsőfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel.
 Van legalább 3 év tapasztalatod nemzetközi, agilis környezetben, Product Ownerként, ahol webes és mobilalkalmazásokkal foglalkoztál.
 Folyékony angol nyelvtudással rendelkezel.
 Kiterjedt ismeretekkel rendelkezel webfejlesztési technológiákban, keretrendszerekben és a legjobb gyakorlatokban SaaS környezetben.
 Alapos ismereteid vannak felhőalapú platformok (pl. AWS, Azure) járműfelügyeleti alkalmazások hostolásához köthetően.
 Jártas vagy műszaki rendszerek adatvizualizációjában, ideálisan közlekedési vagy gyártási környezetben.
 Erős eredményorientáltság jellemez, különös tekintettel a járműüzemeltetők számára nyújtott kiváló digitális felhasználói élményre.
 Képes vagy önálló munkavégzésre, fejlett tulajdonosi szemlélettel rendelkezel a mozdony- és közlekedési szektor webes termékei iránt.
 A pályázásod során előnyt jelenthet, amennyiben:
 Tudsz németül.
 Van tapasztalatod a SAFe keretrendszerről és a webfejlesztést támogató eszközökről (pl. Jira, Azure DevOps stb.)
 Mozdonyrendszerek, vasúti járműtechnológia vagy gyártási folyamatok ismerete vagy ezek iránti erős érdeklődés jellemez.
 Mi az, amit mi biztosítunk?
 Családbarát munkahelyet, kötetlen munkaidővel, rugalmas hozzáállással.
 Stresszmentes környezetet, ahol nagy hangsúlyt kap a work-life balance.
 Fejlődési lehetőségeket, egyéni tréning kerettel, kidolgozott karrierúttal.
 Fontos számunkra az egészséged, többek közt élet- és egészségbiztosítással óvunk.
 Ergonomikus munkakörnyezetet biztosítunk számodra, ezzel is kényelmessé téve az irodai munkavégzést.
 A felsoroltak mellett egy több mint 20 elemből álló béren kívüli juttatási csomaggal várunk.

title: Product Owner Customer Applications
description:
Wat jij mag verwachten 
 Ben jij een Product Owner die graag impact maakt op digitale oplossingen die dagelijks gebruikt worden door klanten, makelaars en partners? Dan kan deze rol binnen het domein Attract & Connect interessant zijn voor jou.
 Je rapporteert aan de Domein Product Manager en werkt samen met een multidisciplinair team van analisten, developers, UX-profielen en een Scrum Master.
 Zo ziet jouw takenpakket eruit 
 Je neemt de inhoudelijke verantwoordelijkheid op voor verschillende customer applications binnen jouw scope. Daarbij bepaal je mee de productvisie, bewaak je de roadmap en prioriteer je de backlog zodat je team voortdurend werkt aan initiatieven met de grootste meerwaarde.
 Je bouwt mee aan digitale oplossingen zoals online simulaties, leadgeneratie, selfservice voor polissen en schadebeheer. Door actief in gesprek te gaan met makelaars, klanten en interne stakeholders verzamel je inzichten die je vertaalt naar concrete verbeteringen en heldere prioriteiten. 
 Daarnaast werk je nauw samen met UX/UI-designers om customer journeys verder te optimaliseren. Je hebt oog voor zowel functionaliteit als gebruiksvriendelijkheid en draagt bij aan een sterke digitale klantbeleving.
 Naast je rol als Product Owner neem je voor bepaalde initiatieven ook de verantwoordelijkheid op als Epic Owner. Je begeleidt ideeën van concept tot oplevering, stemt af met stakeholders en zorgt ervoor dat epics voldoende voorbereid zijn voordat ze op de roadmap worden ingepland.
 Je werkt daarbij intensief samen met architecten, business stakeholders, analisten en andere productteams. Ook zorg je voor de nodige afstemming en documentatie binnen delivery- en governanceprocessen zodat projecten efficiënt en voorspelbaar gerealiseerd kunnen worden.
 Je betrekt eindklanten, makelaars en interne gebruikers actief bij de ontwikkeling van je producten. Via workshops, interviews, demo’s, gebruiksinzichten en feedbacksessies verzamel je waardevolle input die je vertaalt naar concrete verbeteringen en heldere prioriteiten.
 Wat breng jij mee? 
 Ervaring als Product Owner of in een sterk vergelijkbare rol.
 Ervaring met agile werken binnen een SAFe-context of gelijkaardige omgeving
 Ervaring met het voorbereiden en begeleiden van complexe epics met meerdere stakeholders en afhankelijkheden
 Sterke vaardigheden in stakeholdermanagement, prioritering en backlogbeheer
 Ervaring met customer journeys, digitale producten en klantgerichte toepassingen
 Je presenteert complexe materie helder en vertaalt inzichten naar roadmaps en managementpresentaties
 Uitstekende kennis van het Nederlands en een goede kennis van het Engels. Kennis van het Frans is een plus.
 Interesse? Neemt contact op met de verantwoordelijke Talent Acquisition Specialist (Sarah Venstermans) of solliciteert via het jobportaal van Baloise België!

title: Entrepreneur In Residence
description:
About The Company
 At Smartness , we are building the future of hospitality tech. Our SaaS helps lodging providers boost revenues by 30%+ and get more direct bookings.
We are the fastest-growing B2B SaaS in the industry, trusted by 4,000+ clients across 40+ countries , with billions of euros in bookings processed. Backed by top international investors and named one of Italy's Top 10 LinkedIn Startups, we are on a mission to scale globally.
Want to grow with us? Let's go!
 About The Role
 What Will You Do? 🦾
 As a true Entrepreneur In Residence with a founder’s DNA , you’ll be responsible for ideating, validating, and driving new products to success — like running your own startup, but with the power of an established growth engine behind you.
 Your Missions
 Spot opportunities & validate ideas through research, interviews, and fast MVPs.
 Run lean experiments with landing pages, prototypes, and no-code tools.
 Lead cross-functional squads (Product, Tech, Marketing, Sales) like an internal startup.
 Own go-to-market & early adoption, from positioning to first deals.
 Track KPIs & pivot fast, turning insights into growth.
 Drive end-to-end execution, taking products from 0 to MVP to initial traction.
 What We’re Looking For 👀
 Sales & GTM Skills – You can sell even an MVP: cold calls, demos, closing deals, and writing copy that converts. HubSpot/Salesforce pro with a growth hacking mindset.
 Product Execution – Experienced in problem validation, rapid MVP building (incl. no-code), clear roadmaps, and data-driven decisions.
 Track Record – 3+ years in startups or scale-ups, 2–3 years in GTM-heavy or founder-like roles, proven success taking products from 0 to 1.
 Bonus – Background in Hospitality Tech, HR Tech, or Fintech.
 Languages – Fluent English + Professional Italian.
 What Do We Offer? 👌
 Work in a small and top-performing team that moves extremely fast where you are extremely important.
 Work without having to deal with jerks and ego-maniacs.
 The opportunity to join one of the best travel-tech sales teams in Europe.
 A place where your talent can blossom.
 An environment where mistakes are allowed – we make bold choices to achieve ambitious goals, learn from mistakes, and move forward.
 A place where your voice matters – meetings provide space for new ideas and projects, regardless of your role or seniority.
 Continuous growth – we challenge the status quo, renewing our sales processes and approaches to meet challenging goals.
 We have fun while working! We are easygoing people.
 Work with the best software out there to automate repetitive tasks and let you focus on customers and targets.
 Remote working.
 We offer competitive compensation and the opportunity to participate in the company’s long-term growth through equity access. Early-career professionals typically join with an annual OTE starting from €25,000 across Europe, while candidates with significant relevant experience may receive compensation of up to €65,000, depending on their expertise, scope of responsibilities, and expected impact - plus the opportunity to receive equity, aligning your success with the long-term growth of the company. Our compensation philosophy is designed to reward growth, ownership, and meaningful contributions. As you develop your skills and increase your impact within the company, your compensation can progress rapidly to reflect your achievements and responsibilities. For exceptional candidates demonstrating outstanding potential or experience, we may consider offers beyond the standard compensation ranges.
 Still not convinced? Check out our "Work With Us" page for more about our mission, values, and why we love working at Smartpricing: Lavora con noi - Unisciti alla missione di Smartness
 Before you apply
 If you're reading this, it means you're genuinely interested, and that excites us! Here's what you need to know:
 We're highly driven and set our goals higher than most, pushing boundaries others may deem impossible.
 We work much harder than most companies out there.
 Every day, we step out of our comfort zones, fueling rapid growth and learning, even though it might come with its stress.
 We hold ourselves and our team to the highest standards of excellence and culture.
 Should we feel that this role isn't the right match for you, for the benefit of both parties, we may need to part ways.
 We hope this sheds light on whether this could be your next adventure. If you believe it is, we warmly invite you to apply. Discover your full potential with us!
 A quick heads-up: we reply to every candidate. If you're waiting for an update, please check your spam/junk folder too - sometimes our emails end up there. We wouldn't want you to miss a message from us!
By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be collected, processed, and retained by the company solely for the purposes of managing and assessing my candidacy.

title: Product Manager
description:
We are seeking an experienced Digital Product Manager to lead a significant digital transformation programme within a leading life assurance and health organisation. The role will take ownership of the product roadmap and delivery associated with the consolidation of multiple legacy platforms into a new, unified digital experience across web and native mobile applications. The successful candidate will work closely with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams to ensure the platform delivers a high-quality, customer-focused experience while meeting the requirements of a highly regulated environment.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own and develop the product vision, strategy and roadmap for the migration and consolidation of digital platforms.
 Lead the end-to-end delivery of digital products and enhancements across web and mobile applications.
 Prioritise product initiatives based on customer value, business impact, data and technical feasibility.
 Define and monitor KPIs relating to customer engagement, adoption and overall product performance.
 Manage senior stakeholders across Product, Technology, Marketing, Project Management, Business Analysis, QA, CRM and Compliance.
 Communicate product strategy, priorities and delivery progress effectively to senior leadership and C-suite stakeholders.
 Use customer insight, analytics and feedback to continually improve the digital experience.
 Ensure product initiatives comply with relevant regulatory and data protection requirements, including GDPR, DPIAs and TIAs.
 Manage risks relating to technical debt, scalability and regulatory change.
 Provide leadership and direction to the wider product team, promoting accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
 Key Experience 
 The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Digital Product Management, with demonstrable experience owning product strategy, roadmaps and end-to-end delivery.
 Experience delivering large-scale digital transformation, platform migration or consolidation programmes is particularly important, alongside experience with customer-facing web and/or native mobile applications.
 Candidates should also demonstrate:
 Experience delivering digital products at scale, ideally supporting 50,000+ users.
 Strong senior stakeholder management and influencing skills.
 Experience within a regulated environment such as insurance, financial services or healthcare.
 Familiarity with APIs, Azure, CMS and CRM integrations.
 Experience working across Agile and multidisciplinary delivery teams.
 Knowledge of GDPR and associated DPIA/TIA processes.
 A data-driven approach to product development and customer engagement.
 The ability to combine strategic product thinking with hands-on delivery.
 HOW TO APPLY: 
 If you are interested in this role, please apply with your updated CV

title: Product Lead | Q1 27
description:
In Short 
 Own the roadmap. Build the features. Put AI to real work. See your work used every day. 
 Tracklab is hiring a Product Lead to take our platform to the next level: the system of record that 120+ industrial companies rely on every day to manage supplier and product compliance data.
 You’ll join a small team of 5 engineers, 1 product manager and an AI Engineer , working directly with Nicolas our cofounder.
 Tracklab 🏭 
 🚀 Our mission: Tracklab is building the system of record for regulated supply chains. 
 Today, in critical industries such as food & beverage, chemicals, packaging, flavors & fragrances, animal nutrition and pharma, compliance data still moves through emails, PDFs and Excel files.
 As regulations accelerate across Europe and globally (technical data, product safety, sustainability frameworks & ESG), this creates:
 Major regulatory exposure
 Product recalls costing hundreds of thousands to millions of euros
 Poor data reliability
 Heavy operational friction
 Tracklab provides the infrastructure layer that allows industrial companies to collect, structure, validate and securely share trusted supplier and product data in an auditable, AI-native way.
 120+ 
 industrial clients
 40k+ 
 connected suppliers
 🔥 Our ambition is simple 
 become the infrastructure standard companies rely on to operate in an increasingly regulated world.
 Each Tracklab deployment starts as a SaaS platform implemented within a single industrial company, structuring its compliance and operational data. But the real power comes from what happens next. As companies invite their suppliers and partners onto the platform, these individual deployments connect together, forming a trusted data network across supply chains.
 👥 A strong team 
 Tracklab was founded in the end of 2022 by:
 Nicolas Henry (Ponts & Chaussées, Columbia University, ex-Uber San Francisco)
 Fadel Bennani (HEC Paris, ex-Bain & Company)
 You will report directly to Nicolas Henry , co-founder, and work hand in hand with our Engineering & Data team as well as our Operations team .
 The Role 
 We are at the point where product can no longer be co-piloted between the founders and a single PM. We are looking for a Product Lead who takes full ownership of the product function: discovery, roadmap, specifications, delivery quality, and the team.
 ⚖️ This is a hands-on leadership role : roughly 60% individual contribution on our hardest problems, 40% structuring the product function (rituals, standards, mentoring, hiring) and grow rapidly into a broader strategic role. 
 🇫🇷🇺🇸 The main language is French, but English proficiency is a must-have.
 What you'll own 
 🧭 The product roadmap end to end 
 From client discovery and business objectives to prioritization, arbitration and delivery. You own the "why" and the "when".
 📐 Complexity turned into shippable specs 
 Data models, documentary workflows, versioning, traceability. You go all the way down to the object level with Engineering.
 ⚙️ A tight loop with Engineering & Data 
 You work daily with our Tech Lead and our AI team to arbitrate scope, sequencing and technical trade-offs.
 📊 Measuring what we ship 
 Usage instrumentation, adoption metrics, and honest post-launch reviews.
 🏗️ Our most ambitious product bets 
 You take the features nobody else can carry, the ones that touch the core of the platform, and you drive them from a blank page to adoption.
 👥 Building and leading the product team 
 You set the bar on discovery and specs, and you grow the team as we scale.
 📣 The go-to-market of every release 
 With Marketing, Sales, Ops and CSM: positioning, enablement, product newsletters, adoption.
 Most important qualities for a Product Lead role at Tracklab 
 You have already shipped complex B2B products , the kind with deep data models and real business logic, not just CRUD screens and dashboards
 You are comfortable being the most rigorous person in the room on a topic nobody fully owns yet
 You can hold a long-term vision and a two-week sprint in your head at the same time, and arbitrate between them without drama
 You genuinely enjoy going deep into a client's operational reality: you would rather spend a day in a quality department than in a strategy deck
 You lead by raising standards, not by adding process . You give clear feedback and you make decisions
 Entrepreneurial mindset: you thrive in a fast-moving environment where the answer is rarely written down anywhere
 Skills & experience 
 Must haves 
 6 to 10 years in product , including senior or lead roles in a B2B SaaS environment
 Proven track record shipping complex, data-heavy features end to end (data modeling, workflows, permissions, integrations)
 Experience mentoring or managing at least one PM, formally or informally
 Strong written communication in French and English: your specs are read by engineers, clients and founders
 Comfortable working directly with engineers on architecture and trade-offs, without needing a translator
 Structured discovery practice: you talk to users constantly and you can prove what you learned
 Nice to haves 
 Experience with PLM, PIM, ERP, MES, QMS or any system of record for industrial or regulated data
 Knowledge of agri-food, cosmetics, chemicals or other regulated industries
 Experience building AI-native features in production: extraction, validation, agents, evaluation loops
 You can prototype (SQL, Figma, vibe-coded prototypes) to derisk a spec before it reaches the backlog
 Salary, compensation, location, benefits, and holidays 
 Full-time permanent position (CDI), starting end of 2026 or Q1 2027 
 60 - 75k gross annual salary, depending on experience + bonus
 BSPCE : this is a key hire and it is compensated as such
 An office-first company. 1 day of remote work per week + flex remote policy summer / holiday season (year-end)
 50% public transport reimbursement, Swile (Meal voucher)
 A fully equipped office nested in the heart of Montmartre (Paris, 75018)
 How to apply and process

title: Product Owner (m/w/d) (German Speaking)
description:
Nur Vollzeit – Standort Wien (AT) 
 Hybrid, 2 Tage Homeoffice pro Woche | Gehalt: Ab EUR 3.500,00€ Brutto/Monat (Nach KV; Überzahlung möglich)
 Warum du? 
 Du möchtest:
 einen Job, bei dem dein Einsatz und deine Entscheidungen unmittelbare Wirkung haben.
 eigene Projekte von der ersten Idee bis zum Release begleiten und Verantwortung dafür übernehmen.
 eng mit Kund:innen und Entwickler:innen zusammenarbeiten und aus echten Problemen einfache, funktionierende Lösungen machen.
 moderne Technologien und KI nicht nur spannend finden, sondern aktiv in deinem Arbeitsalltag einsetzen.
 in einem jungen Team arbeiten, schnell lernen und dich insbesondere in den Bereichen Produkt, UX und KI weiterentwickeln.
 Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!
 Wer sind wir? 
 reebuild ist das KI-gestützte Backoffice für die Bau- und Immobilienbranche. Wir automatisieren Rechnungsprüfung, Kostenmanagement und Materialverwaltung, damit Bauunternehmen und Projektentwickler weniger Zeit mit Verwaltung verbringen und mehr mit dem, was auf der Baustelle zählt. Über 120 Unternehmen in Österreich, Deutschland und darüber hinaus haben über unsere Plattform bereits mehr als 530 Millionen Euro Rechnungsvolumen verarbeitet.
 In unserem Team in Wien gilt: Fortschritt vor Hierarchie. Wirkung vor Status. Kurze Wege, klare Prioritäten und viel Raum, eigene Ideen umzusetzen. Unser Ziel ist null Verwaltungsaufwand am Bau, und dafür suchen wir Menschen, die mit anpacken wollen.
 Dein Profil 
 Als Product Owner (m/w/d) bist du die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kund:innen und unserem Development-Team. Dabei geht es nicht darum, Anforderungen einfach weiterzugeben oder Tickets zu verwalten. Du möchtest verstehen, welches Problem wir eigentlich lösen müssen, entwickelst daraus gemeinsam mit dem Team die passende Lösung und begleitest diese von der ersten Idee über Prototyping und Development bis zum Release und darüber hinaus. Als Teil unseres Product Teams prägst du Produktideen und Projekte von Anfang an mit. Dabei hast du Gestaltungsspielraum, direkten Austausch im Team und siehst schnell, wie deine Arbeit bei echten Nutzer:innen ankommt.
Deine Aufgaben 
 Du verstehst Probleme, bevor du Lösungen baust.
 Du sprichst gezielt mit unseren Kund:innen, analysierst ihre Arbeitsabläufe und findest heraus, wo die tatsächlichen Probleme liegen. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unserem Customer-Success-Team zusammen, ohne selbst die laufende Kundenbetreuung zu übernehmen.
 Aus diesen Erkenntnissen entwickelst du klare Produktanforderungen und Lösungskonzepte.
 Du bringst Ideen schnell zum Leben.
 Du entwickelst User Flows, Wireframes und klickbare bzw. funktionale Prototypen, um Ideen möglichst früh greifbar zu machen und zu testen. Dabei arbeiten wir nicht ausschließlich mit klassischen Design-Tools: Wir setzen bereits heute AI-Coding-Tools ein, um Prototypen direkt im Frontend-Code umzusetzen.
 Du verantwortest deine Projekte End-to-End.
 Von der ersten Problemstellung über Konzeption und Prototyping bis zur Umsetzung arbeitest du eng mit unseren Entwickler:innen zusammen. Du stellst sicher, dass Problem, Ziel und gewünschtes Verhalten klar sind, denkst bei technischen Entscheidungen mit und entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Development-Team die passende Lösung.
 Während der Umsetzung behältst du Zeitpläne und Abhängigkeiten im Blick, löst Blocker, steuerst Erwartungen und passt bei Bedarf den Leistungsumfang an.
 Du gewährleistet gemeinsam mit uns Qualität.
 Vor einem Release testest du deine Features selbst, hinterfragst UX und Verständlichkeit und prüfst, ob die Lösung tatsächlich das ursprüngliche Kundenproblem löst.
Nach dem Release ist deine Arbeit nicht automatisch abgeschlossen: Du holst Feedback vom Customer-Success-Team und unseren Entwicklungspartner:innen ein, beobachtest die Nutzung und entscheidest gemeinsam mit dem Team, wo wir weiter iterieren müssen.
Dein Profil 
 So arbeitest du: 
 Du hast praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung digitaler Produkte und weißt, wie aus einem Problem ein fertiges Feature wird.
 Du bist technisch affin, kannst mit Entwickler:innen auf Augenhöhe diskutieren und bringst idealerweise erste Coding-Erfahrung oder Kenntnisse in UX, User Flows und Prototyping mit.
 Du arbeitest gerne direkt mit Kund:innen, hörst gut zu und übersetzt komplexe Anforderungen in verständliche Lösungen.
 Du organisierst dich selbstständig, übernimmst Verantwortung und kommunizierst klar im Team - Ownership heißt für uns nicht, alles allein zu machen.
 Du arbeitest lösungsorientiert und pragmatisch, und probierst lieber aus, statt lange zu diskutieren. Dabei bleibst du sorgfältig und behältst ein Auge für Details.
 Du bist neugierig, offen für neue Tools und hast Interesse daran, KI sinnvoll in deinen Arbeitsalltag zu integrieren.
 Du hast Lust, dich in die Bau- und Immobilienbranche einzuarbeiten. Branchenerfahrung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Deutsch beherrschst du sicher, Englisch ist von Vorteil.
Benefits 
 Was dich bei uns erwartet:
 Ownership: Du bekommst eigene Projekte und den Gestaltungsspielraum, um sie von der Problemstellung bis zum fertigen Produkt zu begleiten.
 Steile Lernkurve : Du arbeitest gleichzeitig an Produkt, UX, Technologie und AI und lernst die Prozesse einer Branche kennen, in der es noch großes Digitalisierungspotenzial gibt.
 Moderne Product-Arbeit: Kurze Feedback-Schleifen und Entscheidungswege sowie moderne Tools. Wir nutzen AI gezielt, um unsere Produktentwicklung zu beschleunigen und zu verbessern.
 Direkter Impact: Deine Ideen erreichen schnell echte Nutzer:innen. Feedback fließt direkt zurück, sodass deine Arbeit zügig im Produkt und bei unseren Kund:innen landet.
 Teamwork: Du arbeitest eng mit Customer-Success-Team und Development zusammen. Eigenverantwortung ist uns wichtig – genauso wichtig ist es uns aber, gemeinsam bessere Lösungen zu entwickeln.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
About Acta 
 Acta is a forestation project developer working on large-scale carbon and biodiversity projects across Europe and Central Asia. We restore ecosystems, improve forest management, and generate high-integrity carbon credits in partnership with public and private stakeholders.
 As Acta grows from a small founding team into a multi-country organisation, we are looking for a Chief of Staff to work alongside our CEO and keep the company’s priorities, people and projects moving in the same direction.
 The Role 
 The Chief of Staff is the CEO’s right hand. You will manage the CEO’s priorities and follow-ups, run the company’s leadership rhythm, lead hiring and team build-out, and coordinate cross-team work so decisions get made on time and actually happen. You will also lead strategic special projects, from setting up a new country entity to preparing for an investor meeting.
 This is a hands-on, high-trust role. A lot of the work is follow-through; the rest is working on whatever matters most to the company at the time.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Managing CEO’s office 
 Manage the CEO’s priorities, agenda and follow-ups; prepare briefings before key meetings and drive actions after them
 Draft correspondence, memos and internal communications in Bulgarian and English
 Act as a point of contact for the team and external parties on CEO’s behalf when needed
 Leadership rhythm and coordination 
 Run the leadership meeting cadence: agendas, minutes, decision logs and action tracking
 Keep one clear view of company priorities, project milestones and owners, and flag slippage early
 Coordinate cross-team deliverables (e.g. feasibility study write-up, investor packs, partner proposals): split the work, assign owners, track to completion
 Own Acta’s task management and documentation standards (PM Tool, shared drives, meeting records)
 People and organisation 
 Lead recruitment end to end: role design, job descriptions, sourcing, interview design, candidate assessment and offers, working with HR
 Maintain the organisation structure, headcount plan and team cost model with Finance
 Coordinate onboarding for new hires and consultants, including scopes of work and engagement terms
 Support performance reviews and team routines as the team grows
 Investors, board and reporting 
 Coordinate investor, board and investment committee materials, pulling inputs from finance, technical and business development leads
 Prepare regular internal reporting on progress, risks and decisions needed
 Strategic and special projects 
 Lead time-bound projects for the CEO, such as new country entity set-up, onboarding of country leadership, and internal tools and policies
 Coordinate Acta’s participation in major events: logistics, materials and meeting schedules
 Step in to cover gaps across the business when priorities shift
 Profile 
 5–8 years in strategy consulting, programme or PMO management, chief of staff or business operations roles; startup or scale-up experience a plus
 Experience working directly with CEO's, partners or senior executives
 Strong programme management: tracks many workstreams, owners and deadlines without losing detail (PMP or similar a plus)
 Experience running recruitment processes or building teams
 Excellent writer: clear briefings, minutes, memos and presentations, produced fast
 Advanced Excel / Google Sheets and PowerPoint; comfortable with Asana or similar tools
 Discreet and trustworthy with confidential information
 Fluent Bulgarian and excellent English, written and spoken (both required)
 Nice to Have (Not Required) 
 Exposure to carbon markets, climate, forestry or sustainability
 Familiarity with Bulgarian employment processes and documentation
 Experience supporting fundraising or investor relations
 What This Role Offers 
 A front-row seat to how a climate company is built, working side by side with the CEO
 Broad exposure across strategy, people, finance, investors and international projects
 Real ownership, in a role that grows with you and with the company
 A mission-driven team building projects that matter, at scale

company: INKUBIT - Microsoft AI & Business Applications Partner
title: Founder Associate
description:
Anstellungsart: Vollzeit, 40 Stunden pro Woche
 Über die Position 
 Als Founder Associate bei INKUBIT arbeitest du eng mit unserem Gründer und CEO zusammen und erhältst spannende Einblicke in unterschiedliche Bereiche eines führenden Microsoft Solutions Partners. Dazu zählen Strategie und Unternehmensentwicklung ebenso wie das operative Geschäft, strategische Partnerschaften und Business Development.
 In dieser vielseitigen Position unterstützt du unseren CEO im Tagesgeschäft, übernimmst eigenverantwortlich Projekte und wirkst an verschiedenen Initiativen im Unternehmen mit.
 Dabei geht es vor allem darum, Ideen in die Tat umzusetzen : Du bringst Struktur in offene Themen, recherchierst Informationen, stimmst dich mit den richtigen Ansprechpartnern ab und sorgst dafür, dass Vorhaben vorankommen. Mit der Zeit übernimmst du zunehmend Verantwortung für eigene Projekte und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung von INKUBIT aktiv mit.
 1. CEO & Executive Support 
 Du organisierst und priorisierst den E-Mail-Posteingang und den Kalender unseres CEOs, koordinierst Termine und behältst wichtige Themen und Fristen im Blick.
 Du verfasst E-Mails und erstellst Präsentationen, Briefings, Tagesordnungen und weitere Geschäftsunterlagen.
 Du dokumentierst wichtige Entscheidungen und offene Aufgaben und sorgst dafür, dass vereinbarte nächste Schritte umgesetzt werden.
 Du koordinierst die Kommunikation zwischen dem CEO, internen Teams, Kunden, Partnern und externen Ansprechpartnern.
 Bei Bedarf übernimmst du die Organisation von Geschäftsreisen sowie weitere administrative und organisatorische Aufgaben.
 Du unterstützt unseren CEO dabei, Prioritäten zu setzen, den Überblick zu behalten und wichtige Themen voranzubringen.
 2. Special Projects & Founder Initiatives 
 Ein wichtiger Teil deiner Aufgabe besteht darin, Projekte und Initiativen, die unser CEO vorantreibt, eigenständig zu koordinieren und umzusetzen.
 Je nach aktuellen Prioritäten gehören dazu beispielsweise folgende Aufgaben:
 Du beschäftigst dich mit neuen Geschäftsideen, Märkten und Technologien und bewertest deren Potenzial.
 Du entwickelst aus ersten Ideen und Fragestellungen konkrete Konzepte, Maßnahmenpläne und Handlungsempfehlungen.
 Du recherchierst und analysierst relevante Informationen und bereitest Business Cases, Präsentationen und Entscheidungsgrundlagen auf.
 Du koordinierst Projekte, stimmst dich mit den Beteiligten ab und behältst Aufgaben, Zeitpläne und nächste Schritte im Blick.
 Du wirkst an Initiativen rund um neue Dienstleistungen, Geschäftsmodelle, Prozessoptimierung, Automatisierung und künstliche Intelligenz mit.
 Dabei bekommst du häufig ein Ziel vorgegeben, aber keine detaillierte Anleitung zur Umsetzung . Du solltest Freude daran haben, dich selbstständig in neue Themen einzuarbeiten, eigene Lösungsansätze zu entwickeln und diese in die Praxis umzusetzen.
 3. Business Operations & Commercial Support 
 Da unser Gründer und CEO selbst aktiv in Business Development, strategische Partnerschaften und geschäftliche Initiativen eingebunden ist, unterstützt du ihn auch bei ausgewählten Aufgaben in diesen Bereichen. Dabei stehen insbesondere Recherche, Vorbereitung, Koordination und Nachverfolgung im Vordergrund. Eine eigenständige Vertriebsverantwortung ist mit dieser Position nicht verbunden.
 Dazu gehören beispielsweise folgende Aufgaben:
 Du recherchierst potenzielle Kunden, Märkte und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten.
 Du erstellst Präsentationen, Vertriebsunterlagen sowie weitere interne und kundenbezogene Dokumente.
 Du unterstützt bei ausgewählten Kundenaktivitäten, der Zusammenarbeit mit Partnern sowie bei Initiativen in den Bereichen Vertrieb, Marketing und Go to Market.
 Du koordinierst bereichsübergreifende Aktivitäten und hilfst dabei, interne Prozesse, Dokumentationen und Arbeitsabläufe zu verbessern.
 Das bringst du mit 
 Organisationstalent und ein gutes Gespür für Prioritäten: Du behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Aufgaben den Überblick, arbeitest strukturiert und achtest auf Details.
 Eigeninitiative und Selbstständigkeit: Du denkst mit, erkennst, was zu tun ist, und setzt Aufgaben eigenständig und zuverlässig um.
 Kommunikationsstärke und ein sicheres Auftreten: Du kommunizierst professionell und souverän mit Kollegen, Kunden, Partnern und Führungskräften.
 Sehr gute Präsentationsfähigkeit und Ausdrucksstärke: Du kannst komplexe Informationen verständlich aufbereiten und überzeugende, professionell gestaltete Präsentationen und Geschäftsunterlagen erstellen.
 Analytisches Denkvermögen und Problemlösungskompetenz: Du arbeitest dich schnell in neue Themen ein, erkennst Zusammenhänge und entwickelst praktikable Lösungsansätze.
 Erste relevante Berufserfahrung: Idealerweise hast du bereits im Executive Support, in der Projektkoordination, im Bereich Business Operations oder in einer vergleichbaren Position gearbeitet. Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften oder Gründern ist von Vorteil.
 Flexibilität und Lernbereitschaft: Du stellst dich schnell auf neue Situationen ein, gehst offen an unterschiedliche Aufgaben heran und möchtest dich fachlich und persönlich weiterentwickeln.
 Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
 Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft Office: Du beherrschst insbesondere PowerPoint, Excel und Outlook, nutzt moderne digitale Tools und Anwendungen auf Basis künstlicher Intelligenz und bist offen für neue Technologien. Erfahrung mit Dynamics 365 oder anderen CRM-Systemen ist von Vorteil.
 Du fühlst dich in einem dynamischen Umfeld wohl, übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und hast Freude daran, auch komplexe oder neue Themen zu strukturieren. Du kannst flexibel zwischen organisatorischen Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und übergreifenden Projekten wechseln und möchtest deine Ideen einbringen, dazulernen und gemeinsam mit INKUBIT wachsen.
 Das bieten wir dir 
 100% Remote Work und flexible Arbeitszeiten: Genieße die Flexibilität, überwiegend remote

title: Strategic Program Manager
description:
Strategic Program Manager bij Steboma 
 Kandidaatprofiel 
 Vanaf 5 jaar ervaring in consulting of programmamanagement
 Track record in het implementeren van plannen binnen een organisatie
 Aansturing van cross-functionele programma's op voortgang en toegevoegde waarde
 Overtuigende stakeholdermanager, van directie tot werkvloer
 Affiniteit met industrie of bouw
 Na jaren van stevige groei legt Steboma de lat opnieuw hoog. Met aandeelhouder Waterland werkt het bedrijf aan een strategische agenda die de hele organisatie raakt. De kennis is in huis, de plannen liggen er. Als rechterhand van CEO en CFO vertaalt de Strategic Program Manager het strategisch plan samen met het directieteam naar concrete projecten. 
 Over Steboma 
 Als marktleider in ventilatietechniek draagt Steboma met een breed scala aan producten en diensten bij aan gezondere en comfortabele woonomgevingen in heel Nederland. Het bedrijf staat voor kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en continuïteit. Ook duurzaamheid weegt zwaar: er wordt gewerkt met materialen en technologieën die lang meegaan en efficiënt presteren.
 Steboma werd in 1984 opgericht in Beverwijk. Inmiddels werken er zo'n tweehonderd medewerkers vanuit meerdere locaties in Nederland. Sinds private-equity-investeerder Waterland in 2022 als aandeelhouder toetrad, gaat de groei in rap tempo door, organisch en via diverse overnames.
 De organisatiecultuur is nuchter en hands-on. Verantwoordelijkheden liggen laag in de organisatie en de lijnen zijn kort met de directie, waardoor beslissingen snel worden genomen. Gezamenlijk voelen alle medewerkers zich verantwoordelijk voor de reputatie van het bedrijf. Wat aan een opdrachtgever beloofd is, wordt altijd nagekomen.
 “Een plan is pas af als het op de werkvloer draait. Daarvoor hebben we een Strategic Program Manager nodig die zelf de mouwen opstroopt en tegelijkertijd de hele organisatie meekrijgt.” - Marco Koster CEO
 Vacature Strategic Program Manager 
 Hoe Steboma verder wil groeien, is in grote lijnen uitgestippeld. Het aantal vestigingen wordt uitgebreid, organisch of via overnames. Momenteel wordt er een centraal magazijn ingericht en samen met het directieteam krijgt de uitrol van het strategische plan verdere invulling. Daarnaast verkent Steboma waar digitalisering, automatisering en AI de meeste waarde toe kunnen voegen. Op langere termijn staat ook internationalisering op de kaart. Een agenda van dit formaat verdient een eigen aanjager die alle initiatieven samenbrengt in één roadmap: de Strategic Program Manager.
 Een deel van de projecten ligt bij eigenaren in de organisatie. De Strategic Program Manager scherpt de prioriteiten aan, stuurt op resultaat en rapporteert wekelijks over de stand van zaken. Andere projecten pakt de Strategic Program Manager zelf op, van research en analyse tot en met implementatie. Dat eigen werk beslaat minstens de helft van de tijd en leunt op de expertise van collega's door het hele bedrijf.
 Overnames zijn een vast onderdeel van de groeistrategie, vooral in service en onderhoud. Samen met de divisiedirecteur pakt de Strategic Program Manager de operationele integratie op, en zorgt dat de overgenomen bedrijven worden samengevoegd tot één organisatie. Over dit soort overname- en integratietrajecten praat de Strategic Program Manager mee in het managementteam. De rapportagelijn van de rol loopt rechtstreeks naar de CEO en de CFO.
 De ideale kandidaat is een nuchtere doener die zich snel nieuwe onderwerpen eigen maakt en vanuit de inhoud overtuigt. Een technische of bedrijfskundige achtergrond helpt om snel mee te kunnen praten over de techniek achter het werk. Voor een consultant die de overstap van advies naar uitvoering wil maken, biedt deze rol directe invloed bij een PE-backed marktleider, inclusief de mogelijkheid om te participeren en een helder perspectief: haar/zijn voorganger groeide vanuit deze rol door naar de leiding van een divisie.
 Interesse? 
 Steboma werkt voor invulling van deze vacature met Top of Minds.

title: Project Manager IT — SAP AMR (SAP CAR) | Planificación de la Distribución
description:
En Mango vestimos de pasión todo lo que hacemos. Con origen en Barcelona y presencia en más de 120 países, inspiramos al mundo con creatividad, innovación y autenticidad.

Como Project Manager IT de SAP AMR (SAP CAR), liderarás las iniciativas de implantación y mejora de los procesos de Planificación de la Distribución, garantizando el cumplimiento eficiente de los objetivos estratégicos de la compañía.
TU NUEVO PUESTO

Formarás parte de un equipo de IT especializado en soluciones SAP para el área de Supply Chain y Distribución, en un entorno colaborativo, retador y orientado a la mejora continua, donde la capacidad analítica es clave para anticipar problemas y diseñar soluciones robustas.

 Traducirás necesidades de negocio en soluciones funcionales, apoyándote en un enfoque lógico-matemático para el diseño de procesos y la interpretación de datos.
 SOBRE TI

 Experiencia liderando equipos o iniciativas funcionales dentro de proyectos SAP.
 Se valorará experiencia como consultor funcional en SAP AMR (SAP CAR).

 Se valorará experiencia en el negocio Retail, en la industria de la moda y en procesos logísticos.

 TUS BENEFICIOS
 Incorporación inmediata con contrato indefinido.

 Política de referrals, podrás participar en la incorporación de talento a nuestros equipos, ¡y te recompensaremos por ello!

title: Senior Technical Project Manager, Client Projects
description:
Lefty is the leading influencer marketing platform trusted by the world's most prestigious luxury and lifestyle brands We help brands run end-to-end influencer programs: talent discovery, relationship management, automated campaign reporting, and performance measurement.
 Our largest clients increasingly ask for tailored work: data feeds into their BI tools, automated exports, integrations with the tools they already use, AI-based content labelling, migrations from other platforms. We're looking for a Senior Technical Project Manager to own these projects.
 The Role 
 You are the main point of contact for our clients' technical projects, from the first request to go-live and beyond. You report to both the CPO and the CTO, and work closely with Account Managers, CSMs and Engineering. Your time is split roughly 70% on client projects and 30% on internal projects.
 You are as comfortable explaining an API schema to a client's data team as presenting a project roadmap to a brand's Global Head of Influence. You set clear expectations, keep everyone informed, and deliver what was promised.
 What You'll Do 
 Client-facing: 
 Run discovery with clients: understand the business need behind each request
 Talk to both technical (IT, data, BI, security) and senior business stakeholders
 Turn client needs into a clear brief: scope, price, ROI, timeline
 Manage expectations: say what's possible, what isn't, and what it costs
 Send regular status updates and run steering meetings on key accounts
 Handle escalations calmly and find solutions when things slip
 Client projects (70%): 
 Scope and deliver projects such as:
 Data exports and automated feeds into client tools (Looker, SharePoint, data warehouses)
 Integrations between Lefty and the tools brands already use (social listening, CRM, SSO)
 Data imports and migrations from other platforms
 AI-based automation (content labelling, logo recognition)
 Custom metrics, reports and workspace configurations
 Write technical specifications and coordinate engineering work
 Test deliveries and validate data quality before handover
 Keep the Client Projects Tracker up to date
 Internal projects (30%): 
 Lead internal data and tooling projects, such as bringing CRM and deals data into our admin tools
 Partner with AMs and CSMs on account priorities and upsell opportunities
 Identify recurring client requests and feed them into the product roadmap
 Build repeatable processes for scoping, pricing and delivery
 What We're Looking For 
 Must-haves: 
 Combined experience of software engineer and client-facing technical project management
 Hands-on understanding of APIs, data models, exports, 3rd party integration
 Strong client presence: credible with engineers and at ease with senior executives
 Proven ability to manage expectations, negotiate scope and communicate proactively
 Track record delivering complex projects for enterprise clients in B2B SaaS
 Fluent in English and French
 Bonus: 
 Experience with BI, data and social listening tools (Looker, Power BI, BigQuery, SQL, Radarly, Talkwalker)
 Experience with luxury, beauty or retail clients
 Exposure to enterprise security requirements (SSO, security reviews)
 Interest in influencer marketing and social media ecosystems
 Appetite for AI and workflow automation tools
 The Details 
 Paris — hybrid (3 days in office / 2 days remote)
 Clients include the world's top luxury houses and top brands
 High-growth context — 3x revenue target over 5 years
 Interview Process 
 Step 1 — HR call (30 min): overall fit
 Step 2 — CPO & CTO call (45 min): technical depth and project management approach
 Step 3 — Live case study (2h): scoping a client request and presenting it to a client (with Head of AM, CPO, CTO)

title: Senior Technical Project Manager
location: Vester Svenstrup, North Denmark Region, Denmark
description:
Vil du drive udviklingen af fremtidens autonome robotter fra idé til lancering? 
 Som Senior Technical Project Manager hos Turf Tank får du det end-to-end strategiske ansvar for at bringe komplekse robotløsninger på markedet. Du bliver en central rolle i en innovativ organisation, hvor du forener mekanik, software og hardware. Vær med til at revolutionere den globale sportsverden med markedsledende, autonome udendørsmaskiner.
 dine opgaver 
 Du driver eksekveringen af Turf Tanks nye produkter og sikrer fremdrift på tværs af mekanik, elektronik og software frem mod lancering.
 Du bidrager til virksomhedens langsigtede roadmap, hvor du omsætter idéer til konkrete, eksekverbare udviklingsprojekter.
 Du samler og leder specialister i tværfaglige teams og skaber en fælles retning i en hverdag med højt tempo.
 Du implementerer et pragmatisk framework for agil projekteksekvering, der sikrer struktur gennem kritiske milepæle.
 Du sikrer produktionsklarhed, compliance og certificering af produkterne i tæt samarbejde med supply chain, produktion og testhuse.
 din profil og værktøjskasse 
 Du har en relevant teknisk uddannelse, f.eks. inden for mekatronik, robotteknologi, maskiningeniør eller software.
 Du har solid erfaring med teknisk projektledelse af produkter, der kombinerer mekanik, elektronik og software.
 Du har bevist, at du kan bringe hardware- og softwareprodukter hele vejen fra konceptfasen gennem test og certificering til serieproduktion og lancering.
 Du har erfaring med at lede og facilitere tværfaglige teams.
 Som person trives du i en flad og entreprenant kultur, hvor sund fornuft og handlekraft vejer tungere end tunge, bureaukratiske processer. Du har den tekniske dybde til at stille de rigtige, kritiske spørgsmål til specialisterne, samtidig med at du bevarer det strategiske overblik over projektet.
 Du er en modig beslutningstager, der tør tage kritiske valg i projekter, når det er nødvendigt for at sikre kvalitet og fremdrift. Din stærke evne til stakeholder management gør dig i stand til at skabe følgeskab og tillid på alle niveauer i organisationen.
 ansøgning og kontakt 
 Er du klar til at sætte dit aftryk som Senior Technical Project Manager hos Turf Tank? Så send os din ansøgning via ansøgningsknappen allerede i dag. Randstad styrer processen, og alle henvendelser behandles naturligvis fortroligt. For at passe på dig og dine persondata, modtager vi udelukkende ansøgninger via vores online rekrutteringssystem. Har du brug for at vide mere om stillingen, er du altid velkommen til at kontakte Senior Specialist, Frederik Brusgaard, på +45 2172 4985.
 om turf tank 
 Turf Tank er en banebrydende, dansk robotvirksomhed i markant international vækst, som har revolutioneret markedet for pleje af sportsbaner. Med deres intelligente, GPS-styrede linjemarkeringsrobotter og kommende nye produkter hjælper virksomheden over 5.500 verden over - fra lokale foreninger til verdenskendte sportsklubber.
 På hovedkvarteret i Svenstrup bliver du en del af en innovativ, ambitiøs og uformel kultur. Her arbejder passionerede kolleger i udviklingsafdelingen tæt sammen under ét tag i et miljø præget af åbenhed, tværfagligt samarbejde og enormt fokus på servicevenlighed. Du får frihed til at præge udviklingen i en virksomhed, der tør tage chancer og konstant rykker grænserne for fremtidens udendørsmaskiner.
 om randstad 
 Randstad er verdens førende partner full-service HR-hus. Vores vision er at være verdens mest specialiserede og inkluderende bemandingsvirksomhed – en foretrukken samarbejdspartner for både kandidater og virksomheder. Med en dyb indsigt i arbejdsmarkedet og vores fire specialiserede forretningsområder, Operational, Professional, Digital og Enterprise, hjælper vi vores kunder med at opbygge de kvalificerede, mangfoldige og agile teams, det kræver for at skabe succes i dag.
 Vi er dedikerede til at sikre lige muligheder for alle uanset baggrund og støtter vores kandidater i at forblive relevante på et arbejdsmarked i hastig forandring. Gennem den værdi, vi skaber, arbejder vi målrettet for at gøre arbejdslivet bedre for alle. Randstad har hovedkontor i Holland, opererer på 39 markeder og beskæftiger cirka 38.000 medarbejdere på verdensplan.
 I 2025 hjalp vi knap 150.000 kunder og over 1,7 millioner talenter, hvilket resulterede i en omsætning på 23,1 mia. euro. Randstad N.V. er noteret på Euronext Amsterdam. For yderligere information, besøg randstad.dk.

title: Project Manager - Cloud Operations
description:
Hospitals don't have room for downtime. Neither do we.
 Healthcare systems across the Nordics run on infrastructure that must work every shift, every scan, every critical decision. As a Project Manager in our Nordic Cloud Operations team, you help keep our cloud services stable, secure and ready for the clinicians who depend on them.
You bring customers, colleagues and technical specialists together, keep everyone aligned, and follow projects through from start to finish.
 Why this role is different
 You'll lead projects in a team where the technical expertise is already strong. You speak the engineering language and learn what is needed to drive technical projects successfully. You are the person who holds everything together. You create structure, build trust with customers and stakeholders, and make sure everyone knows what we're delivering, when, and why.
The role suits someone who enjoys being the link between people: turning a customer need into a clear plan, keeping many threads together, and making sure nothing falls between the cracks. You'll learn the technology as you go, with experienced colleagues close by.
 What You'll Do
 You own the delivery side of our cloud operations projects across the Nordic region, from planning and coordination through go-live and stabilization.
 Day to day, you'll be:
 Plan, lead and follow up projects in our Nordic cloud operations, from start through go-live and handover to operations
 Define scope, tasks and resource needs together with the team
 Build and maintain roadmaps of projects with clear timlines, definition of done and deliverables
 Deliver against agreed milestones, scope and timelines
 Build strong relationships with the team, customers and internal stakeholders, and manage expectations at all levels
 Communicate clearly and regularly about status, risks and decisions, and escalate in time when needed
 Help improve how we plan, coordinate and deliver our services
 ,
 Who You Are
 At Sectra, we always prioritize attitude and ability when hiring. We like to say: "Hire for attitude and ability. Train for skill." Who you are and your potential matter more than what you know today. We look for a willingness and ability to learn quickly, a strong analytical mindset, and the ability to communicate clearly and constructively with colleagues, partners and customers.
 For this role, we require:
 A bachelor's or master's degree in a relevant field, such as IT, engineering or business
 Some experience of project management or coordination, for example from a first PM role, a lead engineer, or leading projects in a previous job
 A structured way of working and the ability to keep an overview when there's a lot going on
 Strong communication and relationship skills, with a genuine interest in understanding customer needs
 An interest in IT systems, infrastructure concepts and enough technical understanding to follow the conversation with specialists
 Fluency in Swedish, Danish or Norwegian, and very good English, spoken and written
 Even better if you have:
 Experience in healthcare IT or working with regulated environments
 Have experience from healthcare IT or other business-critical IT services
 Certifications in project methodologies; Prince2, Agile, ITIL, or similar
 Knowledge of DICOM, HL7, or medical imaging infrastructure
 Are involved in something outside work or studies, such as sports, associations or music
 If you don’t meet every point above but feel this role could be a good fit, we still encourage you to apply.
 The Team
 Nordic Cloud Operations is a close-knited team with a wide scope and deep extertise. We care about doing things properly, supporting each other when things get complex, and creating an environment where it’s safe to ask questions and share responsibility. There's real depth of knowledge here and a genuine commitment to the mission behind the work.
You’ll be supported by experienced colleagues and a mentor when you start. We believe the best way to learn is together, through collaboration, feedback, and trust.
 The mission behind the work
 Sectra's solutions are used by clinicians and radiologists at hospitals across the World to diagnose, treat, and care for patients every day. When you keep our cloud infrastructure running smoothly, the impact is real, enabling faster decisions, safer care, and better outcomes.
 Apply
 Send us your CV and a short cover letter that tells us who you are and what draws you to this role. You don't need to fit every point on this list, but if the work sounds like it's for you, we'd like to hear from you.
Start date is flexible. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, so don't wait too long.
Depending on the role, a mandatory background security screening might be performed as part of the recruitment process at Sectra. Please reach out to the responsible hiring team if you have any questions regarding this. Learn more about our recruitment process here.
 As this role requires strong written and verbal proficiency, we ask that applications be submitted in a Scandinavian language or English.

title: Project Manager, Anaesthesia & Patient Monitoring Solutions
location: Ballerup, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description:
Ambu A/S is currently looking for a Project Manager to join our Patient Monitoring & Anaesthesia Solutions team in Global R&D.
Do you have experience in project management within the Medical Device industry and a strong technical background? Are you motivated by leading cross-functional teams and turning technical and business needs into successful product solutions?
As a Project Manager in our Patient Monitoring & Anaesthesia Solutions team within Global R&D, you will have the opportunity to lead a diverse portfolio of development projects, ranging from major new product development initiatives to focused projects that enhance, upgrade and extend the value of our successful existing products.
This variety is an important part of the role. You will be expected to adapt your project management approach to the scope and complexity of each project while maintaining a strong focus on quality, execution and business impact.
At our headquarters in Ballerup, where we develop many of our medical devices, we have a strong collaborative culture and a clear focus on bringing products to market based on a thorough understanding of customer needs. We develop, maintain products and production processes that combine multiple technologies in innovative ways. This requires strong project management capabilities, sound business and technical understanding, and broad experience with medical device development.
 Key Responsibilities
 Your main responsibilities will include:
 Leading medical device development projects of varying scope and complexity, from major new product development initiatives to product enhancements, upgrades and design changes, through to successful implementation at our production sites
 Establishing a motivating and collaborative working environment within global, cross-functional project teams
 Maintaining close collaboration with global stakeholders, particularly the Solution Steering Committee, to align resources, timelines, budgets and project strategies
 Setting clear project direction and ensuring effective planning and tracking of project progress, timelines and budgets
 Taking part in prototype builds, testing activities and interviews with users and stakeholders
 Contributing actively to the Solutions Team by sharing best practices, experiences and lessons learned across projects
 Suggested candidate profile
 Skills
 Skills and experience can be gained in many different ways, and we recognise that the right candidate cannot be defined by a checklist alone. However, you are likely to succeed in this position if you:
 Hold a degree in engineering or a related technical field and have technical experience that enables you to support sound decision-making and address technical challenges throughout a project
 Have solid experience in Medical Device project management and bring a broad project management skill set and toolbox
 Are comfortable leading projects of different sizes and levels of complexity and can adapt your project management approach accordingly
 Have experience working with globally distributed project teams and suppliers
 Are curious, open-minded and possess strong interpersonal and collaboration skills
 Are committed and structured, with a strong sense of responsibility towards your work and your team
 Possess strong leadership skills and are able to create direction, engagement and momentum in cross-functional teams
 Have a certification in Project Management
 Are fluent in written and spoken English
 Apply
 Apply directly on our job portal, as we are not able to receive applications through e-mail.
The Talent Attraction team till engage with applicants on an ongoing basis, hence we encourage you to not hesitate, and apply today!
 Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter 
 Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.
We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

title: Project Manager (Robotica Asistencial)
description:
Project Manager de Innovación | Tecnología e Impacto Social 
 Lleida · 30.000–40.000 € brutos anuales 
 On-site 
 Conecta las necesidades de las personas con soluciones tecnológicas que les ayuden de verdad
 ¿Disfrutas hablando con clientes, entendiendo qué necesitan y coordinando a distintas personas para convertir una idea en un proyecto que funciona?
 Desde Akuaro acompañamos a nuestro partner, una compañía tecnológica consolidada con una fuerte orientación al impacto social, en la incorporación de un Project Manager para su equipo de Innovación .
 Participarás en la implantación de soluciones de robótica social, teleasistencia avanzada, monitorización de personas e inteligencia artificial aplicada al cuidado . Tu misión será conseguir que los proyectos se entreguen con calidad, cumplan sus objetivos y puedan ser adoptados por las personas y entidades que los utilizarán. Project Manager Innovacion - GR…
 No necesitas programar. Sí necesitas escuchar, organizar, coordinar y comunicar con claridad , también cuando haya que explicar una limitación, gestionar un cambio o ajustar expectativas.
 Es una posición de nueva creación , vinculada al crecimiento de nuevos proyectos. Te integrarás en el área de Innovación, reportando directamente al CTO y colaborando con profesionales de desarrollo, robótica, implantación, soporte y del ámbito social y sanitario.
 ¿Cuál será tu papel? 
 Serás el punto de conexión entre clientes, entidades usuarias y equipos técnicos , combinando una relación cercana con una gestión rigurosa del proyecto.
 Entender las necesidades y concretar el alcance. Escucharás a clientes, usuarios y profesionales asistenciales, convirtiendo sus necesidades en requisitos y entregables comprensibles para los equipos que desarrollan e implantan las soluciones.
 Gestionar el proyecto de principio a fin. Definirás la planificación, los recursos, los hitos y los entregables, realizando el seguimiento operativo y económico para controlar plazos, presupuesto y calidad.
 Coordinar equipos multidisciplinares. Facilitarás la colaboración entre perfiles tecnológicos y sociosanitarios, dando seguimiento a tareas, dependencias e incidencias.
 Gestionar expectativas, riesgos y cambios. Comunicarás avances y limitaciones, propondrás acciones correctivas y colaborarás con Comercial y Dirección cuando sea necesario revisar alcances o presupuestos.
 Asegurar el seguimiento y la adopción. Prepararás informes de estado, recogerás el feedback de clientes y usuarios y evaluarás si las soluciones implantadas responden a las necesidades del proyecto.
 El puesto combina responsabilidad sobre la ejecución con relación directa con el cliente; no se limita a organizar reuniones o actualizar cronogramas. Project Manager Innovacion - GR…
 ¿Qué necesitamos que aportes? 
 Al menos dos años gestionando proyectos , con experiencia en planificación, coordinación y seguimiento de actuaciones y entregables.
 Experiencia directa con clientes o entidades usuarias , y capacidad para escuchar, concretar necesidades, gestionar expectativas y comunicar tanto avances como dificultades.
 Capacidad organizativa y de coordinación , con autonomía para detectar desviaciones, proponer soluciones y hacer avanzar el trabajo de diferentes personas y equipos.
 Conocimiento o cercanía al entorno social, sanitario, de la dependencia o de las personas mayores , junto con interés por comprender cómo la tecnología puede mejorar los servicios asistenciales.
 Familiaridad con metodologías y herramientas de gestión de proyectos , como PMBOK, PRINCE2, Agile o Scrum, y Microsoft 365, Teams, Excel, Planner, Project o herramientas similares.
 La posición requiere base de trabajo en Lleida y disponibilidad para desplazamientos puntuales .
 ¿Qué sumará a tu candidatura?
 Valoraremos especialmente la experiencia en proyectos sociosanitarios, tecnológicos, de innovación social o de digitalización , así como el trabajo con administraciones públicas o la participación en proyectos nacionales o europeos de innovación. Project Manager Innovacion - GR…
 También sumará formación en Trabajo Social, Educación Social, Enfermería, Psicología, Gestión Sanitaria, ADE, Informática o ámbitos relacionados. No buscamos una única titulación: priorizamos la experiencia y la capacidad demostrada para desempeñar el puesto. 
 Puedes aportar una trayectoria más cercana a las personas o más próxima a la tecnología. Lo importante será tu capacidad para conectar ambos ámbitos y llevar los proyectos a la práctica .
 ¿Qué te ofrece este proyecto? 
 Retribución de 30.000 a 40.000€ brutos anuales , ajustada a tu experiencia y conocimientos.
 Desarrollo profesional dentro del área de Innovación , con posibilidad de asumir progresivamente mayores responsabilidades en proyectos, coordinación y relación con clientes e instituciones.
 Formación continua en gestión de proyectos, metodologías Agile, liderazgo e innovación, además de acceso ilimitado a Udemy Business . Project Manager Innovacion - GR…
 Un día de teletrabajo semanal , tras un periodo inicial de adaptación completamente presencial en Lleida.
