title: Senior Lead Project Manager for IT Technology Project
location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description:
Are you a very experienced Project Manager with a passion for driving big and complex projects involving software development together with a big global vendor? Do you enjoy leading highly skilled teams in a dynamic and international environment? Then you may be our new Senior Lead Project Manager.
 Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition
 Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time. Join Nordic RCC and contribute to ensuring a secure and sustainable energy in the future.
 Job Description
 Nordic RCC seeks a skilled and experienced Project Manager to drive an IT project with many internal and external stakeholders, several deliverables and milestones, delivered within agreed go-live dates.
You will be responsible for coordinating all aspects of the project as scoping, planning, execution and delivery. Working closely together with a big global vendor and senior stakeholders across Nordic RCC, you will ensure seamless collaboration and a transparent strong approach to project management.
You will guide the project team incl. project managers through strong project risk management and planning, dependencies to other projects, financial control, stakeholder alignment, and progress monitoring in close collaboration with the internal and external Steercos, ensuring alignment with Nordic RCC’s goals.
 Your Primary Tasks And Areas Of Responsibility
 Facilitate a strong collaboration and communication among program/project stakeholders from the different departments in the organization, the vendor's project organisation and the internal/external Steercos
 In control of budget, forecast and monthly financial updates, incl. alignment with financial milestones from vendor
 In control of project scope, resource needs according to project plan, manage project risks continuously through the project lifetime in close collaboration with vendor, internal project managers and the Steercos
 In control of develop, coordinate, communicate and execute project plans with clear milestones and deadlines, ensuring to deliver all milestones on time in close collaboration with both vendor and Nordic RCC
 Monitor program/project progress, assess performance, and report outcomes to key stakeholders/Steercos by monthly meetings and reporting to Leadership team in Nordic RCC
 Lead a strong transition from each go-live to operational phase, ensuring an organized handover to line organization for the different deliverables
 Use best practices and processes, e.g. Stage Gate Model, Governance model, Resource management, Project Risk Management etc. to provide the optimal guidance to cross-functional project teams throughout the project lifecycle with focus on balancing quality, efficiency, deliver on time and financials
 Required Skills And Experience
 The ideal candidate holds a BA or MA in IT with strong project or program management experience working with software development in an IT project in collaboration with a big global vendor.
 Key Skills Include
 Strong drive and passion for project management, ensuring the project teams deliver on time in expected quality/scope and in control of finance
 Strong organizational, planning and time management skills
 Proven track record in managing senior stakeholder expectations and leading cross-functional teams in collaboration with an IT vendor
 Experience in communicating both big-picture objectives and project details, ensuring all project managers/team members understand their roles and contributions
 Demonstrated ability to identify challenges early and proactively drive deliverables in collaboration with vendor and project teams
 At least 10 years of relevant experience in IT project management with a global vendor
 Relevant project management certificates and e.g., relevant change management certificates
 Full professional proficiency in English
 Employment conditions
 You will join a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently more than 24 nationalities with more than 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.
Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We are offering workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance including the possibility for working from home some of your worktime.
Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.
The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.
 Application deadline and contact information
 Please apply online on https://www.globesearch.dk/jobs/8221470. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.
A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.
To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

title: Project Manager
location: Assens, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
description:
Rollen som Project Manager er en hands-on hybridrolle, hvor du ved hjælp af dine både tekniske og kommercielle kompetencer vil få ansvar for at drive projekter i tæt samarbejde med kunder og kolleger fra salg, R&D og produktion og herved sikre leverancer af høj kvalitet i både dokumentation og produkter.
 For at understøtte dette får du en grundig introduktion til teknologier og produkter, så du får det bedst mulige afsæt for fremtidig succes. Du vil til at begynde med arbejde på eksisterende projekter i tæt samarbejde med en erfaren projektleder, så du får indblik i produkt- og projekttyper, leverancebehov samt de værktøjer og processer, der skal anvendes.
 Rejseaktiviteten afhænger af kundernes behov, messer og besøg på lokationer. Der forventes ca. 30–40 rejsedage om året (internationalt), typisk planlagt i perioder på 5–10 dage.
 Som projektleder og som en del af teamet vil du:
 blive en del af en højt specialiseret organisation, der arbejder med letvægtskomposit løsninger og projekter af varierende omfang og varighed
 planlægge og levere internationale projekter af høj kvalitet inden for Naval og Vehicle segmenterne samt sikre, at kundernes projektkrav implementeres og leveres som forventet
 samarbejde med interne og eksterne interessenter om de bedste løsninger gennem AQAP2110-processen og interne arbejdsstrømme, herunder feasibility-møder
 deltage i salgsmøder og messer for at understøtte salgskolleger på det tekniske område, herunder rådgivning og sparring med kunder om produkt- og ballistikløsninger
 foretage kritisk gennemgang af tegninger samt udarbejde specifikationer og projektomfang
 håndtere data i Excel i forbindelse med udarbejdelse af BOM/styklister på baggrund af datapakker
 sikre høj kvalitet i dokumentationen ved overdragelse til produktion
 Kompetencer og viden 
 Din uddannelse eller erfaringsmæssige baggrund ses gerne værende inden for det maskintekniske, komposit eller lignende. Det afgørende er, at du har erfaring fra en lignende teknisk funderet rolle i en produktionsvirksomhed, gerne med kundetilpassede løsninger i en international kontekst. For at få succes i rollen er det vigtigt, at du er nysgerrig og lærevillig, da der venter en stejl og spændende læringskurve med løbende faglige udfordringer. Du behersker dansk og engelsk i skrift og tale, og tyskkundskaber er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Du er vant til at arbejde i Excel.
 Solid teknisk forståelse (mekanisk og/eller komposit eller anden relevant materialekendskab)
 Minimum 3-5 års erfaring med hands-on projektledelse, fra forespørgsel, kalkulationer og salg til faktisk projekt
 Erfaring med teknisk salg/salgsstøtte fra produktionsvirksomhed
 Erfaring med AQAP2110 er en fordel, men ikke et krav
 Erfaring med udarbejdelse af dokumentation til produktion er en fordel
 Erfaring med SolidWorks eller andre CAD-programmer
 Bemærk: Du skal kunne fremvise ren straffeattest og gyldigt kørekort for at komme i betragtning til stillingen, som også kræver PET / FE-godkendelse.
 Integris Composites tilbyder 
 Hos Integris Composites bliver du en del af en organisation, hvor der ikke er langt fra tanke til handling. Arbejdskulturen er præget af ansvar, ordentlighed og samarbejde, og der lægges stor vægt på, at viden deles, og opgaver løses i fællesskab.
 Virksomheden befinder sig i en stærk vækstfase, og du får en alsidig hverdag i et teknisk og internationalt miljø, hvor initiativ værdsættes, og hvor du får mulighed for løbende at udvikle både dine opgaver og dit ansvar.
 Interesseret? 
 Integris Composites samarbejder med GML A/S om denne rekruttering. Du er velkommen til at kontakte Senior Researcher Linda Kviesgaard på lk@gml-hr.dk for at høre mere om stillingen. Enhver henvendelse behandles fortroligt.
 Vi glæder os til at modtage din ansøgning og dit CV. Ansøgninger behandles løbende.

 Retribuzione in linea con esperienza e ruolo, con RAL indicativa nel range €35.000 – €39.000 , valutabile in base al profilo

 welfare aziendale e Ticket Restaurant
 formazione continua strutturata: piattaforme digitali, aula, mentoring, hands-on, certificazioni
 reali opportunità di crescita tecnica e professionale
 ambiente di lavoro fondato su collaborazione, affidabilità e rispetto.
 Si prega di inviare il CV dettagliato con l'autorizzazione al trattamento dei dati personali (ai sensi degli artt. 12, 13 e 14 del Regolamento EU 2016/679). 
 Il presente annuncio è rivolto ad entrambi i sessi, ai sensi delle leggi 903/77 e 125/91, a persone di tutte le età e tutte le nazionalità, ai sensi dei decreti legislativi 215/03 e 216/03 e ai facenti parte di Categorie Protette, legge 68/99.

description:

title: Senior IT Project Manager
description:
Are you ready to drive critical IT projects at the heart of ALK's journey to SAP S/4HANA — one of the most important transformation programmes in a global specialty pharmaceutical company?
 About ALK
 ALK's aspiration is to become the world leader in allergy by helping as many people as possible with allergy to a better life by providing options of prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of allergy. In Global IT, we contribute to this aspiration by supporting the organization with modern IT tools and digitalisation technologies, and by delivering world-class support to our many colleagues around the world.
 The Role
 As a Senior IT Project Manager At ALK, You Will Lead Important Initiatives Within Our S/4HANA Migration Programme, From Inception To Execution. You Are First And Foremost a Strong Project Manager And Facilitator Who Can Guide The Business Through Change. Your Tasks Will Include
 Ensuring timely, on-budget project delivery and successful milestone achievement.
 Aligning project outcomes with the strategic vision of the business.
 Coordinating internal and third-party resources effectively.
 Facilitating workshops and supporting the business through the change process.
 Leading key initiatives across the S/4HANA transformation, managing scope, budget, schedule and risk end to end.
 Steering the relationship with the Steering Committee and Project Group towards collaborative success, and reporting progress into IT management.
 Being structured, organized and proactive, you will anticipate issues before they arise and know when to involve the right people at the right time.
This role is based at our office in Madrid, where our SAP team is located, and reports to the Director of IT Project Portfolio and IT Projects. You will work with colleagues across our IT hubs and can expect occasional travel to our headquarters in Hørsholm and to other ALK sites.
 What We're Seeking
 We are on the lookout for a candidate with:
 A master's degree in engineering, business or relevant fields.
 Proven experience in IT project management, ideally within ERP or large-scale transformation programmes.
 Strong stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills, and the ability to support a business through change.
 A structured, organized and proactive working style.
 Familiarity with SAP and S/4HANA — you don't need to be an expert, but you should be comfortable operating in this landscape and speaking with the specialists. Having already been part of an S/4HANA journey is a strong advantage.
 Willingness to travel internationally on an occasional basis.

title: Technical Project Manager
description:
Clearer is our biggest bet, and we're changing how we build it. AI agents now draft PRDs, write code, generate tests and keep Jira in order. You'll turn that into fast, reliable delivery, with people in charge where it counts.
Clearer is our agentic commerce product for Shopify merchants, built on Boost and REVIEWS.io. You'll own how work gets from an agreed PRD to production across Clearer, Boost, REVIEWS.io and our AI/ML team. You'll design the human-in-the-loop pipeline, find what's slowing us down this week, and clear it.
This isn't a status-reporting job. If you'd rather automate a status report than write one, we'd like to talk to you.
You'll join Product Delivery, a small team within Product, reporting to our VP Product. You get Clearer built and ready to release. Our Programme Manager gets it launched and adopted. Product Managers own what we build and why, and Engineering Managers own sizing and dates. You make their plans fit together and keep them honest. You'll work closely with Clearer's PMs, our VP Engineering, engineering managers, QA, our Chief Architect and our AI/ML team. The role is dedicated to Clearer for at least the first six months, then reviewed.
 What You'll Do
 Own one delivery plan for Clearer, so everyone sees the same initiatives, epics and dependencies across every team. It's generated from Jira, not slides. 
 Spot and clear dependencies before they block anyone, especially as engineers move from Boost onto Clearer. 
 Run the readiness gates, so no epic enters a sprint unready. Settle disputes with evidence. 
 Measure flow and improve it. Track lead time, cycle time, PR wait time, rework and escaped defects. Every fortnight, name the bottleneck and the fix. As agents speed up coding, expect the wait to move to review, QA and decisions. 
 Own the human-in-the-loop map. Know which level of automation each stage runs at, from assist to autonomous, and where the human gate sits. Move a stage up only when the data says it's safe, and make sure every automated step has an owner, an audit trail and an off switch. 
 Build delivery agents with Product Operations, so status updates, Jira hygiene and release notes stop being anyone's manual job. 
 Connect the pipeline, so a strong PRD flows into well-formed stories, AI-generated tests (Claude and Playwright) and release, with as few handoffs as possible. 
 Run planning and raise risk early. Lead capacity and quarterly planning and the release calendar, and bring slippage to our VP Product with options attached, before it becomes a surprise. 
 your first six months
 By 30 days: you've mapped every live Clearer initiative, its dependencies and its owner. You've baselined lead time, cycle time and carryover, and named the top three bottlenecks. 
 By 90 days: the readiness gates are running, so no epic enters a sprint unready. You've published a human-in-the-loop map with agreed targets, and status reporting is off people's plates. 
 By 180 days: Clearer's lead time from idea to live is down by an agreed margin. The roadmap hits 70% confidence for next quarter and 50% for the one after. At least two pipeline stages have moved up a level of automation, with quality holding steady. 
 How You'll Work
 Automate first. If you do a task twice, you build the agent for it. 
 Make the system visible, not yourself. You create clarity, not meetings. 
 Bring evidence. You settle disagreements with data on flow and readiness. 
 Hold the line. You push back on unready work, kindly and firmly, whoever's asking. 
 Own the outcome. Shipped and working matters more than a plan that's on track. 
 Share what works. You help PMs, EMs and QA adopt the standard, and bring what you learn to our AI Guild. 
 What You'll Bring
 4+ years in technical project, programme or delivery management in a SaaS product and engineering team, across several squads at once 
 Enough technical depth to read a PR, follow an architecture conversation and challenge an estimate, and to know how CI/CD, test automation and APIs fit together 
 Hands-on use of AI agents in your own work (Claude, Claude Code, GPT or similar), including at least one automation you built yourself 
 Expert Jira skills, from hierarchies and automation to JQL and dashboards. You'd sooner fix the system than work around it 
 Confidence using flow metrics to change how teams work, not just to report on it 
 Clear, concise writing that works across time zones. Our teams span the UK, Ireland, Vietnam, Australia and North America 
 Nice to have
 Experience with an AI-assisted SDLC, such as AI-generated tests, Playwright, MCP or agent orchestration 
 A background in eCommerce or the Shopify ecosystem 
 Time in a scale-up or PE-backed business with shared engineering services 
 Exposure to R&D tax or capitalisation tagging 
 Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential and mindset as much as experience - if this role excites you, we want to hear from you.
 life at clearer.io
 eCommerce is crowded, noisy and increasingly complex. At clearer.io, we're built for a different outcome: clarity you can act on.
We connect to the stack a merchant already uses. Our AI agents enrich their catalogue, learn from their reviews and customers, and put that intelligence to work inside the tools they already own — so their products get found, trusted and chosen by shoppers and AI, without replatforming. We do this across our products: Clearer, Boost Commerce, REVIEWS.io and Influence, used by thousands of merchants worldwide.
We're a global team with offices in Australia, the UK, Germany, Vietnam and the US, backed for the long term by PSG Equity and Silversmith Capital Partners.
We care about doing the work properly: listening first, building second and shipping quickly where it matters. Results matter more than rhetoric.
What guides us day to day:
 Customers at the heart: we obsess over their needs so we can grow together 
 Purposeful progress: we don't settle - we take initiative and embrace bold thinki

title: RevOps Product Owner – AI & Automation
description:
Descripción de la empresa
 Doctoralia es una plataforma global líder en el sector de la salud digital. Nuestro objetivo es conectar pacientes con profesionales de la salud de forma sencilla, rápida y eficiente. ¿Cómo hacemos esto? A través del marketplace y la App móvil, conseguimos que los usuarios puedan buscar profesionales y/o clínicas del sector privado, leer reseñas de pacientes, consultar la disponibilidad y reservar directamente online. 📱💻
Doctoralia forma parte del grupo Docplanner desde 2017, una empresa multinacional con presencia en más de 13 países. 🌍
Contamos con el respaldo de inversores como Goldman Sachs, One Peak Partners, Point Nine y Target Global, hemos recaudado más de 450 millones de euros y estamos cerca de alcanzar la rentabilidad con más de 180 millones € ARR.
Buscamos un/a RevOps Product Owner – AI & Automation para ser dueño/a de cuatro productos clave de RevOps en España como un portafolio: diagnosticar qué está roto o falta acercándote a cómo se hace el trabajo realmente, escribir las specs que justifican el caso de negocio, negociar prioridad con los equipos globales que controlan estos sistemas, y construir directamente lo que esté al alcance local — incluyendo testeo práctico y prototipado de herramientas e integraciones, aunque la implementación final sea de otro equipo.
Los productos de los que serás dueño/a
 CRM Process & Automation — la salud de nuestros flujos comerciales core en Salesforce/HubSpot: cumplimiento de SLA, higiene de pipeline y la automatización declarativa que mantiene los registros correctos a medida que deals y leads avanzan por el funnel — por ejemplo, que una propiedad se actualice automáticamente cuando un deal pasa a la siguiente etapa — además de la infraestructura de dashboards/reporting que los equipos usan cada día.
 Lead Creation & Assignment — la lógica de enrutamiento y asignación que lleva cada lead al rep correcto en el momento correcto (construida sobre DP Lead), evolucionando hacia un modelo ponderado por capacidad y rendimiento en lugar de round-robin plano.
 Omni-Channel — la capa de WhatsApp (Kraken), llamadas, email/secuencias y agendamiento/calendario en todo el journey de sales + CS: qué canal, qué mensaje, en qué secuencia y cuándo — incluyendo el agendamiento y reagendamiento de demos, onboarding y reuniones de farming.
 CRM UI/UX — la experiencia diaria real que tienen reps y team leads dentro del CRM: comportamiento del action center, vistas, filtros y los gaps que causan tareas perdidas o workarounds mal usados.
 Qué harás
 Ser dueño/a del backlog de cada producto — diagnosticar qué está roto, falta o funciona mal en las cuatro áreas, acercándote a las personas que hacen el trabajo: shadowing, entrevistas, peticiones directas y observación propia — no suposiciones.
 Triar lo que es tuyo — las peticiones rutinarias de business-as-usual van a COE como siempre; los bottlenecks reales e issues sistémicos llegan a tu backlog para un zoom-in adecuado.
 Escribir las specs que justifican el caso — convertir un problema diagnosticado en una solicitud clara y priorizada: qué está mal, qué nos cuesta, cómo sería la solución, por qué vale la pena el tiempo de ingeniería global.
 Negociar prioridad con los equipos globales dueños de estos sistemas — la mayoría de los cambios core en Salesforce, Kraken y otras plataformas subyacentes solo pueden hacerlos equipos fuera de RevOps España; tú eres quien construye el caso de negocio y asegura un lugar en su roadmap.
 Testear y prototipar, de forma práctica — validar herramientas de terceros, prototipar integraciones y entender cómo se conectan las piezas antes de pasar una spec al equipo que la construirá. Construir directamente la automatización y configuración que esté al alcance local.
 Medir lo que lanzas o desbloqueas — horas ahorradas, impacto en conversión/engagement y adopción, por producto. Reportar en términos de los OKRs de RevOps.
 Hacerlo repetible — documentar lo que funciona en playbooks o templates reutilizables.
 Qué buscamos
 Conocimiento profundo de las herramientas y procesos de GTM de Doctoralia España — ya lo tienes en la mayoría de estas cuatro áreas.
 Mentalidad de builder para lo que sí es construible localmente, e instinto de tester para validar herramientas e integraciones antes de que se entreguen a otro equipo. Experiencia práctica con automatización de Salesforce/HubSpot (flows, reglas de validación, triggers) es un plus importante.
 Comunicación escrita sólida — capaz de convertir un problema reportado de forma informal en una spec clara y convincente que un equipo global, con sus propias prioridades, realmente atienda.
 Cómodo/a negociando capacidad de ingeniería escasa con equipos que no te reportan, y dando seguimiento hasta que se lance.
 Fluidez en español e inglés.
 Métricas de éxito
La medida principal de éxito es el throughput por operador de GTM — cada cambio lanzado debe permitir que la gente haga más de lo que ya se espera de ella, no solo "ahorrar tiempo" de forma abstracta. Se mide como una tendencia direccional para el rol afectado tras un cambio lanzado, no como una atribución estrictamente aislada — hay demasiadas otras iniciativas en paralelo (la migración a Salesforce, la ingeniería de outbound, etc.) como para separar causas de forma limpia. Esto se acumula en revenue (o output) por FTE de GTM , nuestra métrica de eficiencia principal.
 Throughput Por Rol (principal)
 SDRs / reps de outbound — reuniones agendadas por rep por semana/mes.
 Account Executives — oportunidades avanzadas o deals cerrados por AE.
 Especialistas de onboarding — onboardings completados por especialista en un período dado.
 Reps de CS / soporte — casos o solicitudes resueltas por rep.
 Reps de farming / cuentas — acciones de renovación o upsell completadas por rep.
 Prerrequisito (hito inicial, no asumido): la instrumentación fiable de throughput por rol todavía no existe del todo — el reporting ha sido poco fiable en varias de estas áreas hasta hace poc

title: Product Strategist - Wizz
description:
About Voodoo
 Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.
 Team
 Our Consumer Apps teams are at the forefront of crafting innovative and engaging apps for daily enjoyment.
Our ambition extends beyond gaming to entertain a global audience. Millions of people around the world, especially in the US, download and use the apps we create.
You'll be working on Wizz, a social app specifically designed for teens, boasting over 3 million monthly active users in the US and UK. Wizz is a friend-finding and chat app where young people can safely express themselves and connect with like-minded peers in an authentic, pressure-free environment. Unlike other social media platforms that focus on followers, posts, or passive consumption, Wizz offers young people a space to have meaningful 1:1 conversations with peers.
As a member of a high-performing team of 20, you'll collaborate to further scale and enhance Wizz, fostering a spirit of goodwill and creativity. As Wizz continues its dynamic growth and development, we are seeking an ambitious Product Strategist to join.
 Role 
 Analyze Wizz competitive environment and identify new business opportunities
 Report directly to the CEO
 Combine analytics and user research to identify user drives, fuel ideation, and lead product improvements.
 Manage some product operations (e.g., CRM, Monetization) and solve problems as they arise.
 Contribute to high-level strategic decisions. Help define short and long-term roadmaps.
 Identify key metrics and take ownership for improving them.
 Profile
 You’re passionate about B2C mobile apps.
 Tier 1 academic background in the business or engineering field
 A first experience (internship) in a fast-paced environment (top-tier consulting firm, banking, start-up, scale-up)
 You’re hyper-analytical: you obsess over product metrics, test your hypotheses rigorously, and make data-driven decisions.
 You haven't necessarily yet experience in product management but you have an intuitive feel for UI and UX.
 You’re highly driven and autonomous.
 You’re fluent in French & English
 Benefits
 Competitive salary upon experience
 Swile Lunch voucher
 Gymlib (100% borne by Wizz)
 Premium healthcare coverage SideCare, for your family 100% borne by Wizz
 Wellness activities in our Paris office
 Unlimited vacation policy
 Remote days on Mondays, Tuesdays and Fridays

title: De Rijksoverheid zoekt: SAFe Product Owner Beheer IdM
description:
Op deze pagina:
 Dit ga je doen
 Dit krijg je
 Dit bieden we nog meer
 Dit vragen wij
 Hier kom je te werken
 Over de functiegroep
 Stel gerust je vraag
 Dit ga je doen
Breng jij structuur in verandering en neem je collega’s mee in jouw manier van werken? Als coördinator/ SAFe Product Owner bij SSC-ICT in Den Haag krijg je die kans. Je verbetert onze maatwerk IT-diensten en ondersteunt daarmee zowel je directe collega’s als tienduizenden rijksmedewerkers bij zeven ministeries.
De coördinator/ SAFe Product Owner Beheer stuurt binnen Identity Management (IdM) op een stabiele en betrouwbare IdM-dienstverlening. Samen met twee andere Product Owners – die zich vooral richten op wijzigingen en klantspecifieke ontwikkelingen – richt jij je op het dagelijkse beheer en de operationele continuïteit van de IdM-diensten.
Je:
 prioriteert en beheert de beheer-backlog;
 vertaalt operationele behoeften naar concrete backlog-items;
 optimaliseert de waarde van het beheerwerk dat het DevOps-team uitvoert;
 schat werkzaamheden in, inclusief overleggen, niet-in-beheer systemen, leverancierssupport en het vier-ogenprincipe;
 stemt af met stakeholders over voortgang, risico’s en capaciteit;
 coördineert reguliere werkzaamheden via o.a. TOPdesk;
 stuurt eenvoudige wijzigingen en gebruikersondersteuning aan;
 borgt ITIL/ASL-processen binnen een SAFe-omgeving.
 Je combineert zo klassieke beheerprocessen met moderne Agile/SAFe-sturing. Daarnaast geef je richting aan het technisch en systeembeheer van de IdM-omgeving, met focus op:
 kwetsbaarhedenmanagement op servers;
 patching, controles en eventuele reboots;
 continuïteitsbeheer van servers en applicaties;
 bewaking en monitoring;
 realisatie en aansturing.
 Naast je rol als Product Owner ben je nadrukkelijk procescoördinator. Je voert de operationele ICT-regie op de dagelijkse dienstverlening, communiceert proactief met afnemers en klanten en pakt configuratiebeheer en rapportages over meldingen op.
Je maakt het werk zichtbaar, transparant en voorspelbaar voor DevOps-engineers, stakeholders en leveranciers, terwijl je steeds de balans bewaakt tussen stabiliteit, kwaliteit en verandervermogen.
Jouw werkzaamheden sluiten aan op het KWIV-profiel 1.3.1 SOURCING MANAGEMENT.
Meer informatie over KWIV-profielen vind je op: Kwaliteitsraamwerk Informatievoorziening (KWIV)
Dit krijg je
 Schaal 12 €4.818 - €7.094 (bruto) 
 Arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd 
 1 jaar 
 36 uur 
 Het salaris is gebaseerd op een werkweek van 36 uur. 
 Dit bieden we nog meer
Naast het salaris ontvang je een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB). Het IKB bestaat uit geld (16,50% van je bruto jaarsalaris) en tijd. Met het IKB maak jij de keuzes die bij jou passen en kun je een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samenstellen. Je kunt er bijvoorbeeld voor kiezen om een deel van je maandinkomen te laten uitbetalen wanneer jij dat wenst. Ook kun je dit budget omzetten in verlof en andersom of besteden aan fiscaal vriendelijke doelen. De Rijksoverheid hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en loopbaanontwikkeling en biedt daarvoor tal van mogelijkheden. Tot de secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden behoren onder meer verschillende studiefaciliteiten, bedrijfsfitness, volledige vergoeding van je OV-reiskosten woon-werkverkeer en gedeeltelijk betaald ouderschapsverlof.
Dit vragen wij
 Wo werk- en denkniveau met minimaal een afgeronde hbo-opleiding in een relevante richting (bijv. ICT, bedrijfskunde of informatiemanagement).
 Aantoonbare ervaring als Product Owner binnen SAFe of in een vergelijkbare rol in een Agile/DevOps-omgeving.
 Aantoonbare ervaring met beheerprocessen en operationele IT-dienstverlening (ITIL/ASL).
 Ervaring in een complexe enterprise-omgeving met meerdere stakeholders.
 Ervaring op het gebied van Identity & Access Management.
 Ervaring met TOPdesk, Jira en Confluence.
 In staat om operationele werkzaamheden te prioriteren en te combineren met backlog- en roadmapsturing.
 Kennis van Objective Key Results (OKR's) is een pre. 
 Competenties
 Je werkt gestructureerd en houdt overzicht in een dynamische beheeromgeving, waarbij je helder en proactief communiceert richting klanten, teams en leveranciers.
 Je bent besluitvaardig en resultaatgericht: je durft prioriteiten te stellen, ook onder druk, en bewaakt daarbij continu de balans tussen risico’s, stabiliteit en voorspelbaarheid.
 Je hebt een groot verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel voor de continuïteit en kwaliteit van de dienstverlening en bent sterk in afstemming en coördinatie tussen verschillende disciplines.
 Je bent analytisch sterk en ziet snel waar processen beter, slimmer of stabieler kunnen. Daarbij combineer je rust met stevigheid: anderen voelen zich gehoord, terwijl jij duidelijk de lijn en richting bewaakt.
 Bijzonderheden
De vermelde einddatum van de vacature is een richtlijn. Regelmatig wordt de einddatum van een vacature verlengd, maar dit heeft geen invloed op de beoordeling van kandidaten die al vóór die datum hebben gereageerd. In sommige gevallen sluit de vacature juist eerder. Wacht dus niet te lang en reageer snel!
Je wordt ingeschaald op basis van ervaring. Voldoe je nog niet volledig aan het profiel, dan begin je eerst in een aanloopschaal en krijg je de kans door te groeien naar het schaalniveau van deze functie.
De wederzijdse kennismaking en selectieprocedure bestaat uit twee gesprekken en mogelijk een assessment. Bij een positief verloop volgt een afrondend arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek.
Een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) is nodig om te kunnen starten als medewerker bij SSC-ICT.
Hier kom je te werken
Meer over BAS/BA/IDM/Identity Management
Je werkt als coördinator/ SAFe Product Owner Beheer binnen het Identity Management (IdM)-team van de afdeling Business Applicaties. Deze afdeling bestaat uit vier teams (SMT/APA, BWAP, EIS en IdM) die samen verantwoordelijk zijn voor bedrijfskritische applicaties en diensten voor de primaire processen van de organisatie.
In het IdM-team werk je met ongeveer 30 collega’s in meerdere subtea

title: Senior Product Manager

 You'll work in close partnership with an Engineering Manager and their pod, balancing user needs, technical feasibility, and commercial priorities in a space that's evolving fast.

 Define and own the product roadmap for native MCP or A2A support across Gravitee's platform.
 Work closely with your Engineering Manager and pod through discovery, design, and delivery.
 Collect and prioritize the needs of customers building or adopting MCP servers and clients, or Agents and A2A
 Prototype new capabilities using AI-assisted tools to validate ideas before committing engineering investment.

 Background in solutions engineering, consulting, or customer success.
 Experience with multi-LLM or agent orchestration products.
 Familiarity with API gateway or API management products.
 Sensitivity to security and governance issues.
 Who Thrives at Gravitee 
 At Gravitee, our growth is powered by people who bring passion to what they build, act with professionalism in how they work, and hold nothing back in their commitment to doing things well.
 You'll do well here if you:
 Care deeply about quality, clarity, and impact
 Are curious, adaptable, and excited by emerging technologies like AI

 Bonus points if you've worked with APIs, cloud-native platforms, AI-enabled systems, or open source, but curiosity matters most.
 Life at Gravitee

 You'll get:

 Stock options - you build it, you own it

 Your birthday off
 Professional development budget to fuel your growth

 A meaningful, progressive, global company culture that is as fun as it is hardworking. Endless growth opportunities.

title: Product Manager, Data
description:
About Netwealth
 Netwealth isn't just a company. We're shaping the future of wealth in Australia. Our award-winning platform and NextGen technology empower advisers and investors to achieve more, and we're proud to be recognised as one of Australia's most innovative FinTech businesses.
Since 1999, we've grown rapidly by challenging the status quo. We move fast, think big, and stay agile. Free from unnecessary bureaucracy so we can deliver smarter solutions for our clients and create real impact.
But what truly sets us apart? Our people. We're a team of curious, optimistic and courageous individuals who collaborate to make life better for more Australians. We value authenticity, and agility, and we believe in creating an environment where you can do your best work, grow your career, and feel part of something meaningful.
If you're looking for a place where your ideas matter, where innovation is celebrated, and where you can help shape a brighter financial future, join us at Netwealth.
The opportunity
We're looking for a Product Manager, Data to help shape the future of data at Netwealth.
This is an opportunity to own a meaningful area of our data portfolio, leading the discovery, prioritisation and delivery of data products that create value for advisers, clients, partners and internal teams. Working within a cross functional squad, you'll partner closely with Engineering, Product and business stakeholders to solve complex problems, influence strategic direction and deliver scalable, high performing data solutions.
You'll balance day to day delivery with long term thinking, identifying future opportunities while embedding a data as a product mindset across our modern data platform.
What you'll be doing
 Own and drive a key area of the data portfolio, ensuring the team focuses on the highest value opportunities for customers and the business
 Lead end to end product management activities including discovery, problem definition, prioritisation, roadmap development and delivery
 Partner with Software Product & Engineering and Data Engineering teams to deliver scalable, reliable and well governed data products across Azure, Snowflake and Power BI
 Define and track data product success through OKRs, metrics, adoption and business outcomes to guide decision making and prioritisation
 Collaborate with stakeholders across Software Product, Engineering, Finance, Sales, Operations, Risk and Compliance to deliver seamless customer experiences
 About You
 You're an experienced product leader with a strong technical data background who enjoys solving complex problems and turning data into meaningful business outcomes. Equally comfortable working with engineers and senior stakeholders, you bring a data driven mindset, strong commercial judgement and a passion for building products that create value for customers and the business.
 Proven experience delivering data, analytics, platform or technology products that have driven measurable business outcomes
 Previous experience as a Data Engineer, Data Analyst or in a similarly technical data focused role
 Strong experience working with Snowflake and a solid understanding of modern data platforms, cloud technologies, analytics and data ecosystems
 Demonstrated product management capability across discovery, delivery, prioritisation, measurement and continuous improvement, supported by strong stakeholder management skills
 Experience working with tools such as Jira, Confluence and Miro, alongside an understanding of data governance, privacy, risk management and emerging technologies including AI
 Life At Netwealth
 At Netwealth, we believe a fulfilling career is built on growth, balance, and belonging . Our people are our greatest strength, and we’re committed to supporting you at every stage of life because when you thrive, so do we.
We're proud to be recognised as one of Australia's top 5 companies for Career Development (endorsed by WORK180). From further education and diverse training opportunities to strong support for internal mobility. Your career can grow here.
Our flexible hybrid model supports balance, with just 4 days in the office each fortnight. When you’re in, you’ll enjoy working from one of our modern, thoughtfully designed spaces across Australia – including our state-of-the-art Melbourne CBD office. All locations feature contemporary facilities to make your day comfortable, and in Melbourne, you’ll also enjoy perks like end-of-trip amenities and daily breakfast to make your commute easier.

description:
Overview 
 We are seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to own the vision, strategy and execution of the roadmap for SmartSense CRE, Ecolibrium's commercial real estate product line within the broader SmartSense platform. The role will work closely with Engineering, Design, Field Operations, Sales and Delivery to turn market insight and customer feedback into products that are competitive, high-quality and aligned to Ecolibrium's business goals.
 The Senior Product Manager will lead market research, define product strategy, guide development from concept to launch and track performance against clear KPIs. SmartSense is a technically layered product spanning real-time IoT telemetry, deterministic rules engines, machine learning models and, in select modules, conversational AI. This role requires strong strategic thinking, genuine technical fluency across these layers, stakeholder management and the ability to inspire and align teams around a shared product vision. Requires 7+ years of relevant experience.
 THE WORK 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Develop and implement product vision, strategy and roadmap for SmartSense CRE, in alignment with Ecolibrium's business goals.
 Conduct thorough market research and competitive analysis, including in AI-enabled energy and building management tooling, to identify trends, opportunities and customer needs.
 Collaborate with Engineering, Design and other teams to guide product development from concept through to launch, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery.
 Define product requirements for AI-driven features (ML forecasting models, conversational AI modules) with the same rigour as deterministic features, including clear scoping of what the AI is and is not responsible for.
 Engage internal and external stakeholders, including customers, to gather feedback, understand requirements and ensure product success.
 Define and monitor key product performance indicators (KPIs) to measure success and inform product decisions.
 Drive continuous product improvement through customer feedback, data analysis and industry best practices.
 Foster a collaborative environment and work closely with cross-functional teams to achieve product goals.
 Translate market insights and customer needs into actionable product requirements and prioritised backlogs.
 Partner with Sales and Presales to support go-to-market activities, positioning and customer-facing product narratives, ensuring AI capabilities are represented accurately and never overstated.
 Lead and motivate cross-functional teams, setting a compelling product vision that inspires others to deliver against it.
 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR 
 Qualifications & Experience 
 Essential 
 Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field; an advanced degree is a plus.
 7+ years of experience in product management, with a proven track record of leading successful product initiatives.
 Experience in IoT, building management systems or related industries is highly desirable.
 Strong understanding of product development processes, market research techniques and data analysis tools.
 Working fluency with AI product concepts: able to distinguish deterministic rule-based logic from machine learning and from LLM-based conversational features, and to make sound product decisions about where each is appropriate.
 Proven ability to lead and motivate cross-functional teams without direct authority.
 Ability to think strategically and translate market insights into actionable product strategies.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical and AI-related concepts to diverse, including non-technical, stakeholders.
 Strong customer orientation with a passion for creating products that deliver exceptional value and user experience.
 Desirable 
 Experience as a visionary, analytical and collaborative product leader who thrives on solving complex problems.
 Exposure to energy management, industrial IoT or connected-building product categories.
 Direct experience shipping AI or ML-powered features, including forecasting models, anomaly detection or conversational/LLM-based assistants, and communicating their capabilities and limits honestly to clients.
 Familiarity with agile product development and data-driven experimentation.
 Awareness of responsible AI practices relevant to enterprise B2B products, such as per-tenant data isolation, model risk considerations and honest disclosure of AI capability and certification status.

title: Senior Product Manager, Data Cloud and Connectors
description:
Overview
 Working at Atlassian
 Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
 About DX
 DX is the developer intelligence platform. We help engineering leaders understand how work gets done, improve developer experience, and make better decisions about productivity and AI. DX combines self-reported insights from developers with data from the systems where software work happens, then turns those signals into insights teams can act on.
 The role
 We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead DX’s data platform and connector portfolio.
The data platform is the foundation beneath every DX insight. It connects to the tools our customers use, ingests and organizes their data, protects its integrity, and makes it available to the rest of the DX product. You will own the product direction and outcomes for Data Cloud, our connector ecosystem, core data integrity, and the data infrastructure behind our demo environment.
This is a deeply technical product role. You do not need to be an engineer, but you must be able to reason credibly about connectors, APIs, data models, database design, data lakes, reliability, enterprise data requirements, and data privacy/security. You will turn that understanding into a data platform that customers and internal product teams can trust.

 Own the product capabilities that keep DX’s demo environment representative, reliable, and useful.
 Build a deep understanding of enterprise data environments, security constraints, integration patterns, and the teams responsible for them.
 Shape ambiguous opportunities with lightweight specs, prototypes, and clear written context before the team commits to a solution.

 Partner with customer-facing and go-to-market teams on connector discovery, pilots, launches, documentation, and positioning.

 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of independently owning a technical product area.

 Firsthand experience using DX as a customer.

 PMs at DX act as the compass and context engine for their product area. We expect PMs to stay close to customers, synthesize context for the team, sprint ahead on ambiguous work with lightweight specs and mockups, and increase the team’s speed of learning. We default to pragmatic, async written work rather than unnecessary process.
 Benefits & Perks

description:

 Delhivery is building a platform to help transporters and fleet owners access financial and vehicle-related services through one platform. With FASTag, payments, wallet and GPS journeys already launched, the next phase includes expanding banking partnerships, automating payments, launching fuel service and building lending capabilities.
 As Product Manager for Financial Services, you will own initiatives from discovery through launch and adoption. You will work closely with engineering, business, operations, finance, compliance and external partners to deliver reliable products that simplify customers’ daily operations.
 What You Will Do 
 Own the roadmap and outcomes: Translate customer needs and business priorities into a focused roadmap across FASTag, wallets, Fuel Card, GPS and upcoming lending products. Track adoption, transaction success, revenue and servicing costs.
 Understand customers and field operations: Spend time with transporters, fleet owners, sales and support teams. Identify friction across onboarding, KYC, purchase, fulfilment, activation and ongoing usage.
 Build reliable transaction journeys: Improve recharges, refunds, reconciliation, disputes and invoicing. Anticipate failed transactions, partner downtime and exceptions, with clear recovery paths for customers and operations.
 Expand the product portfolio: Drive new bank integrations, automated recharges, prepaid wallet integration and GPS offerings. Develop lending journeys spanning discounting, loan origination, servicing and co-lending partnerships.
 Manage integrations and controls: Work with banks, payment providers and technology partners on API readiness, testing and production stability. Partner with compliance and finance on consent, data sharing, KYC and transaction controls.

 Technical fluency to discuss APIs, integrations, data flows and system reliability with engineering and external partners.
 Ability to work through ambiguity, understand operational details and balance customer experience, commercial goals and compliance requirements.
 Practical familiarity with AI tools for research, prototyping, analysis and automation, with sound judgment about their limitations.
 Clear communication and the ability to align stakeholders, resolve dependencies and drive adoption after launch.

 Build on a live platform while shaping its next stage of growth. This role offers ownership across everyday transaction products and new lending capabilities, with direct impact on how transporters access services, manage payments and keep their businesses moving.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
Zig is 's ride-hailing app, and every great trip ends with a seamless payment experience. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our end-to-end payments platform, shaping how money moves from rider payments to driver settlements and reconciliation, while partnering closely with teams across Product, Engineering, Finance, Risk & Compliance, and our payment partners.
 Job responsibilities: 
 Design and be responsible for the vision and a multi-quarter roadmap for the whole payment system, built with the business, Finance and engineering leads, not a backlog of single features.
 Manage and build, buy or integrate, and make the business case for each choice in numbers: cost per transaction, success rate, time to market, operational load.
 Responsible for the full lifecycle of a payment, from authorisation through capture, settlement and reconciliation, including every failure, retry and fallback path.
 Drive down payment failures, wrong or fallback charges, stuck settlements and manual Finance work, and be able to show the trend each month.
 Lead payment-led partnerships: co-branded offers, BIN-based discounts, new wallet and rail integrations.
 Create details PRDs that engineers can build from: flows, state diagrams, edge cases and acceptance criteria.
 Work effectively with API contracts, idempotency, retries, webhooks and asynchronous payment states, and challenge designs on their failure modes.
 Run delivery across iOS, Android, backend and data teams, and ship in measurable increments rather than big-bang releases.
 Partner with Risk, Legal, Finance and Compliance on MAS requirements, PCI-DSS, PDPA, AML and fraud controls, and audit readiness.
 Design for disputes, recoverability and operational support from the start, not as an afterthought.
 Define, manage, and drive improvements on the payment scorecard: payment success rate, authorization rate, time to settle, refund and dispute rate, cost per transaction, reconciliation breaks, and support contacts per 1,000 trips.
 Use SQL, dashboards and experiments to find the biggest leaks and priorities them by recovered or saved.
 Use Generative AI and automation to redesign workflows, reduce repetitive work and human error, improve decision quality, and build the team's strategic consulting capability
 Any ad hoc duties as assigned
 Job Requirements: 
 Minimum 7 years and above in product management, including more than 4 years experiencing the payments, billing, wallet, fintech or marketplace money-movement product is preferred.
 Hands-on knowledge of the payments ecosystem: PSPs, acquirers, card schemes, local rails (PayNow, FAST, GIRO), wallets, tokenisation, 3DS, settlement cycles and reconciliation will be a plus.
 Experience shipping and supporting refunds, chargebacks, partial captures, pre-auth holds, and failure and retry handling will be advantage.
 Strong technical fluency: you can read an API spec, challenge a design and reason about failure modes without writing code.
 Track record of shipping finance-critical or regulated products, working closely with Finance and Compliance.
 Strong analytical skills: comfortable in SQL and BI tools, and you define the success metric before you build.
 Strong in writing and structured thinking, and the ability to shape and presentation to senior stakeholders
 Experience using AI tools to speed up specs, analysis and discovery will be a plus.
 Preferably ride-hailing, delivery, e-commerce, travel or another two-sided marketplace.
 Corporate billing, invoicing, driver payouts or split payments are preferred.
 Cross-border payments, multi-currency, or launching in a new market.
 Fraud tooling, risk scoring and payments observability.

description:
Identify, define, deliver and continuously improve AI products that create measurable business and user value. Translate opportunities into product requirements, features and roadmaps. Guide model and technology choices with specialist teams, establish evaluation and monitoring requirements, and shape product positioning and pricing throughout the product lifecycle.
 The role spans AI product strategy and product ownership across platforms and use cases. It provides a clear connection between business needs, user experience, technical delivery, responsible AI and commercial outcomes.
 Activities and responsibilities 
 1 Identify and prioritise opportunities 
 Investigate user needs, business processes and market opportunities. Define the problem, target users, current performance baseline and intended benefits. Assess whether AI is appropriate and prioritise use cases against value, feasibility, data readiness, cost and risk. Develop the business case and investment priorities with stakeholders.
 2 Develop AI product requirements 
 Own the product requirements document for each use case. Specify intended behaviour, inputs and outputs, scope, user journeys, data requirements, integrations, limitations and measurable acceptance criteria. Describe human review, escalation and fallback needs. Translate business expectations into requirements that delivery teams can implement and evaluate.
 3 Inform model and technology choices 
 Maintain a practical understanding of the AI landscape and emerging technologies. Work with researchers, ML engineers and architects to assess models and solution approaches against product requirements. Frame trade-offs involving quality, response time, cost, explainability, security and deployment constraints. Request relevant benchmarks and experiments to support decisions and revisit choices as evidence changes.
 4 Define features and the product roadmap 
 Translate use cases into clearly articulated capabilities, features and a prioritised backlog. Define what each feature should do and how users will benefit. Build a roadmap covering discovery, experimentation, pilot delivery, release and improvement. Account for data preparation, technical integration and governance dependencies, and adjust scope and sequencing as evidence emerges.
 Delivery and lifecycle responsibilities 
 5 Specify data requirements and readiness 
 Define required data sources, formats, coverage, volumes, quality checks and labelling needs with specialist teams. Coordinate access and permitted use with data owners. Identify gaps and preparation dependencies, and incorporate them into delivery estimates and the roadmap. Document relevant data handling constraints for review by the appropriate control teams.
 6 Establish product and solution evaluations 
 Own the evaluation plan with data scientists, ML engineers and domain experts. Define metrics, baselines, targets, test populations, measurement methods and evaluation periods. Include representative, difficult and failure cases. Evaluate individual capabilities and the complete user workflow, including human intervention and downstream effects. Agree acceptance thresholds, release criteria and the evidence needed for each decision.
 7 Monitor performance and improve the product 
 Specify telemetry, user feedback and reporting requirements. Review quality, adoption, outcomes, failures and cost over time. Evaluate changes to models, prompts, data and workflows before release. Prioritise improvements based on evidence and coordinate responses when performance falls below agreed thresholds, including escalation or rollback where appropriate.
 8 Coordinate responsible AI and release readiness 
 Engage governance, risk, security, legal and compliance stakeholders early. Explain the product purpose, functionality, inputs and outputs, data handling, limitations and proposed controls. Incorporate their requirements into the backlog and release process. Coordinate evidence for review and ensure product claims reflect demonstrated capability. Maintain visibility of approvals, operational ownership and unresolved risks.
 9 Define positioning and pricing 
 Develop the value proposition and product positioning. Understand the full cost of data, models, infrastructure, integration, operations and human review. Compare relevant subscription, consumption and outcome-based pricing approaches where applicable. Assess cost per successful outcome and sensitivity to usage. For internal products, work with Finance and business owners on transparent consumption measures, cost allocation and transfer-pricing proposals.
 10 Drive adoption and value realisation 
 Align business and technical stakeholders around priorities, delivery expectations and product outcomes. Support training, change management and user adoption. Track realised benefits against the business case and review whether the product should expand, change or retire. Manage budget and supplier dependencies with the relevant owners and communicate decisions and progress clearly.
 Accountability and decision boundaries 
 The AI Product Manager owns product outcomes, requirements, priorities and the evaluation framework. Researchers, engineers and architects own technical implementation and specialist design decisions within their mandates. Governance and control functions retain their approval responsibilities. Finance and business owners agree pricing and internal charging arrangements with the product manager.

 Why Join Us?
 Access to a global network of a globally united and mutually responsible "Tribe of Intrapreneurs," passionately dedicated to renewing the travel industry and reinventing the ways businesses stay, work, and pay. NVIDIA's Accelerated Computing team sits is a driving force behind the explosion of Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence and High-Performance Computing. We are looking for a highly capable individual with a consistent track record in technology and the skills for GPU product definition for Data Center. We are a small, dynamic, and motivated team that defines the next generation of products for these high growth markets.
 What You'll Be Doing
 Develop a deep understanding of datacenter workloads and applications, especially around Large Language Models, for training and inference

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office.
 Senior Product Manager
 Our Product Design and Management teams work tirelessly to understand what our customers need and make it a reality. They’re the ones who make our deals come to life and our user experience simple and intuitive.
 Why This Job’s a Big Deal
 As a Senior Product Manager in the Product Operating Model (POM), your focus is on defining, prioritizing, and delivering products or capabilities that solve customer problems and deliver measurable business outcomes. You are accountable for the success of your product, partnering closely with design, engineering, and business stakeholders. You balance customer needs, business goals, and technical feasibility to ensure your product creates real value.
 In This Role You Will Get To
 1 . Product Discovery & Strategy
 Understand the flight order lifecycle through research, data analysis, and feedback loops
 Define the product vision, goals, and outcomes in alignment with the group and portfolio strategy to reduce risk to flights P&L. 
 Research, troubleshoot, diagnose, and recommend solutions to complex business and technical problems.
 Translate data insights and market trends into product opportunities
 Outcome Ownership
 Define, track, and deliver against product outcomes, lagging and leading indicators. Focused on outcomes over output. 
 Balance short-term risks, long-term opportunities , technical debt, and enabler work in your product backlog.
 Continuously evaluate whether product initiatives are driving intended value
 Stakeholder Alignment & Communication
 Collaborate with stakeholders across the organization, including Commercial Teams, Finance, Technology, Accounting, and Financial Planning & Analysis to bring products to market.
 Partner with business sponsors, portfolio managers, and cross-functional teams to align on outcomes
 Partner with Data teams to identify insights that drive faster decision making. 
 Act as the voice of the flights business and advocate for value delivery in decision-making.
 Planning & Execution
 Lead quarterly and sprint planning for your product team with an outcomes focused approach. 
 Ensure dependencies are identified, managed, and communicated
 Participate in demos, standups, and retrospectives to support delivery progress.
 Roll up your sleeves. We are a lean team and there is no job either big or too small. Some days you will be planning for the next quarter, and other days you will be diving into database records or inspecting API responses to help the development team troubleshoot an issue. We are very hands-on.
 Who You Are
 Requires a Bachelor's degree; an MBA is preferred.
 6 to 8 years of experience taking full ownership of product success by defining visions and managing priorities to drive business and customer value.
 A strategic thinker capable of connecting business opportunities with technical execution across engineering and design teams.
 Strong quantitative skills with a focus on data-driven decision-making; knowledge of SQL, Tableau, and BigQuery is advantageous.
 Active practitioner of the Product Operating Model, skilled at making trade-offs and empowering teams to deliver consistent value.
 An effective communicator who builds alignment across teams and stakeholders fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer-centricity within the Flights team and throughout the organization
 Experienced at translating complex problems into clear product requirements and roadmaps with a strong understanding of technical architecture,
 Highly organized, self-directed, and focused on outcomes over output
 Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust
 The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.
 Who We Are
 WE ARE PRICELINE.
 Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!
 Flexible work at Priceline
 Priceline is following a hybrid working model, which includes two days onsite as determined by you and your manager (ideally selecting among Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday). On the remaining days, you can choose to be remote or in the office.
 Perks & Benefits At Priceline
 Our benefits are designed to support your health, wellbeing, and life inside and outside of work. Eligible Priceliners have access to:
 Health & wellness coverage including medical, dental, vision, and mental health resources
 Generous time off including PTO, holidays, a company-wide Priceline Pause reset week, and paid volunteer days

title: Senior Technical Product Manager (8CFBC52)
description:
Referment is working with a banking technology company that develops cloud-native core banking and payments software for financial institutions. Its core platform supports the products banks offer their customers, making data integrity, resilience and performance central to the product decisions you'll make.
As a Senior Technical Product Manager, you'll define the core platform roadmap and work closely with Engineering leadership on challenges such as data consistency, performance at scale and the developer experience. This is a technical product role: you'll need to engage with architecture choices as confidently as you discuss customer needs and commercial priorities.
You'll work across Engineering, go-to-market teams, Customer Success and Client Services to turn bank and developer feedback into platform capabilities. The remit connects product strategy with implementation, including APIs and user journeys that help clients build and launch financial products.
 The Role
 Define and drive the core platform strategy and roadmap, balancing configurability, performance and resilience.
 Work with Engineering leadership to assess technical trade-offs and shape APIs and developer workflows.
 Represent banks and their developers in product decisions, using feedback to focus engineering work on practical core banking problems.
 Help Client Services and implementation partners align complex client requirements with the platform's technical capabilities.
 Communicate the product vision and technical functionality to internal teams and clients, supporting adoption and measurable outcomes.
 Develop product management practices with Engineering Managers and help embed them across the core platform domain.
 What We're Looking For
 At least five years of product management experience in a product-led technology company, with delivery of technical, API-driven or infrastructure products.
 The ability to reason from first principles and debate complex system behaviour, including consistency and availability in a ledger.
 Strong client-facing communication, including technical discussions with enterprise architects and CTOs.
 Comfort writing simple scripts in a language such as Python, alongside the ability to learn unfamiliar technical concepts.
 Commercial judgement that connects platform decisions with customer adoption and outcomes.
 Useful Additional Experience
 Banking or other regulated industries, enterprise B2B platforms and a previous software engineering or similarly technical role would all be useful, but are not mandatory.
This could suit a technical platform product manager who enjoys working closely with engineers while staying involved in customer conversations and complex implementations.

title: Product Manager (Core Platform and Infrastructure)
description:
About Sibros Technologies
 Who We Are
 Sibros is accelerating the future of SDV excellence with its Deep Connected Platform™ that orchestrates full vehicle software update management, vehicle analytics, and remote commands in one integrated system. Adaptable to any vehicle architecture, Sibros’ platform meets stringent safety, security, and compliance standards, propelling OEMs to innovate new connected vehicle use cases across fleet management, predictive maintenance, data monetization, and beyond.
Learn more at www.sibros.tech.
 Our Mission
 Our mission is to help our customers get the most value out of their connected devices.
Follow us on
LinkedIn | Youtube | Instagram
 About The Role
 Job Title: Product Manager - Core Platform & Infrastructure
 Reporting to: Group Product Manager
 Job Type: Full-Time
 Experience: 5+ years
As a Product Manager for Core Infrastructure at Sibros, you aren't just managing a backlog - you are the architect of the foundational pipeline that connects vehicles to the cloud. You will sit at the intersection of embedded automotive systems, distributed cloud computing, and business strategy. We are looking for a highly technical product leader who can navigate the complex, high-stakes landscape of modern vehicle architectures. You will own the core platforms that orchestrate flawless over-the-air (OTA) updates, secure remote diagnostics, and resilient vehicle-to-cloud data ingestion, transforming complex technical constraints into a highly reliable, scalable enterprise platform.
What you’ll do
 Own the Core Vehicle-to-Cloud Pipeline: Lead the full product lifecycle for our foundational infrastructure products, including OTA orchestration engines and remote command delivery. You will ensure this core platform acts as a rock-solid, extensible foundation that reliably powers all downstream applications built on top of it, such as advanced troubleshooting, predictive maintenance, and fleet management tools.
 Optimize Value Delivery: Ruthlessly prioritize the platform backlog. You’ll make the hard trade-off decisions between technical debt, architectural scalability, security compliance, and OEM feature requests to maximize platform ROI.
 Define System Boundaries and APIs: Partner closely with Embedded, Cloud, and Security Engineering to define robust APIs, data contracts, and platform abstractions that allow Sibros to integrate seamlessly into diverse OEM vehicle architectures.
 Drive Platform Reliability & Scale: Define and track critical platform KPIs (e.g. OTA success rates, command latency, system uptime) and use technical discovery to address architectural bottlenecks proactively.
 Autonomous Decision-Making: Act as the primary authority for your platform infrastructure domain, synthesizing deeply technical constraints and market requirements into a clear, prioritized roadmap without requiring day-to-day tactical guidance.
 Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Interface with Business Development, Solutions Architecture, and Engineering to translate complex OEM infrastructure requirements into scalable, platform-agnostic solutions that serve diverse vehicle segments.
 What you should know
 Required Qualifications
 Professional Experience: 5+ years of Product Management experience in high-growth environments, with a proven track record of delivering deeply technical platform products, infrastructure, or middleware at scale.
 Automotive & Mobility Domain Expertise: Strong understanding of the vehicle architecture ecosystem, including telemetry, automotive communication protocols (CAN, Ethernet), and diagnostic standards (UDS, SOVD).
 Systems Thinking & Scale: Experience managing backend or platform products that bridge embedded edge environments and distributed cloud infrastructure. You design with the entire ecosystem in mind, ensuring that changes to the core platform account for, support, and align with upstream OEM workflows, downstream applications, and broader data dependencies.
 Strategic Autonomy: You are a principled, self-directed leader with a history of making high-stakes technical decisions independently. You excel at navigating ambiguity and establishing clear technical directions in a fast-paced environment.
 Technical Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex architectural constraints and infrastructure concepts into strategic business value for executive stakeholders and OEM partners.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Automotive Cybersecurity & Safety Standards: Familiarity with functional safety (ISO 26262), automotive cybersecurity (ISO 21434).
 Engineering Roots: A background in Embedded Software, Cloud Systems Architecture, or Systems Engineering is highly desirable.
 Enterprise Integration: Experience building developer-facing tools, SDKs, or highly flexible APIs used by third-party enterprise engineering groups.
 What We Offer
 Competitive compensation package with performance incentives.
 A dynamic work environment with a flat hierarchy and the opportunity for rapid career advancement.
 Access to continuous learning and development opportunities.
 Flexible working hours to accommodate different time zones.
 Comprehensive benefits package including health insurance and wellness programs.
 A culture that values innovation and promotes a work-life balance.
 Equal Opportunity Employer
 We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.
 This job description provides a comprehensive outline designed to attract highly technical product managers looking to advance their careers in the dynamic and growing software-defined vehicle industry. Adjustments can be made based on the specific needs of your team and changes in business strategies.
