description:
Organization Overview Company Description
 QAD is a leading provider of ERP solutions purpose-built for manufacturing industries — automotive, life sciences, food & beverage, high tech, and industrial. Serving thousands of global manufacturers, QAD's Adaptive Manufacturing Cloud helps companies operate with greater precision, agility, and intelligence.
QAD's AI Platform is the domain intelligence layer that sits between the ERP and autonomous AI agents. It encodes what manufacturing data means, governs what agents are permitted to do, and makes every autonomous decision traceable and accountable — transforming QAD from a system of record into a system of action.
 Job Description
 This role owns the full product lifecycle for QAD's Copilot, Search, and Conversational Analytics capabilities — from architecture through to market launch. You will define what gets built, why it matters to manufacturing users, and how it reaches them: shaping the product vision, driving engineering delivery, and partnering with GTM to ensure adoption.
The intelligence that powers these surfaces — how queries are understood, how manufacturing context is assembled, how data is retrieved, and how responses are generated — is where QAD's AI moat is built. You will need to engage deeply with these layers, not as an engineer but as the product owner who defines the contracts, quality standards, and sequencing decisions that determine whether they work in production at enterprise scale.
You will report to the Head of Platform Product, with day-to-day direction from the Director of the AI Platform org. This role is evaluated through the quality of your product thinking, your influence on engineering direction, and the outcomes you drive in the market.
 The Opportunity
 Manufacturing users today cannot query their own operations without analysts, BI tools, or pre-built reports. QAD's AI platform changes this — but only if the Copilot and Search layer is built correctly and lands with users. You will own both sides of that equation.
 Define the semantic search and conversational analytics product that allows manufacturing users to query operational data — orders, inventory, suppliers, quality records — in natural language, without SQL or BI expertise
 Own the intelligence contract: how queries are understood, how manufacturing context is assembled, how retrieval is orchestrated, and how responses are grounded in governed data — the foundational decisions that determine product quality at scale
 Drive the Copilot from concept to customer — including the contextual layer architecture, the grounding contract against the platform's Semantic Layer, and the GTM motion that gets it adopted in manufacturing workflows
 Build the feedback loops that make the product smarter over time: how recurring query patterns surface ontology gaps, how session analytics drive prioritisation, and how discovery findings translate into product improvements
 Establish QAD's conversational analytics presence in market — working with GTM to define positioning, enablement, and the narrative that differentiates QAD's intelligence layer from horizontal AI tools
 Key Responsibilities
 Copilot & Conversational Analytics
 Own the product definition for QAD's Copilot: how queries are understood, context assembled, data retrieved, and responses generated — specifying the contracts that engineering builds against
 Define the grounding contract: the rules that ensure every Copilot response cites governed manufacturing data, not hallucinated inference — including confidence signalling and graceful fallback behaviour
 Drive the conversational analytics strategy: how natural language queries translate into analytical results across manufacturing data domains without exposing SQL or BI complexity to the user
 Specify the disambiguation model: how the Copilot handles ambiguous queries, missing context, and conflicting data signals in real manufacturing workflows
 Search
 Own the product definition for QAD's semantic search layer: indexing strategy, query understanding, entity recognition, ranking, and result structure across manufacturing data domains
 Define the search intent taxonomy — operational (find order, trace shipment), analytical (show trends, compare periods), and diagnostic (why is this delayed, what caused this variance) — and specify result formats by intent type
 Drive the federated search architecture: how results from ERP operational data, analytical stores, and the knowledge graph are ranked and merged into a coherent, useful response
 Discovery, Delivery & GTM
 Maintain a structured customer discovery programme — extracting real manufacturing query patterns and translating findings into specific product and architecture implications
 Own the product backlog: writing stories to Staff Engineer level of specificity — API contracts, state machines, data flows, edge cases — that engineering can build without verbal clarification
 Partner with GTM to define the launch and adoption strategy for Copilot and Search: positioning, sales enablement, onboarding playbooks, and the narrative that lands with manufacturing buyers
 Define the quality framework for these surfaces: what signals matter for product performance — retrieval relevance, grounding rate, latency distribution — and how they inform roadmap decisions

 Communicate product and architecture decisions clearly to non-technical stakeholders — translating trade-offs into business implications without jargon
 Build credibility with Engineering, Architecture, and GTM through the quality and precision of written work

title: Staff Product Manager, AI Builder Experience
description:

AI Builder Experience (ABX) is MongoDB’s front door for the agentic era. We help human developers and coding agents discover, evaluate, and choose MongoDB, and we make MongoDB work naturally inside the AI-native tools, frameworks, and platforms where software is being built.

title: Senior Technical Product Manager (Biometric Authentication)
description:
Veriff is building the foundational trust layer of the internet, empowering people to safely and privately prove they are who they say they are. Our identity verification platform powers onboarding and authentication for some of the world's largest marketplaces, fintechs, and platforms. Our work centers on four pillars: AD/ADAS, our autonomous driving and advanced driver assist technologies; Arene, our software development platform for software-defined vehicles; Woven City, a test course for mobility; and Cloud & AI, the digital infrastructure powering our collaborative foundation. Work with Clinical Operations, Provider Experience, Compliance, Privacy, and Platform Engineering partners to provide solutions and drive improvements
Partner with Applied Scientists and Engineers to define success criteria for data reconciliation models, insight generation algorithms, and automated triage systems

description:

 About Sezzle:
 With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!
 About the Role:
 We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Technical Product Manager who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.
Sezzle is building the platform that will carry us from a BNPL provider into a full-stack financial institution. This role owns the system at the center of that: Sezzle’s banking core — the ledger, accounts and balances, and the money movement that every future Sezzle financial product will run on.
You would own it end to end. Discovery, architecture and vendor decisions, requirements, build, launch, and everything after — not a slice of someone else’s roadmap, but the full product lifecycle for the platform itself. You’d work directly with Engineering, Finance, Compliance, Treasury, and Risk, with real authority over how this gets built.
 Ideally you’ve built something like this before. If you haven’t, but you’ve owned a ledger, a payments platform, an issuing program, or other financial infrastructure — and you’re the kind of person who learns a domain properly rather than around the edges — we want to talk to you. What matters most is that you’ve owned real infrastructure and that you’re willing to go deep on the parts you don’t know yet.
 What You'll Do:
 Own the banking platform roadmap. Define and sequence the platform work required to support accounts, deposits, cards, and lending on a single ledger and account model.
 Help drive the build-vs-buy decision. Evaluate core banking platforms and processors, run vendor diligence, model cost and time-to-market, and help leadership decide whether we extend what we have or integrate a third party.
 Shape the account and ledger model. Work with Engineering and Finance on account hierarchies, sub-ledgers, chart-of-accounts mapping, posting rules, holds, interest and fee accrual, and general ledger integration.
 Specify money movement. Own product requirements for transfers, ACH, card issuing and network settlement, real-time rails, and returns and reversals — including exception handling, cutoff windows, and settlement reconciliation.
 Make the platform auditable. Ensure the system produces the reporting, traceability, and controls that Finance, audit, and regulators need — reconciliation breaks, balance attestation, and complete transaction history.
 Partner on regulatory readiness. Work with Compliance and Legal to turn their requirements into platform capabilities: screening hooks, onboarding data, error resolution, disclosures and statements, and reporting. You don’t need to arrive fluent in US banking regulation — you do need to be someone who learns it properly.
 Plan migration and cutover. If a migration is in scope, own data mapping, parallel-run strategy, validation criteria, rollback plans, and phased cutover.
 Write the technical requirements. Own detailed specs, API contracts, event schemas, data models, user stories, and release plans end-to-end.
 Use data to prove it works. Write your own SQL. Define platform KPIs — posting latency, reconciliation break rate, settlement accuracy, failure rates — and monitor them relentlessly.
 Manage risk early. Anticipate technical risks, edge cases, race conditions, and dependencies before they become incidents. Money movement defects are the expensive kind.
 Operate with urgency. Deliver against an evolving regulatory and business timeline with incomplete information.
 What We Look For:
 Bachelor’s or advanced degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or other technical discipline (required).
 5–10 years of product experience, with meaningful time spent on financial infrastructure rather than only customer-facing surfaces.
 Real ownership in at least one of the following. You do not need all of them, and we care much more about depth in one than exposure to several:
 Ledgers, general ledger, or balance and transaction systems
 Payments processing, orchestration, or money movement — ACH, card networks, transfers, settlement, or the LATAM equivalents (PIX, SPEI, PSE, CCE)
 Card issuing or card program management
 Deposit, wallet, or account platforms
 Lending origination or loan servicing platforms
 Product work at a processor, BaaS provider, or core banking vendor
 Comfort with double-entry accounting concepts as they show up in software — debits and credits, sub-ledgers, accruals, reconciliation — or a genuine appetite to get comfortable with them quickly.
 Deep technical understanding of APIs, event-driven architecture, idempotency, distributed system failure modes, batch vs. real-time processing, and data flows.
 Strong SQL skills and comfort querying and interpreting data independently.
 Experience working directly with Compliance, Legal, Finance, or Treasury as stakeholders — not only Engineering and Design.
 Comfortable working in ambiguity and making sound, documented decisions with incomplete information.

We address these questions through state-of-the-art machine learning systems that generate hundreds of millions of fine-grained predictions. These forecasts are automatically consumed by systems that order, store, and route inventory — ensuring customers find the products they want, when they need them, and delivered faster than ever.  This Role In One Paragraph
 Build the platform that powers every Zeitview product. Own the core data model and shared platform services that enable data capture, processing, analysis, and delivery across Zeitview’s products and verticals. Define how domain objects and large-scale geospatial, imagery, inspection, and operational datasets are represented, connected, processed, governed, and exposed to applications, customers, and AI systems. This is a technical, high-leverage product role for someone who cares about building reliable, scalable, extensible systems. You’ll work closely with product engineering, data engineering, data science, security, and product teams to turn fragmented systems and data into durable platform primitives that teams can build on with confidence.
 Responsibilities
 Own the roadmap for shared platform services and data capabilities.

 This Role Is Not

title: Product Manager, Enterprise AI Platform (Bengaluru)
description:
We Are Hiring | Product Manager, Enterprise AI Platform | Bengaluru 
 About ReN3 
 ReN3 is a sovereign AI platform for the enterprise, built to unify an organization's knowledge and let teams execute AI-powered work under strict governance and access control. The platform runs in air-gapped, private-cloud, or other sovereign environments, so sensitive data never leaves the client's own infrastructure. ReN3 works with government, banking and financial services, insurance, healthcare, manufacturing, and construction clients, and partners with major infrastructure and cloud providers on deployment.
 About the Role 
 As a Product Manager, you will own a product area from start to finish: the customer problem, the spec, the build, the eval, the release and adoption. You will work directly with engineers, the field team and customers. You create your own path, even when there’s no roadmap to follow, and stand confidently by the choices you make.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own one or two product areas. Examples: agents and workflows, knowledge ingestion and search, or admin and governance.
 Turn customer reality into decisions. Join customer calls, read RFPs and field requests, and decide what to build, what to defer and what to refuse.
 Write specs that ship. Your specs cover acceptance criteria, edge cases, permission rules, empty states and failure states. They should be clear enough for a coding agent to build from and for an engineer to review against.
 Build things yourself. Use coding agents to make prototypes, internal tools, scripts and small product fixes. Opening a PR for a copy change or a UI tweak is part of the job.
 Define quality for AI features. Build eval sets and golden prompts. Measure answer quality, latency and cost. Make ship or no-ship calls from data, not from a good demo.
 Run releases. Prioritise, cut scope, write release notes, and equip the field team to sell, deploy and support what shipped.
 Measure adoption. Know which features customers use, which they don't and why.
 What We're Looking For 
 Must-have 
 Based in Bengaluru
 3–5 years in product management , at least 2 of them on B2B SaaS, developer or platform products. Engineers and founders who moved into product are welcome.
 Daily use of agentic coding. You have shipped something real, mostly built with coding agents: a prototype, an internal tool or a side project. You can show it and explain where the agent went wrong.
 A working understanding of LLM products: retrieval (RAG), tool calling, context limits, hallucination and evals. You know why a demo that works 8 times out of 10 is not yet a product.
 High agency . Take initiative, solve problems, deliver results, adapt quickly, and own your outcomes.
 Clear writing. Short specs, crisp decisions, no filler.
 Comfortable with enterprise requirements: SSO, roles and permissions, audit logs, data residency and security questionnaires.
 Nice-to-have 
 Experience using evaluation tooling such as promptfoo, Braintrust or LangSmith.
 Experience with enterprise sales cycles, RFPs or tenders.
 Products shipped into banking, government or other regulated industries.
 How to apply 
 Submit your resume (more specifications below).
 Ensure your resume includes a link to something you built mostly with coding agents (a repo, a live URL or a 3-minute Loom).
 Ensure your resume includes a short paragraph on one thing the agent got wrong and how you caught it.

title: Product Manager - AI Transformation, Finance
Product Manager (Core Product)
description:
Why work at Higgsfield AI? 
 Higgsfield AI is the fastest-scaling generative AI company in history, hitting $500M in annual revenue run rate, 25M+ users worldwide, 6M+ generations per day, and powering 390 of Fortune 500 brands. We're building at the absolute frontier of AI-powered video creation and next-generation creative tools. Joining Higgsfield means becoming part of a high-impact team shaping the future of AI-native experiences, at a company that isn't just moving fast, but rewriting what fast looks like.
 Why this role exists
 Higgsfield is one of the fastest-growing generative AI companies in the world. The specialty studios get most of the attention, but the general-purpose creation surface, the library, the shared foundation every user touches, is what makes or breaks daily use. We need a PM with real taste to own it.
 What You'll Actually Do
 Own the core product experience end-to-end: image, video, collaboration, asset management, and the overall UX that ties them together. 
 Own the surrounding product: library, projects, sharing, cross-product navigation, the things that make Higgsfield feel like one product instead of a bag of tools. 
 Set the taste bar. Every flow, every empty state, every default. You're the person the team looks to when something feels off. 
 Ship weekly. Our release cycle is days, not quarters. 
 Design the metrics that matter: activation, generation success rate, session depth, weekly retention, feature adoption, cross-product usage. 
 Glue the org together on the core experience. Work directly with Design, Backend, Frontend, and the vertical studio teams so the surface stays coherent as new products land on top of it. 
 Must-haves
 Deep passion and curiosity for generative image, video, and LLMs. You use these tools daily. You have opinions about which models are good at what, and why. 
 Taste. You can look at a flow and tell what's wrong before the metric moves. Design and Engineering both trust your judgment. 
 Experience launching new products and scaling existing ones. You've taken things from zero to one and from one to ten. Founding or early-operator experience is a strong plus. 
 Strong technical background with a real grasp of AI/ML concepts. You can reason about model tradeoffs, latency, quality, and cost without needing an engineer to translate. 
 You ask smart questions, dig for answers yourself, and update your view when the evidence moves. No ego on the line when you're wrong. 
 Who This Is Not For
 You prefer working from complete specifications rather than defining problems yourself. 
 You don't use generative AI tools daily. This role is impossible without lived product intuition. 
 You are looking for a slower release cycle. We ship weekly. 
 Nice to have
 Background at a consumer product, creative tool, or AI-native company in the US, EU, or Asia. 
 Direct experience shipping image or video generation, editing, or creative software. 
 What we offer
 Competitive base salary in USD, based on your experience, skills, and the scope of the role. 
 Equity participation through the company’s stock option program, giving you the opportunity to share in Higgsfield’s long-term growth. 
 Relocation support to Almaty for candidates moving from another city or country. 
 A seat where the surface you own is what millions of users touch every day. 
 A highly collaborative, fast-paced environment where you can work directly with experienced leaders and have a meaningful impact on the product and company. 
 Opportunities for professional growth, ownership, and career development as the company scales. 
 Company-provided equipment, meals, transportation, or other office benefits. 
 This is a fully on-site role based in our Almaty office . Our team works from the office five days per week for the full working day . We believe in-person collaboration is an important part of how we move quickly, solve complex problems, and build strong teams.

title: Applied AI Product Manager
description:
An Applied AI Product Manager is a senior individual contributor responsible for ensuring a product's value and viability within a product line. This role involves leading empowered, cross-functional product teams to solve moderate complexity customer problems that align with high value business needs. The Applied AI Product Manager is accountable for the product's success, from vision to execution, and collaborates closely with various functions and stakeholders to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. The
Applied AI Product Manager harnesses AI and agentic tools to compress the concept-to-cash learning loop-automating analysis, prototyping, and compliance detail-work so the team can focus on the human judgment AI cannot replace: product sense-making.
The Applied AI Product Manager plays a crucial role in ensuring the success of our high value, moderately complex products by balancing customer needs with business objectives. This role requires a blend of strategic vision, analytical skills, and collaborative teamwork to deliver valuable, viable, usable, and feasible solutions. It demands significant experience in the modern product management craft and a drive for continuous improvement-amplified by the fluent, responsible use of AI to learn faster and earn faster.
 Work you'll do
 Product Accountability
 Responsible and accountable for the product's value and viability showcasing a measurable Return on Investments (ROI)
 Drive strategy-aligned solutions to achieve product value objectives.
 Formulate and achieve Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) for identified problems to solve.
 Measure KPIs and analyze outcomes to inform future strategies.
 Leverage AI to harvest outcome evidence early and often, lowering total cost of ownership (TCO).
 Vision and Strategy
 Co-create, own, and evangelize the product vision, strategy, and roadmap, using AI to deepen domain knowledge and simulate future scenarios to chart pathways others have not yet seen.
 Align product objectives with the product line and business goals.
 Co-create in collaboration with business stakeholders, engineering, experience, and delivery.
 Use AI to expedite research, gather evidence, bolster domain knowledge, and craft and innovative visions backed by compelling strategic rationale. 
 Market and User Engagement
 Conduct user research and competitive analysis, using AI agents to synthesize research at speed-accelerating the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.
 Engage the team with users and stakeholders through continuous research and direct interactions.
 Collaborate and guide the team toward solutions that address priority user and business needs.
 Apply analytical skills to analyze data and derive actionable insights, shifting from waiting on analysis to working on insights.
 Adopt innovative and experimental approaches to solving complex problems, including AI-built, disposable prototypes that validate solutions quickly and retire bad ideas just as fast.
 Collaboration and Teamwork
 Work side-by-side with cross-functional (business, engineering, experience, and delivery) team members to achieve KPI outcomes.
 Promote a product operating model that emphasizes outcomes over output (minimize overproduction while maximizing value).
 Build empowered teams and product communities who exhibit collective product ownership and level-up their outcome potential through AI and agentic tools
 Continuous Improvement 
 Promote and drive rapid, emergent, and ongoing learning and adaptation to meet objectives.
 Drive innovation and improvement of the process to drive out waste and accelerate value achievement, using AI as a force-multiplier to offload the repetitive, speed up the sluggish, and automate the mundane.
 Remove obstacles for the team and ensure smooth flow of continuous value achievement. 
 Spread knowledge and best practices within the product vertical community.
 Applied AI Ways of Working
 Amplify innovation: use AI to rapidly deepen domain knowledge, surface untapped market and user potential, and simulate future scenarios-charting new pathways for the business.
 Amplify learning: use AI agents to synthesize research and validate ideas before they enter the backlog-compressing lead time by accelerating the data crunching, ensuring the human connection.
 Amplify focus: act as Editor-in-Chief-using AI to rigorously test assumptions and retire ideas that do not genuinely serve the user's workflow in a way that works for the business.
 Amplify experimentation: use AI to build early, functional, disposable prototypes that validate the architecture and the solution, playing a key role in the Agentic Secure Software Development Life Cycle that paves a clear path to productionize early and often.
 The successful candidate will possess:
 Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
 Effective written and verbal communication skills
 Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
 Ability to build and sustain professional relationships 
 Ability to lead projects or workstreams
 Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
 Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor 
 Ability to meet deadlines
 Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others
 The team
 Deloitte Product Engineering (PxE) is developing advanced, agentic AI-enabled solutions that are redefining the future of work across our organization and for global clients. We are committed to bringing together outstanding product, engineering, and design talent to lead this transformation.
 Qualifications Required:
 Bachelor's degree in business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field. 
 6+ years of proven experience in lean product management or related roles.
 3+ years enterprise scale experience across multiple business areas. 
 1+ years of building AI based intelligent products 
 1+ years experience in using GenAI tools to perform product management tas

title: Agent 产品经理（Agent Product Manager）
description:
岗位概述 
 负责智能体产品从需求定义、原型设计到上线迭代的完整过程。结合用户任务和智能体能力确定产品方案，与设计、工程及行业专家协作推进交付。

 About the Role

 Responsibilities

 Create product prototypes and key flows independently, specifying task inputs, execution and result delivery to support requirements discussions and validation.
 Refine product plans with designers and domain experts, using practical scenarios, professional requirements and agent capabilities to define product details.
 Coordinate engineering delivery, define scope, acceptance criteria and project plans, and resolve implementation issues and trade-offs as they arise.
 Review user feedback and task outcomes after launch, identify where the product falls short of expectations, and prioritize the next round of improvements.
 Requirements 
 Ability to drive end-to-end product development and independently handle requirements analysis, product definition, prototyping and post-launch iteration.
 Experience designing or developing AI products, with an understanding of agent mechanisms, capabilities and limitations, and the ability to design workable product flows.
 Technical understanding and hands-on skills to test product ideas through prototypes or technical experiments and resolve implementation issues with engineering teams.
 Creativity and independent thinking about user needs and AI product design, with the ability to develop concrete proposals and refine them through real use and experiments.
 Sound design judgment, communication and cross-functional coordination skills, with the ability to explain product decisions and deliver with design and engineering teams.
 Candidates with interdisciplinary backgrounds or experience across different fields are welcome. Domain expertise or representative AI agent projects that can be demonstrated are preferred.
 Manus excels at various tasks in work and life, getting everything done while you rest at Manus AI.

 If you're passionate about cutting-edge technology and making a real impact, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Senior Data Product Manager (965B762)
description:
Referment is working with a financial technology business that provides AI-enabled valuation, portfolio-monitoring and data-extraction software to private-market investors. The business is strengthening the data platform behind its investment-monitoring and valuation products and is looking for a senior individual contributor to turn its data strategy into reliable, adopted products.
You will take delivery ownership of the foundational platform and core data products used across the organisation. This is a hands-on product role rather than a people-management position: you will work closely with the Product Director, subject-matter experts, designers and engineering teams distributed across business units, translating strategy into practical operating processes and shipped capabilities.
 The Role
 Shape and implement the operating model for data-product delivery, making it work in day-to-day planning and execution.
 Bring foundational data pipelines and flagship data products into production with clear consumers, service expectations and adoption measures.
 Establish product practices covering intake, prioritisation, data contracts, lifecycle management and success metrics.
 Own and prioritise the roadmap across competing stakeholder needs while maintaining existing products against business goals.
 Write clear product requirements and delivery plans with product, data, design and engineering colleagues, using a lean, problem-first approach.
 Use qualitative and quantitative insight to understand internal users, identify opportunities and measure whether products change decisions and outcomes.
 Support rollout through stakeholder communication, training and practical end-user support.
 What We’re Looking For
 At least six years of hands-on product management experience, with a deep focus on technical data delivery and owning data platforms end to end. We are looking for candidates with a technical data focus rather than generalist product management.
 A professional background in Data Engineering (DE) or Business Intelligence (BI) is essential for this data-only ecosystem project.
 Proven hands-on experience building or scaling data platforms using technologies including Databricks and Snowflake.
 Specific experience delivering greenfield data projects or leading the major redevelopment of existing data ecosystems is required.
 Experience working within fintech scaleups is essential for this role.
 The technical fluency to read data models, challenge pipeline designs and use SQL to test assumptions.
 A track record of building products around adoption, business outcomes and decisions rather than output alone.
 Strong written and verbal communication, with the ability to work credibly with senior data engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
 Comfort influencing teams you do not directly manage and constructively challenging established approaches.
 While experience in private equity, venture capital, valuations or financial services would be useful, it is not essential; strong platform and operating-model experience matters more. Familiarity with using AI tools to improve product workflows is also valuable.
This role is designed for a Senior Data Product Manager, Data Platform Product Manager or technically grounded Product Lead who has already helped build foundational data capabilities and wants to remain close to delivery. We are looking for technical depth and hands-on execution rather than high-level or director-level management.
#Referment

title: Product Manager – Data Warehouse (C090EDC)
description:
Referment is working with a global investment and technology firm to find a product manager for the data infrastructure behind its people analytics. This is a technical product role with meaningful depth across schemas, ETL, APIs and delivery. You will translate stakeholder needs into precise requirements, anticipate edge cases and stay involved through development, testing, rollout and operational support.
 The Role
 Design ETL transformations and data models that turn business needs into reliable, scalable datasets.
 Shape an API layer that centralises business logic, permissions and consistent contracts for downstream consumers.
 Develop product direction for natural-language querying, semantic search and agentic workflows over structured and unstructured data.
 Partner with reporting specialists, developers and data scientists to define technical solutions and detailed requirements.
 Manage the backlog, sprint planning, stakeholder relationships and rollout of changes across the data platform.
 What We're Looking For
 Four to eight years of relevant product-management experience, including data or analytics products.
 Strong Excel, SQL and Python skills, plus experience with data engineers, data scientists and software developers.
 Working knowledge of ETL, business-intelligence infrastructure, APIs and data modelling.
 The ability to explain technical concepts clearly, own delivery and handle confidential information with discretion.
 Generative-AI infrastructure experience, including vector databases, RAG or semantic search, is useful but not essential.
 This could suit a data product manager who is comfortable working close to architecture and engineering while remaining accountable for stakeholder outcomes.

description:
Actian is a leading provider of data management solutions, empowering businesses to harness the power of their data.
This role offers competitive compensation, including base salary and variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, location, and experience.
We are looking for a visionary Senior Product Manager to lead the next generation of Smart Data Products within our ecosystem. You will be at the forefront of a new way of interacting with data through reliable and trustworthy AI agents, providing innovative interactions between users and information. Using Actian's Data Intelligence Platform as our core platform, you will bridge the gap between high-level strategic vision and agile technical execution. You will not only manage a backlog but also co-create alongside engineering teams using AI-driven development workflows. This is a fully remote, senior individual contributor role with high strategic visibility.
 What You’ll Do
 Translate the CPTO's strategic vision into a concrete, scalable Data Product roadmap. You'll pair strong product instincts with data-informed decision making to deliver results. 
 Participate in the product lifecycle from discovery through launch, iteration, and adoption, including setting success metrics, prioritizing features, and ensuring high-quality execution. 
 Lead the full lifecycle of Data Products development, ensuring they are discoverable, trustworthy, and valuable within Actian's Data Intelligence Platform. 
 Oversee the development of AI agents that control data products, enabling conversational and proactive interactions for end-users. 
 Lead cross-functional squads in an agile environment, collaborating with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to ensure high-velocity and high-quality releases. 
 Champion the use of AI product development tooling to accelerate delivery and optimize product features. 
 Partner with Go-to-Market teams to position our Data Products value proposition, shape product messaging, and drive adoption among technical and executive audiences. 
 Navigate the complexity of corporate environments while maintaining the agility of a startup, managing expectations from C-level executives to end-users and clients. 
 Who You Are
 5+ years in Software Product Management, with specific focus on Data Products, Data Platforms, or AI/ML products. 
 Experience working as a product manager on open source technologies. 
 You have "survived and thrived" in both fast-paced startup environments and complex corporate structures. You know how to pivot quickly but also how to navigate decision-making processes in larger organizations. 
 Deep understanding of Data Governance, Data Catalogs, and the modern data stack. 
 Ability to debate strategic inputs and then dive into the concrete inputs for engineering at ground level. 
 Skilled at translating customer and stakeholder needs into innovative product features. 
 Track record of shipping enterprise-grade SaaS features from ideation through scale. 
 Able to balance short-term execution with long-term vision. 
 Customer-driven and passionate about customer success. 
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field. 
 Preferred Qualifications
 Prior work experience in the data management domain (e.g., data catalogs, databases, major CSPs, key data-oriented user personas and their use cases) is a plus. 
 At least 1 year owning zero-to-one or early-stage product launches. 
 This role sits within the Data Intelligence Product Team. Here are values we live by:
 When the wind blows, build windmills not walls 
 If it isn't ruthless, it isn't prioritization 
 Do better, do faster 
 What We Offer:
 The chance to be part of an innovative, fast-growing company making a significant impact in the data management space.
 Collaboration with a passionate and diverse team.
 Competitive salary and benefits package.
 Flexible work arrangements (remote or hybrid).
 Opportunities for professional growth and development.
 We value diversity at our company. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Data Product Manager
description:
Company Description
 Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
 Job Description
 At Experian Consumer Services, data is a core product capability. Our products depend on reliable event capture, trusted customer data, reusable data products, analytics and AI to improve customer experiences and create value through our Marketplace.
We are looking for a Data Product Manager to turn our data strategy into a clear, prioritised and measurable portfolio of data products.
This role will connect customer and commercial priorities with the domain teams, Data Platform, Engineering, Analytics, AI, Operations, Finance, Security and Governance capabilities required to deliver them. You will create clarity across priorities, ownership, dependencies, risks, adoption and value.
Working across the UK and Hyderabad, you will help us move from a central, request-driven data model towards domain-owned data products, self-service analytics and stronger data accountability.
 What You Will Do
 Shape the data product strategy
 Translate ECS strategy, the FY27 product roadmap, Data 4.0 and AI priorities into a coherent data product strategy and roadmap.
 Prioritise data initiatives based on customer value, commercial impact, feasibility, dependencies and risk.
 Ensure that data investments support acquisition, activation, engagement, Marketplace conversion, lender matching, monetisation and platform reliability.
 Establish product ownership and lifecycle discipline
 Define the minimum standards for a data product, including purpose, consumers, inputs, outputs, KPI definitions, quality expectations, freshness, privacy classification, owner, support model and retirement plan.
 Create clear ownership across domains, central teams and shared capabilities.
 Identify opportunities for reuse across domains and prevent duplicated metrics, pipelines and reporting logic.
 Support the transition to a domain-owned and self-service data operating model.
 Connect strategy to execution
 Maintain one integrated view of use cases, domain adoption, source onboarding, data products, migration, dual running, consumer cutover and legacy decommissioning.
 Work with Product, Engineering and Analytics leads to sequence delivery around the highest-value use cases and dependencies.
 Manage risks proactively
 Identify delivery, data quality, privacy, security, capacity, supplier and operational risks before they become incidents or delivery failures.
 Maintain clear risk and dependency views with leading indicators, mitigation actions, accountable owners and decision dates.
 Measure adoption and value
 Define how data product success will be measured, including adoption, reuse, quality, freshness, time to insight, delivery cycle time and operational reliability.
 Work with Product, Analytics and Finance to connect data delivery to business outcomes such as leads, conversion, upsell, engagement, retention, revenue per user, productivity and platform cost.
 Track value delivery against the business case and recommend reprioritisation when assumptions or market conditions change. Ensure that priority use cases have evidence of consumer adoption, business impact and readiness for continued operation.
 Qualifications
 Significant experience in product management, especially data products, data platforms.
 Practical experience with domain ownership, self-service data, data governance, data migrations or data operating model change, and experience working with data engineering teams.
 Experience managing a portfolio of interconnected initiatives rather than a single product backlog.
 Strong understanding of the data lifecycle, including event design, ingestion, modelling, data contracts, quality, metadata, lineage, analytics and activation.
 Enough technical fluency to challenge assumptions, understand trade-offs and connect product decisions to architecture, quality, privacy, reliability and cost.
 Strong commercial judgement and experience linking product or data investments to measurable business value.
 Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and delivery teams without relying on formal authority.
 Exceptional organisation skills, with a clear and repeatable approach to priorities, decisions, dependencies, risks and follow-through.
 Excellent written and verbal communication, including the confidence to communicate difficult news early and constructively.
 Comfort working in a complex, changing environment where information is sometimes incomplete and decisions need to move forward.
 Additional Information
 Benefits package includes:
 Hybrid working - 40% office based
 Great compensation package and discretionary bonus
 Core benefits include Pension, Bupa healthcare, Sharesave Scheme and more
 25 days annual leave with 8 bank holidays and 3 volunteering days. You can purchase additional annual leave.
 Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. title: Senior Product Owner - Equity Risk Systems
description:
Ready to build a new risk system from the ground up? 
 Why HSBC
 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.
 The Role
 We’re looking for a senior product owner to help shape and deliver a new equity risk system from high level concept through to operational software. Working with stakeholders across Trading, Quants, Risk, Operations and Technology you’ll play a central role in shaping the product’s vision, translating complex business needs into meaningful technology outcomes and influencing the decisions that will define the platform for years to come.
 What You'll Be Doing
 Act as the interface between business stakeholders and IT ensuring business intent is represented across the delivery lifecycle
 Shape and maintain the product vision roadmap and release plan for the risk domain
 Deliver the new risk system from concept to operational software, balancing business requirements and technical constraints
 Define measurable outcomes with stakeholders including delivery timelines, quality control and strategic alignment to business needs
 Manage the book of work of current risk system to support the growth agenda
 Work closely with Technology teams through backlog refinement, sprint planning, delivery and defect triage
 What We're Looking For
 Bring deep knowledge of Equity Derivatives and Prime within the context of bank risk reporting
 Understanding of key risk metrics and outputs including VaR, P&L explain, sensitivity analysis, stress testing
 Demonstrate proven experience as a Product Owner or Business Analyst in a risk or front-office environment
 Translate complex business requirements into a structured product roadmap with functional outcomes for Technology teams
 Operate effectively across business stakeholders and Technology teams including governance forums
 Work confidently in Agile delivery environments overseeing backlog management and sprint planning
 Building the Future of Risk 
 This role gives you the scope to shape a strategic risk platform that will be used and trusted across the bank. You’ll bring clarity to complex risk workflows and reporting needs and convert them into deliverable outcomes with clear controls and traceability. You’ll work closely with front office stakeholders to agree priorities and deliver a platform that improves how risk is calculated, managed and influences investment decisions. If you want your product decisions to define a platform for years to come, we’d like to hear from you.
Being open to different points of view is important for our business and the communities we serve. At HSBC, we’re dedicated to creating diverse and inclusive workplaces - no matter their gender, ethnicity, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or age. We are committed to removing barriers and ensuring careers at HSBC are inclusive and accessible for everyone to be at their best. We take pride in being a Disability Confident Leader and will offer an interview to people with disabilities, long term conditions or neurodivergent candidates who meet the minimum criteria for the role.

title: Product Owner
description:
Through our client-facing brands and our other specialist brands, Momentum Group enables business and people from all walks of life to achieve their financial goals and life aspirations.
We help people grow their savings, protect what matters to them and invest for the future. We help companies and organisations care for and reward their employees and members. Through our own network of advisers or via independent brokers and utilising new platforms Momentum Group provides practical financial solutions for people, communities and businesses.
Disclaimer As an applicant, please verify the legitimacy of this job advert on our company career page.
 Role Purpose
 The core role outcome for a Product Owner is to maximise sustainable business value by translating the organisation’s strategy into prioritised technology-enabled products and capabilities that solve meaningful customer and business problems, while balancing commercial value, financial outcomes, risk, regulatory requirements and technical sustainability. The Product Owner is accountable for translating strategic product priorities into a clear, sequenced and executable delivery backlog.
Working closely with the Strategic Product Owner, Architects, Lead Business Analysts and cross-functional delivery teams, the Product Owner ensures that squad delivery remains aligned to strategic intent, business priorities, architectural guardrails and defined outcomes.
In a scaled product model, the Product Owner is primarily focused on the “How and When” of delivery: converting strategic direction into practical squad outputs, enabling delivery predictability and supporting measurable value progression.
 Requirements
 Minimum Requirements
 Relevant tertiary qualification in business, technology, product, finance or a related field.
 Agile, product ownership or delivery-related certification is advantageous.
 Experience
 5–8+ years’ experience in product ownership, business analysis, delivery management or related execution roles, with demonstrable experience translating strategy into prioritised technology-enabled delivery.
 Proven track record delivering complex initiatives across business and technology environments, with clear evidence of business value, commercial or financial outcomes, customer impact and controlled delivery.
 Experience working in cross-functional agile teams, ideally within financial services, wealth, investments or platform-based environments.
 Strong understanding of backlog management, agile execution, delivery governance, stakeholder translation, value-based prioritisation, risk and regulatory considerations, and sustainable technology delivery.
 Duties & Responsibilities
 Backlog Ownership and Delivery Readiness
 Own, manage and continuously refine the product backlog to ensure it reflects agreed strategic priorities, delivery sequencing, business and customer value, commercial and financial outcomes, risk, regulatory requirements, technical sustainability and squad capacity.
 Provide day-to-day execution leadership within the squad by ensuring that work is well defined, appropriately prioritised and delivered in a disciplined, value-led manner that solves meaningful customer and business problems.
 Translate initiatives into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, delivery increments and squad-ready requirements that connect the strategic intent to the customer, business, commercial, risk and technical outcomes expected.
 Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning and prioritisation discussions within the squad.
 Ensure delivery commitments are realistic, appropriately sequenced and achievable within available capacity.
 Delivery Progression and Value Enablement
 Drive the delivery of incremental outputs aligned to defined OKRs, strategic product priorities, measurable business outcomes, customer value and sustainable value realisation.
 Track delivery progress, surface execution insights and support visibility of value progression, including how delivery is contributing to commercial outcomes, financial benefits, risk reduction, regulatory compliance or technical sustainability.
 Identify and escalate blockers, risks, dependencies or constraints that may impact delivery timelines, customer and business outcomes, financial value, regulatory obligations or technical sustainability.
 Support the Strategic Product Owner with delivery insight, progress reporting and evidence required to assess value realisation.
 Overall accountability for strategic outcomes and value realisation remains with the Strategic Product Owner. The Product Owner enables value progression by ensuring that delivery is clear, controlled, execution-ready and visibly linked to sustainable business value.
 Stakeholder Translation and Delivery Alignment
 Translate business and stakeholder requirements into clear, structured and actionable backlog items that are anchored in strategic intent, customer and business problems, commercial value, financial outcomes and required controls.
 Create alignment between business expectations, delivery scope, squad capacity, technical feasibility, regulatory requirements and sustainable product or platform outcomes.
 Provide structured updates on delivery progress, decisions required, risks and dependencies.
 The Product Owner provides delivery translation and alignment. Enterprise-level stakeholder ownership and strategic trade-off decisions remain with the Strategic Product Owner.
 Cross-functional Delivery Integration
 Partner with Architects, Lead Business Analysts and delivery teams to ensure feasibility, design alignment, requirements quality, process clarity, architectural integrity and technical sustainability.
 Coordinate dependencies within the squad and across adjacent squads or delivery teams.
 Ensure delivery activity remains aligned to broader platform, portfolio and roadmap sequencing, with clear visibility of value, dependency, risk and sustainability considerations.

title: Senior Product Owner (SaaS / Healthcare)
description:
MEDFAR Clinical Solutions was founded in 2010 by two aeronautical engineers who realized that the healthcare system was not exploiting the full potential of technology. Supported by a large community of medical experts and focused on clinical success and patient safety, MEDFAR was the first company to certify a cloud-based Electronic Medical Record in Canada: MYLE (Make Your Life Easy).
 Committed to promoting excellence and effectiveness in healthcare worldwide, MEDFAR differentiates itself by offering a unique healthcare management solution for clinics, which replaces inefficient processes with a faster and safer technological alternative.
 Job Description
 At MEDFAR, we are shaping the future of digital healthcare. As a Senior Product Owner, you will play a key role in defining and executing our product vision, collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative solutions that improve patient care and streamline clinical workflows. You will lead strategic initiatives, mentor junior team members, and drive impactful decision-making at the leadership level.
 Responsibilities
 Own the solution strategy for your product domains, translating the vision and roadmap set by Product Management into how each domain delivers on them, informed by market analysis, competitive intelligence, and user research.
 Own the user experience of your product domains as a whole, not only what ships: end-to-end workflows, consistency across features, and known experience gaps. Product Designers support you on the UI and interactions; you remain accountable for the experience delivered.
 Lead user research initiatives, translating complex user needs into clear and actionable product requirements.
 Own and prioritize the product backlog in collaboration with the development team and Product Management, balancing technical, business, and user needs with data-driven decisions to align with strategic goals.
 Collaborate with engineering, design, and marketing teams to execute successful product releases, managing timelines, risks, and resource allocation.
 Mentor and coach junior and intermediate product owners, fostering professional growth and promoting best practices.
 Drive strategic R&D initiatives across multiple development teams and projects.
 Guide development teams by answering questions, defining priorities, identifying opportunities for incremental delivery, and removing roadblocks.
 Represent the product team in leadership-level discussions, influencing strategic decisions and providing progress updates.
 Facilitate collaboration across teams through proactive communication, conflict resolution, and stakeholder management.
 Working Conditions:
 Permanent full-time position (40 hours per week).
 Flexible hybrid or remote work arrangement.
 Occasional in-office presence may be required during the year.
 Candidates must reside in the province of Quebec.
 Qualifications
 Bachelor’s degree in engineering, design, product marketing, management, UX, product analytics, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
 8+ years of experience in product development, with a proven track record of launching and managing successful products.
 Deep expertise in Agile methodologies and software development lifecycles.
 Strategic thinker with strong analytical skills and critical thinking abilities.
 Deep understanding of the market and competitive landscape, enabling informed product decisions.
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills, capable of influencing stakeholders at all levels.
 Proficiency in design tools (e.g., Figma) and software management tools (e.g., Jira, Confluence).
 Experience in building large-scale product solutions with third-party system integrations.
 Ability to navigate complex stakeholder dynamics and align teams to drive impactful product outcomes.
 Experience working with electronic medical records (EMRs), clinical workflows, and patient engagement tools.
 Additional Information
 By joining MEDFAR, you will be part of a purpose-driven organization whose product is disrupting and digitizing health care, making doctors’ and healthcare workers’ lives easier, while enabling better patient health outcomes. Becoming a MEDFARian also means having the opportunity to be part of an innovative community and working in a dynamic environment where your work will have a meaningful and tangible effect not only on your team and the business but most importantly on the healthcare industry.

title: Senior Product Owner
description:
Role: Senior Product Owner 
 Location: Nottingham, UK (Hybrid) 
 Salary: £60k-£65k 
 Key Skills: 
 Decision Engine experience
 Middleware experience
 APIs experience
 The opportunity 
 Our client, a well-established UK financial services business, is looking for an experienced Product Owner to join its product function. Reporting into the Head of Product, you'll sit at the heart of the organisation, connecting the operational side of the business with an in-house engineering team so that every piece of software delivered solves a real problem for customers.
 What you'll be doing 
 Partnering with senior leadership across product, operations and technology to turn business strategy into a clear, achievable product plan
 Shaping and communicating the product vision and roadmap, and helping keep the technology platform modern and fit for the future
 Acting as the decision-maker on technology change, setting priorities and managing the backlog
 Gathering and refining requirements with stakeholders and writing well-defined user stories and backlog items
 Collaborating with engineers on test planning and delivery
 Strengthening day-to-day collaboration and trust between business and technical teams
 Leading and developing your team, encouraging an environment where people feel safe to experiment, test ideas and learn fast
 Helping the wider business shift its focus from discussion to action and delivery
 Taking part in, and facilitating where needed, all Scrum ceremonies
 How success will be measured 
 Delivered work addresses the intended problem and has measurable outcomes
 Results of change are tracked and shared with the wider team
 Stakeholders feel involved in, and ownership of, the solutions being built
 The business sees ongoing, improving value from its investment in product development
 What you'll bring 
 Proven experience as a Product Owner in an agile software environment, ideally within financial services
 Specific experience with decision-engine products.
 A solid grasp of the software development lifecycle and modern technology stacks
 Good working knowledge of APIs and middleware
 Strong analytical and documentation skills
 Familiarity with analytics and user-behaviour tools (such as Hotjar or Google Tag Manager) is a plus
 An understanding of good UX/UI practice and how to build it into requirements from the start
 A track record of seeing projects, preferably software, through to successful delivery

As part of a team at the heart of Barclays' data strategy, you will help deliver the foundational data infrastructure and governance capabilities that enable the organisation to treat data as a strategic asset.
Working across a complex and evolving landscape, you will drive products that empower better decision-making, support regulatory compliance, enhance operational efficiency, and unlock AI-driven innovation. This is an exciting opportunity to influence enterprise wide data capabilities and create meaningful impact across the business.
To be successful as a Product Owner , you should have experience with;
 Technology or Data Experience 
 Product Owner Experience 
 Agile ceremonies 
 Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include
 Exceptional communication skills, written and verbal 
 Microsoft Office/ Presentation Skills 
 Senior Stakeholder management skills 
 You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills
 This role will be based in Glasgow
 Purpose
 The purpose of a Product Owner is to maximize the value of the product by defining a clear product vision (are they setting the vision or would this align to ), managing authoring, refining and prioritizing the Product Backlog balancing trade-offs across desirability, viability and feasibility – making sure the right thing is being ‘built’, and prioritising work based on business goals. They act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring the product meets user/customer needs and delivers optimal value. Product Owners are responsible for developing a roadmap and driving execution of their product area/sub-journey, applying continuous improvement principles and techniques.
 Accountabilities
 Ensure Product Alignment with Business Goals: Ensure that the product & its features are aligned with broader objectives, driving value and contributing to the organization’s overall strategy. Utilisation of market research, analysis of customer feedback and monitoring of industry trends to identify new products, features or enhancements.  
 Communicate Product Vision to Delivery Teams: Clearly articulate the product vision and goals to the delivery teams, ensuring they understand, align and are inspired to deliver the business value and purpose of each feature or user story.
 Create and Refine User Stories: Write clear, concise user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, refining them as needed to ensure the development team has all the necessary information to implement features successfully. 
 Agile Events: Participate in key Agile events such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to keep the team aligned and focused on delivering the product backlog. 
 Managing the Product Backlog: Responsible for creating, maintaining, and prioritising the product backlog, ensuring the highest value features are delivered first, based on business needs, customer requirements and organisational impacts, balancing risk migration and future proofing against the product strategy. 
 Act as the Voice of the Customer: Continuously gather feedback from customers and end-users to understand their pain points and ensure that the product meets their needs and improves their overall experience. 
 Acceptance Criteria Definition & Management: Review and accept or reject work completed by the development team during sprints, ensuring that all delivered features meet the agreed-upon acceptance criteria and deliver business value. 
 Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with stakeholders (e.g., customers, business leaders, and marketing teams) to gather requirements, define product goals, and ensure that the product vision aligns with business objectives. 
 Monitor Product Performance and Iterate: Regularly assess product performance using KPIs and customer feedback, adjusting the product backlog and roadmap to improve functionality and meet evolving customer needs. Manage on-going readiness and 'run' activities of live products including monitoring, governance and approvals. 
 Risk and Control: Managing risk, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to resolve or mitigate and escalate as necessary those risks, and alignment between the product management and control functions.
 Assistant Vice President Expectations
 To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
 Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
 If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
 OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
