title: Product Owner
description:
Burford Capital is the leading global finance and asset management firm focused on law. Its businesses include litigation finance and risk management, asset recovery and a wide range of legal finance and advisory activities. Burford is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: BUR) and the London Stock Exchange (LSE: BUR), and it works with companies and law firms around the world from its principal offices in New York, London, Chicago, Washington, Singapore, and Dubai.
Burford Capital is the largest and most experienced provider of commercial finance to the legal sector in the world, with a core expertise in identifying and optimizing the value of legal assets for companies and law firms. Since its founding in 2009, Burford has worked with hundreds of law firms and corporations, including 94 of the AmLaw 100 and 92 of the Global 100 largest law firms. Our team has grown from five people at the end of 2009 to over 170 people today, including over 55 lawyers.
Burford possesses the resources and expertise of a large company while retaining the flexibility and creativity of a startup. Team members are smart, creative, collaborative, curious, and confident. Everyone rolls up their sleeves to perform and engage collectively for the overall success of the business. Burford values rigorous thinking, clear communication, and efficient execution. Burford is an “always on” environment in which everyone needs to be accessible by email when outside the office, including during evenings and weekends.
Burford pays base salaries consistent with the financial services industry and favors incentive compensation to reward performance. Burford Capital is committed to increasing diversity and maintaining an inclusive workplace culture. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates regardless of their ethnicity, race, gender, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, age, marital status, whether or not they have a disability.
 Responsibilities
 The Strategy and Quantitative Analytics team at Burford Capital is seeking an Product Owner to lead the ongoing development and operation of workstreams within Burford’s investment modelling platform. Acting as a link between the Strategy and Quantitative Analytics team, the Technology Team, and the platform’s users, the Product Owner will own the product requirements, the specifications, and the development plan. Working closely with developers and business analysts, the Product Owner will be responsible for delivering some of the most crucial pieces of Burford’s modelling infrastructure.
Responsibilities include:
 Owning the requirements and analytical direction for multiple workstreams for the development and refinement of Burford’s proprietary investment modelling platform. 
 Understanding technical modelling requirements, analysing proposed solutions, and troubleshooting potential edge cases or conflicts with existing modelling logic. 
 Act as a representative of the Strategy and Quantitative Analytics team to developers and business analysts, directing function requirements. 
 Engaging with users and stakeholders across the business to understand their needs and translate them into clear requirements. 
 Drafting functional and technical specifications for new features, platform improvements, and analytical tools, defining analytical logic, calculations and modelling methodology they must implement. 
 Managing test packets and validation materials to confirm that functionality performs as intended with calculations and outputs that are numerically correct. 
 Defining and overseeing user acceptance testing to confirm that delivered functionality meets requirements and performs as intended. 
 Coordinating with Project Management, Business Architecture, and Technology teams to support effective delivery of software changes. 
 Identifying opportunities to improve Burford’s models and the systems that run them and communicating recommendations to the wider Strategy and Quantitative Analytics team. 
 Professional Development
 The Product Owner will benefit from the following opportunities:
 Formal training introducing litigation finance, financial modelling, and analysis. 
 Hands-on exposure to quantitative investment processes, model development, and the software development lifecycle for analytical platforms. 
 Personalized mentorship from senior members of the Strategy and Quantitative Analytics team. 
 Opportunities to contribute meaningfully to platform development, model analysis, and high-impact projects supporting Burford’s investment decision-making processes. 
 Skills Desired
 Qualifications & Experience
 Candidates should have an outstanding academic record. 
 2-4 years of experience as a Product Owner, or in a comparable role responsible for delivering software products. 
 Candidates should have recently completed a bachelor’s or master’s degree in a STEM field. 
 Development experience with Python through projects or as a software developer is strongly preferable. 
 Experience working alongside development teams, ideally within an Agile delivery environment. 
 Core Competencies & Skills
 Candidates must be detail-oriented and have strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills. 
 Practical experience using AI tools to improve productivity and work quality, with a proactive mindset toward identifying new ways to use AI responsibly and effectively. 
 A collaborative working style that enables them to interact with team members at all levels of the company. 
 High energy, self-starter with an ability to comprehend and quickly learn new concepts. 
 Strong Excel skills are required. Candidates should be able to review, troubleshoot, and validate spreadsheet-based analysis. 
 Excellent written and verbal communication. 
 Global Candidate Privacy Notice:
https://www.burfordcapital.com/global-candidate-privacy-notice/

title: Senior Product Manager – AI Products
description:
Location: London or Manchester - Hybrid, 3 days per week (Mon, Tue & Wed)
 Type: Permanent
 The Opportunity 
 We're working with a growing technology and transformation business that is investing heavily in developing three new AI-powered products.
 This is a unique opportunity to become the founding Product hire, taking hands-on ownership of three AI-powered products, with the opportunity to build and lead the Product function as the business grows.
 Working directly with the Chief Product Officer, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the product strategy, establishing roadmaps and taking products from early-stage development through to launch and commercialisation.
 We're looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior Product Manager / Product Lead who genuinely enjoys being involved in the detail of product delivery.
 While there is an opportunity to build and lead a Product team over time, initially this is very much a hands-on delivery role, requiring someone comfortable rolling up their sleeves, writing requirements, managing backlogs, developing test scripts and personally driving products forward.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Own and develop product roadmaps across multiple AI-powered products.
 Translate business and customer requirements into detailed product briefs, user stories, acceptance criteria and test scripts.
 Manage product backlogs, prioritisation, sprint planning and day-to-day delivery alongside Engineering.
 Take products from early-stage concepts and pilots through to launch, onboarding and ongoing improvement.
 Work directly with customers to gather feedback, validate requirements and shape product development.
 Support product positioning, pricing and go-to-market activities.
 Establish Product processes and ways of working, with the opportunity to build and lead the function over time.
 What We're Looking For 
 Strong hands-on Product Management experience, ideally within B2B SaaS or software products.
 Proven experience personally owning product roadmaps, requirements, user stories, testing and delivery.
 Experience taking products from concept through to launch (0→1).
 Practical understanding of AI-powered products, ideally including LLMs, Generative AI or AI agents.
 Experience working closely with software engineering teams in an Agile environment.
 Comfortable managing multiple products, priorities and customer requirements simultaneously.
 Strong product discovery, prioritisation and problem-solving skills.
 Someone who enjoys being hands-on rather than operating purely at a strategic or leadership level.
 Why Join? 
 This is a rare opportunity to become the first Product hire within a business investing in its own AI-powered technology.
 You'll have genuine ownership from day one, working closely with senior leadership to bring three new products to market while helping establish the Product function from the ground up.
 As the products develop and the business scales, there will be the opportunity to build and lead a team around you, making this an excellent opportunity for an ambitious Senior Product Manager looking to take the next step in their career.
 Lancaster Resources Ltd is operating as an employment agency for this opportunity. Applications will be considered fairly and objectively, based on relevant skills, experience and suitability for the position. By submitting your application, you agree to the use of your personal data in line with our Privacy Policy and applicable data protection legislation. We are committed to equality of opportunity and do not discriminate on the grounds of age, gender, disability, race, religion or belief, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. Should you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please inform us.

title: Product Lead
description:
Toronto or Waterloo, hybrid | Full-time | Reports to the COO
 Lead the product that home care organizations and partners use to keep older adults safe, at a fast-growing senior care technology company in 24 countries.
 The Company
 We went from a lab in Waterloo to 24 countries in five years. Our sensors detect falls and track sleep, health and wellness, with no cameras, wearables or pendants. Families get peace of mind. Older adults keep their independence. Our CTO, Dr. Yihong Qi, holds 680 patents, and the next few hundred get built here.
 Why now
 We are nationally launched with major home care organizations across North America, and the product is becoming more complex as more of them rely on it every day. It needs someone to lead it. This is the time.
 The role
 You own the product for our care organizations and partners: the software they use to monitor residents and clients, the integrations their systems depend on, and the roadmap that decides what we build next. Our hardware is the moat and the vessel. Your product is the experience. You sit between customers, engineering and the sensor, and you turn what partners need into what ships. You work directly with the COO and our CTO, and partner with the Silvie consumer team, so the two products learn from each other.
 What You'll Own
 A product partners choose because it works, with adoption and retention that show it
 The roadmap: what we build, in what order, and why, backed by what customers say and what the data says
 Every release from idea to shipped, working with engineering so the software and the sensor move together
 Integrations and partner needs that turn one deployment into a hundred
 The voice of the partner inside the company, so sales, support and engineering are working on the same thing
 What Year One Looks Like
 Partners use the product daily and say so. The roadmap is clear and shipped on time. Our largest deployments are live and their users are happy. Engineering knows what to build next, because you told them.
 How We Work
 Build it right, then make it better. People's safety rides on what we ship, so we test hard and never settle for good enough.
 Say it as it is. Kind and direct, at every level, including the CEO.
 Real impact. There is more room to make a difference here than at a company ten times our size.
 Do what you said. Trust is built on follow-through, and we return it with real ownership.
 Hard, and worth it. What we build keeps someone's parent safe at home. Rest well, it's part of the job.
 This is for you if
 You'd rather own a problem than be assigned a task
 You want the mission to matter and the pace to be real
 You're happy to be the person who just fixes it
 This isn't for you if
 You want a playbook handed to you
 You need a big team before you can move
 You'll thrive here if
 You have shipped B2B software or connected-device products end to end as a PM. Hardware-adjacent experience is a plus
 You make decisions from customer conversations and data, not from opinion
 You are as comfortable in a partner meeting as in a sprint review
 You have shipped in a lean team where you had to do a bit of everything
 You don't need to check every box. If this sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you.
 Where this goes
 As we double, this role can grow into leading Product for the whole care business.
 What You Get
 A sensor for your parents, on us
 Direct access to the leadership team. No layers.
 Fair pay, with the opportunity for equity
 Impact decides your pay and your path, not tenure
 Hybrid in Toronto or Waterloo, remote if that's where you do your best work
 Health, dental and vision benefits
 The details
 Pay: $140,000 to $190,000 CAD base salary
 This is a new role, created to grow the team, not a backfill
 How we hire: typically an initial interview, a short case, and a final interview in person with our CEO and members of the team. We may adjust this depending on the role
 We leverage AI tools in our hiring process, but prioritize human input and manual review
 Our Commitment
 At Pontosense, we are committed to creating a workplace that is inclusive and accessible to all. We value diversity and believe that everyone deserves an equal opportunity to succeed.
If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during the hiring process, please let us know. We will work with you to make the necessary accommodations to ensure a fair and positive experience for all applicants.
We strive to provide accessible communication and technology for our employees and customers and always look for ways to improve. If you have any feedback or suggestions on how we can improve accessibility in our workplace, please don't hesitate to contact us.
We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome candidates from all backgrounds to apply for open positions at our company.

title: PO(Product Owner)
description:
아직 세상에 없는 제품을, 문제 발견부터 수익화까지 0에서 1로 만들어 낼 PO를 찾습니다. 
 패스트뷰는 하루 1,500만 자의 콘텐츠를 AI로 번역·제작·유통하는 콘텐츠 테크 기업입니다. 연평균 270% 성장과 영업이익 흑자 전환을 만들었고, Microsoft(MSN), SmartNews 등 글로벌 플랫폼에 콘텐츠를 공급하며 최근 미국, 일본 법인 설립으로 글로벌 확장을 본격화하고 있습니다.
 지금 우리는 검증된 유통 사업 위에서 여러 개의 새로운 제품을 동시에 0→1로 띄우는 국면에 있습니다. 이 PO는 그 최전선에서, 기회를 빠르게 발굴하고 작게 검증해 측정 가능한 임팩트로 증명하는 역할입니다.
 [우리가 중요하게 생각하는 것은 세 가지입니다] 
 Impact — 왜 그 문제를 선택했고, 실제로 어떤 성과를 만들었는가
 Speed — 핵심 가설을 얼마나 작게, 빠르게 검증했는가
 Transparency — 가정·판단 근거·실패까지 투명하게 공유하는가
 어떤 프레임워크를 썼는지보다 어떤 문제를 발견했고, 왜 그렇게 판단했으며, 무엇을 만들어 어떤 결과를 냈는지를 봅니다.
 [패스트뷰가 만들고 있는 제품] 
 ShortUs (쇼더스) — 쇼츠 생산과 수익화를 자동화하는 솔루션. 현재 수요 검증 단계이며, 이 PO가 직접 리딩하게 될 핵심 신사업입니다.
 GuardUs (가더스) — SEO·GEO·AI 라이선싱을 아우르는 플랫폼. CP 콘텐츠를 AI 시대에 맞게 노출·보호·수익화하고, LLM 기업으로부터 콘텐츠 사용 수익을 회수합니다.
 ViewUs (뷰어스) — 각국 CP(콘텐츠 제공사)의 콘텐츠를 AI 번역으로 다국어화해 MSN·SmartNews 등 글로벌 플랫폼에 실시간 유통·수익화하는 콘텐츠 신디케이션 플랫폼입니다.
 그리고 계속 발굴 중인 새로운 기회들 — CP사·플랫폼사의 페인 포인트에서 다음 사업이 계속 나오고 있습니다. 이 PO는 그 기회를 가장 먼저 잡는 사람입니다.
 [이런 방식으로 일합니다] 
 만들기 전에 팝니다 (Pretotyping) — 구현 전에 수요부터 확인합니다. 가장 가벼운 방법으로 고객(CP사·플랫폼사)의 반응을 먼저 보고, 수요가 확인된 것부터 빠르게 만듭니다.
 작게 만들고 빠르게 검증합니다 — 가장 중요한 가설 하나를 검증할 최소한의 제품·딜을 만들고, 실제 파트너와 데이터에서 답을 찾습니다.
 검증된 것만 제대로 확장합니다 — 빠르게 만든 초기 실행과 장기 운영 시스템을 구분합니다. 가능성이 확인되면 안정성·비용·확장성을 갖춰 설계합니다.
 [합류하면 함께할 일] 
 정해진 로드맵을 관리하는 자리가 아니라, 여러 신사업을 오너십으로 굴리며 0에서 1을 만드는 자리입니다. 아래 업무들 중에서 상황과 우선순위에 따라 넘나들게 됩니다.
 1. 신사업 및 서비스 발굴 및 실행 (0→1) 
 CP사·플랫폼사의 페인포인트에서 새로운 제품·수익화 기회를 발굴하고 정의합니다.
 수요 검증(Pretotyping)부터 첫 제품·첫 딜, 운영 시스템 설계까지 전 과정을 리딩합니다.
 ShortUs(쇼츠 수익화 자동화)를 직접 리딩하며 사업화합니다.
 2. CP 파트너십 & 제품 탑재 
 국내외 CP사(뉴스·동영상 매체, 통신사, 전문 미디어)를 발굴·컨택하고, 온보딩·계약까지 리딩합니다.
 GuardUs(SEO·GEO·AI 라이선싱)의 가치를 데이터·사례로 증명해 CP에 제품 탑재를 설득하고, 수익 배분·라이선싱 조건을 협의합니다.
 3. 데이터 기반 우선순위 & 임팩트 측정 
 CP·카테고리·플랫폼별 수익성을 분석해 어디에 집중할지 우선순위를 세웁니다.
 매출·이익, 전환율, 발행 빈도, rPM 등 핵심 지표를 정의·측정하고 개선합니다.
 4. 제품·운영 개선과 조직 협업 
 감수·번역, CP어드민, 이코노믹스(매출·정산·이익률) 등 내부 제품·운영의 병목을 진단하고 개발팀과 함께 개선합니다.
 개발·운영·사업 등 여러 조직을 연결해 아이디어를 실제 제품·서비스로 출시합니다.
 [이런 분을 찾습니다] 
 사용자·파트너가 실제로 쓰는 제품 또는 사업을 0에서 1로 직접 만들어 출시·운영하고, 그 변화를 숫자로 증명해 본 분
 애매하게 정의된 문제를 스스로 구조화하고, 가설을 작고 빠르게 검증해 본 분
 외부 파트너(CP사·플랫폼사)를 직접 상대하며 니즈를 제품·딜로 연결해 본 분
 판단 근거와 진행 상황을 — 실패까지 — 투명하게 공유하고, 피드백을 빠르게 반영하는 분
 [이런 경험이 있다면 더 좋습니다] 
 신사업/신규 서비스를 0→1로 런칭하거나 글로벌 진출을 리딩한 경험
 콘텐츠·미디어·광고·커머스 등 플랫폼 비즈니스 도메인 경험
 B2B 파트너십, 콘텐츠 라이선싱, 애그리게이션 모델에 대한 이해
 쇼츠·숏폼 등 영상 콘텐츠 제작·유통·수익화 경험
 일본어 또는 영어 커뮤니케이션 역량 (사내 통역 지원 가능, 필수 아님)

title: Product Owner (AI Enabled)
description:
Product Manager (AI Enabled)
 B One Consulting | Bali, Indonesia | On-site
 About B One Consulting
 We design and build web, mobile, and AI solutions for demanding clients. Our development team is based in Bali, Indonesia, where we ship production-grade products on modern, ambitious stacks.
 The Role
 You'll own the product vision and delivery across our client projects, bridging clients, designers, and engineers. You set the direction and the quality bar, write the brief, challenge the output, and make the call when design, business, and technical constraints pull in different directions. You own whether what ships is right.
 What You'll Do
 •   Own and maintain product backlogs across multiple client projects, from discovery to delivery
 •   Translate client and business requirements into clear user stories, acceptance criteria, and specs
 •   Write clear design briefs: problem, users, constraints, success criteria, scope
 •   Review and challenge design work, from user flows and wireframes to high-fidelity prototypes, and give specific, actionable feedback
 •   Use AI tools to accelerate discovery, specs, and rough concept sketching so intent is clear before design starts
 •   Prioritize ruthlessly, balancing client expectations, technical constraints, and timelines
 •   Run agile ceremonies (sprint planning, refinement, reviews) and keep delivery on track
 •   Act as the main bridge between clients, designers, and engineering teams
 •   Define and track product and usability metrics to validate that what we ship delivers value
 What We're Looking For
 •   5+ years of experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager, ideally in an agency or multi-project environment
 •   Proven track record shipping web and mobile products end-to-end (not just managing backlogs)
 •   Strong design judgment: you can critique a flow or a screen, explain why it works or doesn't, and push back on a designer
 •   Experience using AI tools to augment product and workflows
 •   Strong grasp of agile methodologies and hands-on fluency with Project management tools
 •   Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
 •   Able to delegate: you hand off work with enough context to be done well, then follow up on outcomes rather than activity
 •   Comfortable saying "no", to clients and internally, and explaining the trade-off behind it
 •   Gives direct feedback without making it personal, and takes it the same way
 •   Stays composed across parallel projects and shifting priorities

 About the Role: 
 At Moving Tech, Product Managers own the product journey end-to-end, balancing product development, operations, and customer engagement. This is an opportunity to be a true creator, not just a coordinator.
 Can PMs become TRUE creators? 
 Can they CODE?
 Can they Design?
 Can they analyze data programmatically?
 Can they deeply empathize with the users they’re building for?
 Yes, they can! At Moving Tech, PMs are empowered to upskill themselves and collaborate across teams, including Development, Design, Growth, Communications, Support, and Operations. PMs here don’t just write product specs—they actively participate in the creation process, ensuring specifications are practical and deliverable.
 The PM in the Age of AI 
 We believe AI is the next S-curve, a phase transition on the scale of the microprocessor or the internet that will reprice everything. The cost of building software is collapsing, and the bar for real value is rising fast: the PMs who lead will be the ones who use AI to go faster, deeper, and broader.
 It is a new way of working. What used to be 10x PM work will become the baseline. Tool users must become tool builders. Spec writers, code writers. Specialists, generalists who move fluently across design, engineering, and growth. The PMs who thrive will be the ones who pair theory with hands-on building.
 What does not change is what we believe about building software: that it must create real value, exhibit supreme craft, and be reasoned from first principles. AI is a lever for these beliefs, and a means to deepen our understanding of the problems we solve and the solutions we build.

title: Product Manager
description:
About Decagon
 Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.
Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.
We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.

 Over the past few years, development of LLMs has evolved at a rapid pace. Building truly successful AI products isn’t just about model quality — it’s about the infrastructure, tooling, and workflows that allow customers to configure, monitor, and improve their agents at scale.
The Product Management team owns Decagon’s platform and foundational features: agent building, testing, experimentation, analytics, QA, versioning, integrations, and enterprise controls. We work across every customer segment, partnering closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market to ensure our platform is robust, scalable, and easy to use.
As one of our founding PMs, you’ll help define the product foundation that every Decagon customer uses to build and run their AI agents. You’ll own initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and scoping to launch and adoption, shaping the product experience for some of the world’s most influential businesses.
 About The Role
 On the Product team, you’ll own the roadmap for a major product area and partner with customers and internal teams to deliver features that make Decagon’s platform powerful, flexible, and enterprise-ready. Your work might include:
 Designing AI-powered features that turn raw conversation data into instant, actionable insights for customers.
 Building intelligent systems that give enterprises precise control over how their agents learn, adapt, and deploy in production.
 Creating self-serve configuration experiences that feel effortless — powered by real-time AI guidance and automation.

 You’ll partner closely with engineering, design, sales, agent product managers and our leadership team to ensure the core platform meets the needs of both our largest enterprises and fastest-growing startups.
 In this role, you will

 Proven track record of shipping impactful features in fast-paced environments.

title: Product Manager, New Markets and Monetization
description:
About Anthropic
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About The Role
 Anthropic's New Markets and Monetization team exists to bring transformational AI to every business. Model capabilities are compounding, and the Claude Platform is how businesses build with our models. Our job within the Claude Platform is to make sure that every industry, not just software, can build on frontier AI with our APIs and that everyone who builds on Claude prospers by it.
The work falls into two pillars that reinforce each other.
 Verticals: identifying and building for the next API markets. 
 Monetization: the commercial machinery that lets the platform do business anywhere, with anyone: a single way for usage that flows through partners, resellers, and other platforms.
 We're hiring the founding product managers onto this team, and this posting covers all of them. You will own one of the areas below outright, work day to day with a dedicated engineering lead and designer, and be measured on numbers that are company-level goals for the half. Almost none of this exists yet, so most weeks you will be the person defining the problem rather than receiving it.
 Key Responsibilities
 Partner and platform billing. How usage that reaches Claude through a partner, reseller, or another platform is metered, attributed, and billed, and the program terms that go with it, so indirect volume can grow without our risk growing with it.
 Spend observability and controls. Giving enterprise buyers a precise view of what they spend and where, and turning that into limits and controls they can enforce, including programmatically.
 One account, and the startup path built on it. One login and one wallet across the API and Claude's subscriptions, so a builder's first commit, first production call, and first invoice are on a single plan.
 A vertical. The platform strategy for a particular industry: what builders there need that the platform doesn't yet do, which bets to make, and shipping them with the vertical's own product and go-to-market partners.
 Whatever Your Focus, You Will
 Build on primitives owned by the Billing Platform and Auth & Identity teams, and ship with Growth, Go-to-Market and Startups, Legal, Finance, and Data Science
 Structure the commercial terms yourself, whether that's pricing, revenue attribution, or partner and startup program terms, with Finance, Legal, and Business Development
 Talk to every side of the ecosystem, from enterprise buyers and startup builders to the partners that resell or embed Claude and the industry customers we're building for, and turn it into a roadmap where each new participant makes the platform more valuable to the rest
 Own the team's outcome metrics: the share of the platform's business outside coding, new startup revenue, volume unified across the API and Claude's subscriptions, and the volume partners book on Claude, and make sure the instrumentation exists to know whether what you shipped moved them
 Write the strategy, the specs, and the analysis yourself
 Minimum Qualifications
 Have owned a developer platform, API, billing or money-movement product, or self-serve growth product end to end, and were the person accountable for its revenue or activation number (for most people this means five or more years as a PM, but we care about the ownership, not the years)
 Have built with or shipped on top of large language models, and have a view on what changes about billing, identity, or distribution when the customer is sometimes an agent
 Are technically fluent: you read API docs, work through a billing, identity, or attribution design with engineers, and make calls on platform primitives yourself
 Pull your own data: SQL or equivalent, to define a metric, build a funnel, or size a market
 Have negotiated pricing, revenue share, or program terms with Finance, Legal, or Business Development counterparts
 Write clearly enough that an engineer, an executive, and an external partner can each see the tradeoff you're making
 Care about Anthropic's mission, and specifically about growing this platform in a way where the people building on it share in the upside

 8+ years of product management experience
 Worked on metering, usage attribution, reseller or cloud-marketplace channels, or enterprise spend management
 Taken a developer platform into a new industry, or built product in healthcare, life sciences, financial services, or another regulated industry
 Grown a developer product's self-serve or startup business, including its pricing and packaging
 Built account, identity, or subscription systems that span more than one product
 Taken a product from zero to one, where the users, the product, and the economics all had to be worked out at once

description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn , X , Instagram , and YouTube .
 Job Description:
 The Special Projects team at Shield AI is an elite force within the office of the CTO. It consists of a group of very senior (L5-L8) and highly experienced software engineering experts from diverse fields (aerospace, robotics, cloud infrastructure, game development, interactive media design, ...). The charter of this group is to steer technology development towards strategic alignment with the CTO's vision, through tactical insertion into teams and technologies across the organization. Individuals within this team make direct and at times forward-sprinting contributions to all three pillars of Hivemind, Shield AI's software ecosystem for developing and deploying resilient intelligent teaming for aircrafts. Hivemind consists of four products: EdgeOS (C++ based high-performance middleware for autonomy development), Pilot (autonomy for the edge built atop EdgeOS; a models-based, modular and open architecture C++ codebase), Forge (Shield AI's AI Factory for the design, development, and testing of Hivemind Edge systems; a service-oriented architecture leveraged through an SDK, CLI, and web portal; a Go, Python, Typescript codebase), Commander (Software and hardware to support rich human-in-the-loop and human-on-the-loop interactions with the Hivemind; a C++-based back-end for interaction with Pilot; and a web-application UI for mission planning, command and control by operators implemented in a Typescript/React codebase).
The Special Projects team is chartered to operate effectively within ambiguity. While this team does not own any software products, it tactically and strategically impacts the development of all foundational Hivemind products and leverages those technologies to rapidly deliver low-TRL solutions. This work happens shoulder-to-shoulder with the product teams in some cases, and in a forward-sprinting manner within the Special Projects team in other cases. The result is direct contribution to products in the former case, and development of reference implementations in the latter. The Special Projects team also functions as a pipeline for product and solution engineering teams across the organization. Individuals who enter the Special Projects team rapidly gain depth and breadth in their understanding of the Hivemind software ecosystem. This positions them well for leading technology development effort across the product and solution organization.
 What you'll do:
 Own product definition, roadmap, and metrics across the office of the CTO's agentic AI portfolio: an enterprise knowledge assistant (Brain), an agent-driven engineering platform (Springboard), and enterprise AI/data modernization and app development.
 Translate CTO strategy into crisp requirements, milestones, exit criteria, and KPIs — then hold the line on them.
 Drive adoption of internal platforms: reduce onboarding friction, instrument usage, track NPS and active users, and run developer advocacy and objection handling.
 Shape product direction for foundation-model based autonomy architectures and model lifecycle tooling (evaluation, fine-tuning, verification, deployment).
 Run continuous discovery with engineers, operators, and executive stakeholders; turn findings into prioritized backlogs.
 Prioritize ruthlessly across competing initiatives with small teams and aggressive timelines.
 Analyze the agentic tooling, enterprise AI platform, and foundation model ecosystem; recommend build/buy/partner positions to leadership.
 Author strategy documents, product briefs, and executive updates that drive decisions.
 Manage transitions of maturing products from incubation to owning organizations.
 Required qualifications:
 8+ years of product management for deeply technical products; engineering or CS background.
 Technical fluency: you read code, work APIs and CLIs from a terminal, and prototype with AI coding tools yourself.
 Shipped developer tools, internal platforms, or AI/ML products — and drove their adoption.
 Working fluency in LLM-based systems: agents, evaluation, context management, fine-tuning trade-offs.
 Metrics-driven operating style: you define KPIs, instrument products, and report against thresholds and objectives.
 Exceptional written communication — requirements, strategy docs, executive briefs.
 Proven stakeholder management up to the executive level across engineering, product, and business functions.
 Fluid intelligence that allows one to operate effectively in ambiguous conditions while finding opportunities to drive technical efforts and force multiply.
 This role requires travel to a Shield AI location 1-3 times per quarter
 Preferred qualifications:
 Prior experience as a software engineer.
 Experience in defense, aerospace, or other regulated environments (CUI/ITAR, restricted or disconnected deployments).
 Experience with enterprise data platforms (e.g. Databricks) and ERP/business-system integration.
 Experience with safety-critical or assurance-driven software processes (requirements traceability, V&V, certification artifacts).
 Experience taking zero-to-one internal products through incubation, adoption, and handoff.

 Own product strategy for a major area of the business.  Define and champion a multi-quarter, unified product vision and roadmap that supports all of our artists: early-stage artists, artists gaining traction, and independent labels and ensure they have the tools they need to release music, grow an audience, and earn money.  Set the quality bar. Uphold and elevate a high bar of quality across the team, ensuring that everything we launch will delight artists, be easy to use, and attract and retain independent artists and labels.

title: AI Product Manager
description:
What We Do
Yesterday's insurance wasn't built for today's risk. We see it in the data and we feel it in the field. Emerging technology can reinvent how risk is priced and managed, faster and smarter, anchored in proven expertise. First-movers will define the next era of commercial risk management, and Shepherd is building it.
Shepherd is a technology-driven Managing General Underwriter (MGU) transforming commercial Property & Casualty insurance for high-hazard industries. Our mission is to make risk frictionless for the builders and operators shaping the physical world, protecting progress from concept through construction and into decades of operation.
We're building the fastest, smartest commercial risk platform, where underwriting expertise, data, and automation work together to deliver:
 Faster decisions
 Smarter, more accurate pricing
 Better risk outcomes
 With Shepherd, safety, speed, and quality no longer trade off against one another. They compound. We're not just modernizing insurance products. We're building the risk infrastructure for the next generation of financial services, where technology, underwriting, and partnerships operate in harmony to support the world's most important industries and the progress they make possible.
 Our Investors
 In March 2026, Shepherd raised a $42M Series B — bringing total funding to over $60M — led by Intact Private Capital, the investment arm of one of the largest insurers in the world. Intact is not only our lead investor but also a carrier partner, a testament to the confidence the incumbent industry has in what we're building. Our investors:
 Intact Private Capital, led our Series B round
 Costanoa Ventures, led our Series A round
 Spark Capital, led our Seed round
 Susa Ventures, lead our Pre-Seed round
 Y Combinator
 And several others
 Our Team
We're a team of technologists and insurance enthusiasts, bridging the two worlds together. Check out our About page to learn more.
You'll be supporting the Nova Team
Nova is the team building fully autonomous underwriting. A broker wants coverage for a construction project and emails us a pile of documents: an application, years of claims history, a spreadsheet of what's being built and what it costs, payroll records, prior policies, and a note with the real context buried in the third paragraph. No two brokers send the same thing. An underwriter reads all of it, pulls out a few hundred facts, judges how risky the project is, and prices it. Nova does that work end to end, with agents that read the documents, extract and reconcile the facts, chase down what's missing, and hand back a priced account.
We structure the roadmap as an autonomy ladder borrowed from self-driving. L1 is a human doing the job with assistance. L5 is an email arriving and a priced policy coming out with nobody in between. We're in the middle, and progress means expanding the set of accounts the system handles unsupervised.
The business case is straightforward: our long term vision has a single underwriter overseeing roughly 10x the accounts they handle today, with the system doing intake, analysis, and pricing while the person sets strategy and works exceptions. Getting there is largely a measurement challenge. An account only counts as autonomous if everything on it is right, which makes this a compounding problem rather than an average one, and much of the roadmap comes down to how we define and measure that.
 About The Role
 We're looking for an exceptional, entrepreneurial technical product manager to own the roadmap, execution, discovery, and vision for Nova, and to help define what autonomous underwriting looks like for the whole industry.
This is Nova's first product hire. The team is small, extremely high caliber, and growing. The engineers here have taken autonomous underwriting from an idea to real prices on real accounts, making the product calls themselves along the way. You'd be joining people who know this problem cold and who will expect you to get there fast.
This role sits alongside leadership and at the intersection of three domain expertises: engineers who think in eval runs and retrieval quality, underwriters with decades of pricing judgment, and leadership setting the direction of the business. One day you're aligning with our CTO on the autonomy roadmap and pressure-testing the thesis with the leadership team; the next you're pairing with an engineer on a new extraction flow and putting a working version in front of an underwriter before the day ends. Each group holds part of the answer, the best ideas come out of the overlap, and you'll be the person who creates it. If you want to build a category-defining product with real executive air cover and no ceiling on your impact, this is the seat.
The person who does well here is closer to a founder than to a traditional PM. This is an environment for people who need intellectual challenge, thrive in progress, and are motivated by the impact of their work.
What you'll do
 Own the product end to end. Vision, discovery, prioritization, execution, and the UX and design decisions along the way. Prioritize ruthlessly, be as clear about what we're not building as what we are, and shape how we staff design and engineering against the roadmap. You're accountable for results rather than shipped features: adoption by our underwriters, how much of the work runs without a person, how accurate it is, and whether we can win a deal on a fully autonomous motion. 
 Understand the user deeply. Sit with underwriters, read submissions yourself, and build the instinct for why one contractor's paperwork is far harder to handle than another's. Find the places where the system can make their work faster, more reliable, and more complete, and turn that into requirements and edge case coverage. 
 Own the definition of correct. Our eval framework is effectively the product spec. You'll shape what gets measured, where materiality thresholds sit, which regressions block a release, and

title: Product Manager
description:
About Us
 Rho is the modern banking platform built for the AI era. Startups and growth-stage companies can open accounts in minutes, issue cards, manage expenses, pay bills, and close the books – all in one connected platform backed by real human support.
The Role
Rho is hiring Product Managers, but what we truly seek are GMs/Product CEOs. You'll own a meaningful surface of the platform end-to-end — close enough to the work and close enough to the customer that your judgment is earned, not inherited from a roadmap. You'll know what founders need before they ask, because you've built the intuition that comes from proximity, not process.
How products get built is fundamentally changing. AI is collapsing the line between thinking about something and making it real. The best PMs right now aren't just writing specs — they're prototyping with frontier models, testing ideas the same afternoon they have them, and building product that couldn't have existed a year ago. If that's already how you work, keep reading.
Rho is rebuilding the finance stack for the innovation economy. What happens next depends on the quality of our decisions and the speed at which we make them. The PMs we hire are how we get there.
What You'll Do
 Operate like a founder. Your surface is your company: its metrics are your P&L, its problems are yours whether or not they're in your job description. Nobody assigns founders their work. Default to motion — ship the scrappy version, learn, ship again, and unblock yourself instead of waiting. The surfaces you touch move faster because you're on them.
 And build for them. Develop a deep, almost unfair understanding of how early-stage companies think about money, time, and risk. Design for the workflow they don't know they want yet — the desire path, not the paved one.
 Own a problem space, not a problem. Not a feature, not a ticket queue — a living territory of customer problems that shift and collide. Frame the ones that matter, sharpen the hypothesis, define success before you build, and see it through to landing in a founder's hands. The map will change under you; redraw it and keep moving.
 Decide what matters most — and re-decide when the facts change. Make deliberate calls about what to do now, next, and never. Hold them loosely: when the evidence says pivot, you pivot without ego. A PM who can't say no is just a project manager with better slides.
 Work at the frontier. AI is your leverage in both directions: it 10x's how you work — more ideas tested, more prototypes built, more customer insight absorbed, more shipped — and it expands what you can build, product experiences that weren't possible twelve months ago. You're expected to find both. When a new capability drops, you're the one asking what it unlocks for our customers.
 Get in the weeds. You're prototyping, pressure-testing, and iterating alongside design and engineering — with opinions about the details. Bring people along while you're there: partner deeply across Engineering, Design, Operations, GTM, and leadership, and communicate the why so well the team could make your calls without you in the room.
Who You Are
 You have 3+ years building products — as a founder, PM, or engineer or equivalent experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment — and you've shipped work you're proud to put your name on.
 You have frontier fluency. You work with AI daily — prototyping, analyzing, drafting, automating — and you can point to something you shipped or changed because a new capability made it possible. Not theorizing; doing.
 You have taste. You hold your own view of what good looks like, obsess over the details, and know that in a banking product, every interaction carries trust.
 You have discovery rigor. You can articulate the problem, the hypothesis, and how you'll know it worked before you've written a spec.
 You build. You're not above opening a prototype, sketching a flow, or pulling the data yourself.
 You think like a founder. You've been one, worked next to one, or operated like one — you take ownership past the edges of your role, and you pull things over the line that would die in someone else's backlog.
 You're at home in ambiguity. You make calls on incomplete information and treat a pivot as new information, not a setback. Plans change; you're the steady one when they do.
 You bring people with you. You build trust quickly, communicate proactively, and can align a room even when the answer is no.
 You crave a team that pushes you — smart, ambitious people who make the work fun and help you grow faster than you thought possible.
 Our people are our most valuable asset. Our target compensation range for this role is $165,000 - $320,000 . Compensation will be determined by leveling and performance throughout the interview process. In addition to base pay, Rho offers equity, comprehensive healthcare benefits, and paid time off.

1. Job responsibilities  
 The role helps the CEO and leadership team convert priorities into decision-ready cadence, cross-functional alignment and disciplined follow-through. It leads a small specialist office.
 2. Job descriptions 
 A – Executive governance and decision support: 
 Main tain priority slate; clarify next decision/action; challenge ownerless or stale items

 Prepare concise agenda, evidence and decisions sought; coordinate channel
 Challenge and edit decision memo for clarity; return incomplete evidence; prepare pre-read
 Prepare fact pattern, trade-offs and recommended route; convene only required owners

 Maintain charter register and integrated calendar; specify pack owner and decision branch
 Operate agenda, timebox decisions, route unresolved items, capture one-A outcomes (outcomes with one clearly accountable owner)
 Operate strategy/governance process; coordinate analysis and pack; do not combine accountables
 Maintain decision/action logs, reminders, aging and closure evidence
 Audit adoption, identify overlap/meeting-factory risk, propose prune/merge/control changes

 Refresh portfolio priorities and scenarios; prepare hold/resequence/stop recommendations.

 Launch process, brief owners, control assumptions and submission standards
 Synthesize strategy narrative and options; coordinate pack; protect author/owner boundaries

 Support command cadence, decision readiness, logs and cross-functional coordination

 Assess workload/capacity, trigger evidence and stop/defer/borrow/buy options.

 Executive meeting governance and management cadence.

 Team leadership, coaching, and resource coordination.

title: Chief of Staff
description:
Responsibilities
 We are looking for a highly execution-oriented Chief of Staff who will work directly with the CEO to ensure the company’s most important priorities are actually executed.
This is not a strategy-only or presentation-heavy role. Your main responsibility is to create execution discipline across teams. You will monitor company KPIs, challenge owners when progress is off-track, identify blockers, and help formulate practical solutions.
You will act as the bridge between CEO priorities and day-to-day execution. The goal is simple: important initiatives should not stall, KPI owners should remain accountable, and the CEO should have a clear view of what is working, what is failing, and what decisions need attention.
 Key Responsibilities
 Own the weekly KPI and execution cadence across the company.
 Ensure every major KPI has a clear owner, target, deadline, and next action.
 Follow up directly with KPI owners and push for progress when targets are off-track.
 Identify root causes behind missed KPIs and help teams develop practical solutions.
 Track cross-functional initiatives and unblock dependencies between teams.
 Prepare a concise weekly CEO report covering performance, blockers, risks, and decisions required.
 Turn CEO priorities into clear execution plans and ensure teams follow through.
 Challenge weak assumptions, unclear ownership, and repeated excuses.
 Build better operating systems, reporting processes, and eventually AI-assisted KPI monitoring to reduce manual follow-up.
 What Success Looks Like
 Within 3-6 months, the CEO should no longer need to personally chase every KPI owner. Every major company priority should have clear ownership, measurable progress, and fast escalation when something is blocked. The CEO should receive a short, decision-focused weekly view of the company and spend more time on product, strategy, major partnerships, and new growth opportunities.
 Requirements
 3-7 years of experience in a fast-paced startup, consulting, operations, business, product, or similar role.
 Extremely strong follow-through. You do not stop at identifying a problem. You make sure someone solves it.
 Strong analytical ability and comfortable working with metrics, dashboards, and business performance data.
 Able to identify the real problem behind missed targets and propose practical solutions.
 Comfortable challenging senior team members and holding people accountable.
 Strong written and verbal communication. Able to summarize complex situations clearly and concisely.
 Highly organized and able to manage multiple company-level priorities simultaneously.
 Comfortable working directly with the CEO and operating with limited supervision.
 High ownership mentality. You proactively find gaps instead of waiting for instructions.
 Strong judgment on what requires CEO attention and what should be solved independently.
 Strong Plus
 Experience in SaaS, HR tech, recruitment, fintech, or B2B technology.
 Experience managing company-wide OKRs or KPIs.
 Experience working closely with founders or C-level executives.
 Experience using AI and automation to improve internal operating processes.
 Experience managing cross-functional projects involving product, sales, customer success, and operations.

 Qualifications

 Experience leading cross-functional work with limited day-to-day supervision and influence senior stakeholders without formal authority.

 Experience designing scalable products, processes, tools or operating models that balance customer outcomes, business value, cost, reliability and risk.
 Nice to haves
 Experience in payments, fintech, banking or another regulated financial-services environment.
 Experience in an analytical, Product Management, Product Operations or operational-strategy role.

 (Note: We will not be able to sponsor visas for the role)

title: Product Operations Executive (Mandarin Speaking)
description:
Product Operations Specialist (Mandarin Speaking) 
 📍 Location: Cairo, Egypt
 💼 Employment Type: Full-time
 🗣️ Language Requirement: Mandarin Chinese
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a Mandarin-speaking Product Operations Specialist to join our team in Egypt and serve as a key bridge between our local Egypt team and China-based teams.
 In this role, you will work closely with frontline teams to understand real challenges related to product usage, operational processes, user feedback, and cross-team collaboration. You will turn scattered feedback into clear, structured, and actionable insights, while working with relevant teams in China to drive follow-up and continuous improvement.
 This is not simply a coordination or message-passing role. We are looking for someone who can identify problems, understand the root cause, organize information clearly, and actively drive issues toward resolution.
 Key Responsibilities 
 Work closely with local teams in Egypt to identify issues related to product usage, user experience, operational processes, and team collaboration.
 Communicate regularly with Sales, Customer Service, Operations, and other relevant teams to understand the context, impact, and urgency of reported issues.
 Organize and prioritize feedback into clear and actionable problem statements, including background, impact, examples, and possible improvement directions.
 Communicate with China-based teams in Mandarin Chinese to accurately represent local business needs and operational challenges. 
 Follow up on key issues, track progress, and ensure updates and solutions are communicated back to the local team.
 Document recurring issues, best practices, solutions, and improvement opportunities to improve operational efficiency.
 Support the development of more effective feedback, tracking, and issue-closure mechanisms between Egypt and China teams.
 What We’re Looking For 
 Good Mandarin Chinese proficiency in speaking, listening, reading, and writing, with the ability to communicate professionally in a business environment. 
 Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across different functions and cultures. 
 Strong logical thinking and information-structuring skills; able to turn complex or fragmented feedback into clear, actionable information.
 Fast learner with the ability and willingness to quickly understand new products, business processes, and operational workflows.
 Strong problem-solving mindset , you are not satisfied with simply reporting an issue; you want to understand why it happens and how it can be improved.
 Nice to Have 
 Experience in Product Operations, User Operations, Customer Service Operations, Product Support, Project Coordination, or Issue Management.
 Experience working with multinational or cross-cultural teams, particularly between China and Egypt / MENA.
 English and/or Arabic communication skills.
 Experience in the education, internet, technology, localization, or customer service industries.
 Who Will Succeed in This Role? 
 You do not need to come from a traditional product operations background.
 What matters most is that you are curious, structured, and willing to get close to the business. You can listen carefully, understand complicated situations, identify what really matters, and communicate the problem in a way that enables others to take action.
 You will play an important role in helping our Egypt and China teams understand each other better, solve problems faster, and continuously improve the way we work together.

 Systems That Scale — Turning feedback and recurring friction into durable process

title: Product Operations Lead
description:
About The Company
 Valon is the leading AI platform for mortgage servicing, building the AI-native operating system for regulated finance.
Before providing the system of record that powers the entire industry, we built and ran our own mortgage servicer on it. That gave us a real regulated environment to prove our technology could replace the mainframe systems servicers have used for decades. Carrington acquired that servicer and adopted ValonOS as its core platform, allowing us to focus entirely on scaling our SaaS platform.
ValonOS is now on track to power 1 in 6 U.S. mortgages across major mortgage servicers like Newrez, Carrington, and ServiceMac. Every process on the platform is structured and programmable, enabling our AI agents to perform core servicing work, like handling payments, escrow, and homeowner questions, directly within the system's controls.
We recently raised a $150 million Series D at a $2.3 billion valuation by new investor Ribbit Capital, with continued support from existing backer a16z, amongst others.
 About The Role
 Valon is rolling out its AI-powered platform to enterprise clients operating in a highly regulated, operationally complex industry. We are building a dedicated Product Operations function that ensures customers have a seamless, reliable, and intuitive experience with ValonOS during and after implementation.
As a Product Operations Lead , you will operate as a horizontal force across Product, Engineering, and Customer teams. Your role is to design and own the mechanisms, frameworks, and feedback loops that turn real-world usage into durable product insight. Rather than focusing on a single product area, you’ll work across the breadth of ValonOS, identifying cross-cutting patterns and shaping how the company operates, builds, and ships product.
This role is ideal for someone who thrives in ambiguity, thinks in systems rather than tickets, and wants to influence product direction through leverage instead of org charts. You’ll be trusted to independently identify the highest-impact problems, define structure where none exists, and drive improvements that raise the bar for product quality, reliability, and customer experience across Valon.
 Responsibilities
 Build & Own Scalable Product Operations Systems
 Design and evolve the core Product Operations frameworks that allow Valon to learn from production at scale, including user acceptance testing, data migration testing, etc.
 Identify structural gaps in how product insights are captured, prioritized, and acted on, and create durable mechanisms that work across teams and product areas.
 Operate horizontally across ValonOS, focusing on cross-cutting patterns rather than isolated customer or feature-level issues.
 Drive Product Quality, Reliability & Release Learning
 Lead investigation of complex, ambiguous, or recurring issues that span multiple teams, going beyond symptom-level fixes to systemic root causes.
 Partner with Engineering and FDA to improve issue definition, incident response, and long-term prevention.
 Own and refine how Valon validates product readiness and learns from releases through alpha testing, rollout feedback, and post-launch analysis.
 Influence Product Direction Through Insight & Leverage
 Act as a senior systems-level partner to Product and Engineering, translating real-world usage, operational complexity, and regulatory nuance into clear product implications.
 Synthesize signals across customers, data, and incidents to surface risks and opportunities that inform roadmap and prioritization decisions.
 Operate as a force multiplier by creating artifacts, documentation, and processes that raise the bar for product quality and decision-making across the organization.
 Ideal Background
 5-7+ years in product operations, product-adjacent roles, business operations, consulting, customer success, or a similar analytical environment.
 Strong analytical skills with the ability to break down ambiguous problems and uncover root causes.
 Technical curiosity—you’re eager to learn SQL or work with data to understand product behavior.
 Clear communicator who can translate between technical teams and end users with ease.
 High sense of ownership, reliability, and urgency in driving issues to full resolution.
 Comfort partnering closely with product managers and engineers, and contributing to product thinking.

title: Senior Product Operations Manager
description:
Why Harvey
 At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.
 Role Overview
 As a Senior Product Operations Manager at Harvey, you will be the connective tissue between Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market teams — turning strategy into execution across our entire product lifecycle. You'll build and scale the operating systems that help our product teams make better decisions, ship with confidence, and drive measurable impact for law firms and in-house legal teams pushing the frontier of AI adoption.
You'll work as an extension of product leadership, balancing hands-on execution with strategic initiatives. This is a role for someone who builds from 0 to 1, thrives in ambiguity, and creates structure where none exists.
 What You’ll Do
 Inputs to Product Teams — Ensuring teams have the information they need to make great decisions
 Build and maintain Voice of Customer systems that synthesize feedback from law firm partners, in-house clients, CSMs, and sales into actionable product signals
 Establish rigorous mechanisms for measuring product success and user impact, including analytics dashboards, KPIs, and clear hypotheses
 Create high-leverage engagement points with customers and partners throughout the product lifecycle — from alpha through post-GA
 Streamline key decision points across teams, reducing friction and improving prioritization quality
 Ops of the Product Org — Creating the operating systems that enable product teams to thrive
 Own and improve core product development processes, tooling, and team rituals (planning cycles, monthly reviews, roadmap prioritization, etc.)
 Build reliable run-of-business systems that scale as Harvey grows — launch calendars, intake frameworks, RACI structures
 Drive cross-functional alignment between Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success
 Facilitate roadmap planning by coordinating stakeholder inputs and maintaining transparency across the org
 Outputs from Product Teams — Amplifying product impact by connecting what we build to those who need it
 Design and run Early Access Programs and alpha testing programs that validate product-market fit and surface refinement signals before broad release
 Own launch coordination end-to-end — ensuring timely, high-confidence rollouts with clear success metrics and post-launch monitoring
 Maintain cross-team roadmap visibility that keeps GTM, Legal, and leadership aligned on what's shipping and why
 Make it clear across Harvey what Product is building, how it's progressing, and what's coming next.
 What You Have
 5+ years in Product Operations, Product Management, or a closely related operational role at a high growth tech or SaaS company
 You've built processes and programs from scratch and scaled them thoughtfully — not just inherited and maintained them
 Experience working with AI-native products, ideally in a domain where model quality and output reliability are central to the user experience
 Strong ability to translate complex qualitative and quantitative data — usage metrics, feedback themes, retention signals — into clear recommendations and roadmap inputs
 Proven ability to drive alignment across Product, GTM, and Engineering without direct authority
 Hands-on experience with launch coordination, EAPs, or customer feedback loops in a fast-moving product environment
 You're a natural bridge builder: fluent in strategy, comfortable in the weeds, and skilled at creating clarity where none exists. Ambiguity doesn't slow you down — it's where you do your best work.
 Compensation Range
 $155,400 - $233,200 USD

title: Product Operations Manager, Embedded
description:
About Anthropic
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
 About The Role
 We're hiring several Product Operations Managers to embed within our core product teams. Each will contribute to a key component of our stack. Whether you are ensuring models work within each of our harnesses, prioritizing a great experience across cloud offerings, or building the application layer that keeps users on the frontier, the Product Operations team is an integral part of delivering great products to the world.
Product Operations is the connective tissue between Research, Product, and the market. We shorten the distance between what our models can do and what people get to use. Each of us sits inside one product team as an extension of its leadership, and together we run one shared operating system for how Anthropic ships and learns.
On a given day you might get a launch through its final review, run an early access window, or triaging customer feedback. The rest of the week you build the systems so the team ships and learns faster next time. Our team is small and gets unusual leverage from Claude enabling us to fill gaps across the company and deliver outsized value.
 Responsibilities
 Ship with confidence
 Own launch readiness for your team. Keep our launch calendar the source of truth for what is shipping and when.
 Get every major launch through go/no-go: pre-read written, Security, Safeguards, Legal, and Commercial sign-offs recorded, and any accepted risk written down on purpose.
 Run early access and beta programs that return signal Product and Research can act on. Define the question before the window opens, give testers the scaffolding to answer it, and close each one with a retro on whether the feedback landed.
 Program manage new model launches on your surface: readiness goals set in advance, testing and eval coverage tracked, issues triaged, prompting changes landed, retro run. You won't write the evals. You run the program around them.
 Close the loop with users
 Turn a lot of noise into two clear signals: what users are asking for, ranked by impact and mapped to the roadmap, and which customers or cohorts are blocked, on what, and why it matters.
 Plug your team into Anthropic's shared feedback systems rather than building a private one, and improve the shared systems where they fall short.
 Make sure the field, Support, and Research hear back about what happened with what they sent.
 Run the team's operating system
 Set the team's pace: planning, business and execution reviews, goal tracking, offsites.
 Own how your team works with Legal, Safeguards, Security, GTM, and other product teams so partnering with your team is predictable.
 Push reporting overhead toward zero. Reviews and digests should be generated from data that already exists.
 Fill the gaps. Every embedded seat carries one or two projects unique to its team, for example managing Monthly Business Reviews and helping track progress between cycles.
 Build with Claude
 Build the tools you need yourself: Claude-powered triage, dashboards that read and write to our systems of record, skills and agents that take the chasing out of the job.
 Contribute what you build back to the ProdOps team as reusable patterns (launch checklists, EAP setup, lookbacks, deprecations) so nobody starts from scratch.
 You May Be a Good Fit If You Have
 Have owned an operational program end to end (launches, early access, feedback, or planning) that a product team relied on to make decisions. You designed it and ran it, not just executed someone else's plan.
 Have built a process from zero to one and then simplified it as it scaled. You treat process as a product: it has users, metrics, and a happy path people want to follow.
 Have worked embedded with product leadership and can move a team without formal authority.
 Build with AI yourself. You have shipped Claude or other LLM-powered workflows, written the prompts, iterated on the outputs, and can describe model behavior with specifics.
 Have direct experience managing evals, refining system prompts, and adapting harnesses to new models. 
 Have direct experience working with Cloud providers in partnership or GTM capacity
 Have commitment to safe deployment of AI. Bonus if experience with AI Safety and Safeguards.
 Bonus
 Program managed model launches or model quality at an application-layer AI product.
 Run early access, beta, or design partner programs.
 Product management, technical program management, chief of staff, or strategy and operations experience at a startup or fast-growing product company.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

title: MVNO Technical Product Operations
description:
Who Are We? 
 Voye is a global connectivity provider dedicated to delivering seamless, reliable mobile connectivity for travelers worldwide. We build next-generation consumer and B2B products that keep users connected globally without the friction of traditional roaming. 
 Your Mission 
 As our MVNO Technical Product Operations lead, your mission is to oversee the end-to-end technical execution, quality assurance, and operational workflows of our MVNO platform. You will bridge product management, project delivery, engineering development, telecom partner coordination, and complex business logic to ensure flawless product delivery and network performance. 
 Your work will include 
 ●     Driving technical product operations and project management across product lifecycle phases from requirement definition through rollout. 
 ●     Leading end-to-end QA and testing strategies across billing systems, SIM/eSIM provisioning, mobile connectivity (data, voice, SMS), number porting, and customer journey touchpoints. 
 ●     Coordinating directly with dev teams and engineering leads to prioritize backlogs, clarify business logic, report bugs, and validate product behavior against specs. 
 ●     Managing operational integrations and relationships with host network operators (MNOs), telecom vendors, and third-party platforms. 
 ●     Defining and optimizing business logic for commercial plan configurations, pricing structures, data limits, lifecycle rules, and regulatory requirements. 
 ●     Monitoring daily product health, activation performance, top-up success rates, and escalation pathways across customer operations and engineering. 
 Requirements 
 ●     Proven experience in technical product operations, QA engineering, or technical project management within a telecom, MVNO, or mobile tech environment. 
 ●     Deep operational understanding of SIM/eSIM technologies, mobile connectivity protocols, billing engines, and number porting processes. 
 ●     Strong track record of working closely with software development teams to translate business and product needs into clear technical requirements and test cases. 
 ●     Hands-on experience managing telecom partner relationships, vendor integrations, and technical problem resolution. 
 ●     Exceptional analytical, troubleshooting, and documentation skills with high attention to detail. 
 ●     Fluency in Hebrew and English.
